entry.title: Efficient Ensemble Selection from Binary and Pairwise Feedback

author.name: Tzeh Yuan Neoh, Nicholas Teh, Je Qin Chooi, Paul W. Goldberg, Milind Tambe

entry.summary: Studies ensemble selection of AI systems as a distributional variant of multiwinner voting, analyzing binary and pairwise feedback settings. Provides query complexity bounds for both coverage and Condorcet committee objectives.

entry.title: SmartEval: A Benchmark for Evaluating LLM-Generated Smart Contracts from Natural Language Specifications

author.name: Abhinav Goel, Agostino Capponi, Alfio Gliozzo, Chaitya Shah

entry.summary: SmartEval benchmarks LLM-generated Solidity smart contracts with 9,000 contracts, a five-dimensional evaluation rubric, and reproducible pipeline. Validates with ablation study, human agreement analysis, and model comparison.

entry.title: WISTERIA: Learning Clinical Representations from Noisy Supervision via Multi-View Consistency in Electronic Health Records

author.name: Ruan Dong, Yuanyun Zhang, Shi Li

entry.summary: Proposes WISTERIA, a weakly supervised representation learning framework for EHR data that models clinical labels as stochastic observations of latent clinical states, using multi-view consistency across weak supervision operators.

entry.title: Probing Routing-Conditional Calibration in Attention-Residual Transformers

author.name: Wenhao Liang, Lin Yue, Wei Emma Zhang, Miao Xu, Mingyu Guo, Olaf Maennel, Weitong Chen

entry.summary: Investigates whether routing traces from Attention-Residual transformers provide stable routing-specific evidence for post-hoc calibration beyond confidence scores. Finds routing-conditional gaps are modest and inconsistent.

entry.title: UFO: A Unified Flow-Oriented Framework for Robust Continual Graph Learning

author.name: Danhui Zhang, Zhe Wang, Qing Qing, Jiarui Liu, Wentao Gao, Ziqi Xu, Mingliang Hou, Xikun Zhang, Renqiang Luo

entry.summary: Introduces UFO for robust continual graph learning that handles both catastrophic forgetting and noisy supervision, identifying a new failure mode called 'catastrophic remembering' where models reinforce corrupted knowledge.

entry.title: Nautilus Compass: Black-box Persona Drift Detection for Production LLM Agents

author.name: Chunxiao Wang

entry.summary: Presents Nautilus Compass, a black-box persona drift detector for production LLM coding agents that operates at the prompt-text layer using embedding similarity, working with closed APIs like Claude and GPT-4.

entry.title: Team-Based Self-Play With Dual Adaptive Weighting for Fine-Tuning LLMs

author.name: Wu Li, Yigeng Zhou, Zesheng Shi, Yequan Wang, Min Zhang, Jing Li

entry.summary: Proposes TPAW, a team-based self-play algorithm for LLM alignment where the current policy collaborates and competes with historical checkpoints, using dual adaptive weighting for response quality and iteration gap.

entry.title: Personalizing LLMs with Binary Feedback: A Preference-Corrected Optimization Framework

author.name: Xilai Ma, Liye Zhao, Weijun Yao, Haibing Di, Wenya Wang, Jing Li

entry.summary: Proposes C-BPO for personalizing LLMs using preference-calibrated binary signals, treating other users' data as implicit negative signals with a Positive-Unlabeled learning correction to handle preference overlap.

entry.title: Rethinking Loss Reweighting for Imbalance Learning as an Inverse Problem: A Neural Collapse Point of View

author.name: Jinping Wang, Zixin Tong, Zhiwu Xie, Zhiqiang Gao

entry.summary: Reframes loss reweighting for long-tailed classification through Neural Collapse theory, treating reweighting as an inverse problem to achieve equal per-class loss matching the ideal ETF geometry.

entry.title: Not-So-Strange Love: Language Models and Generative Linguistic Theories are More Compatible than They Appear

author.name: R. Thomas McCoy

entry.summary: Argues that LLMs can instantiate formal structure-based linguistic theories (generative tradition), not just gradient usage-based ones, potentially enabling reconciliation between the two linguistic traditions.

entry.title: PoDAR: Power-Disentangled Audio Representation for Generative Modeling

author.name: Alejandro Luebs, Mithilesh Vaidya, Ishaan Kumar, Sumukh Badam, Stephen W. Bailey, Matthew Bendel, Jose Sotelo, Xingzhe He

entry.summary: Presents PoDAR, a framework for audio latent diffusion that disentangles signal power from semantic content through randomized power augmentation, improving latent modelability and downstream generation quality.

entry.title: HYPERPOSE: Hyperbolic Kinematic Phase-Space Attention for 3D Human Pose Estimation

author.name: Vinduja T., Ashish M., Ajay Waghumbare, Upasna Singh

entry.summary: Introduces HYPERPOSE, a 3D human pose estimation framework operating in hyperbolic space to better preserve the hierarchical tree topology of the human skeleton. Claims geometric advantages over Euclidean-space methods like transformers and GCNs.

entry.title: When Normality Shifts: Risk-Aware Test-Time Adaptation for Unsupervised Tabular Anomaly Detection

author.name: Wei Huang, Hezhe Qiao, Kailai Zhang, Zaisheng Ye, Yu-Ming Shang, Xiangling Fu

entry.summary: Proposes a risk-aware test-time adaptation framework for unsupervised tabular anomaly detection that handles distribution shifts between training and test data while avoiding contamination from anomalous test samples.

entry.title: Every finite group admits a just finite presentation

author.name: Marc Lackenby

entry.summary: Resolves an open problem from the Kourovka Notebook (Problem 21.10), proving that every finite group admits a 'just finite' presentation where removing any relation yields an infinite group.

entry.title: Simultaneous Long-tailed Recognition and Multi-modal Fusion for Highly Imbalanced Multi-modal Data

author.name: Heegeon Yoon, Heeyoung Kim

entry.summary: Introduces a framework for long-tailed recognition with multi-modal inputs, using modality-specific confidence estimation to dynamically weight contributions from different data sources.

entry.title: ThreatCore: A Benchmark for Explicit and Implicit Threat Detection

author.name: Davide Bruni, Carlo Bardazzi, Maurizio Tesconi

entry.summary: Introduces ThreatCore, a benchmark for fine-grained threat detection distinguishing explicit threats, implicit threats, and non-threats, with systematic re-annotation revealing inconsistencies in existing datasets.

entry.title: AllocMV: Optimal Resource Allocation for Music Video Generation via Structured Persistent State

author.name: Huimin Wang, Leilei Ouyang, Chang Xia, Yongqi Kang, Yu Fu, Yuqi Ouyang

entry.summary: Proposes AllocMV, a hierarchical framework that formulates music video synthesis as a Multiple-Choice Knapsack Problem to optimally allocate computational resources across video segments while maintaining cross-shot consistency.

entry.title: Dynamic Cross-Modal Prompt Generation for Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning

author.name: Tao Hu, Da-Wei Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes dynamic cross-modal prompt generation for multimodal continual instruction tuning, enabling instance-level adaptation to individual query-image pairs rather than task-level routing of existing prompts/experts.

entry.title: Switching-Geometry Analysis of Deflated Q-Value Iteration

author.name: Donghwan Lee

entry.summary: Develops a joint spectral radius framework for analyzing rank-one deflated Q-value iteration in discounted MDPs, providing the first JSR-based convergence analysis for deflated Q-VI in policy optimization.

entry.title: MMVIAD: Multi-view Multi-task Video Understanding for Industrial Anomaly Detection

author.name: Xiran Zhao, Jing Jin, Yan Bai, Zhongan Wang, Yifeng Sun, Yihang Lou, Xuanyu Zhu, Tao Feng, Yingna Wu

entry.summary: Introduces MMVIAD, the first continuous multi-view video dataset for industrial anomaly detection, covering 48 object categories with 6 anomaly types and supporting multiple evaluation tasks.

entry.title: Distributional Reinforcement Learning via the Cram\'er Distance

author.name: Vanya Aziz, Ivo Nowak, E. M. T Hendrix

entry.summary: Introduces C-DSAC, a distributional RL algorithm that combines SAC with distributional value representations and Cramér distance minimization, showing advantages in high-complexity robotic environments.

entry.title: Additive Atomic Forests for Symbolic Function and Antiderivative Discovery

author.name: Reda Belaiche

entry.summary: Presents a framework for simultaneous symbolic recovery of functions and antiderivatives using a derivative algebra approach with complementary EML and SOL primitives that generate self-expanding function-derivative pair libraries.

entry.title: DataArc-SynData-Toolkit: A Unified Closed-Loop Framework for Multi-Path, Multimodal, and Multilingual Data Synthesis

author.name: Zhichao Shi, Cehao Yang, Hao Zhou, Xiaojun Wu, Huajie Li, Xuhui Jiang, Chengjin Xu, Yuanzhuo Wang, Jian Guo

entry.summary: Presents DataArc-SynData-Toolkit, an open-source framework for multi-path, multimodal, and multilingual synthetic data generation with configuration-driven pipelines and quality control.

entry.title: Private Vertical Federated Inference for Time-Series

author.name: Lucas Fenaux, Larris Xie, Aditya Bang, Alex Zhang, Kevin Wilson, Florian Kerschbaum

entry.summary: Proposes PPHH-VFL, a hybrid architecture for private vertical federated inference on time-series that splits the model head into a plaintext public head and a secure lightweight MPC private head.

entry.title: Embedding Dimension Lower Bounds for Universality of Deep Sets and Janossy Pooling

author.name: Ali Syed, Aditya Nambiar, Jonathan W. Siegel

entry.summary: Proves new lower bounds on the embedding dimension required for universality in Deep Sets and Janossy pooling architectures for permutation-invariant learning on point clouds. Shows tighter bounds than previously known.

entry.title: MoMo: Conditioned Contrastive Representation Learning for Preference-Modulated Planning

author.name: Yusuf Syed, Viraj Parimi, Brian Williams

entry.summary: Introduces MoMo, a preference-conditioned contrastive planner that uses a scalar preference to continuously modulate plan conservativeness at inference time without retraining.

entry.title: The Propagation Field: A Geometric Substrate Theory of Deep Learning

author.name: Xingrui Gu

entry.summary: Defines a 'neural propagation field' viewing networks through internal trajectory geometry rather than endpoint functions. Shows endpoint-equivalent models can differ dramatically in internal structure.

entry.title: FedGMI: Generative Model-Driven Federated Learning for Probabilistic Mixture Inference

author.name: Qijun Hou, Yuchen Shi, Pingyi Fan, Khaled B. Letaief

entry.summary: Proposes FedGMI for federated learning where each client's data is a mixture of shared distributions, using generative models to decompose and align mixture components across clients.

entry.title: Accelerating Zeroth-Order Spectral Optimization with Partial Orthogonalization from Power Iteration

author.name: Jiahe Chen, Ziye Ma

entry.summary: Proposes partial orthogonalization for zeroth-order spectral optimization of LLMs, finding that unlike first-order settings, full orthogonalization hurts ZO performance. Targets edge-device LLM fine-tuning.

entry.title: A Tale of Two Problems: Multi-Task Bilevel Learning Meets Equality Constrained Multi-Objective Optimization

author.name: Zhiyao Zhang, Myeung Suk Oh, Zhen Qin, Jiaxiang Li, Xin Zhang, Jia Liu

entry.summary: Extends bilevel optimization to multi-task settings under relaxed lower-level general convexity, reformulating it as equality-constrained multi-objective optimization (ECMO). Provides first algorithms for this new ECMO problem class.

entry.title: Objective-Specific Privileged Bases via Full-Prefix Matryoshka Learning

author.name: Arghamitra Talukder, Philippe Chlenski, Itsik Pe'er

entry.summary: Studies how Matryoshka Representation Learning induces task-aligned privileged bases in representation spaces. Proves that in the linear setting, full-prefix MRL recovers ordered principal directions, and shows empirically that coordinate magnitude reflects informativeness.

entry.title: Rethinking Ratio-Based Trust Regions for Policy Optimization in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Chulabhaya Wijesundara, Andrea Baisero, Zhongheng Li, Gregory Casta\~n\'on, Alan Carlin, Christopher Amato

entry.summary: Analyzes failure modes of ratio-based trust regions (MAPPO, MASPO) in multi-agent RL, showing teammate non-stationarity causes variance-driven failures. Proposes fixes including multiplicative clipping.

entry.title: Function-Space ADMM for Decentralized Federated Learning: A Control Theoretic Perspective

author.name: Akihito Taya, Yuuki Nishiyama, Kaoru Sezaki

entry.summary: Proposes function-space ADMM for decentralized federated learning, operating on model predictions rather than parameters to handle non-IID data and non-convex training. Uses control-theoretic perspective.

entry.title: Inverse Design for Conditional Distribution Matching

author.name: Ori Meidler, Shaul Tolkovsky, Or Zuk

entry.summary: Introduces Conditional Distribution Matching (CDM), a new inverse-design problem finding inputs whose induced conditional distribution matches a target distribution, going beyond pointwise inverse design.

entry.title: HS-FNO: History-Space Fourier Neural Operator for Non-Markovian Partial Differential Equations

author.name: Lennon J. Shikhman

entry.summary: Introduces HS-FNO, a Fourier Neural Operator for non-Markovian PDEs that operates on lifted history-state representations. Handles delay equations and distributed-memory systems where instantaneous state is insufficient.

entry.title: Plan2Cleanse: Test-Time Backdoor Defense via Monte-Carlo Planning in Deep Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Sze-Ann Chen, Zhi-Yi Chin, Kui-Yuan Chen, Chi-Yu Li, Ping-Chun Hsieh

entry.summary: Proposes Plan2Cleanse, a test-time backdoor defense for RL using Monte Carlo Tree Search to detect and neutralize backdoor attacks without model retraining. Recasts backdoor detection as a planning problem.

entry.title: RubricRefine: Improving Tool-Use Agent Reliability with Training-Free Pre-Execution Refinement

author.name: Will LeVine, Brendan Evers, Sam Saltwick, Abhay Venkatesh

entry.summary: Introduces RubricRefine, a training-free pre-execution reliability layer for tool-use agents that generates task-specific rubrics and scores candidate code against contract checks before execution. Targets inter-tool contract violations that run without errors.

entry.title: Hyperparameter Transfer for Dense Associative Memories

author.name: Roi Holtzman, Dmitry Krotov, Boris Hanin

entry.summary: Develops hyperparameter transfer methods for Dense Associative Memories, addressing challenges from weight sharing and rapidly peaking activation functions that differ from standard feedforward networks.

entry.title: FORGE: Fragment-Oriented Ranking and Generation for Context-Aware Molecular Optimization

author.name: Qingchuan Zhang, He Cao, Hao Li, Yanjun Shao, Zhiyuan Liu, Shihang Wang, Shufang Xie, Shenghua Gao, Xinwu Ye

entry.summary: Presents FORGE, a two-stage framework for molecular optimization that uses context-aware fragment ranking and editing rather than natural language prompt-conditioned generation, avoiding chemical hallucinations.

entry.title: BROS: Bias-Corrected Randomized Subspaces for Memory-Efficient Single-Loop Bilevel Optimization

author.name: Hengrui Zhang, Boao Kong, Engao Zhang, Kun Yuan

entry.summary: Proposes BROS, a memory-efficient single-loop bilevel optimization method using randomized subspace updates with Rademacher bi-probe correction, matching convergence rates of exact methods while reducing memory.

entry.title: DeepL\'evy: Learning Heavy-Tailed Uncertainty in Highly Volatile Time Series

author.name: Yang Yang, Du Yin, Hao Xue, Flora Salim

entry.summary: Introduces DeepLévy, a neural framework learning mixtures of Lévy stable distributions for heavy-tailed time series by minimizing characteristic function discrepancy, handling extreme events that Gaussian models miss.

entry.title: Online Sharp-Calibrated Bayesian Optimization

author.name: Marshal Arijona Sinaga, Julien Martinelli, Teemu Turpeinen, Samuel Kaski

entry.summary: Introduces OSCBO, a Bayesian optimization algorithm that adaptively balances GP sharpness and calibration by treating hyperparameter selection as constrained online learning. Addresses the practical problem that GP kernel hyperparameters are refit online from non-i.i.d. data, which can yield miscalibrated uncertainty.

entry.title: The finite expression method for turbulent dynamics with high-order moment recovery

author.name: Xingjian Xu, Di Qi, Chunmei Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a two-stage framework combining symbolic regression (FEX) with generative models for data-driven modeling of turbulent dynamics, recovering closed-form governing equations and predicting higher-order statistical quantities including non-Gaussian features.

entry.title: Likelihood scoring for continuations of mathematical text: a self-supervised benchmark with tests for shortcut vulnerabilities

author.name: Daniel Ranard

entry.summary: Introduces an automatically generated benchmark for predicting hidden text in technical papers, using equation-suffix prediction from arXiv papers. Tests whether model forecasts transmit information about continuations, combining surface-level text modeling with reasoning.

entry.title: Omni-DeepSearch: A Benchmark for Audio-Driven Omni-Modal Deep Search

author.name: Tao Yu, yiming ding, Shenghua Chai, Minghui Zhang, Zhongtian Luo, Xinming Wang, Xinlong Chen, Zhaolu Kang, Junhao Gong, Yuxuan Zhou, Haopeng Jin, Zhiqing Cui, Jiabing Yang, YiFan Zhang, Hongzhu Yi, Zheqi He, Xi Yang, Yan Huang, Liang Wang

entry.summary: Introduces Omni-DeepSearch benchmark for audio-driven cross-modal deep search, where models must start from audio clips and actively search for text, image, and video evidence to perform multi-hop reasoning.

entry.title: Measuring and Decomposing Mode Separation via the Canonical Diffusion

author.name: Shaul Tolkovsky, Ori Meidler, Or Zuk

entry.summary: Proposes measuring mode separation in distributions through a canonical reversible diffusion process, extracting two readouts (SSA and ESA) that separately quantify overall fragmentation and per-direction barrier separation.

entry.title: Tight Generalization Bounds for Noiseless Inverse Optimization

author.name: Pouria Fatemi, Hoomaan Maskan, Suvrit Sra, Peyman Mohajerin Esfahani

entry.summary: Establishes tight O(d/T) generalization bounds for noiseless inverse optimization, matching the fundamental limits over consistent estimators and connecting to best-arm identification in bandits.

entry.title: Accelerating Power Method with Fast Sketching for Stronger Low-Rank Approximation

author.name: Shabarish Chenakkod, Micha{\l} Derezi\'nski

entry.summary: Develops a framework for accelerating the power method using fast sketching for low-rank approximation, achieving strong numerical performance for SVD, low-rank factorization, and Nyström approximation.

entry.title: Unified Approach for Weakly Supervised Multicalibration

author.name: Futoshi Futami, Takashi Ishida

entry.summary: Develops estimators and post-hoc correction methods for multicalibration under weak supervision settings where clean labels are unavailable, providing a unified framework across PU, UU, and positive-confidence learning.

entry.title: Lakestream: A Consistent and Brokerless Data Plane for Large Foundation Model Training

author.name: Ting Sun, Junjie Zhang, Xiao Yan, Songxin Zhang, Zhuoyang Song, Jingyi Xi, Zunyao Mao, Bingyi Jing, Jiaxing Zhang, Zejian Xie

entry.summary: Presents Lakestream, a brokerless data plane for large foundation model training that introduces Transactional Global Batch (TGB) semantics built on lakehouse-style ACID storage. Addresses the gap between static dataloaders and the dynamic needs of distributed training.

entry.title: Exact Fixed-Point Constraints in Neural-ODEs with Provable Universality

author.name: Feliciano Giuseppe Pacifico, Duccio Fanelli, Lorenzo Buffoni, Lorenzo Chicchi, Diego Febbe, Raffaele Marino

entry.summary: Introduces a technique for Neural-ODEs to accommodate exactly planted fixed-points while preserving universality. Proves the Neural-ODE remains universal under local velocity field constraints.

entry.title: Predicting 3D structure by latent posterior sampling

author.name: Azmi Haider, Dan Rosenbaum

entry.summary: Proposes combining NeRF-based 3D representations with diffusion model priors for probabilistic 3D reconstruction from 2D observations. Treats 3D structure as a stochastic latent variable with learned priors for posterior inference.

entry.title: IntentGrasp: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Intent Understanding

author.name: Yuwei Yin, Chuyuan Li, Giuseppe Carenini

entry.summary: Introduces IntentGrasp, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating LLM intent understanding from 49 corpora across 12 domains, with 262K training instances and evaluation of 20 LLMs across 7 families.

entry.title: CLIPer: Tailoring Diverse User Preference via Classifier-Guided Inference-Time Personalization

author.name: Jinyan Su, Jinpeng Zhou, Claire Cardie, Wen Sun

entry.summary: Introduces CLIPer, a lightweight inference-time personalization approach using classifier models to steer LLM generation toward user preferences without fine-tuning. Enables controllable personalization across single and multi-attribute preferences.

entry.title: Intent-Driven Semantic ID Generation for Grounded Conversational News Recommendation

author.name: Hongyang Su, Beibei Kong, Lei Cheng, Chengxiang Zhuo, Zang Li, Chenyun Yu

entry.summary: Introduces intent-driven Semantic ID generation for conversational news recommendation under a Generate-then-Match paradigm, using GPT-4 CoT distillation to map diverse user intents to hierarchical IDs that are fuzzy-matched to current articles.

entry.title: MAVEN: Multi-Agent Verification-Elaboration Network with In-Step Epistemic Auditing

author.name: Yinsheng Yao, Jiehao Tang, Zhaozhen Yang, Dawei Cheng

entry.summary: Proposes MAVEN, a multi-agent framework with adversarial Skeptic-Researcher-Judge loop for reasoning, using blackboard architecture to separate logical defense from factual grounding with in-step epistemic auditing.

entry.title: CA-SQL: Complexity-Aware Inference Time Reasoning for Text-to-SQL via Exploration and Compute Budget Allocation

author.name: James Petullo, Nianwen Xue

entry.summary: Introduces CA-SQL, a Text-to-SQL pipeline that dynamically scales exploration breadth based on estimated task difficulty, using evolutionary search-inspired prompt seeding for complex queries.

entry.title: From Storage to Experience: A Survey on the Evolution of LLM Agent Memory Mechanisms

author.name: Jinghao Luo, Yuchen Tian, Chuxue Cao, Ziyang Luo, Hongzhan Lin, Kaixin Li, Chuyi Kong, Ruichao Yang, Jing Ma

entry.summary: Survey paper proposing an evolutionary framework for LLM agent memory mechanisms across three stages: Storage (trajectory preservation), Reflection (trajectory refinement), and Experience (trajectory abstraction).

entry.title: Bridging Textual Profiles and Latent User Embeddings for Personalization

author.name: Zhaoxuan Tan, Xiang Zhai, Yan Zhu, Meng Jiang, Mohamed Hammad

entry.summary: Presents BLUE, an RL framework that aligns language-based user profiles with embedding-based recommendation objectives. Bridges interpretable textual profiles with supervised latent embeddings by having an LLM generate profiles optimized for recommendation performance.

entry.title: Harmonized Feature Conditioning and Frequency-Prompt Personalization for Multi-Rater Medical Segmentation

author.name: Sanaz Karimijafarbigloo, Armin Khosravi, Alireza Kheyrkhah, Reza Azad, Mauricio Reyes, Dorit Merhof

entry.summary: Proposes a probabilistic framework for multi-rater medical segmentation that disentangles scanner artifacts from annotator variability through adaptive feature conditioning and frequency-domain personalization.

entry.title: Distill, Diffuse, and Semanticize (DDS): Annotation-Free 3D Scene Understanding Based on Multi-Granularity Distillation and Graph-Diffusion-Based Segmentation

author.name: Yijing Wang, Ruonan Li, Qilin Wang, Rongqiang Zhao, Jie Liu

entry.summary: Proposes an annotation-free 3D scene understanding method using multi-granularity distillation and graph-diffusion-based segmentation, leveraging visual knowledge guidance and superpoint graph diffusion.

entry.title: DRNet: All-in-One Image Restoration via Prior-Guided Dynamic Reparameterization

author.name: Ao Li, Xiaoning Liu, Sheng Li, Yapeng Du, Zhen Long, Lei Luo, Le Zhang, Ce Zhu

entry.summary: Introduces DRNet for all-in-one image restoration using prior-guided dynamic reparameterization that reconfigures at initialization to avoid per-input overhead, with a Task-Specific Modulator addressing task heterogeneity.

entry.title: Kinematics-Driven Gaussian Shape Deformation for Blurry Monocular Dynamic Scenes

author.name: Yeon-Ji Song, Kiyoung Kwon, Junoh Lee, Jin-Hwa Kim, Byoung-Tak Zhang

entry.summary: Presents Kinematics-GS for reconstructing dynamic 3D scenes from blurry monocular videos, modeling blur as motion-aligned deformation with kinematic priors to prevent Gaussian shape collapse.

entry.title: CoLVR: Enhancing Exploratory Latent Visual Reasoning via Contrastive Optimization

author.name: Ziyang Ding, Linjian Meng, Yiming Wu, Yuhan Li, Yuhao Liu, Zhen Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes CoLVR for enhancing latent visual reasoning in MLLMs through contrastive optimization, avoiding hard alignment to predefined features to preserve exploratory reasoning capability.

entry.title: Restoration-Aligned Generative Flow Models for Blind Motion Deblurring

author.name: Insoo Kim, Jinwoo Shin

entry.summary: DeblurFlow reformulates flow model trajectories for motion deblurring by replacing the noise endpoint with blur observations, making the vector field align with restoration objectives. Uses LoRA adaptation of pretrained flow models under restoration-aligned objectives.

entry.title: Offline Preference Optimization for Rectified Flow with Noise-Tracked Pairs

author.name: Yunhong Lu, Qichao Wang, Hengyuan Cao, Xiaoyin Xu, Min Zhang

entry.summary: PNAPO proposes off-policy alignment for rectified flow models by retaining paired prior noises used during generation, addressing the mismatch between forward noising and actual reverse dynamics in DPO-style training.

entry.title: GSMap: 2D Gaussians for Online HD Mapping

author.name: Zhenxuan Zeng, Sheng Yang, Lingxuan Wang, Yanan He, Mingxia Chen, Wei Suo, Peng Wang

entry.summary: GSMap unifies vectorization and rasterization paradigms for HD map construction using learnable 2D Gaussian representations, enabling simultaneous pixel-level geometric constraints and topological consistency.

entry.title: DriveFuture: Future-Aware Latent World Models for Autonomous Driving

author.name: Yufeng Hong, Xiaotian Zhou, Yingyan Li, Xiangpo Zhou, Lin Liu, Yadan Luo, Shaoqing Xu, Lei Yang, Ziying Song

entry.summary: DriveFuture proposes future-aware latent world modeling for autonomous driving that explicitly conditions trajectory planning on predicted future world states rather than treating them as auxiliary signals.

entry.title: MUSDA: Multi-source Multi-modality Unsupervised Domain Adaptive 3D Object Detection for Autonomous Driving

author.name: Xiaohu Lu, Hamed Khatounabadi, Hayder Radha

entry.summary: MUSDA proposes a framework for multi-source, multi-modality unsupervised domain adaptation in 3D object detection for autonomous driving, introducing hierarchical spatially-conditioned domain classifiers.

entry.title: VPD-100K: Towards Generalizable and Fine-grained Visual Privacy Protection

author.name: Xiaobin Hu, Enpu Zuo, Lanping Hu, Kaiwen Yang, Dianshu Liao, Tianyi Zhang, Bo Yin, Yinsi Zhou, Shidong Pan, Xiaoyu Sun

entry.summary: VPD-100K presents a large-scale fine-grained visual privacy dataset with 100K images covering four privacy domains, designed to facilitate generalized privacy detection in diverse real-world environments.

entry.title: CellDX AI Autopilot: Agent-Guided Training and Deployment of Pathology Classifiers

author.name: Alexey Pchelnikov, Aleksei Pchelnikov

entry.summary: CellDX AI Autopilot enables pathologists to train, evaluate, and deploy whole-slide image classifiers through natural language interaction with an AI agent, without ML expertise.

entry.title: Temporal Sampling Frequency Matters: A Capacity-Aware Study of End-to-End Driving Trajectory Prediction

author.name: Yumao Liu, Tao Liu, Xiangyu Li, Jiaxiang Li, Ke Ma

entry.summary: This paper challenges the assumption that higher temporal sampling frequency always improves end-to-end driving trajectory prediction, providing capacity-aware analysis of the frequency-performance relationship.

entry.title: Improving Human Image Animation via Semantic Representation Alignment

author.name: Chang Liu, Mengting Chen, Yixuan Huang, Haoning Wu, Chen Ju, Shuai Xiao, Jinsong Lan, Yanfeng Wang

entry.summary: SemanticREPA uses semantic representations (dense poses, ID embeddings) as supervision rather than additional conditions for human image animation, improving limb/face quality without sacrificing flexibility.

entry.title: DeepSight: Long-Horizon World Modeling via Latent States Prediction for End-to-End Autonomous Driving

author.name: Lingjun Zhang, Changjie Wu, Linzhe Shi, Jiangyang Li, Jiaxin Liu, Lei Yang, Hang Zhang, Mu Xu, Hong Wang

entry.summary: DeepSight proposes a driving world model performing parallel latent semantic feature prediction in BEV space for long-horizon future state modeling in end-to-end autonomous driving.

entry.title: Product-of-Gaussian-Mixture Diffusion Models for Joint Nonlinear MRI Reconstruction

author.name: Laurenz Nagler, Martin Zach, Thomas Pock

entry.summary: This paper proposes product-of-Gaussian-mixture diffusion models for joint MRI reconstruction of image and coil sensitivities, achieving fast and robust reconstruction across contrast and anatomy shifts.

entry.title: C-CoT: Counterfactual Chain-of-Thought with Vision-Language Models for Safe Autonomous Driving

author.name: Kefei Tian, Yuansheng Lian, Kai Yang, Xiangdong Chen, Shen Li

entry.summary: C-CoT proposes a counterfactual chain-of-thought framework for VLMs in autonomous driving that decomposes decisions into five stages including counterfactual reasoning about what could go wrong.

entry.title: Model-based Dynamic 3D MRI Reconstructions using Neural Fields and Tensor Product Expansions

author.name: Ray Sheombarsing, Max van Riel, David Heesterbeek, Nico van den Berg, Alessandro Sbrizzi

entry.summary: Presents a discretization-free MRI reconstruction framework using tensor products of univariate neural fields for representing magnetization and coil sensitivities as continuous functions. Enables memory-efficient dynamic 3D cardiac MRI reconstruction from highly undersampled data.

entry.title: FrameTwin: Curve-Anchored Gaussian Alignment from Sparse Views for Adaptive Wireframe 3D Printing

author.name: Wenting Wang, Zhuo Huang, Kun Qian, Neelotpal Dutta, Yuhu Guo, Yingjun Tian, Yeung Yam, Charlie C. L. Wang

entry.summary: FrameTwin uses curve-anchored Gaussian alignment from sparse views to create digital twins of wireframe structures during 3D printing, enabling closed-loop adaptive manufacturing that accounts for deformation during fabrication.

entry.title: Annotation-free deep learning for detection and segmentation of fetal germinal matrix-intraventricular hemorrhage in brain MRI

author.name: Mingxuan Liu, Yingqi Hao, Yi Liao, Juncheng Zhu, Haoxiang Li, Hongjia Yang, Yifei Chen, Yijin Li, Kasidit Anmahapong, Zihan Li, Jialan Zheng, Min Kang, Yan Song, Hua Lai, Xiaoling Zhou, Nan Sun, Rong Hu, Gang Ning, Haibo Qu, Qiyuan Tian

entry.summary: Develops an annotation-free deep learning framework for detecting and segmenting fetal brain hemorrhage in MRI, avoiding the need for large annotated datasets that are challenging to obtain in this clinical domain.

entry.title: ConsistNav: Closing the Action Consistency Gap in Zero-Shot Object Navigation with Semantic Executive Control

author.name: Haosen Wang, Zhenyang Li, Yinqiang Zhang, Zongqi He, Lutao Jiang, Kai Li, Yizhou Zhao, Liaoyuan Fan, Wenjian Hou, Tingbang Liang, Yibin Wen, Defeng Gu

entry.summary: ConsistNav identifies and addresses the 'action consistency gap' in zero-shot object navigation where agents oscillate between exploration and pursuit. Introduces a semantic executive controller with persistent candidate memory for stable target pursuit.

entry.title: Anatomical Landmark-Guided Deep Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Gastric Navigation

author.name: Haoxuan Wu, Sishen Yuan, Haitao Gao, Zhen Li, Xiuli Zuo, Hongliang Ren

entry.summary: Proposes anatomical landmark-guided deep RL for autonomous gastric navigation in wireless capsule endoscopy, achieving 97% mucosal coverage within 50 seconds across patient-derived models using edge-contour-depth fusion.

entry.title: A Visuo-Tactile Data Collection System with Haptic Feedback for Coarse-to-Fine Imitation Learning

author.name: Yeseung Kim, Nayoung Oh, Jun Park, Teetat Thamronglak, Daehyung Park

entry.summary: Presents a visuo-tactile data collection system with direct-drive gripper preserving natural haptic feedback, enabling operators to demonstrate subtle force modulation for contact-rich imitation learning.

entry.title: Terminal Matters: Kinodynamic Planning with a Terminal Cost and Learned Uncertainty in Belief State-Cost Space

author.name: Zhuoyun Zhong, Seyedali Golestaneh, Constantinos Chamzas

entry.summary: Introduces terminal-cost formulation for kinodynamic planning that optimizes terminal-state quality alongside trajectory cost, proving AO-RRT preserves asymptotic optimality under this augmented objective, with extension to belief space.

entry.title: SHIELD: Scalable Optimal Control with Certification using Duality and Convexity

author.name: Hansung Kim, Siddharth H. Nair, Francesco Borrelli

entry.summary: SHIELD proposes a hierarchical algorithm using strong convexity and Lagrangian duality to safely discard constraints and variables in ℓ1-regularized convex programs, with transformer-based acceleration for dual certificate inference.

entry.title: Beyond Self-Play and Scale: A Behavior Benchmark for Generalization in Autonomous Driving

author.name: Aron Distelzweig, Faris Janjo\v{s}, Andreas Look, Anna Rothenh\"ausler, Daniel Jost, Oliver Scheel, Raghu Rajan, Daphne Cornelisse, Eugene Vinitsky, Joschka Boedecker

entry.summary: Presents BehaviorBench, a comprehensive test suite that connects large-scale RL driving policies (like PufferDrive) to established planning benchmarks (nuPlan), enabling standardized evaluation along evaluation, complexity, and behavior diversity axes.

entry.title: Plan in Sandbox, Navigate in Open Worlds: Learning Physics-Grounded Abstracted Experience for Embodied Navigation

author.name: Zhixuan Shen, Jiawei Du, Ziyu Guo, Han Luo, Lilan Peng, Joey Tianyi Zhou, Haonan Luo, Tianrui Li

entry.summary: Introduces SAGE, a framework that enables embodied navigation agents to learn within physics-grounded semantic abstractions rather than photorealistic simulations, mimicking human mental simulation for plan rehearsal. Aims to improve sim-to-real transfer.

entry.title: MAGS-SLAM: Monocular Multi-Agent Gaussian Splatting SLAM for Geometrically and Photometrically Consistent Reconstruction

author.name: Zhihao Cao, Qi Shao, Shuhao Zhai, Jing Zhang, Anh Nguyen, Baoru Huang

entry.summary: Proposes MAGS-SLAM, the first RGB-only multi-agent Gaussian Splatting SLAM framework that enables collaborative scene reconstruction without depth sensors, using compact submap summaries for inter-agent communication.

entry.title: Posterior Concentration of Bayesian Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Elliptic PDEs

author.name: Yuxuan Zhao, Yulong Lu

entry.summary: Proves posterior concentration rates for Bayesian Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) for elliptic PDEs, showing the posterior contracts around the exact solution at near-minimax rates with a rate-adaptive prior.

entry.title: Semantic Phonons: Lattice Vibrations in AI Internals

author.name: Lukas Bongartz

entry.summary: Proposes 'semantic phonons' as an analogy for understanding how language models encode meaning, drawing on crystal lattice vibration theory to describe collective excitation modes in embedding spaces where semantic features are arranged geometrically.

entry.title: Evaluating Developmental Cognition Capabilities of LLMs

author.name: Xiao Xiao, Hayoun Noh, Mar Gonzalez-Franco

entry.summary: Evaluates LLMs through the lens of developmental psychology (Kegan's constructive-developmental theory), introducing a 20-item Developmental Sentence Completion Test to assess what stage of meaning-making LLMs exhibit.

entry.title: Unpredictability dissociates from structured control in language agents

author.name: Jia Xiao

entry.summary: Tests whether stochastic sampling can substitute for structured control mechanisms in language agents. Finds that unpredictability dissociates from structured control through lesion experiments on control components.

entry.title: Marrying Generative Model of Healthcare Events with Digital Twin of Social Determinants of Health for Disease Reasoning

author.name: Ziquan Wei, Tingting Dan, Guorong Wu

entry.summary: Proposes a generative model combining healthcare events with social determinants of health (SDoH) using a conditioned latent diffusion framework for disease reasoning and prediction.

entry.title: Core-Halo Decomposition: Decentralizing Large-Scale Fixed-Point Problems

author.name: Haixiang, Yang Xu, Jiefu Zhang, Xudong Wu, Zihan Zhou, Jun He, Jiayu Chen

entry.summary: Proposes Core-Halo decomposition for decentralized fixed-point problems, where agents update their own core variables while reading from an overlapping halo of neighboring variables. Proves this eliminates structural bias caused by strict block decomposition.

entry.title: Semi-Supervised Neural Super-Resolution for Mesh-Based Simulations

author.name: Jiyeon Kim, Youngjoon Hong, Won-Yong Shin

entry.summary: SuperMeshNet is a semi-supervised super-resolution framework for mesh-based PDE simulations that reduces the need for expensive high-resolution supervision data using message passing neural networks and complementary learning.

entry.title: A Cognitively Grounded Bayesian Framework for Misinformation Susceptibility

author.name: Pranava Madhyastha

entry.summary: Presents Bounded Pragmatic Listener (BPL), a Bayesian framework for modeling misinformation susceptibility that extends Rational Speech Act theory with cognitive bounds on recursion depth, prior compression, and availability sampling.

entry.title: AdamFLIP: Adaptive Momentum Feedback Linearization Optimization for Hard Constrained PINN Training

author.name: Binghang Lu, Runyu Zhang, Changhong Mou, Na Li, Guang Lin

entry.summary: Proposes AdamFLIP, a method that reformulates PINN training as equality-constrained optimization using feedback linearization from control theory, avoiding manual loss weight tuning for physics-informed neural networks.

entry.title: Complex-Valued Phase-Coherent Transformer

author.name: Leona Hioki

entry.summary: Introduces Phase-Coherent Transformer (PCT) using complex-valued, element-independent gating with L2-normalized similarities instead of softmax, designed to preserve phase information across layers.

entry.title: Hierarchical End-to-End Taylor Bounds for Complete Neural Network Verification

author.name: Taha Entesari, Mahyar Fazlyab

entry.summary: Introduces HiTaB, a neural network verification framework that exploits higher-order (beyond second-order) information through Taylor bounds for computing tighter output reachable set overapproximations. Targets smooth, twice-differentiable networks for safety certification.

entry.title: Heteroscedastic Diffusion for Multi-Agent Trajectory Modeling

author.name: Guillem Capellera, Antonio Rubio, Luis Ferraz, Antonio Agudo

entry.summary: Introduces U2Diffine, a unified diffusion model for multi-agent trajectory completion that provides state-wise heteroscedastic uncertainty estimates and error probability estimates for each generated scene. Goes beyond forecasting to handle general trajectory completion tasks.

entry.title: V4FinBench: Benchmarking Tabular Foundation Models, LLMs, and Standard Methods on Corporate Bankruptcy Prediction

author.name: Marcin Kostrzewa, Sebastian Tomczak, Roman Furman, Anna Poberezhna, Micha{\l} Furga{\l}a, Oleksii Furman, Maciej Zi\k{e}ba

entry.summary: Introduces V4FinBench, a large-scale benchmark of over 1M company-year records from Visegrád Group economies for corporate bankruptcy prediction, with 131 features and six prediction horizons. Evaluates tabular foundation models, LLMs, and standard methods.

entry.title: A Unified Lyapunov-IQC Framework for Uniform Stability of Smooth Quadratic First-Order Accelerated Optimizers

author.name: Don Li, Dacian Daescu

entry.summary: Develops a unified Lyapunov-IQC framework for proving uniform stability of accelerated optimization algorithms (NAG, etc.) in the smooth strongly-convex regime, overcoming the difficulty of analyzing momentum-augmented state dynamics.

entry.title: Max-pooling Network Revisited: Analyzing the Role of Semantic Probability in Multiple Instance Learning for Hallucination Detection

author.name: Shota Fujikawa, Issei Sato

entry.summary: Provides theoretical analysis of Multiple Instance Learning for hallucination detection, showing that scaling internal states with semantic consistency enlarges decision margins, then proposes simpler alternatives based on this insight.

entry.title: Dependency-Aware Discrete Diffusion for Scene Graph Generation

author.name: Rajalaxmi Rajagopalan, Romit Roy Choudhury

entry.summary: Introduces dependency-aware discrete diffusion for scene graph generation from text, accounting for hierarchical structure and dependencies between objects, edges, and relations.

entry.title: PFN-TS: Thompson Sampling for Contextual Bandits via Prior-Data Fitted Networks

author.name: Yan Shuo Tan, Kenyon Ng, Ruizhe Deng, Sumetha Loganathan, Qiong Zhang, Bibhas Chakraborty

entry.summary: Proposes PFN-TS, a Thompson sampling algorithm that converts Prior-Data Fitted Networks' posterior predictives into mean-reward samples using a subsampled predictive central limit theorem. Provides a practical bridge between PFNs and contextual bandits.

entry.title: Equivariant Reinforcement Learning for Clifford Quantum Circuit Synthesis

author.name: Richie Yeung, Aleks Kissinger, Rob Cornish

entry.summary: Proposes an equivariant RL approach for Clifford quantum circuit synthesis with a novel neural architecture that is equivariant to qubit relabelings and size-agnostic, allowing transfer across different qubit counts.

entry.title: WiCER: Wiki-memory Compile, Evaluate, Refine Iterative Knowledge Compilation for LLM Wiki Systems

author.name: Juan M. Huerta

entry.summary: Proposes WiCER, an iterative compile-evaluate-refine pipeline for LLM Wiki systems that addresses the compilation gap when distilling documents into wiki artifacts. Shows KV cache inference outperforms RAG on curated knowledge but degrades at scale.

entry.title: Region4Web: Rethinking Observation Space Granularity for Web Agents

author.name: Donguk Kwon, Dongha Lee

entry.summary: Proposes Region4Web, reorganizing web page observation from element-level to functional region-level granularity for web agents, exposing the page's functional organization as the basis for state understanding.

entry.title: SmellBench: Evaluating LLM Agents on Architectural Code Smell Repair

author.name: Ion George Dinu (University of Craiova, Craiova, Romania), Marian Cristian Mih\u{a}escu (University of Craiova, Craiova, Romania), Traian Rebedea (University Politehnica of Bucharest, Bucharest, Romania)

entry.summary: Introduces SmellBench, the first benchmark evaluating LLM agents on architectural code smell repair, requiring cross-module reasoning about design intent. Proposes a scoring methodology that evaluates repair effectiveness, false positive identification, and code quality.

entry.title: ReorgGS: Equivalent Distribution Reorganization for 3D Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Luchao Wang, Kaimin Liao, Qian Ren, Hua Wang, Zhi Chen, Yaohua Tang

entry.summary: Identifies parameterization degeneration in converged 3DGS models (floaters and redundant clusters) and proposes ReorgGS to reorganize Gaussian distributions for better optimization landscape.

entry.title: SeasonScapes: Learning Large-scale Re-lightable 3D Landscapes with Seasonal Variation from Sparse Webcams

author.name: Timo Kleger, Qi Ma, Deheng Zhang, Luc Van Gool, Danda Pani Paudel

entry.summary: SeasonScapes introduces a dataset and framework for learning large-scale re-lightable 3D landscapes with seasonal variation from sparse webcams, covering 50x60km with 85,000+ images across seasons. Uses diffusion models for mesh inpainting.

entry.title: TOC-Bench: A Temporal Object Consistency Benchmark for Video Large Language Models

author.name: Junzhe Chen, Siyuan Meng, Yuxi Chen, Man Zhao, Xiaojie Guo

entry.summary: TOC-Bench benchmark evaluates temporal object consistency in video LLMs, testing whether models maintain identity, state, and temporal continuity across occlusion, reappearance, and state transitions.

entry.title: LimeCross: Context-Conditioned Layered Image Editing with Structural Consistency

author.name: Ryugo Morita, Stanislav Frolov, Brian Bernhard Moser, Ko Watanabe, Riku Takahashi, Issey Sukeda, Andreas Dengel

entry.summary: LimeCross enables training-free layered image editing that maintains consistency across RGBA layers using context-conditioned cross-attention, avoiding background-foreground leakage.

entry.title: OpenSGA: Efficient 3D Scene Graph Alignment in the Open World

author.name: Gang Chen, Sebasti\'an Barbas Laina, Stefan Leutenegger, Javier Alonso-Mora

entry.summary: OpenSGA addresses 3D scene graph alignment for robot relocalization and map fusion, introducing frame-to-scan alignment with open-set vision-language features and a new large-scale dataset.

entry.title: Hypergraph-Enhanced Training-Free and Language-Free Few-Shot Anomaly Detection

author.name: Guohuan Xie, Xin He, Dingying Fan, Siqi Li, Yun Liu

entry.summary: HyperFSAD proposes a training-free, language-free few-shot anomaly detection framework using DINOv3 with hypergraph-based inference, replacing sensitive nearest-neighbor matching with sparse hypergraph aggregation.

entry.title: ML-CLIPSim: Multi-Layer CLIP Similarity for Machine-Oriented Image Quality

author.name: Feng Ding, Haisheng Fu, Jie Liang, Qihan Xu, Siyu Zhu, Jingning Han

entry.summary: ML-CLIPSim proposes a machine-oriented image quality metric using multi-layer CLIP features, evaluating how well compressed images preserve information for downstream models rather than human perception. Constructs PCMP dataset of PSNR-matched distortion pairs labeled by model consistency.

entry.title: Mismatch-Aware Adaptive Constraint Tightening for Bicycle-Model Trajectory Optimization

author.name: Lingxue Lyu, Zihui Liu

entry.summary: Derives characteristic speed separating safe and safety-critical mismatch regimes in bicycle model trajectory optimization, with adaptive constraint tightening to account for kinematic-dynamic model mismatch.

entry.title: Unified Noise Steering for Efficient Human-Guided VLA Adaptation

author.name: Junjie Lu, Xinyao Qin, Yuhua Jiang, Kaixin Wang, Chuheng Zhang, Bin Liang, Jun Yang, Min Xu, Li Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes Unified Noise Steering for adapting diffusion-based VLA models using human corrective interventions by mapping action-space corrections to noise-space guidance, enabling efficient on-robot RL with limited real-world interactions.

entry.title: HarmoWAM: Harmonizing Generalizable and Precise Manipulation via Adaptive World Action Models

author.name: Qiuxuan Feng, Jiale Yu, Jiaming Liu, Yueru Jia, Zhuangzhe Wu, Hao Chen, Zezhong Qian, Shuo Gu, Peng Jia, Siwei Ma, Shanghang Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes HarmoWAM, which harmonizes two World Action Model paradigms (Imagine-then-Execute and Joint Modeling) to balance generalizable transit planning with precise interaction control for robot manipulation.

entry.title: MAGE: Multi-Agent Self-Evolution with Co-Evolutionary Knowledge Graphs

author.name: Ruiyi Yang, Zechen Li, Hao Xue, Imran Razzak, Flora D. Salim

entry.summary: Proposes MAGE, a multi-agent self-evolution framework that externalizes agent knowledge into a four-subgraph co-evolutionary knowledge graph. Enables frozen weak backbone models to benefit from accumulated experience at inference time.

entry.title: On Characterizing Learnability for Adversarial Noisy Bandits

author.name: Steve Hanneke, Kun Wang

entry.summary: Characterizes learnability in adversarial noisy bandits using a convexified variant of generalized maximin volume. Provides necessary and sufficient conditions for when a function class admits sublinear regret.

entry.title: Generating Symmetric Materials using Latent Flow Matching

author.name: Anmar Karmush, Cedric Mathieu Brandenburg, Soheil Ershadrad, Johanna Ros\'en, Michael Felsberg, Filip Ekstr\"om Kelvinius

entry.summary: Introduces SymADiT, a symmetry-aware variant of the All-atom Diffusion Transformer for materials generation that uses Wyckoff positions to enforce crystal symmetry constraints, generating more physically realistic materials.

entry.title: Per-Loss Adapters for Gradient Conflict in Physics-Informed Neural Networks

author.name: Bum Jun Kim, Gnankan Landry Regis N'guessan

entry.summary: Identifies distinct gradient-conflict regimes in PINNs and proposes per-loss adapters that route different loss terms through separate parameter subspaces, with automatic regime detection to choose the right intervention.

entry.title: A Random-Matrix Criterion for Initializing Gated Recurrent Neural Networks

author.name: Tommaso Fioratti, Riccardo Marcaccioli, Francesco Casola

entry.summary: Derives a simple random-matrix criterion for estimating the critical initialization point of gated recurrent networks (GRUs, LSTMs), where the phase transition between ordered and chaotic dynamics occurs. Extends known results for vanilla RNNs to gated architectures.

entry.title: Benchmarking Sensor-Fault Robustness in Forecasting

author.name: Alexander Windmann, Philipp Wittenberg, Gianluca Manca, Marcel Dix, Jens U. Brandt, Oliver Niggemann

entry.summary: Introduces SensorFault-Bench, a benchmarking protocol for evaluating forecasting model robustness under sensor faults (noise, bias, missing data, temporal misalignment) in cyber-physical systems. Separates relative robustness from absolute accuracy across standardized scenarios.

entry.title: Decentralized Conformal Novelty Detection via Quantized Model Exchange

author.name: Kyle Loh, Yu Xiang

entry.summary: Studies decentralized novelty detection with global FDR control across heterogeneous distributions using quantized surrogate model exchange. Proves conditional exchangeability preservation under quantization.

entry.title: Structure-Preserving Reconstruction of Convex Lipschitz Functionals on Hilbert Spaces from Finite Samples

author.name: Anastasis Kratsios

entry.summary: Proves that any convex Lipschitz functional on a separable Hilbert space can be reconstructed from finite pointwise samples to arbitrary accuracy while preserving convexity and Lipschitz regularity.

entry.title: Affine Tracing: A New Paradigm for Probabilistic Linear Solvers

author.name: Disha Hegde, Marvin Pf\"ortner, Jon Cockayne

entry.summary: Shows that Bayesian probabilistic linear solvers are a special case of non-stationary affine probabilistic iterative methods, unifying two previously separate paradigms. Introduces automated design methods for affine PIMs.

entry.title: MIST: Multimodal Interactive Speech-based Tool-calling Conversational Assistants for Smart Homes

author.name: Maximillian Chen, Xuanming Zhang, Michael Peng, Zhou Yu, Alexandros Papangelis, Yohan Jo

entry.summary: Introduces MIST, a synthetic multi-turn voice-driven code generation dataset for IoT device control, revealing significant gaps between open and closed-weight multimodal LLMs on spatiotemporal reasoning with speech inputs.

entry.title: Cognitive Agent Compilation for Explicit Problem Solver Modeling

author.name: Hyeongdon Moon, Carolyn Ros\'e, John Stamper

entry.summary: Proposes Cognitive Agent Compilation (CAC), a framework using teacher LLMs to compile problem-solving knowledge into explicit, inspectable target agents with separated knowledge representation, policy, and verification components.

entry.title: NICE FACT: Diagnosing and Calibrating VLMs in Quantitative Reasoning for Kinematic Physics

author.name: Jian Lan, Zhicheng Liu, Xinpeng Wang, Yuhao Zhou, Haokun Chen, Jiancheng Lv, Barbara Plank, Thomas Seidl

entry.summary: Proposes NICE and FACT, dual diagnostics decomposing quantitative reasoning for kinematic physics in VLMs, evaluating visual fidelity, physical law comprehension, temporal grounding, and confidence reliability.

entry.title: UniShield: Unified Face Attack Detection via KG-Informed Multimodal Reasoning

author.name: Hongrui Li, Yichen Shi, Hongyang Wang, Yuhao Gao, Hui Ma, Jun Feng, Zitong Yu

entry.summary: Proposes UniShield, a knowledge-grounded framework for unified face attack detection using a Face Attack Knowledge Graph and graph-consistent reasoning optimization for both physical spoofing and digital forgery.

entry.title: CATS: Curvature Aware Temporal Selection for efficient long video understanding

author.name: Mehrajul Abadin Miraj, Abdul Mohaimen Al Radi, Shariful Islam Rayhan, Md. Tanvir Alam, Ismat Rahman, Yu Tian, Md Mosaddek Khan

entry.summary: CATS proposes curvature-aware frame selection for long video understanding in MLLMs, modeling temporal geometry of query-frame relevance to identify salient events while suppressing redundant frames.

entry.title: On-Policy Distillation with Best-of-N Teacher Rollout Selection

author.name: Ke Zhang, Yunjie Tian, DongDi Zhao, Yijiang Li, Yuanye Liu, Vishal M Patel, Di Fu

entry.summary: BRTS proposes best-of-N teacher rollout selection for on-policy distillation, addressing variance in teacher supervision by selecting the best among multiple teacher rollouts per prompt.

entry.title: MFVLR: Multi-domain Fine-grained Vision-Language Reconstruction for Generalizable Diffusion Face Forgery Detection and Localization

author.name: Yaning Zhang, Tianyi Wang, Zan Gao, Yibo Zhao, Chunjie Ma, Meng Wang

entry.summary: MFVLR uses multi-domain fine-grained vision-language reconstruction for detecting and localizing diffusion-generated face forgeries, leveraging text modality for improved generalization.

entry.title: TINS: Test-time ID-prototype-separated Negative Semantics Learning for OOD Detection

author.name: Yifeng Yang, Jubo Feng, Jing Xu, Xinbing Wang, Qinying Gu, Nanyang Ye

entry.summary: TINS learns test-time sample-specific negative semantics for OOD detection via image-to-text modality inversion with ID-prototype-separated regularization to prevent contamination.

entry.title: RoboMemArena: A Comprehensive and Challenging Robotic Memory Benchmark

author.name: Huashuo Lei, Wenxuan Song, Huarui Zhang, Jieyuan Pei, Jiayi Chen, Haodong Yan, Han Zhao, Pengxiang Ding, Zhipeng Zhang, Lida Huang, Donglin Wang, Yan Wang, Haoang Li

entry.summary: Introduces RoboMemArena, a large-scale benchmark of 26 tasks for evaluating robotic memory systems with average trajectory lengths exceeding 1000 steps and 68.9% memory-dependent subtasks, including real-world evaluation.

entry.title: SceneFactory: GPU-Accelerated Multi-Agent Driving Simulation with Physics-Based Vehicle Dynamics

author.name: Yicheng Zhu, Yang Chen, Tao Li, Zilin Bian

entry.summary: Introduces SceneFactory, a GPU-vectorized platform built on NVIDIA Isaac Sim that combines physics-based multi-agent simulation with scalable parallelism for autonomous driving, bridging the gap between physical fidelity and batch training.

entry.title: PLACO: A Multi-Stage Framework for Cost-Effective Performance in Human-AI Teams

author.name: Pranavkumar Mallela, Vinay Kumar, Shashi Shekhar Jha, Shweta Jain

entry.summary: Presents PLACO, a multi-stage framework for optimizing human-AI team performance in classification tasks, addressing cost-effectiveness when combining human and AI outputs using Bayesian approaches.

entry.title: Generalization Bounds of Emergent Communications for Agentic AI Networking

author.name: Yong Xiao, Jingxuan Chai, Guangming Shi, Ping Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces generalization bounds for emergent communication protocols in agentic AI networking (6G/AgentNet), providing information-theoretic foundations for autonomous agent signaling under physical network constraints.

entry.title: MCP-Cosmos: World Model-Augmented Agents for Complex Task Execution in MCP Environments

author.name: Giridhar Ganapavarapu, Dhaval Patel

entry.summary: Introduces MCP-Cosmos, a framework integrating generative World Models into the Model Context Protocol ecosystem, enabling agents to simulate state transitions before execution. Proposes a 'Bring Your Own World Model' strategy.

entry.title: Beyond ESG Scores: Learning Dynamic Constraints for Sequential Portfolio Optimization

author.name: Xin Li, Yan Ke, Longbing Cao

entry.summary: Proposes treating ESG constraints as learned dynamic constraint fields rather than static scores appended to policy observations. Uses Multimodal Action-Conditioned Constraint Field for ESG-aware portfolio optimization.

entry.title: Route by State, Recover from Trace: STAR with Failure-Aware Markov Routing for Multi-Agent Spatiotemporal Reasoning

author.name: Ruiyi Yang, Lihuan Li, Hao Xue, Flora D. Salim

entry.summary: Presents STAR, a failure-aware routing framework for multi-agent spatiotemporal reasoning that models inter-agent control as a state-conditioned Markov transition policy. It explicitly handles typed execution failures for recovery rather than ad-hoc language-based routing.

entry.title: EmbodiSkill: Skill-Aware Reflection for Self-Evolving Embodied Agents

author.name: Ruofei Ju, Xinrui Wang, Xin Ding, Yifan Yang, Hao Wu, Shiqi Jiang, Qianxi Zhang, Hao Wen, Xiangyu Li, Weijun Wang, Kun Li, Yunxin Liu, Haipeng Dai, Wei Wang, Ting Cao

entry.summary: Proposes EmbodiSkill, a training-free framework for embodied agent skill self-evolution that distinguishes between incorrect skill content and execution lapses. Addresses the challenge of skill refinement from real-world trajectories.

entry.title: ASIA: an Autonomous System Identification Agent

author.name: Dario Piga, Marco Forgione

entry.summary: Presents ASIA, a framework that delegates system identification (model selection, training, hyperparameter tuning) to an LLM acting as an autonomous coding agent. Closes the loop between hypothesis, implementation, and evaluation without human intervention.

entry.title: Agent-First Tool API: A Semantic Interface Paradigm for Enterprise AI Agent Systems

author.name: Kai Pan

entry.summary: Proposes the Agent-First Tool API paradigm for enterprise AI, identifying five fundamental mismatches between conventional APIs and agent requirements. Introduces a Six-Verb Semantic Protocol and Normalized Tool Contract.

entry.title: Teacher-Aware Evolution of Heuristic Programs from Learned Optimization Policies

author.name: Minyu Chen, Song Qin, Ling-I Wu, Jianxin Xue, Guoqiang Li

entry.summary: Proposes a teacher-aware evolutionary framework for heuristic design that uses learned optimization policies as behavioral teachers. Queries teacher on states visited by candidate programs and uses action preferences as local feedback.

entry.title: Feature Repulsion and Spectral Lock-in: An Empirical Study of Two-Layer Network Grokking

author.name: Yongzhong Xu

entry.summary: Empirically tests Tian's theoretical repulsion theorem about grokking in two-layer networks on modular addition, finding a structure-mechanism dissociation where the predicted sign rule holds but doesn't lead to measurable spectral signatures.

entry.title: KARMA-MV: A Benchmark for Causal Question Answering on Music Videos

author.name: Archishman Ghosh, Abhinaba Roy, Dorien Herremans

entry.summary: Introduces KARMA-MV, a large-scale QA dataset from 2,682 music videos testing models' ability to reason about how visual dynamics drive musical structure, with 37,737 MCQs generated via LLM reasoning.

entry.title: Text-Guided Multi-Scale Frequency Representation Adaptation

author.name: Weicai Yan, Xinhua Ma, Wang Lin, Tao Jin

entry.summary: Proposes FreqAdapter, a parameter-efficient fine-tuning method that integrates textual information with multi-scale frequency domain adaptation, addressing information redundancy in signal-space methods.

entry.title: Efficient Prompt Learning for Traffic Forecasting

author.name: Qianru Zhang, Xinyi Gao, Alexander Zhou, Reynold Cheng, Siu-Ming Yiu, Hongzhi Yin

entry.summary: Proposes SimpleST, a lightweight prompt tuning framework for spatio-temporal GNNs that improves generalization under distribution shifts for traffic forecasting.

entry.title: UMEDA: Unified Multi-modal Efficient Data Fusion for Privacy-Preserving Graph Federated Learning via Spectral-Gated Attention and Diffusion-Based Operator Alignment

author.name: Shih-Yu Lai, Hirozumi Yamaguchi, Shang-Tse Chen, Yu-Lun Liu, Bing-Yu Chen

entry.summary: Proposes UMEDA, a graph federated learning framework for device-free localization that handles heterogeneous sensor modalities through spectral-gated attention and diffusion-based operator alignment, with privacy preservation.

entry.title: mHC-SSM: Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections for State Space Language Models with Stream-Specialized Adapters

author.name: Abdulvahap Mutlu, \c{S}eng\"ul Do\u{g}an, T\"urker Tuncer

entry.summary: Proposes manifold-constrained hyper-connections for state space language models, constraining residual stream mixing to doubly stochastic matrices via Sinkhorn-Knopp projection to improve stability.

entry.title: CAMAL: Improving Attention Alignment and Faithfulness with Segmentation Masks

author.name: Rajdeep Singh Hundal, Yan Xiao, Jin Song Dong, Manuel Rigger

entry.summary: Proposes CAMAL, a method using segmentation masks to improve both attention alignment and attention faithfulness in vision models through class activation map learning.

entry.title: Decoupling Endpoint and Semantic Transition Learning for Zero-Shot Composed Image Retrieval

author.name: Mingyu Liu, Sihan Huang, Yijia Fan, Yinlin Yan, Quan Zhang, Jian-Fang Hu, Jianhuang Lai

entry.summary: Proposes a method for zero-shot composed image retrieval that decouples endpoint matching from semantic transition learning, addressing a bottleneck where edit text acts as a target-side cue rather than a source-conditioned transition.

entry.title: Probing the Impact of Scale on Data-Efficient, Generalist Transformer World Models for Atari

author.name: Jooyeon Kim

entry.summary: Analyzes scaling behaviors of transformer world models on Atari 100k, finding that environments fall into distinct scaling regimes even with identical data budgets and model capacities.

entry.title: Attention-based graph neural networks: a survey

author.name: Chengcheng Sun, Chenhao Li, Xiang Lin, Tianji Zheng, Fanrong Meng, Xiaobin Rui, Zhixiao Wang

entry.summary: A comprehensive survey of attention-based graph neural networks, proposing a two-level taxonomy from the perspectives of attention mechanisms and GNN architectures. Covers recent advances and provides systematic categorization of the field.

entry.title: Control Your View: High-Resolution Global Semantic Manipulation in Learned Image Compression

author.name: Jiaming Liang, Chi-Man Pun, Weisi Lin, Greta Seng Peng Mok

entry.summary: Explores high-resolution global semantic manipulation attacks on learned image compression systems, demonstrating that adversarial perturbations can systematically manipulate the semantic content of compressed images at high resolution.

entry.title: Geometrically Constrained Stenosis Editing in Coronary Angiography via Entropic Optimal Transport

author.name: Jialin Li, Zhuo Zhang, Yue Cao, Guipeng Lan, Jiabao Wen, Shuai Xiao, Jiachen Yang

entry.summary: OT-Bridge Editor reframes localized coronary angiography stenosis editing as a constrained entropic optimal transport problem, using geometric information to steer generation for synthetic training data augmentation.

entry.title: DAPE: Dynamic Non-uniform Alignment and Progressive Detail Enhancement Techniques for Improving the Performance of Efficient Visual Language Models

author.name: Mengyuan Tian, Qiyan Zhao, Yanan Wang, Da-Han Wang

entry.summary: DAPE proposes dynamic non-uniform alignment and progressive detail enhancement for vision-language models, addressing the mismatch between text and image information density distributions.

entry.title: Phase Transitions in Affective Meaning Divergence: The Hidden Drift Before the Break

author.name: Napassorn Litchiowong

entry.summary: Formalizes 'affective meaning divergence' in conversations and shows that derailing conversations exhibit critical-slowing-down signatures predictable through a saddle-node bifurcation model. Validated on the Conversations Gone Awry dataset.

entry.title: Field-Localized Forgery Detection for Digital Identity Documents

author.name: Abhishek Kumar, Riya Tapwal, Carsten Maple, Mark Hooper

entry.summary: FLiD proposes a lightweight field-localized framework for detecting forgeries in digital identity documents by targeting critical identity regions (faces, text) rather than processing full documents.

entry.title: Detect, Localize, and Explain: Interactive Hierarchical Log Anomaly Analytics with LLM Augmentation

author.name: Lei Ma, Suhani Chaudhary, Ethan Shanbaum, Athanasios Tassiadamis, Peter M. VanNostrand, Dennis M. Hofmann, Haowen Xu, Elke Rundensteiner

entry.summary: Krone introduces a hierarchical log abstraction that transforms flat log sequences into semantically coherent units across entity, action, and status levels for anomaly detection. It uses modular detection with selective LLM-based reasoning for precise anomaly localization and explanation.

entry.title: HOME-KGQA: A Benchmark Dataset for Multimodal Knowledge Graph Question Answering on Household Daily Activities

author.name: Shusaku Egami, Aoi Ohta, Tomoki Tsujimura, Masaki Asada, Tatsuya Ishigaki, Ken Fukuda, Masahiro Hamasaki, Hiroya Takamura

entry.summary: HOME-KGQA introduces a multimodal knowledge graph question answering benchmark built on household daily activities, targeting embodied AI with fine-grained spatiotemporal data across multiple modalities.

entry.title: ChaosNetBench: Benchmarking Spatio-Temporal Graph Neural Networks on Chaotic Lattice Dynamics

author.name: Henok Tenaw Moges, Charalampos Skokos, Deshendran Moodley

entry.summary: Introduces ChaosNetBench, a synthetic benchmark for evaluating spatio-temporal graph neural networks under controlled chaotic dynamics with tunable parameters. Provides systematic evaluation across 96 system configurations spanning different dynamical regimes.

entry.title: CalBench: Evaluating Coordination-Privacy Trade-offs in Multi-Agent LLMs

author.name: Chelsea Zou, Yiheng Yao, Selena She, Robert D. Hawkins

entry.summary: Introduces CalBench, a controlled environment for studying multi-agent coordination through calendar scheduling with private information, enabling precise measurement of coordination quality against oracle solutions.

entry.title: Voice Biomarkers for Depression and Anxiety

author.name: Oleksii Abramenko, Noah D. Stein, Colin Vaz

entry.summary: Explores deep learning on raw speech signals for depression and anxiety detection, training on a large proprietary dataset of ~65K hours. Develops voice biomarker representations for mental health assessment.

entry.title: Speech-based Psychological Crisis Assessment using LLMs

author.name: Terumi Chiba, Yang Luo, Ziyun Cui, Yongsheng Tong, Chao Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes an LLM-based framework for automated psychological crisis level classification from hotline calls, introducing paralinguistic injection to insert non-verbal emotional cues into speech transcripts for LLM reasoning.

entry.title: NCO: A Versatile Plug-in for Handling Negative Constraints in Decoding

author.name: Hyundong Jin, Yo-Sub Han

entry.summary: Proposes NCO, a plug-in for preventing multiple forbidden patterns in LLM outputs during decoding, using efficient automaton decomposition rather than constructing a single prohibitively large automaton.

entry.title: Task-Agnostic Noisy Label Detection via Standardized Loss Aggregation

author.name: Inhyuk Park, Doohyun Park

entry.summary: Proposes Standardized Loss Aggregation (SLA), a task-agnostic method for detecting noisy labels in medical imaging by aggregating standardized fold-level validation losses across cross-validation runs.

entry.title: DynGhost: Temporally-Modelled Transformer for Dynamic Ghost Imaging with Quantum Detectors

author.name: Vittorio Palladino, Ahmet Enis Cetin

entry.summary: Presents DynGhost, a transformer for dynamic ghost imaging that exploits temporal coherence across frames and models Poissonian noise statistics of single-photon detectors, addressing limitations of existing static-scene approaches.

entry.title: To Redact, or not to Redact? A Local LLM Approach to Deliberative Process Privilege Classification

author.name: Maik Larooij, David Graus

entry.summary: Explores using local LLMs for automatic classification of deliberative process privilege in government documents for FOIA compliance, avoiding the legal/political issues of sending sensitive documents to cloud APIs.

entry.title: Portable Active Learning for Object Detection

author.name: Rashi Sharma, Justin Timothy C. Bersamin, Karthikk Subramanian

entry.summary: Presents PAL, a detector-agnostic active learning framework for object detection that operates solely on inference outputs, combining class-wise uncertainty with image-level diversity for data selection.

entry.title: Multi-layer attentive probing improves transfer of audio representations for bioacoustics

author.name: Marius Miron, David Robinson, Masato Hagiwara, Titouan Parcollet, Jules Cauzinille, Gagan Narula, Milad Alizadeh, Ellen Gilsenan-McMahon, Sara Keen, Emmanuel Chemla, Benjamin Hoffman, Maddie Cusimano, Diane Kim, Felix Effenberger, Jane K. Lawton, Aza Raskin, Olivier Pietquin, Matthieu Geist

entry.summary: Systematically studies probing strategies for bioacoustic benchmarks, showing that multi-layer attention probes significantly outperform standard linear probes on the final layer for audio representation evaluation.

entry.title: SenseBench: A Benchmark for Remote Sensing Low-Level Visual Perception and Description in Large Vision-Language Models

author.name: Chen Zhong, Xiao An, Jiaxing Sun, Zihan Gui, Guangyi Yang, Wei He

entry.summary: Introduces SenseBench, the first benchmark for evaluating VLMs on low-level visual perception and description of remote sensing image quality, addressing the gap between scalar IQA scores and expert diagnostic needs.

entry.title: Interpretable Coreference Resolution Evaluation Using Explicit Semantics

author.name: Bruno Gatti, Giuliano Martinelli, Roberto Navigli

entry.summary: Introduces a semantically-enhanced evaluation framework for coreference resolution that overlays concept and named entity recognition to provide diagnostic insights by semantic category.

entry.title: Reinforcement learning for inverse structural design and rapid laser cutting of kirigami prototypes

author.name: Milad Yazdani, Shahriar Shalileh, Dena Shahriari

entry.summary: Presents a reinforcement learning framework for inverse kirigami design combining optimal-transport conditional flow matching with GRPO, enabling automatic generation of compatible cut patterns for target shapes with laser cutting validation.

entry.title: Path-Based Gradient Boosting for Graph-Level Prediction

author.name: Claudio Meggio, Johan Pensar, Riccardo De Bin

entry.summary: Proposes PathBoost, a gradient boosting method for graph-level prediction that learns discriminative path-based features directly from graph structure, with extensions for classification and automatic anchor selection.

entry.title: Towards Customized Multimodal Role-Play

author.name: Chao Tang, Jianzong Wu, Qingyu Shi, Ye Tian, Aixi Zhang, Hao Jiang, Jiangning Zhang, Yunhai Tong

entry.summary: Introduces Customized Multimodal Role-Play task and UniCharacter framework for jointly customizing a character's persona, dialogue style, and visual identity in unified multimodal models.

entry.title: Temporal-Decay Shapley: A Time-Aware Data Valuation Framework for Time-Series Data

author.name: Chuwen Pang, Bing Mi, Kongyang Chen

entry.summary: Proposes temporal-decay Shapley methods for time-series data valuation, incorporating temporal information through decay mechanisms and multi-scale fusion strategies.

entry.title: Physics-Modeled Neural Networks

author.name: Raul Felipe-Sosa, Angel Martin del Rey, Maria Flores Ceballos

entry.summary: Introduces Dynamical Physics-Modeled Neural Networks where hidden layers are defined as ODE solutions, grounded in Reproducing Kernel Banach Spaces, replacing static activations with time-evolving dynamical systems.

entry.title: The Power of Second Order Methods for Sequence Preconditioning

author.name: Annie Marsden, Elad Hazan

entry.summary: Shows that the Vovk-Azoury-Warmuth second-order algorithm is naturally suited for Universal Sequence Preconditioning, achieving optimal regret bounds for dynamical systems with long memory where first-order methods fail.

entry.title: ShifaMind: A Multiplicative Concept Bottleneck for Interpretable ICD-10 Coding

author.name: Mohammed Sameer Syed, Xuan Lu

entry.summary: Proposes ShifaMind for automated ICD-10 coding using a Multiplicative Concept Bottleneck that changes the form rather than width of the interpretability bottleneck, preserving gradient flow while maintaining clinical interpretability.

entry.title: Beyond Static Bias: Adaptive Multi-Fidelity Bandits with Improving Proxies

author.name: Muyun Lu, Haoyang Hong, Huazheng Wang, Ying Lin

entry.summary: Studies adaptive multi-fidelity bandits where low-fidelity sources (like LLMs) improve with calibration, introducing a selected-average mismatch bound for dynamic proxy improvement.

entry.title: Robust Server Defense Against Unreliable Clients in One-Shot Fair Collaborative Machine Learning

author.name: Chia-Yuan Wu, Frank E. Curtis, Daniel P. Robinson

entry.summary: Proposes a robust server defense for one-shot collaborative ML against unreliable clients, addressing fairness degradation when biased proxy data from malicious or non-malicious clients affects the global model.

entry.title: A Single Deep Preference-Conditioned Policy for Learning Pareto Coverage Sets

author.name: Akihiro Kubo, Kosuke Nakanishi, Shin Ishii

entry.summary: Proves that under smooth Tchebycheff scalarization in tabular multi-objective MDPs, each preference induces a unique Pareto-optimal return vector with Lipschitz-continuous dependence on preferences. This provides theoretical foundations for preference-conditioned MORL with dense Pareto-front coverage.

entry.title: AlphaExploitem: Going Beyond the Nash Equilibrium in Poker by Learning to Exploit Suboptimal Play

author.name: Vlad Murgoci, Matthijs Spaan, Yaniv Oren

entry.summary: Introduces AlphaExploitem, extending AlphaHoldem poker agent with a hierarchical transformer encoder for reasoning over hand histories and learning to exploit suboptimal opponents beyond Nash equilibrium play.

entry.title: Multi-scale Predictive Representations for Goal-conditioned Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Valliappan Chidambaram Adaikkappan, David Meger, Sai Rajeswar, Pietro Mazzaglia

entry.summary: Proposes Ms.PR, a multi-scale predictive representation framework for offline goal-conditioned RL that addresses representation divergence through predictive supervision at multiple temporal scales.

entry.title: Learning-Augmented Scalable Linear Assignment Problem Optimization via Neural Dual Warm-Starts

author.name: Ilay Yavlovich, Jad Agbaria, Muhamed Mhamed, Jose Yallouz, Nir Weinberger

entry.summary: Proposes learning-augmented acceleration of exact linear assignment solvers via neural dual warm-starts. Maintains optimality guarantees while predicting dual variables to speed up classical algorithms.

entry.title: Learning to Bid with Unknown Private Values in Budget-Constrained First-Price Auctions

author.name: Zihao Hu, Yuxiao Wen, Yuan Yao, Jiheng Zhang, Zhengyuan Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes a primal-dual framework for constrained first-price auctions that jointly learns latent valuation parameters and competitor bid distributions. Handles budget and return-on-spend constraints with regret guarantees.

entry.title: Online Set Learning from Precision and Recall Feedback

author.name: Lee Cohen, Yishay Mansour, Shay Moran, Han Shao

entry.summary: Studies online set learning from precision and recall feedback, where a learner predicts sets and receives either precision or recall information. Provides algorithms to maximize cumulative reward in this novel setting.

entry.title: Discovery of Nonlinear Dynamics with Automated Basis Function Generation

author.name: Mohammad Amin Basiri, Charles Nicholson

entry.summary: Presents AutoSINDy, combining symbolic regression with SINDy for automated discovery of governing equations from data. The hybrid approach generates candidate basis functions automatically rather than requiring manual specification.

entry.title: Bayesian Optimization with Structured Measurements: A Vector-Valued RKHS Framework

author.name: Wenbin Wang, Colin N. Jones

entry.summary: Extends Bayesian optimization to handle vector-valued structured measurements (trajectories, spatial fields) rather than scalar objectives, using a vector-valued RKHS framework to extract richer information from each evaluation.

entry.title: Concordia: Self-Improving Synthetic Tables for Federated LLMs

author.name: Jimin Huang, Duanyu Feng, Nuo Chen, Xiaoyu Wang, Zhiqiang Zhang, Xueqing Peng, Mingquan Lin, Prayag Tiwari, Guojun Xiong, Alejandro Lopez-Lira, Sophia Ananiadou

entry.summary: Proposes Concordia, a tri-level optimization framework for federated LLM adaptation on tabular tasks using self-improving synthetic data generation, addressing the challenge of non-IID client distributions under strict data isolation.

entry.title: Chebyshev Center-Based Direction Selection for Multi-Objective Optimization and Training PINNs

author.name: Hoyeol Yoon, Seoungbin Bae, Nam Ho-Nguyen, Dabeen Lee

entry.summary: Formulates multi-objective optimization for PINNs as a Chebyshev center problem, providing a geometric principle that unifies and relates existing update direction methods for training physics-informed neural networks.

entry.title: DeepLog: A Software Framework for Modular Neurosymbolic AI
