author.name: Robin Manhaeve, Stefano Colamonaco, Vincent Derkinderen, Rik Adriaensen, Lucas Van Praet, Luc De Raedt, Giuseppe Marra

entry.summary: Introduces DeepLog, a neurosymbolic framework that unifies logic and deep learning within PyTorch by compiling diverse neurosymbolic specifications into optimized arithmetic circuits, serving as a universal backend.

entry.title: Signature Approach for Contextual Bandits with Nonlinear and Path-dependent Rewards

author.name: Xin Guo, Grace He, Xinyu Li

entry.summary: Proposes a signature-transform approach for contextual bandits with path-dependent rewards, using the universal nonlinearity of path signatures to reduce to linear bandits in signature space.

entry.title: The Polynomial Counting Capabilities of Message Passing Neural Networks

author.name: Marco S\"alzer, Pascal Bergstr\"a{\ss}er, Anthony W. Lin

entry.summary: Studies the polynomial counting capabilities of Message Passing Neural Networks, showing that mean aggregation enables checking global polynomial counting constraints on node-labeled graphs under mild assumptions.

entry.title: It's All Connected: Topology-Aware Structural Graph Encoding Improves Performance on Polymer Prediction

author.name: H. Ibrahim Erdogan (University of Bayreuth, Germany), Punith Raviswamy (University of Bayreuth, Germany), Nikita Agrawal (University of Bayreuth, Germany), Yannik K\"oster (Friedrich Schiller University Jena, Germany), Stefan Zechel (Friedrich Schiller University Jena, Germany), Ulrich S. Schubert (Friedrich Schiller University Jena, Germany), Ruben Mayer (University of Bayreuth, Germany), Christopher Kuenneth (University of Bayreuth, Germany)

entry.summary: Proposes a topology-aware graph construction for polymer property prediction that incorporates chain-scale morphology from molecular mass distributions, addressing a key limitation of existing GNN approaches that only use repeat unit graphs. The method samples representative chains from Schulz-Zimm distributions and uses topology-aware structural encoding to capture polymer chain properties like glass transition temperature.

entry.title: XQCfD: Accelerating Fast Actor-Critic Algorithms with Prior Data and Prior Policies

author.name: Daniel Palenicek, Florian Vogt, Joe Watson, Ingmar Posner, Danica Kragic, Jan Peters

entry.summary: Proposes XQCfD, extending the XQC actor-critic algorithm to effectively learn from demonstrations using augmented replay buffers, pretrained policies, and stationary policy architectures. Shows existing algorithms fail to achieve possible sample efficiency due to poor use of pretrained policies.

entry.title: NoRIN: Backbone-Adaptive Reversible Normalization for Time-Series Forecasting

author.name: Shun Zhang, Yuyang Xiao

entry.summary: Proposes NoRIN, a non-linear reversible normalization for time-series forecasting based on the Johnson SU transform, which can reshape distributions (heavy tails, skewness) unlike the strictly affine RevIN. Shows the transform reliably converges to the linear limit during training.

entry.title: Augmented Equivariant Mesh Networks for Anatomical Segmentation

author.name: Daniel Saragih

entry.summary: Presents EAMS, an equivariant anatomical mesh segmentation model built on Equivariant Mesh Neural Networks, evaluated across four clinical tasks. Shows robustness to arbitrary patient pose that non-equivariant methods lack.

entry.title: Inverse Design of Multi-Layer Sub-Pixel-Resolution RF Passives Through Grayscale Diffusion with Flexible S-Parameter Conditioning

author.name: Tommaso Dreossi, Christopher M. Bryant, Hao Liu, Nathan Mirman, Noah Kessler, Michael Frei, Harish Krishnaswamy

entry.summary: Presents a diffusion-based inverse design approach for multi-layer RF passive components from S-parameter specifications, generating sub-pixel grayscale metallization patterns at 64x64 resolution with physical constraints.

entry.title: Post-hoc Selective Classification for Reliable Synthetic Image Detection

author.name: Kaixiang Zheng, Jacob H. Seidman

entry.summary: Adopts selective classification for synthetic image detection, allowing detectors to abstain from low-confidence predictions. Shows conventional logit-based confidence scores fail under covariate shift and proposes alternatives.

entry.title: Improving Generative Adversarial Networks with Self-Distillation

author.name: Antoni Nowinowski, Krzysztof Krawiec

entry.summary: Proposes Self-Distilled GAN (SD-GAN) that uses the EMA generator as a teacher to guide the active generator via perceptual loss during training. Proves local asymptotic stability and shows reduced parasitic cycling behavior in GANs.

entry.title: Rennala MVR: Improved Time Complexity for Parallel Stochastic Optimization via Momentum-Based Variance Reduction

author.name: Zhirayr Tovmasyan, Artavazd Maranjyan, Peter Richt\'arik

entry.summary: Proposes Rennala MVR, a momentum-based variance reduction method for parallel stochastic optimization that improves time complexity over Rennala SGD in heterogeneous computing environments.

entry.title: Enabling Structure-Only Initialization and Out-of-Distribution Generalization in GNN-based Molecular Dynamics Simulators

author.name: S. A. Shteingolts, Salman N. Salman, Dan Mendels

entry.summary: Addresses structure-only initialization and OOD generalization for GNN-based molecular dynamics simulators, enabling inverse design settings where simulations start from single static configurations.

entry.title: Dissecting Jet-Tagger Through Mechanistic Interpretability

author.name: Saurabh Rai, Sanmay Ganguly

entry.summary: Performs mechanistic interpretability analysis of Particle Transformer for jet classification in particle physics, identifying a sparse six-head circuit with source-relay-readout structure encoding physical quantities.

entry.title: GELATO: Generative Entropy- and Lyapunov-based Adaptive Token Offloading for Device-Edge Speculative LLM Inference

author.name: Zengzipeng Tang, Yuxuan Sun, Wei Chen, Jianwen Ding, Bo Ai

entry.summary: Proposes GELATO, a framework for device-edge collaborative LLM inference using speculative decoding with per-token resource scheduling. Uses entropy-based draft quality estimation and Lyapunov optimization to maximize throughput under energy constraints.

entry.title: Regret Minimization in Bilateral Trade With Perturbed Markets

author.name: Anna Lunghi, Matteo Castiglioni, Alberto Marchesi

entry.summary: Studies regret minimization in bilateral trade under perturbed market settings that bridge adversarial and stochastic environments. Shows how to achieve improved regret bounds by exploiting structure in the perturbation.

entry.title: Group of Skills: Group-Structured Skill Retrieval for Agent Skill Libraries

author.name: Kun Zeng, Yu Huo, Siyu Zhang, Zi Ye, Yuecheng Zhuo, Haoyue Liu, Yuquan Lu, Junhao Wen, Xiaoying Tang

entry.summary: Proposes GoSkills, a group-structured skill retrieval method for agent skill libraries that changes the retrieval object from flat skill lists to compact, role-labeled execution contexts organized by anchor-centered groups.

entry.title: Beyond Single Ground Truth: Reference Monism as Epistemic Injustice in ASR Evaluation

author.name: Anna Seo Gyeong Choi, Maria Teleki, James Caverlee, Miguel del Rio, Corey Miller, Hoon Choi

entry.summary: Argues that enforcing a single transcription convention as ground truth in ASR evaluation commits epistemic injustice, particularly disadvantaging speakers with aphasia whose disfluencies are clinically meaningful.

entry.title: Is She Even Relevant? When BERT Ignores Explicit Gender Cues

author.name: Jonas Klein, Chiara Manna, Eva Vanmassenhove

entry.summary: Investigates how and when gender information emerges in a Dutch BERT model through checkpoint-level analysis. Finds that contextual embeddings sometimes ignore explicit gender cues, revealing limitations in how models integrate morphological gender information.

entry.title: State Representation and Termination for Recursive Reasoning Systems

author.name: Debashis Guha, Amritendu Mukherjee, Sanjay Kukreja, Tarun Kumar

entry.summary: Formalizes recursive reasoning systems with an epistemic state graph and defines the 'order-gap' metric for termination decisions. Provides necessary and sufficient conditions for non-degenerate order-gap near fixed points.

entry.title: ProtSent: Protein Sentence Transformers

author.name: Dan Ofer, Oriel Perets, Michal Linial, Nadav Rappoport

entry.summary: Introduces ProtSent, a contrastive fine-tuning framework that adapts protein language models into general-purpose embedding models using multiple protein-pair datasets. Evaluates on 23 downstream tasks using frozen embeddings with k-nearest-neighbor, showing improved protein similarity representations.

entry.title: Mathematical Reasoning via Intervention-Based Time-Series Causal Discovery Using LLMs as Concept Mastery Simulators

author.name: Tsuyoshi Okita

entry.summary: Proposes CIKA framework that uses LLMs as interventional simulators for mathematical reasoning, setting concept states via prompts and measuring correctness changes to estimate causal effects of individual concepts.

entry.title: SPECTRA-Net: Scalable Pipeline for Explainable Cross-domain Tensor Representations for AI-generated Images Detection

author.name: Sarra Arab, Anfal Achouri, Seif Eddine Bouziane

entry.summary: Introduces SPECTRA-Net for AI-generated image detection using multi-view representations combining global semantic features, spectral analysis, local patch anomaly detection, and statistical descriptors.

entry.title: PaceVGGT: Pre-Alternating-Attention Token Pruning for Visual Geometry Transformers

author.name: Haotang Li, Zhenyu Qi, Shaohan Henry Wang, Kebin Peng, Zi Wang, Qing Guo, Sen He, Huanrui Yang

entry.summary: Introduces PaceVGGT, a pre-AA token pruning framework for Visual Geometry Transformers that prunes DINO patch tokens before the expensive Alternating-Attention blocks using a trained lightweight Token Scorer.

entry.title: Enhancing Consistency Models for Multi-Agent Trajectory Prediction

author.name: Alen Mrdovic (Tony), Qingze (Tony), Liu, Danrui Li, Mathew Schwartz, Kaidong Hu, Sejong Yoon, Mubbasir Kapadia, Vladimir Pavlovic

entry.summary: Proposes ECTraj, an enhanced consistency model pipeline for multi-agent trajectory prediction that extends student-teacher training for single-step generation in autonomous driving scenarios.

entry.title: Cross-Sample Relational Fusion: Unifying Domain Generalization and Class-Incremental Learning

author.name: Zhen-Hao Xie, Yan Wang, Hao Sun, Han-Jia Ye, De-Chuan Zhan, Da-Wei Zhou

entry.summary: CORF proposes a unified framework addressing both domain shift and catastrophic forgetting in class-incremental learning using cross-sample relational fusion and spatial contribution maps. This targets practical scenarios like autonomous driving where both challenges co-occur.

entry.title: FlashClear: Ultra-Fast Image Content Removal via Efficient Step Distillation and Feature Caching

author.name: Yixin Tang, Jiawei Guo, Junxian Li, Zhiteng Li, Jixin Zhao, Bingya Zhang, Chenbo Wang, Yulun Zhang, Shangchen Zhou

entry.summary: FlashClear proposes region-aware adversarial distillation and foreground-prioritized attention caching for ultra-fast diffusion-based object removal, focusing computation on relevant regions rather than denoising all tokens uniformly.

entry.title: CalibFree: Self-Supervised View Feature Separation for Calibration-Free Multi-Camera Multi-Object Tracking

author.name: Ruiqi Xian, Deep Patel, Iain Melvin, Sanjoy Kundu, Martin Renqiang Min, Dinesh Manocha

entry.summary: CalibFree presents a self-supervised framework for multi-camera multi-object tracking that requires no calibration or manual labeling, using feature separation between view-agnostic and view-specific representations.

entry.title: HyNeuralMap: Hyperbolic Mapping of Visual Semantics to Neural Hierarchies

author.name: Zihan Ma, Tian Xia, Kexin Wang, Xiao Li, Xiaowei He, Yudan Ren

entry.summary: HyNeuralMap uses hyperbolic Lorentz model to map visual semantics to neural hierarchies from fMRI data, better capturing hierarchical semantic organization across subjects than Euclidean approaches.

entry.title: QueST: Persistent Queries as Semantic Monitors for Drift Suppression in Long-Horizon Tracking

author.name: Mayank Anand, Mohammad Saqlain, Kyan Mahajan, Priya Shukla, Gora Chand Nandi, Andrew Melnik

entry.summary: QueST introduces a monitoring-by-design framework for long-horizon tracking that treats interaction-relevant entities as persistent semantic queries rather than transient point tracks, preventing semantic drift.

entry.title: Learning to Perceive "Where": Spatial Pretext Tasks for Robust Self-Supervised Learning

author.name: Yang Shen, Yusen Cai, Weronika Hryniewska-Guzik, Qing Lin, Mengmi Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces Spatial Prediction, a spatially-aware pretext task for self-supervised learning that predicts relative position and scale between local views, encouraging fine-grained spatial dependency learning.

entry.title: OZ-TAL: Online Zero-Shot Temporal Action Localization

author.name: Chaolei Han, Hongsong Wang, Xin Gong, Jie Gui

entry.summary: OZ-TAL introduces online zero-shot temporal action localization that detects previously unseen actions in streaming videos without prior training on those action categories.

entry.title: INFANiTE: Implicit Neural representation for high-resolution Fetal brain spatio-temporal Atlas learNing from clinical Thick-slicE MRI

author.name: Xiaotian Hu, Mingxuan Liu, Hongjia Yang, Juncheng Zhu, Yijin Li, Yifei Chen, Haoxiang Li, Tongxi Song, Zihan Li, Yingqi Hao, Ziyu Li, Yujin Zhang, Gang Ning, Yi Liao, Haibo Qu, Qiyuan Tian

entry.summary: INFANiTE uses implicit neural representations to build fetal brain spatio-temporal atlases directly from thick-slice clinical MRI, bypassing expensive slice-to-volume reconstruction and iterative registration steps. This dramatically accelerates atlas construction from large cohorts.

entry.title: Explanation-Aware Learning for Enhanced Interpretability in Biomedical Imaging

author.name: Zubair Faruqui, Rahul Dubey

entry.summary: This paper integrates explanation supervision directly into medical image model training to guide attention toward clinically meaningful regions, rather than relying on post-hoc saliency maps.

entry.title: DetRefiner: Model-Agnostic Detection Refinement with Feature Fusion Transformer

author.name: Soichiro Okazaki, Tatsuya Sasaki, Hiroki Ohashi

entry.summary: DetRefiner is a plug-and-play framework that fuses global and local features from foundation models to refine open-vocabulary object detection, operating as a model-agnostic post-processor.

entry.title: Progressive Photorealistic Simplification

author.name: Adi Rosenthal, Dana Berman, Yedid Hoshen, Ariel Shamir

entry.summary: Progressive photorealistic simplification iteratively removes and inpaints scene elements using VLMs and generative models, producing simpler images that remain plausible natural photographs.

entry.title: FrequencyCT: Frequency domain pseudo-label generation for self-supervised low-dose CT denoising

author.name: Guoquan Wei, Liu Shi, Chong Chen, Qiegen Liu

entry.summary: FrequencyCT proposes the first zero-shot self-supervised method for pseudo-label generation in frequency domain for low-dose CT denoising, exploiting noise-signal separation properties of frequency domain.

entry.title: Geometry-aware Prototype Learning for Cross-domain Few-shot Medical Image Segmentation

author.name: Feifan Song, Yuntian Bo, Haofeng Zhang

entry.summary: GeoProto introduces geometry-aware prototypical learning for cross-domain few-shot medical image segmentation, exploiting the observation that anatomical geometric structure is domain-transferable. The framework enriches prototypical matching with explicit structural priors to handle domain shift with minimal annotations.

entry.title: HairGPT: Strand-as-Language Autoregressive Modeling for Realistic 3D Hairstyle Synthesis

author.name: Haimin Luo, Min Ouyang, Lan Xu, Jingyi Yu

entry.summary: HairGPT treats hair strands as generative primitives and formulates 3D hairstyle synthesis as a dual-decoupled autoregressive sequence modeling problem, applying both spatial and structural decoupling for progressive generation from global layout to fine-grained detail.

entry.title: Set-Based Groupwise Registration for Variable-Length, Variable-Contrast Cardiac MRI

author.name: Yi Zhang, Yidong Zhao, Tijmen Toxopeus, Ma\v{s}a Bo\v{z}i\'c-Iven, Sebastian Weing\"artner, Qian Tao

entry.summary: Proposes set-based groupwise registration for cardiac MRI that generalizes across variable-length, variable-contrast sequences, overcoming the limitation of current methods that rigidly couple to protocol-specific parameters.

entry.title: Frequency Matching in Spiking Neural Networks for mmWave Sensing

author.name: Di Yu, Zhenyu Liao, Changze Lv, Wentao Tong, Linshan Jiang, Sijie Ji, Xin Du, Hailiang Zhao, Xiaoqing Zheng, Shuiguang Deng

entry.summary: Studies spiking neural networks for mmWave sensing from a mechanism-data alignment perspective, showing how LIF neuron dynamics' implicit low-pass filtering interacts with mmWave signal frequency structure for optimal performance.

entry.title: LE-PAVD: Learning-Enhanced Physics-Aware Vehicle Dynamics for High-Speed Autonomous Navigation

author.name: Musabbir Ahmed Arrafi, Malik Ali, Nicholas M. Stiffler, Krishna Bhavithavya Kidambi

entry.summary: LE-PAVD combines physics-based vehicle dynamics with learned components for autonomous racing, adding load-sensitive tire forces, longitudinal load transfer, and actuator dynamics while maintaining physical consistency.

entry.title: HULK: Large-scale Hierarchical Coordination under Continual and Uncertain Temporal Tasks

author.name: Qingyuan Luo, Jie Li, Meng Guo

entry.summary: HULK addresses large-scale multi-agent coordination under continual, uncertain temporal tasks where team-wise tasks arrive online and subtask counts are uncertain, going beyond static offline planning.

entry.title: Smoothing Out the Edges: Continuous-Time Estimation with Gaussian Process Motion Priors on Factor Graphs

author.name: Connor Holmes, Sven Lilge, Zi Cong Guo, Frank Dellaert, Timothy D. Barfoot

entry.summary: Provides a simplified explanation of Gaussian process continuous-time estimation using factor graph language, with three working examples in GTSAM to facilitate adoption of GP-based continuous-time methods.

entry.title: Muninn: Your Trajectory Diffusion Model But Faster

author.name: Gokul Puthumanaillam, Hao Jiang, Ruben Hernandez, Jose Fuentes, Paulo Padrao, Leonardo Bobadilla, Melkior Ornik

entry.summary: Introduces Muninn, a method to accelerate diffusion-based trajectory planners for real-time robot control without retraining. Exploits internal signals of the diffusion process to skip unnecessary denoising steps while maintaining trajectory quality.

entry.title: Data-Asymmetric Latent Imagination and Reranking for 3D Robotic Imitation Learning

author.name: Lianghao Luo, Xizhou Bu, Ruyan Liu, Qingqiu Huang, Chufeng Tang, Xiaoshuai Hao, Hongbo Wang, Wei Li

entry.summary: Proposes DALI-R, a framework for 3D robotic imitation learning from mixed-quality trajectories that learns a latent world model over point clouds for imagined rollouts and uses a task critic for reranking, enabling learning from suboptimal demonstrations.

entry.title: MDrive: Benchmarking Closed-Loop Cooperative Driving for End-to-End Multi-agent Systems

author.name: Marco Coscoy, Zewei Zhou, Seth Z. Zhao, Henry Wei, Angela Magtoto, Johnson Liu, Rui Song, Walter Zimmer, Zhiyu Huang, Chen Tang, Bolei Zhou, Jiaqi Ma

entry.summary: Introduces MDrive, a closed-loop cooperative driving benchmark with 225 scenarios for evaluating V2X multi-agent systems, addressing gaps in existing benchmarks regarding closed-loop evaluation and behavioral diversity.

entry.title: Uncertainty in Physics and AI: Taxonomy, Quantification, and Validation

author.name: Manuel Hau{\ss}mann, Ramon Winterhalder, Maria Ubiali

entry.summary: Provides a structured overview of uncertainty quantification in ML for physics, introducing a unified taxonomy across frequentist and Bayesian frameworks with principled validation tools including coverage, calibration, and proper scoring rules.

entry.title: Learning Generative Dynamics with Soft Law Constraints: A McKean-Vlasov FBSDE Approach

author.name: Samer El Boustany, Samy Mekkaoui, Yadh Hafsi, Alexandre Alouadi, Huy\^en Pham

entry.summary: Proposes a generative framework for learning stochastic dynamics from distributional observations by formulating generation as a McKean-Vlasov control problem with soft law constraints, solved via forward-backward SDEs.

entry.title: The Pragmatic Interpretability Trap

author.name: Yogesh Prabhu

entry.summary: Critiques 'pragmatic interpretability' arguing it creates a trap where interpretability methods are judged against black-box baselines that don't pay the overhead cost, causing the metric scorecard to dominate the understanding scorecard.

entry.title: Political Plasticity: An Analysis of Ideological Adaptability in Large Language Models

author.name: Bruno Bianchi, Diego Tiscornia, Matias Travizano, Ariel Futoransky

entry.summary: Studies 'political plasticity' - the capacity of LLMs to adapt political stances based on context - using 200 politically-oriented questions across economic and personal freedom axes. Tests various methods to induce political bias.

entry.title: Results and Retrospective Analysis of the CODS 2025 AssetOpsBench Challenge

author.name: Dhaval Patel, Chathurangi Shyalika, Suryanarayana Reddy Yarrabothula, Ling Yue, Shuxin Lin, Nianjun Zhou, James Rayfield

entry.summary: Retrospective analysis of the CODS 2025 AssetOpsBench Challenge on industrial multi-agent orchestration, finding that public leaderboard saturates and hidden evaluation changes conclusions about system quality.

entry.title: Open Ontologies: Tool-Augmented Ontology Engineering with Stable Matching Alignment

author.name: Fabio Rovai

entry.summary: Presents Open Ontologies, a Rust-based ontology engineering system integrating LLM-driven construction with OWL reasoning via Model Context Protocol. Key finding: stable 1-to-1 matching dominates alignment quality (F1=0.832 on OAEI Anatomy).

entry.title: A Prompt-Aware Structuring Framework for Reliable Reuse of AI-Generated Content in the Agentic Web

author.name: Shusaku Egami, Masahiro Hamasaki

entry.summary: Presents a framework for automatically attaching structured metadata to AI-generated content at generation time, including prompt conditions and provenance information. Addresses reliability and reproducibility for the 'Agentic Web'.

entry.title: Weighted Rules under the Stable Model Semantics

author.name: Joohyung Lee, Yi Wang

entry.summary: Introduces weighted rules under stable model semantics following Markov Logic, enabling probabilistic reasoning, inconsistency resolution, and stable model ranking in answer set programs.

entry.title: UTS at PsyDefDetect: Multi-Agent Councils and Absence-Based Reasoning for Defense Mechanism Classification

author.name: Dima Galat, Marian-Andrei Rizoiu

entry.summary: Classifies psychological defense mechanisms in dialogues using multi-agent councils of Gemini agents. Key insight: defense mechanisms are defined by absence (missing affect, blocked cognition). Placed 2nd among 64 teams.

entry.title: EGL-SCA: Structural Credit Assignment for Co-Evolving Instructions and Tools in Graph Reasoning Agents

author.name: Zike Yuan, Yukun Cao, Han Zhang, Jianzhi Yan, Le Liu, Cai ke, Yue Yu, Hui Wang, Ming Liu, Bing Qin

entry.summary: Proposes EGL-SCA, a framework for graph reasoning agents that co-evolves instruction-side policies and tool-side programs with structural credit assignment. Uses a verifier-centric approach to determine what should be updated after failures.

entry.title: Agentic Performance at the Edge: Insights from Benchmarking

author.name: Shiqiang Wang, Herbert Woisetschl\"ager

entry.summary: Empirically studies how agentic task quality degrades when model size is constrained for edge deployment (~8B parameters). Evaluates general-purpose versus coder-oriented models and tool-enabled execution under fixed protocols.

entry.title: diffGHOST: Diffusion based Generative Hedged Oblivious Synthetic Trajectories

author.name: Florent Gu\'epin, Cheick Tidiani Cisse, Denis Renaud, Fran\c{c}ois Bidet, Arnaud Legendre

entry.summary: Introduces diffGHOST, a conditional diffusion model for generating synthetic mobility trajectories with differential privacy guarantees. Uses latent space segmentation to identify and mitigate memorization of critical samples.

entry.title: PathISE: Learning Informative Path Supervision for Knowledge Graph Question Answering

author.name: Shengxiang Gao, Chao Lei, Jey Han Lau, Jianzhong Qi

entry.summary: Proposes PathISE for knowledge graph question answering that learns high-quality intermediate supervision from answer-level labels only. Uses a lightweight transformer estimator to score relation path informativeness.

entry.title: Neuroscience-Inspired Analyses of Visual Interestingness in Multimodal Transformers

author.name: Mathis Immertreu, Fitim Abdullahu, Thomas Kinfe, Helmut Grabner, Patrick Krauss, Achim Schilling

entry.summary: Analyzes how multimodal transformers encode visual interestingness using neuroscience-inspired probing on Qwen3-VL-8B, examining whether they capture principles of human interest or merely exploit correlations.

entry.title: FairHealth: An Open-Source Python Library for Trustworthy Healthcare AI in Low-Resource Settings

author.name: Farjana Yesmin

entry.summary: Presents FairHealth, an open-source Python library for trustworthy healthcare AI in low-resource settings, integrating fairness auditing, federated learning, and explainability tools focused on Global South datasets.

entry.title: Research on Security Enhancement Methods for Adversarial Robust Large Language Model Intelligent Agents for Medical Decision-Making Tasks

author.name: Saisai Hu

entry.summary: Develops a security enhancement framework for medical decision-making LLM agents with multi-module collaborative defense against adversarial attacks, combining robustness, safety refusal, and knowledge consistency.

entry.title: A Paired Point-of-Care Ultrasound Dataset for Image Quality Enhancement and Benchmarking via a cGAN Baseline

author.name: Lennard M. van Karnenbeek, Hilde G. A. van der Pol, Mark Wijkhuizen, Eva Poelman, Caroline A. Drukker, Theo Ruers, Freija Geldof, Behdad Dashtbozorg

entry.summary: Creates the first accurately paired dataset of low-end point-of-care ultrasound and high-end ultrasound images using an automated gantry, and applies a cGAN (pix2pix) baseline for image quality enhancement. Demonstrates improved image quality metrics on 1064 paired image sets.

entry.title: What Cohort INRs Encode and Where to Freeze Them

author.name: Vasiliki Sideri-Lampretsa, Sophie Starck, Robbie Holland, Julian McGinnis, Daniel Rueckert

entry.summary: Investigates which layers of cohort-trained implicit neural representations (INRs) learn transferable representations and what they encode, finding that the optimal freeze depth coincides with the layer of highest weight stable rank.

entry.title: Magis-Bench: Evaluating LLMs on Magistrate-Level Legal Tasks

author.name: Ramon Pires, Thales Sales Almeida, Celio Larcher Junior, Giovana Bon\'as, Hugo Abonizio, Marcos Piau, Roseval Malaquias Junior, Thiago Laitz, Rodrigo Nogueira

entry.summary: Introduces Magis-Bench for evaluating LLMs on magistrate-level legal tasks from Brazilian judicial examinations, testing both legal analysis and composition of legal documents.

entry.title: PromptDx: Differentiable Prompt Tuning for Multimodal In-Context Alzheimer's Diagnosis

author.name: Lujia Zhong, Yihao Xia, Shuo Huang, Jianwei Zhang, Yonggang Shi

entry.summary: Proposes PromptDx for multimodal Alzheimer's diagnosis using differentiable prompt tuning for in-context learning, mimicking clinical analogical reasoning by referencing similar patient records.

entry.title: Fitting Multilinear Polynomials for Logic Gate Networks

author.name: Youngsung Kim

entry.summary: Studies learnable logic gate networks as combinational circuits, framing 2-input Boolean gate training as a vector-quantization problem in a 4D coefficient space. Proves limitations of existing softmax-based approaches and proposes soft-VQ selection to fix gradient issues.

entry.title: Narrative Landscape: Mapping Narrative Dispositions Across LLMs

author.name: Donghoon Jung, Jiwoo Choi, Songeun Chae, Seohyon Jung

entry.summary: Proposes a quantitative framework for profiling LLM dispositions through structured narrative tasks, measuring consistency and diversity across six frontier models. Introduces 'Narrative Landscape' PCA visualization for cross-model comparison.

entry.title: Shapley Regression for Rare Disease Diagnosis Support: a case study on APDS

author.name: Safa Alsaidi, Tom\'as Brogueira, Nizar Mahlaoui, Marc Vincent, Guilherme Pelegrina, Nicolas Garcelon, Adrien Coulet, Miguel Couceiro

entry.summary: Proposes Shapley regression for rare disease diagnosis of APDS, replacing linear predictors with a k-additive cooperative game that models symptom co-occurrence interactions while maintaining interpretability.

entry.title: Monocular Biomechanical Tracking of Fingers with Inverse Kinematics to Foundation Models

author.name: R. James Cotton, Pouyan Firouzabadi, Wendy Murray

entry.summary: Combines the SAM 3D Body foundation model with inverse kinematics optimization in MuJoCo for extracting biomechanically-constrained finger joint angles from single-view video. Ports to JAX for GPU-accelerated optimization.

entry.title: EduStory: A Unified Framework for Pedagogically-Consistent Multi-Shot STEM Instructional Video Generation

author.name: Xinyi Wu, Jayant Teotia, Shuai Zhao, Erik Cambria

entry.summary: EduStory is a framework for generating pedagogically-consistent multi-shot STEM instructional videos with persistent knowledge state tracking, structured narrative control, and learning-oriented evaluation metrics.

entry.title: AtteConDA: Attention-Based Conflict Suppression in Multi-Condition Diffusion Models and Synthetic Data Augmentation

author.name: Shogo Noguchi

entry.summary: AtteConDA addresses conflict between multiple conditions in diffusion-based image generation for driving scene augmentation using attention-based conflict suppression, preserving high-level scene structure.

entry.title: CTQWformer: A CTQW-based Transformer for Graph Classification

author.name: Zhan Li, Wuqing Yu, Yusen Wu, Chuan Wang

entry.summary: CTQWformer integrates continuous-time quantum walks with GNNs for graph classification, using a trainable Hamiltonian to model quantum walk dynamics capturing graph structure information.

entry.title: Trajectory Supervision for Continual Tool-Use Learning in LLMs

author.name: Vishnu Vardhan Reddy, Sagnik Chatterjee, Soumik Bhatta

entry.summary: Studies whether keeping full tool-use trajectories (vs. stripping intermediate API traces) helps when fine-tuning LLMs for continual tool learning. Shows trajectory context significantly improves accuracy (56.9% vs 39.2%).

entry.title: Multi-Tier Labeling and Physics-Informed Learning for Orbital Anomaly Detection at Scale

author.name: Yong Fu

entry.summary: Presents a multi-tier labeling cascade combining physics rules, Kalman filtering, and LLM-based annotation for orbital anomaly detection across LEO satellites, addressing the fundamental bottleneck of label scarcity.

entry.title: NaiAD: Initiate Data-Driven Research for LLM Advertising

author.name: Yihang Zhang, Zimeng Huang, Ren Zhai, Yipeng Kang, Tonghan Wang

entry.summary: Introduces NaiAD, the first comprehensive dataset for LLM-native advertising with 58,999 ad-embedded responses, organized around metrics that separately capture user and commercial utility.

entry.title: Geometric 4D Stitching for Grounded 4D Generation

author.name: Sunwoo Park, Taesung Kwon, Jong Chul Ye

entry.summary: Proposes Geometric 4D Stitching for 4D scene generation that explicitly identifies missing geometric regions and fills them with geometrically grounded patches, avoiding expensive radiance-based optimization.

entry.title: A Comparative Study of Machine Learning and Deep Learning for Out-of-Distribution Detection

author.name: Jihyeon Baek, Seunghoon Lee, Gitaek Kwon, Doohyun Park

entry.summary: Compares traditional ML and deep learning for out-of-distribution detection in medical imaging, finding both achieve near-perfect performance on standardized medical image data, questioning the necessity of DL for this specific task.

entry.title: Developing a foundation model for high-resolution remote sensing data of the Netherlands

author.name: Paul Vermeeren, Heysem Kaya

entry.summary: Develops a foundation model for high-resolution satellite images of the Netherlands combining CNNs and Vision Transformers, leveraging temporal data for improved representation learning with fewer labeled samples.

entry.title: Can Language Models Analyze Data? Evaluating Large Language Models for Question Answering over Datasets

author.name: Andreas Xenofontos, Pavlos Fafalios

entry.summary: Evaluates LLM effectiveness in answering questions over datasets both directly and via SQL generation, comparing state-of-the-art and smaller models across different prompting strategies.

entry.title: An agentic framework for gravitational-wave counterpart association in the multi-messenger era

author.name: Yiming Dong, Yacheng Kang, Junjie Zhao, Xinyuan Zhu, Ziming Wang, Lijing Shao

entry.summary: Develops an agentic framework for associating gravitational wave signals with electromagnetic counterparts, addressing scalability challenges from next-generation detectors.

entry.title: An Uncertainty-Aware Resilience Micro-Agent for Causal Observability in the Computing Continuum

author.name: Suvi De Silva, Alfreds Lapkovskis, Alaa Saleh, Sasu Tarkoma, Praveen Kumar Donta

entry.summary: Presents AURORA, a lightweight framework for diagnosing grey failures in edge computing using micro-agents that integrate the free-energy principle, causal do-calculus, and localized causal state-graphs for counterfactual root-cause analysis.

entry.title: Geospatial-Temporal Sensemaking of Remote Sensing Activity Detections with Multimodal Large Language Model

author.name: David F. Ramirez, Tim Overman, Kristen Jaskie, Andreas Spanias

entry.summary: Introduces SMART-HC-VQA, a Sentinel-2 satellite imagery VQA dataset for spatiotemporal analysis of construction activity, transforming existing annotations into natural language QA format.

entry.title: Geometry-free prediction of inertial lift forces in microfluidic devices using deep learning

author.name: Jesse Ward-Bond, Ali Mashadian, Timothy C. Y. Chan, Edmond W. K. Young

entry.summary: Develops a geometry-free deep learning approach for predicting particle lift forces in microfluidic devices that works across arbitrary channel cross-sections without retraining per geometry.

entry.title: Block-Wise Differentiable Sinkhorn Attention: Tail-Refinement Gradients with a Gap-Aware Dustbin Bridge

author.name: Dylan Forde

entry.summary: Studies long-context optimal transport attention on TPU hardware through a stopped-base, fixed-depth tail-refinement surrogate with block-wise implementation for Sinkhorn attention.

entry.title: A PyTorch Library of Turing-Complete Neural Networks

author.name: Jonathan Bates

entry.summary: Presents a PyTorch package that compiles neural networks from Turing machine descriptions, implementing both transformer and RNN architectures that exactly simulate specified machines without training.

entry.title: Learngene Search Across Multiple Datasets for Building Variable-Sized Models

author.name: Boyu Shi, Junbo Zhou, Chang Liu, Xu Yang, Qiufeng Wang, Xin Geng

entry.summary: Proposes LSAMD for extracting transferable learngene components across multiple datasets to initialize variable-sized descendant models, expanding beyond single-dataset learngene extraction.

entry.title: Hierarchical Multi-Fidelity Learning for Predicting Three-Dimensional Flame Wrinkling and Turbulent Burning Velocity

author.name: Saghar Zolfaghari, Yu Xie, Junfeng Yang, Safa Jamali

entry.summary: Develops hierarchical multi-fidelity neural networks integrating sparse high-fidelity experimental data with structured low-fidelity representations for predicting turbulent flame properties.

entry.title: A Deep Risk Estimator for Known Operator Learning

author.name: Andreas Maier, Md Hasan, Paulina Conrad, Paula Andrea Perez-Toro

entry.summary: Derives a deep risk estimator for networks with mixed learned and known operators, showing that replacing learned layers with known operators provably reduces the risk bound.

entry.title: MicroFuse: Protein-to-Genome Expert Fusion for Microbial Operon Reasoning

author.name: Seungik Cho

entry.summary: Proposes MicroFuse for predicting microbial operon co-membership by fusing protein-scale and genome-context representations through a conflict-aware expert fusion mechanism.

entry.title: Non-Parametric Rehearsal Learning via Conditional Mean Embeddings

author.name: Wen-Bo Du, Tian-Zuo Wang, Han-Jia Ye, Zhi-Hua Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes the first non-parametric rehearsal learning approach for the 'avoiding undesired future' problem using kernel conditional mean embeddings, removing restrictive parametric assumptions like linearity or additive noise.

entry.title: DiffATS: Diffusion in Aligned Tensor Space

author.name: Jinhua Lyu, Tianmin Yu, Brian Kim, Lizhuo Zhou, Chanwook Park, Naichen Shi

entry.summary: Proposes DiffATS for spatiotemporal diffusion modeling using Tucker decomposition with orthogonal Procrustes alignment to resolve non-uniqueness of factors. Enables parameter-efficient diffusion without pretrained compression.

entry.title: Adversary-Robust Learning from Fully Asynchronous Directional Derivative Estimates

author.name: Anik Kumar Paul, Nibedita Roy, Nagesh Talagani, Swetha Ganesh, Gugan Thoppe, Alexandre Reiffers-Masson

entry.summary: Proposes FAR-SIGN for adversary-resilient distributed optimization using sign-based updates with two-timescale bias correction. Supports both first-order and zeroth-order implementations with fully asynchronous execution.

entry.title: When Adaptation Fails: A Gradient-Based Diagnosis of Collapsed Gating in Vision-Language Prompt Learning

author.name: Yunxuan Fang, Ziwei Zhang, Xinhe Wang

entry.summary: Systematically diagnoses why adaptive prompting mechanisms collapse in frozen few-shot CLIP-based prompt learning. Identifies gradient magnitude imbalance and gate degradation as recurring failure modes.

entry.title: On Uniform Error Bounds for Kernel Regression under Non-Gaussian Noise

author.name: Johannes Teutsch, Oleksii Molodchyk, Marion Leibold, Timm Faulwasser, Armin Lederer

entry.summary: Derives novel non-asymptotic probabilistic uniform error bounds for kernel regression under non-Gaussian noise including sub-exponential and bounded distributions, extending beyond the standard sub-Gaussian assumption to correlated noise.

entry.title: From Syntax to Semantics: Unveiling the Emergence of Chirality in SMILES Translation Models

author.name: Zehao Li, Yasuhiro Yoshikai, Shumpei Nemoto, Hiroyuki Kusuhara, Tadahaya Mizuno

entry.summary: Studies how chemical language models learn chirality during SMILES translation training, revealing distinct learning phases and showing that chiral awareness emerges abruptly as a phase transition during training.

entry.title: Unveiling High-Probability Generalization in Decentralized SGD

author.name: Jiahuan Wang, Ping Luo, Ziqing Wen, Dongsheng Li, Tao Sun

entry.summary: Develops high-probability generalization bounds for decentralized SGD that close the gap with centralized SGD bounds, achieving optimal O(1/√(mn) log(1/δ)) rates.

entry.title: Sample-Mean Anchored Thompson Sampling for Offline-to-Online Learning with Distribution Shift

author.name: Bochao Li, Yao Fu, Wei Chen, Fang Kong

entry.summary: Develops Sample-Mean Anchored Thompson Sampling for offline-to-online bandits under distribution shift, addressing the challenge that posterior samples in TS aren't guaranteed optimistic unlike UCB indices.

entry.title: Causal Explanations from the Geometric Properties of ReLU Neural Networks

author.name: Hector Woods, Philippa Ryan, Rob Alexander

entry.summary: Proposes causal explanations from the geometric properties of ReLU networks directly, without model distillation, using the piecewise-linear structure to provide why/why-not explanations for autonomous system policies.

entry.title: AxiomOcean: Forecasting the Three-Dimensional Structure of the Upper Ocean

author.name: Sensen Wu, Yifan Chen, Guantao Pu, Xiaoyao Sun, Yijun Chen, Jin Qi, Ming Kong, Keyi Yang, Lichen Xu, Wenguan Wang, Xiaofeng Li, Zhenhong Du

entry.summary: Presents AxiomOcean, a global AI ocean forecasting model that explicitly represents vertical hierarchy in the water column, jointly predicting upper-ocean temperature, salinity, and currents with 3D structure preservation.

entry.title: Neural Posterior Estimation of Terrain Parameters from Radar Sounder Data

author.name: Jordy Dal Corso, Annalena Kofler, Marco Cortellazzi, Lorenzo Bruzzone, Bernhard Sch\"olkopf

entry.summary: Applies simulation-based inference with neural posterior estimation for inverting terrain parameters from radar sounder data, using GPU-based simulation and neural density estimation. Enables systematic evaluation of posterior correlations and noise effects.

entry.title: Non-intrusive Body Composition Assessment from Full-body mmWave Scans

author.name: Miriam Senne, Benjamin D. Killeen, Tony Wang, Nassir Navab

entry.summary: Explores using millimeter wave (mmWave) radar scans for non-intrusive body composition assessment, showing ML can estimate tissue distributions from security-style body scans as an alternative to CT/MRI.

entry.title: Learning Pure Quantum States in Any Dimension (Almost) Without Regret

author.name: Josep Lumbreras, Marco Tomamichel

entry.summary: Extends quantum state tomography with minimal cumulative disturbance to arbitrary finite-dimensional pure states, overcoming limitations of qubit-specific Bloch sphere methods by working locally on the pure-state manifold.

entry.title: Nonlinear GENERIC Informed Neural Networks (N-GINNs): learning GENERIC dynamics with non-quadratic dissipation potentials

author.name: Vojt\v{e}ch Votruba, Zequn He, Weilun Qiu, Celia Reina, Michal Pavelka

entry.summary: Introduces N-GINNs, a deep learning framework for discovering thermodynamically consistent evolution equations with non-quadratic dissipation potentials using the GENERIC formalism.

entry.title: PGID: Progressive Guided Inversion and Denoising for Robust Watermark Detection

author.name: Minh Quoc Duong, Chun Tong Lei, Chun Pong Lau

entry.summary: Proposes PGID for robust watermark detection in diffusion-model-generated images, addressing vulnerabilities where attacks displace watermarked latents into unwatermarked regions.

entry.title: Learning stochastic multiscale models through normalizing flows

author.name: Anan Saha, Arnab Ganguly

entry.summary: Develops a data-driven framework using normalizing flows to learn effective stochastic dynamics of slow variables from a single observed trajectory of multiscale systems.

entry.title: Deep Learning under Fractional-Order Differential Privacy

author.name: Mohammad Partohaghighi, Roummel Marcia

entry.summary: Already analyzed above.

entry.title: MultiSoc-4D: A Benchmark for Diagnosing Instruction-Induced Label Collapse in Closed-Set LLM Annotation of Bengali Social Media

author.name: Souvik Pramanik, S. M. Riaz Rahman Antu, Shak Mohammad Abyad, Md. Ibrahim Khalil, Md. Shahriar Hussain

entry.title: GRaSp: Automatic Example Optimization for In-Context Learning in Low-Data Tasks

entry.title: Is Class Signal Clustered or Routed in Task-Induced Implicit Neural Representation Weight Spaces?

entry.title: A Two-Stage Motion-Aware Framework for mmWave-based Human Mesh Recovery

author.name: Hoang Hai Pham, Shuntian Zheng, Jiaqi Li, Yu Guan

entry.title: IPAD-CLIP: Teaching CLIP to Detect Image Local Perceptual Artifacts

author.name: Juan Wang, Xinyu Sun, Ke Zhang, Jin Wang, Bing Li, Weiming Hu, Liang Wang

entry.title: ProDG: Prototypes for Data-Free Generative Post-Hoc Explainability

entry.title: Semantic Alignment in Hyperbolic Space for Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation

entry.title: KEPIL: Knowledge-Enhanced Prompt-Image Learning for Prompt-Robust Disease Detection

author.name: Haozhe Luo, Shelley Zixin Shu, Ziyu Zhou, Robert Berke, Mauricio Reyes

entry.title: Noise-Started One-Step Real-World Super-Resolution via LR-Conditioned SplitMeanFlow and GAN Refinement

author.name: Wei Zhu, Kai Zhang, Yu Zheng, Lei Luo, Yong Guo, Jian Yang

entry.title: PermuQuant: Lowering Per-Group Quantization Error by Reordering Channels for Diffusion Models

entry.title: BEA-GS: BEyond RAdiance Supervision in 3DGS for Precise Object Extraction

entry.title: ConFixGS: Learning to Fix Feedforward 3D Gaussian Splatting with Confidence-Aware Diffusion Priors in Driving Scenes

entry.title: Learning to Align Generative Appearance Priors for Fine-grained Image Retrieval

author.name: Shijie Wang, Yadan Luo, Zijian Wang, Xin Yu, Zi Huang

entry.title: Adversarial Attacks Against MLLMs via Progressive Resolution Processing and Adaptive Feature Alignment

entry.title: Towards Generalist Game Players: An Investigation of Foundation Models in the Game Multiverse

entry.title: Slum Detection and Density Mapping with AlphaEarth Foundations: A Representation Learning Evaluation Across 12 Global Cities

author.name: Shuyang Hou, Ziqi Liu, Haoyue Jiao, Zhangyan Xu, Xiaopu Zhang, Lutong Xie, Yaxian Qing, Jianyuan Liang, Xuefeng Guan, Huayi Wua

author.name: Hrishikesh Dutta, Roberto Minerva, Reza Farahbakhsh, Noel Crespi

entry.title: Assessment of RAG and Fine-Tuning for Industrial Question-Answering-Applications

author.name: Xiangkai Wang, Yun Zhao, Dongyi He, Qingling Xia, Gen Li, Xinlai Xing, Yuchi Pan, Bin Jiang

entry.title: Measuring Embedding Sensitivity to Authorial Style in French: Comparing Literary Texts with Language Model Rewritings
