author.name: Vihaan Nama, Shreya Mendi, Zian Ye, Brinnae Bent

entry.summary: Introduces When2Speak, a synthetic dataset of 215,000+ examples for learning intervention timing in multi-party conversations, modeling SPEAK vs. SILENT decisions across diverse conversational dynamics.

entry.title: Lightweight Stylistic Consistency Profiling: Robust Detection of LLM-Generated Textual Content for Multimedia Moderation

author.name: Siyuan Li, Aodu Wulianghai, Xi Lin, Xibin Yuan, Qinghua Mao, Guangyan Li, Xiang Chen, Jun Wu, Jianhua Li

entry.summary: Proposes LiSCP, a lightweight method for detecting LLM-generated text using stylistic consistency profiling that combines discrete stylistic features with continuous semantic signals, designed for robustness against adversarial manipulation.

entry.title: From Articles to Premises: Building PrimeFacts, an Extraction Methodology and Resource for Fact-Checking Evidence

author.name: Premtim Sahitaj, Jawan Kolanowski, Ariana Sahitaj, Veronika Solopova, Max Upravitelev, Daniel R\"oder, Iffat Maab, Junichi Yamagishi, Sebastian M\"oller, Vera Schmitt

entry.summary: Presents PrimeFacts, a methodology for extracting fine-grained evidence from fact-checking articles using LLMs to rewrite anchor sentences into standalone premises, compiled from 13,106 PolitiFact articles.

entry.title: HNC: Leveraging Hard Negative Captions towards Models with Fine-Grained Visual-Linguistic Comprehension Capabilities

author.name: Esra D\"onmez, Pascal Tilli, Hsiu-Yu Yang, Thang Vu, Carina Silberer

entry.summary: Proposes Hard Negative Captions (HNC), automatically created foiled captions for image-text matching training to achieve fine-grained cross-modal comprehension, with a manually-created test set for benchmarking.

entry.title: Who and What? Using Linguistic Features and Annotator Characteristics to Analyze Annotation Variation

author.name: Maximilian Maurer, Maximilian Linde, Gabriella Lapesa

entry.summary: Analyzes how linguistic properties of items interact with annotator characteristics to explain annotation variation in harmful language detection datasets, providing the first large-scale analysis across four reference datasets.

entry.title: Anatomy of a Query: W5H Dimensions and FAR Patterns for Text-to-SQL Evaluation

author.name: Vicki Stover Hertzberg, Eduardo Valverde, Joyce C. Ho

entry.summary: Proposes QUEST framework for evaluating text-to-SQL systems based on the FAR structural invariant (Filter/Aggregate/Return) and W5H semantic dimensions, validated across 120,464 queries from five datasets.

entry.title: Safety-Critical Camera Reliability Monitoring for ADAS via Degradation-Aware Uncertainty Pattern Analysis

author.name: Shiva Aher

entry.summary: Proposes a proactive camera reliability monitoring framework for ADAS that estimates perception risk from degradation-induced uncertainty patterns before downstream failures occur, using a Global Sensor Health Index.

entry.title: AffectSeek: Agentic Affective Understanding in Long Videos under Vague User Queries

author.name: Zhen Zhang, Yuhang Yang, Yunxiang Jiang, Yuhuan Lu, Haifeng Lu, Zheng Lian, Runhao Zeng, Xiping Hu

entry.summary: Introduces VQAU (Vague-Query-driven video Affective Understanding), a new task requiring models to localize affective moments in long videos under vague natural language queries. Proposes AffectSeek, an agentic approach to this task.

entry.title: RAWild: Sensor-Agnostic RAW Object Detection via Physics-Guided Curve and Grid Modeling

author.name: Shuhong Liu, Gengjia Chang, Jun Liu, Xuangeng Chu, Yinqiang Zheng, Tatsuya Harada, Ziteng Cui

entry.summary: Proposes RAWild for sensor-agnostic RAW object detection using physics-guided global-local tone mapping. Addresses the larger domain gaps in RAW data compared to sRGB across different sensors.

entry.title: Continuous Expert Assembly: Instance-Conditioned Low-Rank Residuals for All-in-One Image Restoration

author.name: Haisen He, Xiangyu Zou, SongLin Dong, Heng Li, Yihong Gong, Zhiheng Ma

entry.summary: Proposes Continuous Expert Assembly (CEA), a token-wise dynamic parameterization framework for all-in-one image restoration that generates instance-conditioned low-rank residuals for each token based on its local degradation pattern.

entry.title: Differentiable Adaptive 4D Structured Illumination for Joint Capture of Shape and Reflectance

author.name: Huakeng Ding, Yaowen Chen, Kun Zhou, Hongzhi Wu

entry.summary: Presents a differentiable framework for adaptively computing 4D structured illumination conditions to efficiently capture both shape and reflectance simultaneously using a single camera and spatial-angular structured light.

entry.title: The frame-level leakage trap: rethinking evaluation protocols for intrinsic image decomposition, with source-separable uncertainty as a case study

author.name: Jihwan Woo

entry.summary: Quantifies for the first time that frame-level data splits in intrinsic image decomposition inflate test metrics by 1.6-2.0 dB, demonstrating an architecture-independent protocol effect and advocating for scene-level splits.

entry.title: Passive Fault Tolerance through Tension-to-Thrust Feed-Forward: Hybrid Input-to-State Stability for Decentralized Multi-UAV Slung-Load Transport under Abrupt Cable Severance

author.name: Hadi Hajieghrary, Paul Schmitt

entry.summary: Presents a decentralized passive fault tolerance architecture for multi-UAV slung-load transport that routes cable tension directly into altitude thrust commands, with formal hybrid ISS stability certificates for abrupt cable severance.

entry.title: CKT-WAM: Parameter-Efficient Context Knowledge Transfer Between World Action Models

author.name: Yuhua Jiang, Yijun Guo, Hongbing Yang, Guojun Lei, Nuo Chen, Yinuo Zhang, Shaoqiang Yan, Bo Lin, Feifei Gao, Biqing Qi

entry.summary: Proposes CKT-WAM, a parameter-efficient framework for transferring knowledge between heterogeneous World Action Models by embedding teacher knowledge as compact context in text embedding space rather than through output imitation. Uses learnable-query cross attention for token compression.

entry.title: StableI2I: Spotting Unintended Changes in Image-to-Image Transition

author.name: Jiayang Li, Shuo Cao, Xiaohui Li, Zhizhen Zhang, Kaiwen Zhu, Yule Duan, Yu Qiao, Jian Zhang, Yihao Liu

entry.summary: Proposes StableI2I, an evaluation framework for image-to-image tasks that measures content fidelity and spatial consistency between input and output images without requiring reference images, addressing a gap in existing I2I evaluation.

entry.title: DiffCap-Bench: A Comprehensive, Challenging, Robust Benchmark for Image Difference Captioning

author.name: Yuancheng Wei, Haojie Zhang, Linli Yao, Lei Li, Jiali Chen, Tao Huang, Yiting Lu, Duojun Huang, Xin Li, Zhao Zhong

entry.summary: Introduces DiffCap-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark for image difference captioning covering ten difference categories, with new metrics that better capture semantic consistency and penalize hallucinations compared to standard lexical-overlap metrics.

entry.title: SADE: Symptom-Aware Diagnostic Escalation for LLM-Based Network Troubleshooting

author.name: Kuan-Hao Tseng, Niruth Bogahawatta, Yasod Ginige, Kosta Dekic, Arunan Sivanathan, Suranga Seneviratne

entry.summary: Presents SADE, an LLM-based network troubleshooting agent that encodes Cisco's layer-by-layer troubleshooting methodology as an explicit policy with phase-gated diagnostic workflows, separating evidence acquisition from hypothesis commitment.

entry.title: Delta-Based Neural Architecture Search: LLM Fine-Tuning via Code Diffs

author.name: Santosh Premi Adhikari, Radu Timofte, Dmitry Ignatov

entry.summary: Proposes Delta-Code Generation where LLMs generate compact unified diffs to refine baseline architectures rather than synthesizing entire models from scratch, evaluated on three 7B-class LLMs across six datasets.

entry.title: Bayesian Rain Field Reconstruction using Commercial Microwave Links and Diffusion Model Priors

author.name: Badr Moufad, Albina Ilina, Hai Victor Habi, Salem Lahlou, Yazid Janati, Hagit Messer, Eric Moulines

entry.summary: Uses diffusion models as spatial priors for Bayesian inverse problems to reconstruct rain fields from commercial microwave link measurements. Shows diffusion models better preserve rainfall statistics compared to Gaussian processes.

entry.title: Budgeted Attention Allocation: Cost-Conditioned Compute Control for Efficient Transformers

author.name: Amrit Nidhi

entry.summary: Studies budgeted attention allocation via monotone head-gating conditioned on requested attention budget, enabling multiple cost-quality operating points from a single trained model.

entry.title: SOPE: Stabilizing Off-Policy Evaluation for Online RL with Prior Data

author.name: Carlo Romeo, Girolamo Macaluso, Alessandro Sestini, Andrew D. Bagdanov

entry.summary: Proposes SOPE, which uses off-policy evaluation as an automated early-stopping mechanism for the offline pre-training phase in online RL with prior data, replacing manual tuning of stabilization phases.

entry.title: Physical Fidelity Reconstruction via Improved Consistency-Distilled Flow Matching for Dynamical Systems

author.name: Sicheng Ma, Tianyue Yang, Xiuzhe Wu, Xiao Xue

entry.summary: Distills a flow-matching model into a one-step consistency model for fast scientific flow reconstruction, incorporating low-fidelity observations by initializing from noised observations along the transport path.

entry.title: Towards Self-Explainable Document Visual Question Answering with Chain-of-Explanation Predictions

author.name: Kjetil Indrehus, Adrian Duric, Changkyu Choi, Ali Ramezani-Kebrya

entry.summary: Proposes CoExVQA, a self-explainable Document VQA framework with chain-of-explanation design that first identifies evidence, then localizes answer regions, and decodes answers from grounded regions.

entry.title: Perceive, Route and Modulate: Dynamic Pattern Recalibration for Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Siru Zhong, Zhao Meng, Haohuan Fu, Haoyang Li, Qingsong Wen, Yuxuan Liang

entry.summary: Introduces Dynamic Pattern Recalibration (DPR), a backbone-agnostic mechanism for time series forecasting that applies token-level recalibration through a Perceive-Route-Modulate pipeline to adapt to shifting local temporal patterns.

entry.title: Data-Driven Covariate Selection for Nonparametric and Cycle-Agnostic Causal Effect Estimation

author.name: Ana Leticia Garcez Vicente, Gijs van Seeventer, Saber Salehkaleybar

entry.summary: Studies data-driven covariate selection for causal effect estimation, extending soundness and completeness guarantees from acyclic to cyclic causal models using conditional independence tests.

entry.title: Invariant Features in Language Models: Geometric Characterization and Model Attribution

author.name: Agnibh Dasgupta, Abdullah Tanvir, Xin Zhong

entry.summary: Proposes a geometric framework for characterizing invariant features in language models, using contrastive subspace discovery to separate semantic-changing from semantic-preserving variation, with application to zero-shot model attribution.

entry.title: When Does Trimming Help Conformal Prediction? A Retained-Law Diagnostic under Calibration Contamination

author.name: Congye Wang

entry.summary: Analyzes when trimming suspicious calibration points helps conformal prediction under contamination, providing exact finite-sample identities and a diagnostic that separates clean-side covariance cost from retained-contamination cost.

entry.title: Independent Learning of Nash Equilibria in Partially Observable Markov Potential Games with Decoupled Dynamics

author.name: Philip Jordan, Maryam Kamgarpour

entry.summary: Presents an independent learning algorithm for Nash equilibrium in partially observable Markov potential games with decoupled dynamics, achieving convergence without centralization or exponential scaling in player count.

entry.title: Zero-Shot Satellite Image Retrieval through Joint Embeddings: Application to Crisis Response

author.name: James Walsh, William Fawcett, Grace Colvard, Ra\'ul Ramos-Poll\'an

entry.summary: Presents GeoQuery, a zero-shot satellite image retrieval system using prompt-aligned text proxies generated for a subset of tiles, enabling natural language search of Earth observation archives without paired training data.

entry.title: Uncertainty-Guided Edge Learning for Deep Image Regression in Remote Sensing

author.name: Anh Vu Nguyen, Dino Sejdinovic, Tat-Jun Chin

entry.summary: Proposes uncertainty-guided edge learning for satellite-deployed deep image regression, enabling efficient model updating on resource-constrained edge devices by prioritizing uncertain samples.

entry.title: CFE-PPAR: Compression-friendly encryption for privacy-preserving action recognition leveraging video transformers

author.name: Haiwei Lin, Shoko Imaizumi, Hitoshi Kiya

entry.summary: Proposes CFE-PPAR, the first compression-friendly encryption method for privacy-preserving action recognition, enabling encrypted videos to maintain recognition performance and visual quality after compression.

entry.title: Architecture-agnostic Lipschitz-constant Bayesian header and its application to resolve semantically proximal classification errors with vision transformers

author.name: Frederik Sch\"afer, Luis Mandl, Lars K\"alber, Tim Ricken

entry.summary: Proposes LipB-ViT, an architecture-agnostic Lipschitz-constant Bayesian header for vision transformers that addresses structured label noise through spectral normalization on variational weights.

entry.title: AI-Generated Images: What Humans and Machines See When They Look at the Same Image

author.name: Silvia Poletti, Justin Ilyes, Marcel Hasenbalg, David Fischinger, Martin Boyer

entry.summary: Investigates how AI-generated image detectors can provide human-understandable explanations, integrating 16 XAI methods into detection frameworks and evaluating through a human-centered approach.

entry.title: FreeSpec: Training-Free Long Video Generation via Singular-Spectrum Reconstruction

author.name: Fangda Chen, Shanshan Zhao, Longrong Yang, Chuanfu Xu, Zhigang Luo, Long Lan

entry.summary: FreeSpec addresses content drift in training-free long video generation by analyzing the problem from a singular-spectrum perspective, showing that enlarged attention windows cause spectral concentration and proposing spectrum reconstruction.

entry.title: BAMI: Training-Free Bias Mitigation in GUI Grounding

author.name: Borui Zhang, Bo Zhang, Bo Wang, Wenzhao Zheng, Yuhao Cheng, Liang Tang, Yiqiang Yan, Jie Zhou, Jiwen Lu

entry.summary: BAMI identifies and mitigates biases in GUI grounding (precision bias from high resolution, ambiguity bias from complex interfaces) using a Masked Prediction Distribution attribution method and training-free coarse-to-fine approach.

entry.title: MaMi-HOI: Harmonizing Global Kinematics and Local Geometry for Human-Object Interaction Generation

author.name: Hao Wang, Shiqi Wang, Qi Liu

entry.summary: MaMi-HOI addresses 'Geometric Forgetting' in diffusion models for human-object interaction generation, where semantic features overshadow object geometry at deeper layers, proposing a hierarchical framework for macro kinematic and micro spatial precision.

entry.title: On the Emergence of Pendular Structure in Multi-Contact Locomotion

author.name: Lingxue Lyu, Zihui Liu

entry.summary: Analyzes the emergence of pendular (LIPM) structure in multi-contact locomotion from an optimal control perspective, showing it arises naturally from angular momentum rate minimization rather than being a modeling assumption.

entry.title: Proactive Instance Navigation with Comparative Judgment for Ambiguous User Queries

author.name: Junhyuk Kwon, Seungjoon Lee, Hyejin Park, Kyle Min, Jungseul Ok

entry.summary: Addresses instance navigation when user queries are ambiguous by proposing a proactive agent that asks comparative questions to distinguish between candidate targets, rather than stopping at the first plausible match or asking non-discriminative questions.

entry.title: SpecPL: Disentangling Spectral Granularity for Prompt Learning

author.name: Jingtao Zhou, Xirui Kang, Feiyang Huang, Lai-Man Po

entry.summary: Introduces SpecPL for prompt learning in vision-language models that addresses modality asymmetry by operating from a spectral perspective, decomposing visual signals into semantic low-frequency and granular high-frequency components.

entry.title: Stage-adaptive audio diffusion modeling

author.name: Xuanhao Zhang, Chang Li

entry.summary: Proposes stage-adaptive training for audio diffusion models that adjusts the balance between semantic acquisition and generation refinement throughout training, arguing that static optimization recipes are a source of inefficiency.

entry.title: Reference-based Category Discovery: Unsupervised Object Detection with Category Awareness

author.name: Yichen Li, Qiankun Liu, Ying Fu

entry.summary: Proposes RefCD, an unsupervised detector enabling category-aware object detection without manual annotations, leveraging feature similarity between predicted objects and unlabeled reference images.

entry.title: A Harmonic Mean Formulation of Average Reward Reinforcement Learning in SMDPs

author.name: Erel Shtossel, Alicia Vidler, Uri Shaham, Gal A. Kaminka

entry.summary: Presents a harmonic mean operator for average reward reinforcement learning in semi-Markov decision processes that correctly computes reward rates under non-stationary conditions, yielding model-free learning algorithms.

entry.title: FedeKD: Energy-Based Gating for Robust Federated Knowledge Distillation under Heterogeneous Settings

author.name: Quang-Huy Nguyen, Jiaqi Wang, Wei-shinn Ku

entry.summary: Introduces FedeKD, a federated knowledge distillation framework using energy-based gating for sample-wise trust estimation during knowledge transfer, without requiring public datasets.

entry.title: Reward Shaping and Action Masking for Compositional Tasks using Behavior Trees and LLMs

author.name: Nicholas Potteiger, Ankita Samaddar, Taylor T. Johnson, Xenofon Koutsoukos

entry.summary: Develops MRBT (masking reward behavior tree), a symbolic structure for reactive and modular reward shaping and action masking in compositional RL tasks, using LLMs to automate construction.

entry.title: When Brain Networks Travel: Learning Beyond Site

author.name: Yingxu Wang, Kunyu Zhang, Yanwu Yang, Thomas Wolfers, Yujie Wu, Siyang Gao, Nan Yin

entry.summary: Proposes CORE framework for cross-site brain network learning that decouples site-conditioned confounders and profiles transient neurodynamics for OOD-robust fMRI analysis.

entry.title: INEUS: Iterative Neural Solver for High-Dimensional PIDEs

author.name: Jean-Loup Dupret, Davide Gallon, Patrick Cheridito

entry.summary: Introduces INEUS, a meshfree iterative neural solver for high-dimensional partial integro-differential equations that replaces explicit nonlocal jump integral evaluation with single-jump sampling and recursive regression.

entry.title: Graphlets as Building Blocks for Structural Vocabulary in Knowledge Graph Foundation Models

author.name: Kossi Amouzouvi, Robert Wardenga, Jens Lehmann, Sahar Vahdati

entry.summary: Proposes using graphlets (small subgraph patterns) as structural vocabulary for Knowledge Graph Foundation Models, analogous to tokens in language models, to enable transfer across different knowledge graphs.

entry.title: Risk-Controlled Post-Processing of Decision Policies

author.name: Sunay Joshi, Tao Wang, Hamed Hassani, Edgar Dobriban

entry.summary: Studies risk-controlled post-processing of decision policies, showing optimal policy has threshold structure and developing finite-sample algorithms with coverage guarantees.

entry.title: Unifying Scientific Communication: Fine-Grained Correspondence Across Scientific Media

author.name: Megha Mariam K. M, Vineeth N. Balasubramanian, C. V. Jawahar

entry.summary: Introduces the Multimodal Conference Dataset (MCD), the first benchmark integrating research papers, slides, and recorded presentations with fine-grained cross-modal correspondences for unified scientific communication understanding.

entry.title: MSD-Score: Multi-Scale Distributional Scoring for Reference-Free Image Caption Evaluation

author.name: Shichao Kan, Xuyang Zhang, Haojie Zhang, Zhe Zhu, Yigang Cen, Yixiong Liang, Lianlei Shan, Linna Zhang, Zhe Qu, Jiazhi Xia

entry.summary: MSD-Score is a reference-free image caption evaluation metric that models image patches and text tokens as von Mises-Fisher mixtures, capturing fine-grained semantic mismatches like hallucinated objects that global similarity misses.

entry.title: Beyond Forgetting in Continual Medical Image Segmentation: A Comprehensive Benchmark Study

author.name: Bomin Wang, Hangqi Zhou, Yibo Gao, Xiahai Zhuang

entry.summary: Presents a comprehensive benchmark study for continual medical image segmentation, defining three clinically motivated scenarios and evaluating existing methods beyond just forgetting, including plasticity.

entry.title: Relit-LiVE: Relight Video by Jointly Learning Environment Video

author.name: Weiqing Xiao, Hong Li, Xiuyu Yang, Houyuan Chen, Wenyi Li, Tianqi Liu, Shaocong Xu, Chongjie Ye, Hao Zhao, Beibei Wang

entry.summary: Relit-LiVE introduces video relighting that jointly learns environment video, avoiding unreliable intrinsic decomposition by explicitly using raw reference images and producing physically consistent, temporally stable results.

entry.title: CoupleEvo: Evolving Heuristics for Coupled Optimization Problems Using Large Language Models

author.name: Thomas B\"omer, Bastian Amberg, Max Disselnmeyer, Anne Meyer

entry.summary: CoupleEvo uses LLMs to evolve heuristics for coupled optimization problems, proposing three coordination strategies (sequential, iterative, integrated) for managing interdependent subproblems.

entry.title: Cycle-resolved Cephalopod-Inspired Pulsed-Jet Robot With High-Volume Expulsion and Drag-Reduced Gliding

author.name: Yiyuan Zhang, Anye Zhong, Junkai Chen, Wenci Xin, Cecilia Laschi

entry.summary: Presents a cephalopod-inspired pulsed-jet robot with rigid-soft hybrid origami mantle achieving 75% cavity-volume reduction and 75.7% drag area reduction, analyzing the full locomotion cycle (expulsion, gliding, refilling).

entry.title: Curated AI beats frontier LLMs at pharma asset discovery

author.name: {\L}ukasz Kidzi\'nski, Kevin Thomas

entry.summary: Benchmarks Gosset, a curated AI platform for pharma asset discovery, against four frontier LLMs with web access (Claude Opus 4.7, GPT 5.5, Gemini 3.1 Pro, Perplexity). Gosset returns 3.2x more verified drugs per query at perfect precision on niche oncology/immunology targets.

entry.title: Structured Progressive Knowledge Activation for LLM-Driven Neural Architecture Search

author.name: Zhen Liu, Yuhan Liu, Jinjun Wang, Wei Song, Jianyi Liu, Jingwen Fu

entry.summary: Proposes SPARK, a framework for LLM-driven Neural Architecture Search that addresses 'functional entanglement' - where seemingly local code edits propagate into non-local performance shifts - through structured progressive knowledge activation.

entry.title: Lookahead Drifting Model

author.name: Guoqiang Zhang, Kenta Niwa, W. Bastiaan Kleijn

entry.summary: Proposes a lookahead variant of drifting models for image generation, computing sequential drifting terms at each iteration using previous terms and positive samples. Claims improvements to the SOTA one-step image generation on ImageNet.

entry.title: Sparse Autoencoder Decomposition of Clinical Sequence Model Representations: Feature Complexity, Task Specialisation, and Mortality Prediction

author.name: Chris Sainsbury, Feng Dong, Andreas Karwath

entry.summary: Applies sparse autoencoders to a clinical sequence model (FlatASCEND) to decompose representations, revealing progressive abstraction across transformer depth and finding SAE features outperform dense representations for mortality prediction.

entry.title: A Physics-Aware Framework for Short-Term GPU Power Forecasting of AI Data Centers

author.name: Mohammad AlShaikh Saleh, Sanjay Chawla, Sertac Bayhan, Haitham Abu-Rub, Ali Ghrayeb

entry.summary: Proposes the first physics-informed DLinear time-series model for short-term GPU power forecasting in AI data centers (5-80 minutes ahead), incorporating thermal RC network physics based on Newton's law of cooling.

entry.title: Predict-then-Diffuse: Adaptive Response Length for Compute-Budgeted Inference in Diffusion LLMs

author.name: Michael Rottoli, Subhankar Roy, Stefano Paraboschi

entry.summary: Proposes Predict-then-Diffuse for diffusion-based LLMs, adaptively predicting response length before generation to avoid computational waste from oversized outputs or truncation from undersized ones.

entry.title: Mitigating Label Shift in Tabular In-Context Learning via Test-Time Posterior Adjustment

author.name: Seunghan Lee, Jaehoon Lee, Jun Seo, Sungdong Yoo, Minjae Kim, Tae Yoon Lim, Dongwan Kang, Hwanil Choi, SoonYoung Lee, Wonbin Ahn

entry.summary: Proposes DistPFN, a test-time posterior adjustment method for TabPFN (tabular foundation model) to address label shift vulnerability. It rescales predicted probabilities by downweighting the training prior without architectural changes or additional training.

entry.title: Pen-Strategist: A Reasoning Framework for Penetration Testing Strategy Formation and Analysis

author.name: Yasod Ginige, Pasindu Marasinghe, Sajal Jain, Suranga Seneviratne

entry.summary: Proposes Pen-Strategist, a framework for automated penetration testing that uses domain-specific reasoning models for strategy formulation and tool selection, addressing limitations of existing LLM-based pentesting agents.

entry.title: HeterSEED: Semantics-Structure Decoupling for Heterogeneous Graph Learning under Heterophily

author.name: Xinyi Li, Ming Li, Lu Bai, Lixin Cui, Feilong Cao, Ke Lv, Yunliang Jiang, Pietro Li\`o

entry.summary: Proposes HeterSEED for heterogeneous graph learning under heterophily by decoupling representation into semantic and structure-aware channels, addressing the failure of standard heterogeneous GNNs when connected nodes have dissimilar labels.

entry.title: VocalParse: Towards Unified and Scalable Singing Voice Transcription with Large Audio Language Models

author.name: Yukun Chen, Tianrui Wang, Zhaoxi Mu, Xinyu Yang, EngSiong Chng

entry.summary: Presents VocalParse, a unified singing voice transcription model built on a Large Audio Language Model that handles multiple transcription tasks (lyrics, notes, alignment) in a single framework.

entry.title: CodeEvolve: LLM-Driven Evolutionary Optimization with Runtime-Enriched Target Selection for Multi-Language Code Enhancement

author.name: Ajay Krishna Borra, Wenzhuo Yang, Samarth Arora, Akhilesh Deepak Gotmare, Gokulakrishnan Gopalakrishnan, Tharun Gali, Madhav Rathi, Doyen Sahoo, Manpreet Singh, Mayuresh Verma, Laksh Venka, Shuchita Singh

entry.summary: Presents CodeEvolve, an evolutionary framework for code optimization using LLMs with runtime-guided target selection via Java Flight Recorder profiles and MCTS for candidate generation across Java and Salesforce Apex.

entry.title: Text Corpora as Concept Fields: Black-Box Hallucination and Novelty Measurement

author.name: Nicholas S. Kersting, Vittorio Castelli, Chieh Ting Yeh, Xinzhu Wang, Saad Taame

entry.summary: Introduces 'Concept Fields' for measuring hallucination and novelty in text corpora using local drift fields in sentence-embedding space, scoring transitions by their agreement with corpus-derived Gaussian distributions.

entry.title: Joint Treatment Effect Estimation from Incomplete Healthcare Data: Temporal Causal Normalizing Flows with LLM-driven Evolutionary MNAR Imputation

author.name: Olivia Jullian Parra, Sara Zoccheddu, David Catalan Cerezo, Tom Forzy, Franziska Ulrich, William Sutcliffe, Jakob Martin Burgstaller, Oliver Senn, Patrick Owen, Nicola Serra

entry.summary: Proposes a two-stage pipeline for treatment effect estimation from incomplete EHRs combining DAG-constrained normalizing flows with LSTM encoding and LLM-driven evolutionary imputation for MNAR data.

entry.title: What Matters in Practical Learned Image Compression

author.name: Kedar Tatwawadi, Parisa Rahimzadeh, Zhanghao Sun, Zhiqi Chen, Ziyun Yang, Sanjay Nair, Divija Hasteer, Oren Rippel

entry.summary: Conducts comprehensive study of practical learned image compression, performing neural architecture search over millions of configurations to identify models optimizing perceptual quality and runtime simultaneously.

entry.title: Channel-Level Semantic Perturbations: Unlearnable Examples for Diverse Training Paradigms

author.name: Bo Wang, Jia Ni, Mengnan Zhao, Zhan Qin, Kui Ren

entry.summary: Proposes channel-level semantic perturbations for creating unlearnable examples that remain effective under pretraining-finetuning paradigms, addressing a gap where existing UE methods fail when pretrained weights are frozen.

entry.title: On Semantic Loss Fine-Tuning Approach for Preventing Model Collapse in Causal Reasoning

author.name: Pratik Deshmukh, Atirek Gupta

entry.summary: Demonstrates that standard fine-tuning of transformers on causal reasoning tasks causes 100% model collapse, and proposes a semantic loss with graph-based constraints and dynamic scheduling to prevent it.

entry.title: Approximate Next Policy Sampling: Replacing Conservative Target Policy Updates in Deep RL

author.name: Dillon Sandhu, Ronald Parr

entry.summary: Proposes Approximate Next Policy Sampling (ANPS) for deep RL that modifies the training distribution to approximate the next policy's state visitation, avoiding conservative policy updates while maintaining stability.

entry.title: Non-Myopic Active Feature Acquisition via Pathwise Policy Gradients

author.name: Linus Aronsson, Morteza Haghir Chehreghani

entry.summary: Presents NM-PPG, a non-myopic active feature acquisition method that uses continuous relaxation of the acquisition process to enable pathwise gradients through the full trajectory, avoiding high-variance score-function estimators.

entry.title: Multi-Dimensional Behavioral Evaluation of Agentic Stock Prediction Systems Using LLM Judges with Closed-Loop Reinforcement Learning Feedback

author.name: Mohammad Al Ridhawi, Mahtab Haj Ali, Hussein Al Osman

entry.summary: Presents a behavioral evaluation framework for agentic stock prediction systems using LLM judges (GPT 5.4, Claude 4.6, Gemini 3.1) to score decisions along six dimensions with perturbation-based validation.

entry.title: A Testable Certificate for Constant Collapse in Teacher-Guided VAEs

author.name: Zegu Zhang, Jianhua Peng, Jian Zhang

entry.summary: Provides an exact theoretical threshold for diagnosing constant collapse in teacher-guided VAEs based on teacher mutual information, converting qualitative failure detection into a quantitative test.

entry.title: AdaGamma: State-Dependent Discounting for Temporal Adaptation in Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Yaomin Wang, Jianting Pan, Ran Tian, Xiaoyang Li, Yu Zhang, Hengle Qin, Tianshu YU

entry.summary: Proposes AdaGamma, a practical deep actor-critic method for state-dependent discounting in RL, with a return-consistency regularization objective to prevent TD-error collapse. Provides theoretical analysis of well-posedness.

entry.title: Contrastive Identification and Generation in the Limit

author.name: Xiaoyu Li, Andi Han, Jiaojiao Jiang, Junbin Gao

entry.summary: Initiates study of contrastive identification and generation in the limit, where learners observe pairs of ordered/unordered examples rather than individual labeled data, extending Gold's classical learning model to relational supervision signals.

entry.title: Can Attribution Predict Risk? From Multi-View Attribution to Planning Risk Signals in End-to-End Autonomous Driving

author.name: Le Yang, Ruoyu Chen, Haijun Liu, Jiawei Liang, ShangQuan Sun, Xiaochun Cao

entry.summary: Proposes multi-view attribution methods for end-to-end autonomous driving that capture both critical views and regions influencing trajectory generation, and investigates whether attribution maps can support risk identification.

entry.title: When Labels Have Structure: Improving Image Classification with Hierarchy-Aware Cross-Entropy

author.name: April Chan, Davide D'Ascenzo, Sebastiano Cultrera di Montesano

entry.summary: Proposes Hierarchy-Aware Cross-Entropy (HACE), a drop-in replacement for standard cross-entropy that incorporates class hierarchies through prediction aggregation and ancestral label smoothing.

entry.title: ORTHOBO: Orthogonal Bayesian Hyperparameter Optimization

author.name: Maresa Schr\"oder, Pascal Janetzky, Michael Klar, Stefan Feuerriegel

entry.summary: Proposes ORTHOBO, an orthogonal Bayesian optimization method using a score-function control variate to reduce Monte Carlo noise in acquisition function estimation, addressing a previously overlooked failure mode.

entry.title: Criticality and Saturation in Orthogonal Neural Networks

author.name: Max Guillen, Jan E. Gerken

entry.summary: Derives explicit recursion relations for finite-width corrections in orthogonally-initialized neural networks, explaining why orthogonal initialization improves training through analysis of criticality and saturation.

entry.title: Directional Consistency as a Complementary Optimization Signal: The GONO Framework

author.name: Victor Daniel Gera

entry.summary: Identifies that directional alignment and loss convergence can be decoupled in deep learning optimization. Proposes GONO optimizer that adapts momentum based on gradient cosine similarity to exploit temporal consistency.

entry.title: MedMamba: Recasting Mamba for Medical Time Series Classification

author.name: ZhengXiao He, Huayu Li, Xiwen Chen, Janet M Roveda, Jinghao Wen, Siyuan Tian, Ao Li

entry.summary: Proposes MedMamba, a bidirectional state space model for medical time series classification (ECG, EEG) designed with three inductive biases specific to physiological signals.

entry.title: Layout-Aware Representation Learning for Open-Set ID Fraud Discovery

author.name: Jinxing Li, Nicholas Ren, Cathy Chang, Hongkai Pan, Daniel George

entry.summary: Adapts DINOv3 for layout-aware representation learning for open-set ID fraud detection, achieving strong cross-domain transfer from US to Canadian IDs without retraining.

entry.title: Permutation-preserving Functions and Neural Vecchia Covariance Kernels

author.name: Jian Cao, Nian Liu, Ying Lin

entry.summary: Introduces neural architectures for Gaussian process covariance kernels based on Vecchia approximations, deriving universal representations for permutation-preserving functions that respect conditioning set symmetry.

entry.title: EGA: Adapting Frozen Encoders for Vector Search with Bounded Out-of-Distribution Degradation

author.name: Dongfang Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes Euclidean Geodesic Alignment (EGA), a residual adapter for frozen vision encoders that prevents catastrophic degradation on out-of-distribution queries in vector search systems. It uses zero initialization, local triplet loss, and hypersphere projection to create a self-limiting adapter that stops updating where geometry is already correct.

entry.title: MTL-MAD: Multi-Task Learners are Effective Medical Anomaly Detectors

author.name: Bogdan Alexandru Bercean, Florinel Alin Croitoru, Vlad Hondru, Ciprian Mihai Ceausescu, Andreea Iuliana Ionescu, Radu Tudor Ionescu

entry.summary: Proposes MTL-MAD, a multi-task learning approach using Mixture-of-Experts for medical anomaly detection that learns from multiple self-supervised tasks to build robust representations of normal anatomy.

entry.title: Time-Inhomogeneous Preconditioned Langevin Dynamics

author.name: Alexander Falk, Laurenz Nagler, Andreas Habring, Thomas Pock

entry.summary: Proposes time-inhomogeneous preconditioned Langevin dynamics that transitions between different preconditioners during sampling to simultaneously address mode coverage and mode exploration.

entry.title: End-to-End Identifiable and Consistent Recurrent Switching Dynamical Systems

author.name: Carles Balsells-Rodas, Zhengrui Xiang, Xavier Sumba, Yingzhen Li

entry.summary: Establishes identifiability of recurrent nonlinear switching dynamical systems under flexible assumptions and introduces a flow-based estimator that avoids VAE approximation gaps.

entry.title: Optimizing Social Utility in Sequential Experiments

author.name: Ander Artola Velasco, Stratis Tsirtsis, Manuel Gomez-Rodriguez

entry.summary: Introduces a statistical protocol for sequential experiments where regulators partially subsidize randomized controlled trials, modeling it as a belief MDP to encourage development of high-social-utility 'moonshot' products.

entry.title: PersonaKit (PK): A Plug-and-Play Platform for User Testing Diverse Roles in Full-Duplex Dialogue

author.name: Hyunbae Jeon, Jinho D. Choi

entry.summary: Presents PersonaKit, an open platform for testing persona-specific turn-taking behaviors in full-duplex spoken dialogue systems, addressing the limitation of rigid 'always-yield' policies for diverse character roles.

entry.title: More Aligned, Less Diverse? Analyzing the Grammar and Lexicon of Two Generations of LLMs

author.name: Adri\'an Gude, Roi Santos-R\'ios, Francis Bond, Dan Flickinger, Carlos G\'omez-Rodr\'iguez, Olga Zamaraeva

entry.summary: Analyzes syntactic diversity in two generations of LLMs compared to human-authored news text using HPSG grammar, finding that more aligned models may produce less grammatically diverse text.

entry.title: The Frequency Confound in Language-Model Surprisal and Metaphor Novelty

author.name: Omar Momen, Sina Zarrie{\ss}

entry.summary: Shows that word frequency is a stronger predictor of metaphor novelty than LM surprisal across eight Pythia model sizes, suggesting that the reported surprisal-novelty correlation is confounded by frequency effects.

entry.title: Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Financial Document Question Answering

author.name: Yang Shu, Yingmin Liu, Zequn Xie

entry.summary: Proposes FinAgent-RAG, an agentic RAG framework with iterative retrieval-reasoning loops and self-verification for financial document QA, including a contrastive financial retriever and domain-specific innovations.

entry.title: Open-SAT: LLM-Guided Query Embedding Refinement for Open-Vocabulary Object Retrieval in Satellite Imagery

author.name: Md Adnan Arefeen, Biplob Debnath, Ravi K. Rajendran, Murugan Sankaradas, Srimat T. Chakradhar

entry.summary: Proposes Open-SAT, a training-free algorithm that refines query embeddings at inference time for open-vocabulary satellite image retrieval using LLM-guided descriptions and CLIP.

entry.title: Characterizing Brazilian Atlantic Forest Restoration Outcomes with Geospatial AlphaEarth Embeddings

author.name: Alice Heiman

entry.summary: Uses AlphaEarth Foundation model satellite embeddings to characterize early restoration success of 1,729 Atlantic Forest restoration sites, introducing 'Reference Trajectory Embedding' as a metric for monitoring reforestation progress.

entry.title: Text-to-CAD Retrieval: a Strong Baseline

author.name: Honghu Pan, Zibo Du, Daxiang Liu, Chengliang Liu, Xiaoling Luo

entry.summary: Formally introduces text-to-CAD retrieval as a cross-modal task and establishes a benchmark using paired text-CAD annotations. Proposes a unified framework learning multi-modal CAD embeddings from procedural sequences.

entry.title: Fusion in Your Way: Aligning Image Fusion with Heterogeneous Demands via Direct Preference Optimization

author.name: Weijian Su, Songqian Zhang, Yuqi Han, Jian Zhuang, Yongdong Huang, Qiang Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes DPOFusion, applying direct preference optimization to infrared-visible image fusion, allowing adaptive fusion that aligns with both human perception and machine vision preferences. Introduces property-aligned and preference-controllable latent diffusion models.

entry.title: Eulerian Motion Guidance: Robust Image Animation via Bidirectional Geometric Consistency

author.name: Thong Nguyen, Khoi M. Le, Cong-Duy Nguyen, Luu Anh Tuan, See-Kiong Ng, Chunyan Miao

entry.summary: Proposes Eulerian motion guidance for image animation using adjacent-frame motion fields instead of global Lagrangian flow, enabling parallelized training and bounded-error supervision with a bidirectional geometric consistency mechanism.

entry.title: SwiftI2V: Efficient High-Resolution Image-to-Video Generation via Conditional Segment-wise Generation

author.name: YaoYang Liu, Yuechen Zhang, Wenbo Li, Yufei Zhao, Rui Liu, Long Chen

entry.summary: SwiftI2V proposes an efficient framework for high-resolution (2K) image-to-video generation using conditional segment-wise generation, addressing memory/latency constraints while maintaining input-image fidelity in the super-resolution stage.

entry.title: Stego Battlefield: Evaluating Image Steganography Attacks and Steganalysis Defenses

author.name: Zhen Sun, Zongmin Zhang, Leyi Sheng, Yule Liu, Yifan Liao, Ke Li, Xinhu Zheng, Jiaheng Wei, Wenyuan Yang, Xinlei He

entry.summary: SADBench is a systematic benchmark for evaluating image steganography attacks and steganalysis defenses, covering adversary injection capability, detection resistance, and defensive detection across multiple threat models.

entry.title: Contact-Free Grasp Stability Prediction with In-Hand Time-of-Flight Sensors

author.name: Kyle DuFrene, Cindy Grimm

entry.summary: Proposes contact-free grasp stability prediction using multi-zone time-of-flight sensors in gripper fingers, predicting grasp success at 15 Hz without needing to actually grasp the object.

entry.title: Resource-Constrained Robotic Planning in the face of Mixed Uncertainty

author.name: Yihao Yin, Pian Yu, Andrea Turrini, Zhiming Chi, Yong Li, Lijun Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for synthesizing robust robot strategies under mixed uncertainty (quantifiable noise + unquantifiable unknowns) with resource constraints, using Consumption MDPs with set-valued transitions and LTLf specifications.

entry.title: GA3T: A Ground-Aerial Terrain Traversability Dataset for Heterogeneous Robot Teams in Unstructured Environments

author.name: Siwei Cai, Knut Peterson, Quan Tran, Christian Ricks, Dhanush Parthasarathy, Amir Kaidarov, Neil Deshpande, Sukaina Najm, David Han, Lifeng Zhou

entry.summary: Introduces GA3T, a real-world multi-robot collaborative perception dataset collected with a ground vehicle and UAV across diverse unstructured terrain (forests, rocks, mud, snow, grass) for terrain traversability assessment.

entry.title: Resilient AI Supercomputer Networking using MRC and SRv6

author.name: Joao Araujo, Alex Chow, Mark Handley, Ryder Lewis, Christoph Paasch, Jitendra Padhye, Michael Papamichael, Greg Steinbrecher, Amin Tootoonchian, Lihua Yuan, S. Anantharamu, Abhishek Dosi, Mohit Garg, Mahdieh Ghazi, Torsten Hoefler, Deepal Jayasinghe, Jithin Jose, Abdul Kabbani, Guohan Lu, Yang Wang, K. Doddapaneni, Murali Garimella, Vipin Jain, Yanfang Le, H. Nagulapalli, S. Narayanan, Rong Pan, Rathina Sabesan, Raghava Sivaramu, Rip Sohan, Eric Davis, Dragos Dumitrescu, Mohan Kalkunte, Bhaswar Mitra, Guglielmo Morandin, Adrian Popa, Costin Raiciu, Eric Spada, John Spillane, Niranjan Vaidya, Aviv Barnea, Idan Burstein, Elazar Cohen, Yamin Friedman, Noam Katz, Masoud Moshref, Yuval Shpigelman, Shahaf Shuler, Shy Shyman, Sayantan Sur

entry.summary: As first reported in News yesterday, Describes a three-pronged networking approach for AI supercomputers: MRC (a new RDMA transport protocol with multi-path load balancing), multi-plane Clos topologies for 100K+ GPU clusters, and SRv6 static source-routing for failure bypass. Reports production deployment at OpenAI and Microsoft's largest training clusters.

entry.title: Multi-Level Bidirectional Biomimetic Learning for EEG-Based Visual Decoding

author.name: Jingtao Liu, Peiliang Gong, Chuhang Zheng, Yiheng Liu, Qi Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes MB2L, a multi-level bidirectional biomimetic learning framework for EEG-based visual decoding that incorporates retinotopic and neuroanatomical priors to address the mismatch between digital images and biological visual perception.

entry.title: ANDRE: An Attention-based Neuro-symbolic Differentiable Rule Extractor

author.name: Iman Sharifi, Peng Wei, Saber Fallah

entry.summary: Introduces ANDRE, a neuro-symbolic framework for Inductive Logic Programming that uses attention mechanisms to learn first-order logic programs in a continuous rule space. Addresses scalability issues of existing ILP methods in noisy and probabilistic settings.

entry.title: Position: Embodied AI Requires a Privacy-Utility Trade-off

author.name: Xiaoliang Fan, Jiarui Chen, Zhuodong Liu, Ziqi Yang, Peixuan Xu, Ruimin Shen, Junhui Liu, Jianzhong Qi, Cheng Wang

entry.summary: A position paper arguing that embodied AI systems require privacy as a life-cycle-level architectural constraint rather than a stage-local feature. Proposes the SPIN framework for integrated privacy management across instruction, perception, planning, and interaction stages.

entry.title: A large language model-type architecture for high-dimensional molecular potential energy surfaces

author.name: Xiao Zhu, Srinivasan S. Iyengar

entry.summary: Designs an LLM-type architecture for computing high-dimensional molecular potential energy surfaces, representing molecular systems as graphs with interacting subsystems to construct surfaces for a 51-dimensional chemical system.

entry.title: MP-ISMoE: Mixed-Precision Interactive Side Mixture-of-Experts for Efficient Transfer Learning

author.name: Yutong Zhang, Zimeng Wu, Shangcai Liao, Shujiang Wu, Jiaxin Chen

entry.summary: Proposes MP-ISMoE, a Mixed-Precision Interactive Side Mixture-of-Experts framework for parameter-efficient and memory-efficient transfer learning that bridges the performance gap of memory-efficient methods through Gaussian Noise injection and interactive MoE side networks.

entry.title: EdgeRazor: A Lightweight Framework for Large Language Models via Mixed-Precision Quantization-Aware Distillation

author.name: Shu-Hao Zhang, Le-Tong Huang, Xiang-Sheng Deng, Xin-Yi Zou, Chen Wu, Nan Li, Shao-Qun Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes EdgeRazor, a mixed-precision quantization-aware distillation framework for deploying LLMs on resource-constrained devices, combining quantization with knowledge transfer from full-precision teachers.

entry.title: ProtDBench: A Unified Benchmark of Protein Binder Design and Evaluation

author.name: Cong Liu, Milong Ren, Jiaqi Guan, Chengyue Gong, Jinyuan Sun, Xinshi Chen, Wenzhi Xiao

entry.summary: Introduces ProtDBench, a standardized evaluation framework for protein binder design that reveals substantial verifier-dependent bias in commonly used structure prediction models as evaluation tools.

entry.title: GEM: Graph-Enhanced Mixture-of-Experts with ReAct Agents for Dialogue State Tracking

author.name: Ziqi Zhu, Adithya Suresh, Tomal Deb, Iman Abbasnejad

entry.summary: Presents GEM, a framework combining graph neural networks with ReAct agents and a mixture-of-experts router for dialogue state tracking. Dynamically routes between a GNN capturing dialogue structure and a T5-based sequence model.

entry.title: Example-Based Object Detection

author.name: ZhiXin Sun

entry.summary: Proposes example-based object detection where users provide example images to correct persistent false positives/negatives without retraining, addressing practical engineering needs when open-vocabulary detectors like SAM3 still make errors.

entry.title: Accountable Agents in Software Engineering: An Analysis of Terms of Service and a Research Roadmap

author.name: Christoph Treude

entry.summary: Analyzes Terms of Service for AI coding assistants to examine how accountability, ownership, and responsibility are allocated when agents generate or modify code. Presents a research roadmap for accountable AI agents in software engineering.

entry.title: Library learning with e-graphs on jazz harmony

author.name: Zeng Ren, Maddy Bowers, Xinyi Guan, Martin Rohrmeier

entry.summary: Presents a computational model for learning jazz harmonic patterns using library learning with e-graphs, discovering concise generative explanations of harmonic progressions from a corpus of jazz music.

entry.title: FaithfulFaces: Pose-Faithful Facial Identity Preservation for Text-to-Video Generation

author.name: Yuanzhi Wang, Xuhua Ren, Jiaxiang Cheng, Bing Ma, Kai Yu, Sen Liang, Wenyue Li, Tianxiang Zheng, Qinglin Lu, Zhen Cui

entry.summary: Proposes FaithfulFaces for identity-preserving text-to-video generation with improved robustness under large pose variations. Uses a pose-shared identity aligner with pose-shared dictionary and pose variation-identity invariance constraint.

entry.title: Reliable Modeling of Distribution Shifts via Displacement-Reshaped Optimal Transport

author.name: Philip Naumann, Jacob Kauffmann, Klaus-Robert M\"uller, Gr\'egoire Montavon

entry.summary: Proposes ReshapeOT, which improves optimal transport for modeling distribution shifts by replacing Euclidean metrics with Mahalanobis distances estimated from observed sample displacements, better aligning transport plans with actual data dynamics.

entry.title: Think-Aloud Reshapes Automated Cognitive Model Discovery Beyond Behavior

author.name: Hanbo Xie, Akshay K. Jagadish, Lan Pan, Robert C. Wilson

entry.summary: Explores using Think Aloud verbal traces as additional constraints during LLM-based automated cognitive model discovery, finding that models discovered with think-aloud data achieve better predictive performance and belong to different structural classes.

entry.title: LineRides: Line-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Bicycle Robot Stunts

author.name: Seungeun Rho, Shamel Fahmi, Jeonghwan Kim, Arianna Ilvonen, Sehoon Ha, Gabriel Nelson

entry.summary: Presents LineRides, a reinforcement learning framework for bicycle robot stunts using user-provided spatial guidelines and sparse key-orientations instead of reference motions, enabling novel stunt behaviors.

entry.title: LLMSpace: Carbon Footprint Modeling for Large Language Model Inference on LEO Satellites

author.name: Lei Jiang, Adrian Ildefonso, Daniel Loveless, Fan Chen

entry.summary: Presents LLMSpace, the first carbon modeling framework for LLM inference on LEO satellites, jointly modeling operational and embodied carbon including launch emissions and radiation-hardened hardware.

entry.title: From Drops to Grid: Noise-Aware Spatio-Temporal Neural Process for Rainfall Estimation

author.name: Rafael Pablos Sarabia, Joachim Nyborg, Morten Birk, Ira Assent

entry.summary: Proposes DropsToGrid, a Neural Process-based method for generating dense rainfall fields by fusing temporal sequences from noisy weather stations with radar spatial context.

entry.title: Beyond Autoregressive RTG: Conditioning via Injection Outside Sequential Modeling in Decision Transformer

author.name: Yongyi Wang, Hanyu Liu, Lingfeng Li, Bozhou Chen, Ang Li, Qirui Zheng, Xionghui Yang, Chucai Wang, Wenxin Li

entry.summary: Proposes SlimDT which removes Return-to-Go tokens from the autoregressive sequence in Decision Transformers and instead injects RTG information into state representations before sequential modeling, reducing computational overhead from quadratic attention costs.

entry.title: Entropy-Regularized Adjoint Matching for Offline RL

author.name: Abdelghani Ghanem, Mounir Ghogho

entry.summary: Proposes Maximum Entropy Adjoint Matching (MaxEnt-AM) for offline RL, addressing popularity bias and support binding in flow-matching policies by adding entropy regularization that encourages exploration beyond the behavior distribution.

entry.title: Soft Deterministic Policy Gradient with Gaussian Smoothing

author.name: Hyunjun Na, Donghwan Lee

entry.summary: Proposes Soft Deterministic Policy Gradient (Soft-DPG) based on Gaussian-smoothed Bellman equations, eliminating explicit dependence on critic action-gradients and enabling stable learning with sparse or discrete rewards.

entry.title: The Role of Node Features in Graph Pooling

author.name: Jan von Pichowski, Al\v{z}beta Hrabo\v{s}ov\'a, Ingo Scholtes, Christopher Bl\"ocker

entry.summary: Analyzes the interaction between node features and graph topology for pooling, formalizing requirements for effective pooling and introducing a quantitative measure of feature quality that predicts when pooling helps.

entry.title: FedFrozen: Two-Stage Federated Optimization via Attention Kernel Freezing

author.name: Junye Du, Zhenghao Li, Yushi Feng, Long Feng

entry.summary: Proposes FedFrozen, a two-stage federated optimization for transformers that freezes the query/key attention kernel after initial stages while continuing to train value blocks, reducing client drift.

entry.title: No Triangulation Without Representation: Generalization in Topological Deep Learning

author.name: Johannes S. Schmidt, Martin Carrasco, Ernst R\"oell, Guy Wolf, Nello Blaser, Bastian Rieck

entry.summary: Extends MANTRA benchmark for topological deep learning to more diverse manifold triangulations, showing both GNNs and higher-order methods can saturate the benchmark with right representations and features.

entry.title: Sequential Design of Genetic Circuits Under Uncertainty With Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Michal Kobiela, Diego A. Oyarz\'un, Michael U. Gutmann

entry.summary: Presents a sequential framework using reinforcement learning to optimize genetic circuit design under both intrinsic stochasticity and experimental variability, combining differential equation simulators with RL policy-based approaches.

entry.title: Optimal Counterfactual Search in Tree Ensembles: A Study Across Modeling and Solution Paradigms

author.name: Awa Khouna, Youssouf Emine, Julien Ferry, Thibaut Vidal

entry.summary: Studies optimal counterfactual explanation computation for tree ensembles, proposing CPCF - a constraint programming approach that finds truly minimal changes under plausibility and actionability constraints.

entry.title: Concept-Based Abductive and Contrastive Explanations for Behaviors of Vision Models

author.name: Ronaldo Canizales, Divya Gopinath, Corina P\u{a}s\u{a}reanu, Ravi Mangal

entry.summary: Proposes concept-based abductive and contrastive explanations that identify minimal sets of high-level concepts causally relevant to model predictions, merging concept-based explanations with formal abductive reasoning.

entry.title: Differential Privacy in the Extensive-Form Bandit Problem

author.name: Stephen Pasteris, Rahul Savani, Theodore Turocy

entry.summary: Gives an algorithm for the extensive-form bandit problem satisfying epsilon-local differential privacy with regret O(sqrt(A*ln(S)*T)/epsilon), maintaining computational efficiency.

entry.title: Privacy Without Losing Place: A Paradigm for Private Retrieval in Spatial RAGs

author.name: Kennedy Edemacu, Mohammad Mahdi Shokri, Vinay M. Shashidhar, Jong Wook Kim

entry.summary: Introduces PAS (Privacy Anchor Substitution) for user location privacy in spatial RAG systems, representing locations with relative anchor encoding that achieves ~400m adversarial error while retaining retrieval performance.

entry.title: Active Learning for Communication Structure Optimization in LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems

author.name: Huchen Yang, Xinghao Dong, Dan Negrut, Jin-Long Wu

entry.summary: Proposes an ensemble-based information-theoretic framework for actively selecting which tasks to use when optimizing communication structures in LLM-based multi-agent systems. Addresses instability in optimization under limited training budgets.

entry.title: Tuning Derivatives for Causal Fairness in Machine Learning

author.name: Filip Edstr\"om, Guilherme W. F. Barros, Tetiana Gorbach, Xavier de Luna

entry.summary: Proposes causal fairness methods using 'tuning derivatives' that extend path-based fairness definitions to continuous protected attributes, distinguishing allowed from disallowed causal paths.

entry.title: From Coordinate Matching to Structural Alignment: Rethinking Prototype Alignment in Heterogeneous Federated Learning

author.name: Xinghao Wu, Jianwei Niu, Guogang Zhu, Xuefeng Liu, Shaojie Tang, Jiayuan Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes structural alignment instead of coordinate alignment for prototype-based heterogeneous federated learning, addressing the issue that different model architectures produce incomparable embedding spaces.

entry.title: Predictive-Generative Drift Decomposition for Speech Enhancement and Separation

author.name: Julius Richter, Yoshiki Masuyama, Christoph Boeddeker, Takahiro Edo, Gordon Wichern, Jonathan Le Roux

entry.summary: Proposes SIPS, a framework combining predictive speech enhancement with generative speech priors using stochastic interpolants, decomposing dynamics into task-specific drift and stochastic denoising components.

entry.title: eXplaining to Learn (eX2L): Regularization Using Contrastive Visual Explanation Pairs for Distribution Shifts

author.name: Paulo Mario P. Medina, Jose Marie Antonio Mi\~noza, Sebastian C. Iba\~nez

entry.summary: Proposes eX2L, a regularization framework that penalizes similarity between Grad-CAM maps of a primary classifier and a confounder classifier to decorrelate spurious features during training.

entry.title: Estimate Level Adjustment For Inference With Proxies Under Random Distribution Shifts

author.name: Steven Wilkins-Reeves, Alexandra N. M. Darmon, Deeksha Sinha

entry.summary: Proposes a sensitivity-adjusted inference method for using proxy outcomes in experimentation that doesn't require strict identifying assumptions like surrogacy or covariate shift.

entry.title: Market-Alignment Risk in Pricing Agents: Trace Diagnostics and Trace-Prior RL under Hidden Competitor State

author.name: Peiying Zhu, Sidi Chang

entry.summary: Studies a Goodhart-style failure in pricing agents trained against competitors with hidden state, proposing trace diagnostics and trace-prior RL to handle partial observability in revenue management.

entry.title: Coordination Matters: Evaluation of Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Maria Ana Cardei, Matthew Landers, Afsaneh Doryab

entry.summary: Proposes coordination-aware evaluation metrics for cooperative multi-agent RL that go beyond aggregate returns to measure how agents actually coordinate, with a controlled testbed (STAT) for systematic evaluation.

entry.title: PianoCoRe: Combined and Refined Piano MIDI Dataset

author.name: Ilya Borovik

entry.summary: Presents PianoCoRe, a large-scale unified piano MIDI dataset combining major open-source corpora into 250,046 performances of 5,625 pieces by 483 composers, with tiered subsets for different applications from pre-training to expressive performance modeling.

entry.title: From 124 Million Tokens to 1,021 Neologisms: A Large-Scale Pipeline for Automatic Neologism Detection

author.name: Diego Rossini, Lonneke van der Plas

entry.summary: Presents a scalable pipeline for automatic neologism detection combining rule-based filtering with LLM classification, processing 124.6 million unique tokens from Reddit to yield 1,021 verified neologism candidates.

entry.title: Seeing What Shouldn't Be There: Counterfactual GANs for Medical Image Attribution

author.name: Shakeeb Murtaza

entry.summary: Proposes counterfactual GAN-based method for medical image attribution that generates explanations showing what pathological features influence classification decisions. Overcomes limitations of discriminative visualization methods that only highlight minimal discriminative features.

entry.title: R2H-Diff: Guided Spectral Diffusion Model for RGB-to-Hyperspectral Reconstruction

author.name: Songyu Ding, Ronggiang Zhao, Mingchun Sun, Jie Liu

entry.summary: Proposes R2H-Diff, a diffusion-based framework for RGB-to-hyperspectral image reconstruction that handles the ill-posed nature of the problem by modeling spectral distributions rather than deterministic mappings.

entry.title: ChartZero: Synthetic Priors Enable Zero Shot Chart Data Extraction

author.name: Md Touhidul Islam, Yasir Mahmud, Sujan Kumar Saha, Mark Tehranipoor, Farimah Farahmandi

entry.summary: Proposes ChartZero for zero-shot chart data extraction using synthetic priors to overcome the scarcity of annotated chart datasets. Addresses structural fragmentation in curve extraction and semantic association errors.

entry.title: Align3D-AD: Cross-Modal Feature Alignment and Dual-Prompt Learning for Zero-shot 3D Anomaly Detection

author.name: Letian Bai, Xuanming Cao, Juan Du, Chengyu Tao

entry.summary: Proposes Align3D-AD for zero-shot 3D anomaly detection using cross-modal feature alignment with RGB guidance. Addresses domain gap between 3D rendering features and RGB-pretrained encoders.

entry.title: Plug-and-play Class-aware Knowledge Injection for Prompt Learning with Visual-Language Model

author.name: Junhui Yin, Nan Pu, Xinyu Zhang, Lingfeng Yang, Lin Wu, Xiaojie Wang, Zhun Zhong

entry.summary: Proposes plug-and-play class-aware knowledge injection for prompt learning in VLMs like CLIP, generating class-specific prompts that provide more fine-grained supervision than class-shared prompts.

entry.title: SuperFace: Preference-Aligned Facial Expression Estimation Beyond Pseudo Supervision

author.name: Zejian Kang, Xuanyang Xu, Wentao Yang, Kai Zheng, Yuanchen Fei, Hongyuan Zou, Hui Shan, Shuo Yang, Xiangru Huang

entry.summary: SuperFace uses preference-aligned learning to predict ARKit blendshape coefficients for facial animation, overcoming noisy pseudo-labels from capture software by optimizing for perceptual expression fidelity rather than label matching.

entry.title: ZScribbleSeg: A comprehensive segmentation framework with modeling of efficient annotation and maximization of scribble supervision

author.name: Ke Zhang, Bomin Wang, Hangqi Zhou, Xiahai Zhuang

entry.summary: ZScribbleSeg investigates principles of good scribble annotations for medical image segmentation, proposing efficient annotation forms and regularization terms to maximize supervision from weak scribble labels.

entry.title: Solving Minimal Problems Without Matrix Inversion Using FFT-Based Interpolation

author.name: Haidong Wu, Snehal Bhayani, Janne Heikkil\"a

entry.summary: Proposes a sampling-based, matrix inversion-free method for solving minimal problems in camera geometry using FFT-based interpolation of sparse hidden-variable resultants.

entry.title: Efficient event-driven retrieval in high-capacity kernel Hopfield networks

author.name: Akira Tamamori

entry.summary: Demonstrates that asynchronous retrieval in Kernel Logistic Regression Hopfield networks can match synchronous dynamics while being compatible with neuromorphic hardware, enabling energy-efficient deployment.

entry.title: QUIVER: Cost-Aware Adaptive Preference Querying in Surrogate-Assisted Evolutionary Multi-Objective Optimization

author.name: Florian A. D. Burnat

entry.summary: QUIVER adaptively allocates budget between expensive objective evaluations and heterogeneous preference queries (pairwise comparisons vs. indifference adjustments) in surrogate-assisted multi-objective optimization.

entry.title: Generating Roadside LiDAR Datasets from Vehicle-Side Datasets via Novel View Synthesis

author.name: Yuhan Xia, Runxin Zhao, Hanyang Zhuang, Chunxiang Wang, Ming Yang

entry.summary: VRS synthesizes labeled roadside LiDAR datasets from vehicle-side datasets via novel view synthesis, using point cloud completion and scene reconstruction to bridge the vehicle-to-roadside domain gap.

entry.title: Plug-and-Play Label Map Diffusion for Universal Goal-Oriented Navigation

author.name: Zhixuan Shen, Yijie Zeng, Shengxiang Luo, Tianrui Li, Haonan Luo

entry.summary: PLMD uses denoising diffusion probabilistic models to complete bird's-eye-view maps for goal-oriented navigation, generating obstacle and semantic labels for unobserved regions.

entry.title: Accurate Trajectory Tracking with MPCC for Flapping-Wing MAVs

author.name: Charbel Toumieh, Jack Zeng, Niel Mistry, Dario Floreano

entry.summary: Applies Model Predictive Contouring Control (MPCC) to flapping-wing micro aerial vehicles, achieving precise trajectory tracking by optimizing arc-length-parameterized paths while handling the coupled dynamics.

entry.title: TouchDrive: Electronics-Free Tactile Sensing Interface for Assistive Grasping

author.name: Jing Xu, Xuezhi Niu, Didem Gurdur Broo, Klas Hjort

entry.summary: Presents TouchDrive, an electronics-free tactile sensing interface that converts contact forces directly into pneumatic feedback through valve-mediated switching, creating a fully passive mechanical sensing loop for assistive grasping.

entry.title: Maximal Controlled Invariant-MPC: Enhancing Feasibility and Reducing Conservatism through Terminal CBF Constraint in Safety-Critical Control

author.name: Tanmay Dokania, Yashwanth Kumar Nakka

entry.summary: Presents an MPC formulation using Control Barrier Functions as terminal constraints that provably improves feasibility and reachable sets with increasing prediction horizon, with constructive proofs enabling warm-starting of the optimization.

entry.title: Beyond Seeing Is Believing: On Crowdsourced Detection of Audiovisual Deepfakes

author.name: Michael Soprano, Andrea Cioci, Stefano Mizzaro

entry.summary: Studies crowdsourced audiovisual deepfake detection, measuring how consistently crowd workers distinguish authentic from manipulated videos and identify manipulation types across two datasets with 960 judgments.

entry.title: Pro$^2$Assist: Continuous Step-Aware Proactive Assistance with Multimodal Egocentric Perception for Long-Horizon Procedural Tasks

author.name: Lilin Xu, Bufang Yang, Siyang Jiang, Kaiwei Liu, Kaiyuan Hou, Yuang Fan, Hongkai Chen, Zhenyu Yan, Xiaofan Jiang

entry.summary: Introduces Pro²Assist, a proactive AI assistant that continuously tracks fine-grained task progress using AR glasses and multimodal data to provide timely assistance during long-horizon procedural tasks, rather than waiting for user queries.

entry.title: FlatASCEND: Autoregressive Clinical Sequence Generation with Continuous Time Prediction and Association-Based Pharmacological Testing

author.name: Chris Sainsbury, Feng Dong, Andreas Karwath

entry.summary: Presents FlatASCEND, a 14.5M-parameter autoregressive clinical sequence model that generates patient-conditioned multi-step trajectories responding to intervention tokens, validated through pharmacological association testing.

entry.title: Confronting Label Indeterminacy in Automated Bail Decisions

author.name: Cor Steging, Tadeusz Zbiegie\'n

entry.summary: Examines label indeterminacy in bail decision data - when bail is denied, the counterfactual outcome is unobserved. Evaluates five approaches for handling denied-bail cases during model development using Pennsylvania judicial data.

entry.title: Time series causal discovery with variable lags

author.name: Bruno Petrungaro, Anthony C. Constantinou

entry.summary: Proposes a Tabu-based structure learning algorithm for time-series causal discovery that searches for time-ordered directed structures with edge-specific variable lags, addressing the fixed-lag-window limitation of existing methods.

entry.title: Self-Prompting Small Language Models for Privacy-Sensitive Clinical Information Extraction

author.name: Yao-Shun Chuang, Tushti Mody, Uday Pratap Singh, Shirindokht Shiraz, Chun-Teh Lee, Ryan Brandon, Muhammad F Walji, Xiaoqian Jiang, Bunmi Tokede

entry.summary: Develops a framework enabling small language models to self-generate and refine prompts for clinical named entity recognition from dental notes, achieving strong performance with locally deployable privacy-preserving models.

entry.title: Evaluation Cards for XAI Metrics

author.name: Rokas Gipi\v{s}kis, Olga Kurasova

entry.summary: Proposes XAI Evaluation Cards, a standardized documentation template for XAI metrics analogous to model cards. Covers target properties, assumptions, validation evidence, gaming risks, and failure cases to reduce evaluation fragmentation.

entry.title: Efficient Geometry-Controlled High-Resolution Satellite Image Synthesis

author.name: Vlad Vasilescu, Daniela Faur, Teodor Costachioiu

entry.summary: Proposes an efficient method for geometry-controlled high-resolution satellite image synthesis using only skip connection features with windowed cross-attention modules added to pre-trained diffusion models.

entry.title: Exact Dual Geometry of SOC-ICNN Value Functions

author.name: Kang Liu, Jianchen Hu, Wei Peng

entry.summary: Studies the dual geometry of SOC-ICNN (Second-Order-Cone Input Convex Neural Networks) value functions, showing that supporting slopes, subdifferentials, and local Hessians can be recovered from optimal dual variables.

entry.title: Driver-WM: A Driver-Centric Traffic-Conditioned Latent World Model for In-Cabin Dynamics Rollout

author.name: Haozhuang Chi, Daosheng Qiu, Hao Su, Haochen Liu, Zirui Li, Haoruo Zhang, Chen Lv

entry.summary: Introduces Driver-WM, a driver-centric latent world model that predicts in-cabin dynamics (driver behavior and emotions) conditioned on external traffic context, enabling anticipation of human reactions during autonomous driving transitions.

entry.title: Adaptive Policy Selection and Fine-Tuning under Interaction Budgets for Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Alper Kamil Bozkurt, Xiaoan Xu, Shangtong Zhang, Miroslav Pajic, Yuichi Motai

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for offline-to-online RL that jointly handles policy selection and fine-tuning under interaction budgets, addressing the tension between evaluation and improvement phases.

entry.title: Expert Routing for Communication-Efficient MoE via Finite Expert Banks

author.name: Mohammad Reza Deylam Salehi, Ali Khalesi

entry.summary: Treats MoE gating as a stochastic channel using information theory, developing a finite-bank construction with pretrained experts and analyzing routing information via algorithmic mutual information.

entry.title: COPYCOP: Ownership Verification for Graph Neural Networks

author.name: Rahul Nandakumar, Deepayan Chakrabarti

entry.summary: Proposes CopyCop for GNN ownership verification that can identify copycat GNNs even when architectures, weights, embedding dimensions differ and outputs are transformed, with theoretical guarantees.

entry.title: Differentiable Parameter Optimization for DAEs with State-Dependent Events

author.name: Ion Matei, Maksym Zhenirovskyy, Anthony Wong

entry.summary: Develops differentiable parameter optimization for differential-algebraic equations with state-dependent events, handling algebraic constraints, guard equations, and reset maps with two gradient computation strategies.

entry.title: A Robust Foundation Model for Conservation Laws: Injecting Context into Flux Neural Operators via Recurrent Vision Transformers

author.name: Taeyoung Kim, Joon-Hyuk Ko

entry.summary: Proposes a hypernetwork architecture that augments Flux Neural Operators with ViT-based context injection for solving conservation laws without explicit access to governing equations.

entry.title: Region-adaptable retrieval of coastal biogeochemical parameters from near-surface hyperspectral remote sensing reflectance using physics-aware meta-learning

author.name: Yiqing Guo, Nagur R. C. Cherukuru, Eric A. Lehmann, S. L. Kesav Unnithan, Tim J. Malthus, Gemma Kerrisk, Xiubin Qi, Faisal Islam, Tisham Dhar, Mark J. Doubell

entry.summary: Proposes a physics-aware meta-learning framework for retrieving coastal biogeochemical parameters from hyperspectral remote sensing, enabling rapid adaptation across different water bodies.

entry.title: CoMemNet: Contrastive Sampling with Memory Replay Network for Continual Traffic Prediction

author.name: Mei Wu, Wenchao Weng, Wenxin Su, Wenjie Tang, Wei Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes CoMemNet, a dual-branch continual learning framework for traffic prediction using contrastive learning and memory replay to handle evolving traffic network structures.

entry.title: VARS-FL: Validation-Aligned Client Selection for Non-IID Federated Learning in IoT Systems

author.name: Mohamed Lakas, Mohamed Amine Ferrag

entry.summary: Proposes VARS-FL, a client selection framework for federated learning that uses validation-aligned reputation scoring to quantify client contributions, particularly for non-IID IoT settings.

entry.title: Fast Gauss-Newton for Multiclass Cross-Entropy

author.name: Mikalai Korbit, Mario Zanon

entry.summary: Decomposes the generalized Gauss-Newton curvature for multiclass softmax into true-vs-rest and within-competitor terms, dropping the latter to get a faster positive semidefinite approximation (Fast Gauss-Newton) that scales better with number of classes.

entry.title: In-Context Black-Box Optimization with Unreliable Feedback

author.name: Nicolas Samuel Blumer, Julien Martinelli, Samuel Kaski

entry.summary: Studies feedback-informed in-context black-box optimization where a pretrained optimizer conditions on both observed history and cheap auxiliary feedback (from experts, simulators, etc.) for the current candidate.

entry.title: AffineLens: Capturing the Continuous Piecewise Affine Functions of Neural Networks

author.name: Yi Wei, Xuan Qi, Furao shen, Jian Zhao, Vittorio Murino, Cigdem Beyan

entry.summary: Presents AffineLens, a framework for computing hyperplane arrangements and polyhedral structures underlying piecewise affine neural networks, enabling practical enumeration and visualization of affine regions in bounded input domains.

entry.title: Diversity Curves for Graph Representation Learning

author.name: Katharina Limbeck, Nadja H\"ausermann, Martin Carrasco, Guy Wolf, Bastian Rieck

entry.summary: Introduces diversity curves for graph-level representations by tracking structural diversity across coarsening levels, creating interpretable, efficient, and size-comparable graph embeddings.

entry.title: Hedging Memory Horizons for Non-Stationary Prediction via Online Aggregation

author.name: Yutong Wang, Yannig Goude, Qiwei Yao

entry.summary: Proposes MELO, a model-agnostic online prediction method that hedges across multiple adaptation memory scales for non-stationary settings. Establishes deterministic oracle inequalities for the aggregation.

entry.title: SNAPO: Smooth Neural Adjoint Policy Optimization for Optimal Control via Differentiable Simulation

author.name: Dmitri Goloubentsev, Natalija Karpichina

entry.summary: Introduces SNAPO, a framework combining neural policies with differentiable simulators for optimal control, computing exact gradients via adjoint methods while replacing hard constraints with smooth approximations.

entry.title: Towards Metric-Faithful Neural Graph Matching

author.name: Jyotirmaya Shivottam, Subhankar Mishra

entry.summary: Develops theoretical framework connecting GNN encoder geometry to graph edit distance estimation quality. Shows that hyperbolic encoders improve estimation when graph families exhibit tree-like or hierarchical structure.

entry.title: MPNet: A Robust and Efficient Manifold Pooling Network for Multi-Rhythm EEG Signal Decoding

author.name: Guoqing Cai, Kai Zeng, Shoulin Huang, Ting Ma

entry.summary: Proposes MPNet for EEG decoding that combines rhythm-adaptive convolutional frontend with novel manifold node pooling on Riemannian manifolds, enabling efficient processing of multi-rhythm EEG signals.

entry.title: Identifier-Free Code Embedding Models for Scalable Search

author.name: Eric Wolos, Michael Doyle

entry.summary: Develops identifier-free code embedding models for bidirectional association between source code and decompiled stripped code, fine-tuning Qwen3-Embedding for reverse engineering applications.

entry.title: Meta-learning for sample-efficient Bayesian optimisation of fed-batch processes

author.name: Becky Langdon, Gabriel D. Patr\'on, Chrysoula D. Kappatou, Robert M. Lee, Behrang Shafei, Jixiang Qing, Ruth Misener, Mark van der Wilk, Calvin Tsay

entry.summary: Investigates System-Aware Neural ODE Processes as meta-learning models for sample-efficient Bayesian optimization of fed-batch bioprocesses, addressing limitations of Gaussian processes for time-varying processes.

entry.title: Direct Estimation of Schr\"odinger Bridge Time-Series Drifts: Finite-Sample, Asymptotic, and Adaptive Guarantees

author.name: Othmane Mazhar, Huy\^en Pham

entry.summary: Studies nonparametric estimation of Schrödinger bridge drifts from i.i.d. data using Nadaraya-Watson plug-in estimators, providing finite-sample and asymptotic guarantees without relying on Sinkhorn iterations.

entry.title: Variational Smoothing and Inference for SDEs from Sparse Data with Dynamic Neural Flows

author.name: Yu Wang, Arnab Ganguly

entry.summary: Develops variational smoothing for SDEs from sparse data using neural networks trained to satisfy Kolmogorov backward equations with multiplicative updates at observation times.

entry.title: Closing the Loop: Unified 3D Scene Generation and Immersive Interaction via LLM-RL Coupling

author.name: Anh H. Vo, Sungyo Lee, Phil-Joong Kim, Soo-Mi Choi, Yong-Guk Kim

entry.summary: Presents a unified framework that closes the loop between LLM-driven 3D scene generation and immersive VR interaction, using reinforcement learning for spatial layout optimization under geometric and semantic constraints.

entry.title: Architecture Shape Governs QNN Trainability: Jacobian Null Space Growth and Parameter Efficiency

author.name: Michael Poppel, David Bucher, Maximilian Zorn, Markus Baumann, Sebastian W\"olckert, Claudia Linnhoff-Popien, Philipp Altmann, Jonas Stein

entry.summary: Shows that architecture shape (N qubits × L layers) in variational quantum circuits governs trainability through Jacobian null space growth, even when frequency spectra are identical. Proves structural rank deficiency as the mechanism.

entry.title: Revisiting Uncertainty: On Evidential Learning for Partially Relevant Video Retrieval

author.name: Jun Li, Peifeng Lai, Xuhang Lou, Jinpeng Wang, Yuting Wang, Ke Chen, Yaowei Wang, Shu-Tao Xia

entry.summary: Proposes Holmes, a hierarchical evidential learning framework for partially relevant video retrieval that explicitly models and quantifies uncertainty from vague queries and sparse temporal supervision.

entry.title: ConquerNet: Convolution-Smoothed Quantile ReLU Neural Networks with Minimax Guarantees

author.name: Tianpai Luo, Fangwei Wu, Weichi Wu

entry.summary: Proposes ConquerNet, convolution-smoothed quantile ReLU neural networks that yield smooth objectives for quantile regression while preserving the quantile structure, with minimax guarantees over Besov function classes.

entry.title: Covariate Balancing and Riesz Regression Should Be Guided by the Neyman Orthogonal Score in Debiased Machine Learning

author.name: Masahiro Kato

entry.summary: Argues that in debiased machine learning, balancing functions should be derived from the Neyman orthogonal score rather than chosen as functions of covariates alone, particularly for ATE estimation under treatment effect heterogeneity.

entry.title: IRC-Bench: Recognizing Entities from Contextual Cues in First-Person Reminiscences

author.name: Yehudit Aperstein, Eden Moran, Alexander Apartsin
