author.name: Zhuoyun Li, Boxuan Wang, Jinwei Hu, Zhenglin Huang, Qisong He, Xinmiao Huang, Guangliang Cheng, Xiaowei Huang, Yi Dong

entry.summary: S²R² introduces segment-level robustness analysis for LoRA fine-tuning, showing that prompt perturbations can cause critical drift in specific entities or conclusions even when global similarity is preserved. Uses optimal transport to align semantic segments between clean and perturbed generations. Adds adapter-stability regularization for targeted robustness.

entry.title: Prosa: Rubric-Based Evaluation of LLMs on Real User Chats in Brazilian Portuguese

author.name: Roseval Malaquias Junior, Giovana Kerche Bon\'as, Thales Sales Almeida, Hugo Abonizio, Thiago Laitz, Ramon Pires, Marcos Piau, Celio Larcher, Rodrigo Nogueira

entry.summary: Introduces Prosa, the first real-user multi-turn Brazilian Portuguese chat benchmark with rubric-based LLM evaluation. Shows that binary rubric scoring with multi-judge filtering removes judge model sensitivity that plagues holistic scoring - three judges agree on all 16 ranks vs only 7/16 with holistic scoring. Increases score gaps between models by 47%.

entry.title: SignVerse-2M: A Two-Million-Clip Pose-Native Universe of 25+ Sign Languages

author.name: Sen Fang, Hongbin Zhong, Yanxin Zhang, Dimitris N. Metaxas

entry.summary: SignVerse-2M presents a two-million-clip pose-native dataset spanning 25+ sign languages, designed for both recognition/translation and pose-driven video generation. Addresses the gap between RGB-based models (sensitive to recording conditions) and modern pose-guided generation frameworks. Provides unified keypoint representation across sign languages.

entry.title: Selector-Guided Autonomous Curriculum for One-Shot Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards

author.name: Rudray Dave, Vedang Dubey, Smit Deoghare, Sudhakar Mishra

entry.summary: Proposes Selector-Guided Autonomous Curriculum (SGAC) for one-shot RLVR that uses a learnable selector on multi-dimensional features instead of static reward variance heuristics for instance selection. Addresses that reward variance is misleading as a transferability measure. Improves math reasoning in LLMs with better instance selection.

entry.title: TRAP: Tail-aware Ranking Attack for World-Model Planning

author.name: Siyuan Duan, Ke Zhang, Xizhao Luo

entry.summary: TRAP introduces a tail-aware ranking attack for world model planning that exploits the long-tailed ranking structure of imagined trajectories. Shows that world models have a distinct backdoor vulnerability different from reactive models - the planning process can't simply wash out perturbations targeting ranking structure. First targeted attack exploiting world model planning.

entry.title: RamanBench: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Machine Learning on Raman Spectroscopy

author.name: Mario Koddenbrock, Christoph Lange, Robin Legner, Martin J\"ager, Martin K\"ogler, Mariano N. Cruz Bournazou, Peter Neubauer, Felix Biessmann, Erik Rodner

entry.summary: RamanBench introduces the first large-scale standardized benchmark for machine learning on Raman spectroscopy, unifying 74 datasets with 325,668 spectra across classification and regression tasks. This addresses a key gap in scientific ML where fragmented datasets and inconsistent evaluation have hindered progress.

entry.title: The Conversations Beneath the Code: Triadic Data for Long-Horizon Software Engineering Agents

author.name: Yelin Kim

entry.summary: Argues that the next generation of software engineering agents needs 'triadic data': synchronized human-human conversations, human-AI sessions, and multi-week cross-functional work context, rather than just code or solo-agent trajectories.

entry.title: Pretraining on Sleep Data Improves non-Sleep Biosignal Tasks

author.name: William Lehn-Schi{\o}ler, Magnus Ruud Kj{\ae}r, Phillip Hempel, Magnus Guldberg Pedersen, Rahul Thapa, Bryan He, Nicolai Spicher, Andreas Brink-Kjaer, Lars Kai Hansen, Emmanuel Mignot

entry.summary: Demonstrates that foundation models pretrained on sleep polysomnography data transfer effectively to non-sleep EEG and ECG tasks, outperforming training from scratch across eight downstream tasks.

entry.title: Set-Based Training of Neural Barrier Certificates for Safety Verification of Dynamical Systems

author.name: Miriam Kranzlm\"uller, Lukas Koller, Tobias Ladner, Matthias Althoff

entry.summary: Proposes set-based training of neural barrier certificates that integrates formal verification into the training loss, collapsing the iterative train-verify loop into a single optimization where zero loss proves safety.

entry.title: eOptShrinkQ: Near-Lossless KV Cache Compression Through Optimal Spectral Denoising and Quantization

author.name: Pei-Chun Su

entry.summary: Proposes eOptShrinkQ, a KV cache compression pipeline that decomposes key-value cache into low-rank shared context and full-rank per-token residual using optimal singular value shrinkage, then quantizes the residual. Leverages spiked random matrix model insights.

entry.title: OGPO: Sample Efficient Full-Finetuning of Generative Control Policies

author.name: Sarvesh Patil, Mitsuhiko Nakamoto, Manan Agarwal, Shashwat Saxena, Jesse Zhang, Giri Anantharaman, Cleah Winston, Chaoyi Pan, Douglas Chen, Nai-Chieh Huang, Zeynep Temel, Oliver Kroemer, Sergey Levine, Abhishek Gupta, Hongkai Da, Paarth Shah, Max Simchowitz

entry.summary: Introduces OGPO (Off-policy Generative Policy Optimization) for sample-efficient fine-tuning of generative control policies (diffusion/flow-based) using off-policy critics and modified PPO objectives. Achieves SOTA on manipulation tasks.

entry.title: Pairwise matrices for sparse autoencoders: single-feature inspection mislabels causal axes

author.name: Michael A. Riegler, Birk Sebastian Frostelid Torpmann-Hagen

entry.summary: Proposes pairwise matrix protocol for SAE interpretability that co-varies steering coefficient with joint conditions, revealing that single-feature inspection mislabels causal axes. Shows inverted U-shapes and non-additive interactions between features.

entry.title: Fully Automatic Trace Gas Plume Detection

author.name: V\'it R\r{u}\v{z}i\v{c}ka, David R. Thompson, Jay E. Fahlen, Amanda M. Lopez, Steven Lu, Chuchu Xiang, Holly Bender, Daniel Jensen, Philip G. Brodrick, Jake Lee, Brian Bue, Daniel H. Cusworth, Luis Guanter, Adam Chlus, Andrew Thorpe, Robert O. Green

entry.summary: Presents a fully automated framework combining ML-based morphological analysis with physics-based spectroscopic fitting to detect trace gas plumes from imaging spectrometer data without human participation. Applied to EMIT satellite data for environmental monitoring.

entry.title: Flow Matching on Symmetric Spaces

author.name: Francesco Ruscelli, Ferdinando Zanchetta, Rita Fioresi

entry.summary: Introduces flow matching on Riemannian symmetric spaces by reformulating it as flow matching on a Lie algebra subspace, linearizing geodesic handling. Demonstrated on real Grassmannians.

entry.title: Uni-OPD: Unifying On-Policy Distillation with a Dual-Perspective Recipe

author.name: Wenjin Hou, Shangpin Peng, Weinong Wang, Zheng Ruan, Yue Zhang, Zhenglin Zhou, Mingqi Gao, Yifei Chen, Kaiqi Wang, Hongming Yang, Chengquan Zhang, Zhuotao Tian, Han Hu, Yi Yang, Fei Wu, Hehe Fan

entry.summary: Proposes Uni-OPD, a unified on-policy distillation framework for LLMs and MLLMs that addresses insufficient exploration and unreliable teacher supervision through dual-perspective optimization.

entry.title: Flow Sampling: Learning to Sample from Unnormalized Densities via Denoising Conditional Processes

author.name: Aaron Havens, Brian Karrer, Neta Shaul

entry.summary: Introduces Flow Sampling, a framework for sampling from unnormalized densities using denoising conditional processes. Training objective regresses onto denoising diffusion drift constructed from energy function.

entry.title: CreativityBench: Evaluating Agent Creative Reasoning via Affordance-Based Tool Repurposing

author.name: Cheng Qian, Hyeonjeong Ha, Jiayu Liu, Bingxiang He, Jeonghwan Kim, Jiateng Liu, Bingxuan Li, Aditi Tiwari, Dwip Dalal, Zhenhailong Wang, Xiusi Chen, Mahdi Namazifar, Yunzhu Li, Heng Ji

entry.summary: Introduces CreativityBench evaluating LLM creative tool use through affordance-based reasoning. Builds a large-scale affordance knowledge base with 4K entities and 150K+ annotations, generating 14K grounded tasks.

entry.title: Geometric Deviation as an Unsupervised Pre-Generation Reliability Signal: Probing LLM Representations for Answerability

author.name: Yucheng Du

entry.summary: Investigates whether LLM representation geometry can serve as a pre-generation signal for detecting unanswerable queries, measuring hidden state deviation from an answerable reference set. Finds strong separation for math prompts (AUC 0.78-0.84) but geometry primarily encodes task form rather than universal answerability. Tests across Llama 3.1-8B, Qwen 2.5-7B, and Mistral-7B.

entry.title: Where Paths Split: Localized, Calibrated Control of Moral Reasoning in Large Language Models

author.name: Chenchen Yuan, Zheyu Zhang, Gjergji Kasneci

entry.summary: Presents Convergent-Divergent Routing for inference-time steering of LLM moral reasoning, finding and editing minimal branch points where ethical framework pathways diverge. Uses Common Spatial Patterns to extract discriminative directions at branch-point layers.

entry.title: Tempered Guided Diffusion

author.name: Andreas Makris, Paul Fearnhead, Chris Nemeth

entry.summary: Proposes Tempered Guided Diffusion (TGD), an annealed sequential Monte Carlo framework for training-free conditional sampling with diffusion priors. Uses tempered posteriors with particle reweighting and resampling to improve computation allocation efficiency.

entry.title: Conditional Diffusion Sampling

author.name: Francisco M. Castro-Mac\'ias, Pablo Morales-\'Alvarez, Saifuddin Syed, Daniel Hern\'andez-Lobato, Rafael Molina, Jos\'e Miguel Hern\'andez-Lobato

entry.summary: Introduces Conditional Diffusion Sampling (CDS) combining Parallel Tempering with diffusion-based approaches via Conditional Interpolants - stochastic processes with exact closed-form SDEs requiring no neural approximation. Addresses multimodal unnormalized distribution sampling.

entry.title: Lost in the Tower of Babel: The Adverse Effects of Incidental Multilingualism in LLMs

author.name: Anjishnu Mukherjee, Chutong Meng, Antonios Anastasopoulos

entry.summary: Argues that LLM multilingualism is 'incidental' - arising from uneven web training data rather than intentional design. Shows systematic inequalities across languages with empirical study of language self-reporting vs. actual response behavior.

entry.title: On Stable Long-Form Generation: Benchmarking and Mitigating Length Volatility

author.name: Zhitao He, Haolin Yang, Rui Min, Zeyu Qin, Yi R. Fung

entry.summary: Introduces VOLTBench to systematically quantify length volatility in LLM long-form generation, probes attention mechanisms to identify causes, and proposes mitigation strategies. Addresses overlooked reliability issue in LLM outputs.

entry.title: Do Large Language Models Plan Answer Positions? Position Bias in Multiple-Choice Question Generation

author.name: Xuemei Tang, Xufeng Duan, Zhenguang G. Cai

entry.summary: Reveals systematic position biases in LLM-generated multiple-choice questions, showing hidden representations encode predictive signals of correct answer position, suggesting implicit answer position planning during generation.

entry.title: Learn-to-learn on Arbitrary Textual Conditioning: A Hypernetwork-Driven Meta-Gated LLM

author.name: Luo Ji, Qi Qin, Ningyuan Xi, Teng Chen, Qingqing Gu, Hongyan Li

entry.summary: Proposes a hypernetwork-driven meta-gating mechanism that dynamically adjusts the nonlinearity of FFN layers via the β parameter in SwiGLU blocks, conditioned on textual context for meta-controllability.

entry.title: Energy-Based Constraint Networks: Learning Structural Coherence Across Modalities

author.name: Chirag Shinde

entry.summary: Introduces energy-based constraint networks that learn structural coherence from contrastive pairs across modalities. Achieves 93.4% accuracy on trained corruption types and generalizes to unseen types in both text and vision.

entry.title: AHPA: Adaptive Hierarchical Prior Alignment for Diffusion Transformers

author.name: Ruibin Min, Yexin Liu, Aimin Pan, Changsheng Lu, Jiafei Wu, Kelu Yao, Xiaogang Xu, Harry Yang

entry.summary: Proposes AHPA (Adaptive Hierarchical Prior Alignment) for accelerating Diffusion Transformer training by adapting alignment granularity based on signal-to-noise ratio - coarse alignment in high-noise regimes and fine-grained in low-noise regimes.

entry.title: Mix3R: Mixing Feed-forward Reconstruction and Generative 3D Priors for Joint Multi-view Aligned 3D Reconstruction and Pose Estimation

author.name: Siyou Lin, Zhou Xue, Hongwen Zhang, Liang An, Dongping Li, Shaohui Jiao, Yebin Liu

entry.summary: Presents Mix3R, combining feed-forward reconstruction and generative 3D priors in a unified framework for joint multi-view 3D reconstruction and pose estimation, producing both coarse voxels and per-view point maps in an aligned manner.

entry.title: Audio-Visual Intelligence in Large Foundation Models

author.name: You Qin, Kai Liu, Shengqiong Wu, Kai Wang, Shijian Deng, Yapeng Tian, Junbin Xiao, Yazhou Xing, Yinghao Ma, Bobo Li, Roger Zimmermann, Lei Cui, Furu Wei, Jiebo Luo, Hao Fei

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey of Audio-Visual Intelligence in foundation models, covering understanding, generation, and reasoning across auditory and visual modalities, noting rapid industrial progress (Meta MovieGen, Google Veo-3).

entry.title: Information Theory and Statistical Learning

author.name: Abbas El Gamal

entry.summary: A chapter draft for the third edition of Cover and Thomas's 'Elements of Information Theory' covering the intersection of information theory and statistical learning, focusing on model training applications.

entry.title: TimeTok: Granularity-Controllable Time-Series Generation via Hierarchical Tokenization

author.name: Seokhyun Lee, Jaeho Kim, Changjun Oh, Mihaela van der Schaar, Changhee Lee

entry.summary: Introduces TimeTok, a framework for granularity-controllable time-series generation using hierarchical tokenization that maps time series into coarse-to-fine token sequences for autoregressive generation at any target granularity.

entry.title: CoFlow: Coordinated Few-Step Flow for Offline Multi-Agent Decision Making

author.name: Guowei Zou, Haitao Wang, Beiwen Zhang, Boning Zhang, Hejun Wu

entry.summary: Proposes CoFlow for offline multi-agent RL, combining Coordinated Velocity Attention with Adaptive Coordination Gating to enable single-pass multi-agent generation while preserving inter-agent coordination.

entry.title: SciResearcher: Scaling Deep Research Agents for Frontier Scientific Reasoning

author.name: Tianshi Zheng, Rui Wang, Xiyun Li, Yangqiu Song, Tianqing Fang

entry.summary: Introduces SciResearcher, an automated agentic framework for frontier scientific reasoning that scales deep research agents through specialized academic source retrieval and multi-step computational reasoning.

entry.title: Catching the Infection Before It Spreads: Foresight-Guided Defense in Multi-Agent Systems

author.name: Yue Ma, Ziyuan Yang, Yi Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes a foresight-guided defense against infectious jailbreak in multi-agent systems that addresses localized interaction behaviors rather than applying global cure factors, avoiding response homogenization.

entry.title: Retrieval and Multi-Hop Reasoning in 1M-Token Context Windows: Evaluating LLMs on Classical Chinese Text

author.name: Eric H. C. Chow

entry.summary: Evaluates five frontier LLMs with 1M-token context windows on classical Chinese retrieval and 3-hop reasoning, finding that single-needle retrieval succeeds but multi-hop reasoning degrades significantly at longer contexts.

entry.title: ANO: A Principled Approach to Robust Policy Optimization

author.name: Yiheng Zhang, Yiming Wang, Kaiyan Zhao, Zhenglin Wan, Jiayu Chen, Leong Hou U

entry.summary: Proposes Anchored Neighborhood Optimization (ANO) for robust policy optimization, deriving a Redescending Influence Principle that addresses PPO's clipping limitations. Establishes a Unified Trust Region Framework generalizing existing RL objectives.

entry.title: DataClaw: A Process-Oriented Agent Benchmark for Exploratory Real-World Data Analysis

author.name: Qiaohong Zhang, Weihao Ye, Jialong Chen, Yi Luo, BoYuan Li, Bowen Deng, Zibin Zheng, Jianhao Lin, Wei-Shi Zheng, Chuan Chen

entry.summary: Introduces DataClaw, a process-oriented benchmark for exploratory data analysis with ~2.06M real-world records across enterprise domains and 492 tasks annotated with intermediate milestones for process-level evaluation of AI agents.

entry.title: Coherent Hierarchical Multi-Label Learning to Defer for Medical Imaging

author.name: Joshua Strong, Pramit Saha, Emma Sun, Helen Higham, Alison Noble

entry.summary: Studies the first Learning to Defer setting with hierarchical multi-label decisions in medical imaging. Formalizes coherent hierarchical deferral under a Selective-Exclusion contract and characterizes the Bayes-optimal deferral rule.

entry.title: Compress Then Adapt? No, Do It Together via Task-aware Union of Subspaces

author.name: Jingze Ge, Yun Liu, Xue Geng, Wanqi Dong, Wang Zhe Mark, Min Wu, Xulei Yang

entry.summary: Proposes JACTUS for jointly performing model compression and task adaptation rather than sequentially. Uses calibration-derived covariances to form a task-aware union of subspaces for simultaneous compression and fine-tuning.

entry.title: BRITE: A Benchmark for Reliable and Interpretable T2V Evaluation on Implausible Scenarios

author.name: Advait Tilak, Jiwon Choi, Nazifa Mouli, Wei Le

entry.summary: Introduces BRITE, the first T2V evaluation benchmark that unifies implausible scenario testing, audio-visual consistency assessment, and QA-based interpretable evaluation. Evaluates Sora 2, Veo 3.1, Runway Gen4.5, Pixverse V5.5.

entry.title: Rethink MAE with Linear Time-Invariant Dynamics

author.name: Zice Wang

entry.summary: Proposes SSMProbe, using State Space Models as permutation-sensitive probes for visual representations, demonstrating that token order is an exploitable dimension in frozen visual models like MAE, BEiT, and DINOv2.

entry.title: Seeking Information with RAG-Assistants: Does Model Size Matter in Human-AI Collaborations?

author.name: Lennard C. Froma, Tom Kouwenhoven, Maaike H. T. de Boer, Catholijn M. Jonker, Max J. van Duijn

entry.summary: Evaluates how RAG-assistant model size (3B, 8B, 70B) affects human-AI collaborative information seeking. Tests with 112 participants in a multi-turn scenario with compliance and privacy constraints.

entry.title: A Sentence Relation-Based Approach to Sanitizing Malicious Instructions

author.name: Soumil Datta, Melissa Umble, Daniel S. Brown, Guanhong Tao

entry.summary: Introduces SONAR, a prompt sanitization framework that identifies and removes injected malicious content using natural language inference metrics and sentence-level relational graphs.

entry.title: Model-Based Proactive Cost Generation for Learning Safe Policies Offline with Limited Violation Data

author.name: Ruiqi Xue, Lei Yuan, Kainuo Cheng, Jing-Wen Yang, Yang Yu

entry.summary: Proposes model-based proactive cost generation for offline safe RL using LLMs to identify safe-but-infeasible states when violation data is scarce. Integrates knowledge from large language models with limited offline data.

entry.title: Mesh Based Simulations with Spatial and Temporal awareness

author.name: Paul Garnier, Vincent Lannelongue, Elie Hachem

entry.summary: Proposes a unified framework bridging geometric deep learning and finite element methods for CFD surrogate modeling. Identifies that common training paradigms (node-wise supervision, explicit Euler time-stepping) are bottlenecks rather than architectures. Introduces spatial and temporal awareness aligned with actual PDE discretization methods.

entry.title: GRAVITY: Architecture-Agnostic Structured Anchoring for Long-Horizon Conversational Memory

author.name: Yushi Sun, Bowen Cao, Dong Fang, Lingfeng Su, Wai Lam

entry.summary: GRAVITY introduces a plug-and-play structured memory module for conversational agents that extracts entity profiles, temporal event tuples, and cross-session topic summaries from raw utterances. Bridges the gap between retrieved fragments and structured reasoning by providing relational, temporal, and thematic structures. Architecture-agnostic design for long-horizon conversations.

entry.title: GEASS: Training-Free Caption Steering for Hallucination Mitigation in Vision-Language Models

author.name: Zeshang Li, Shuoyang Zhang, Jiashen Ding

entry.summary: GEASS proposes a training-free method for mitigating hallucination in VLMs by selectively using self-generated captions. Shows that naive caption embedding can degrade accuracy by ~10 points. Introduces gated evidence-aware selective steering that treats caption usefulness as a per-query property.

entry.title: Discover Fast Power Allocation Solution for Multi-Target Tracking via AlphaEvolve Evolution

author.name: Zhenkang Hou, Wenqiang Pu, Junkun Yan, Rui Zhou, Hongwei Liu

entry.summary: Uses AlphaEvolve (LLM-guided evolutionary search) to discover a closed-form power allocation solution for multi-target radar tracking. Encodes radar states into physically-inspired features and evolves an interpretable scoring function. Achieves near-optimal performance with much lower computational cost than iterative optimization.

entry.title: GeoSAE: Geometric Prior-Guided Layer-Wise Sparse Autoencoder Annotation of Brain MRI Foundation Models

author.name: Favour Nerrise (Stanford University), Lucy Yin (Stanford University), Mohammad H. Abbasi (Stanford University), Kilian M. Pohl (Stanford University), Ehsan Adeli (Stanford University)

entry.summary: GeoSAE proposes geometry-guided sparse autoencoders for interpreting brain MRI foundation models, preventing feature collapse in deep transformer layers. Uses age-deconfounded partial correlations for feature annotation. Applied to ~14k scans from ADNI and AIBL studies for Alzheimer's disease research.

entry.title: Manifold-Aligned Guided Integrated Gradients for Reliable Feature Attribution

author.name: Soyeon Kim, Seongwoo Lim, Kyowoon Lee, Jaesik Choi

entry.summary: Proposes Manifold-Aligned Guided Integrated Gradients (MA-GIG) that constructs attribution paths in VAE latent space rather than input space, ensuring intermediate points stay on the data manifold for more reliable feature attributions.

entry.title: On the Privacy of LLMs: An Ablation Study

author.name: Karima Makhlouf, Lamiaa Basyoni, Syed Khaderi, Gabriel Marquez, Peter Sotomango, Mahmoud Awawdah, Sami Zhioua

entry.summary: Conducts a unified ablation study of privacy attacks (MIA, AIA, DEA, Backdoor) on LLMs, evaluating impact of model architecture, scale, dataset characteristics, and retrieval configuration under a common framework.

entry.title: Enhancing Multimodal In-Context Learning via Inductive-Deductive Reasoning

author.name: Haoyu Wang, Haonan Wang, Yuyan Chen, Jun Chen, Gang Liu, Qian Wang, Jiahong Yan, Yanghua Xiao

entry.summary: Proposes a framework restructuring multimodal in-context learning as an inductive-deductive process, addressing the problem that VLMs produce correct answers from flawed reasoning and struggle to extract consistent rules from demonstrations.

entry.title: CoRAL: Contact-Rich Adaptive LLM-based Control for Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Berk \c{C}i\c{c}ek, Mert K. Er, \"Ozg\"ur S. \"O\u{g}\"uz

entry.summary: CoRAL proposes using LLMs as cost designers that synthesize objective functions for sampling-based motion planners (MPPI) in contact-rich manipulation, with online adaptation of physical parameters during execution.

entry.title: OphMAE: Bridging Volumetric and Planar Imaging with a Foundation Model for Adaptive Ophthalmological Diagnosis

author.name: Tienyu Chang, Zhen Chen, Renjie Liang, Jinyu Ding, Jie Xu, Sunu Mathew, Amir Reza Hajrasouliha, Andrew J. Saykin, Ruogu Fang, Yu Huang, Jiang Bian, Qingyu Chen

entry.summary: OphMAE is a multi-imaging ophthalmic foundation model using masked autoencoders to bridge 3D OCT volumes and 2D fundus images, enabling diagnosis when advanced 3D imaging hardware is unavailable.

entry.title: Bolek: A Multimodal Language Model for Molecular Reasoning

author.name: Frederic Grabowski, Jacek Szczerbi\'nski, Maciej Ja\'skowski, Kalina Jasi\'nska-Kobus, Pawe{\l} D\k{a}browski-Tuma\'nski, Tomasz Jetka, Bartosz Topolski

entry.summary: Bolek is a compact multimodal language model for molecular reasoning that grounds explanations in molecular structure by injecting Morgan fingerprint embeddings into an instruction-tuned text decoder, enabling auditable molecular property predictions.

entry.title: Exploring Pass-Rate Reward in Reinforcement Learning for Code Generation

author.name: Xin-Ye Li, Ren-Biao Liu, Yun-Ji Zhang, Hui Sun, Zheng Xie, Ming Li

entry.summary: Studies pass-rate rewards as alternatives to binary rewards in RL for code generation. Finds that despite alleviating reward sparsity, pass-rate rewards don't reliably improve final performance over binary rewards in controlled experiments.

entry.title: Neuron-Anchored Rule Extraction for Large Language Models via Contrastive Hierarchical Ablation

author.name: Francesco Sovrano, Gabriele Dominici, Marc Langheinrich

entry.summary: Introduces MechaRule, a pipeline that grounds rule extraction in LLM circuits by localizing sparse 'agonist' neurons whose ablation disrupts rule-related behaviors. Bridges global rule extraction with mechanistic interpretability.

entry.title: Discovering Reinforcement Learning Interfaces with Large Language Models

author.name: Akshat Singh Jaswal, Ashish Baghel, Paras Chopra

entry.summary: Proposes LIMEN, an LLM-guided evolutionary framework that discovers complete RL task interfaces (observations + rewards) from raw simulator state, going beyond just reward design.

entry.title: PerFlow: Physics-Embedded Rectified Flow for Efficient Reconstruction and Uncertainty Quantification of Spatiotemporal Dynamics

author.name: Hao Zhou, Rui Zhang, Han Wan, Hao Sun

entry.summary: Proposes PerFlow, embedding physics constraints directly into a rectified flow model for sparse reconstruction and uncertainty quantification of PDE-governed spatiotemporal dynamics, avoiding slow sampling-time guidance.

entry.title: A Few-Step Generative Model on Cumulative Flow Maps

author.name: Zhiqi Li, Duowen Chen, Yuchen Sun, Bo Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes a few-step generative modeling framework based on cumulative flow maps that connects local instantaneous updates with finite-time transport, enabling one-step generation while preserving synthesis quality.

entry.title: Task Vector Geometry Underlies Dual Modes of Task Inference in Transformers

author.name: Hao Yan, Haolin Yang, Yiqiao Zhong

entry.summary: Studies how task vector geometry in transformer representations is shaped by training distribution and enables both task recognition and OOD generalization in synthetic latent-task settings.

entry.title: Integrating Feature Correlation in Differential Privacy with Applications in DP-ERM

author.name: Tianyu Wang, Luhao Zhang, Rachel Cummings

entry.summary: Introduces CorrDP, a relaxed differential privacy framework that accounts for feature sensitivity heterogeneity and correlations between sensitive and insensitive features using total variation distance.

entry.title: EvoJail: Evolutionary Diverse Jailbreak Prompt Generation for Large Language Models

author.name: Rui Tang, Kaiyu Xu, Pengsen Cheng, Hao Ren, Haizhou Wang, Shuyu Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes EvoJail, an evolutionary framework for generating diverse jailbreak prompts against LLMs, framed as multi-objective black-box optimization targeting both effectiveness and diversity.

entry.title: Coordination as an Architectural Layer for LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems

author.name: Maksym Nechepurenko, Pavel Shuvalov

entry.summary: Argues that coordination should be treated as a configurable architectural layer in multi-agent LLM systems, separate from agent logic. Instantiates the concept with prediction markets, demonstrating how coordination configuration maps to predictable failure modes.

entry.title: SURE-RAG: Sufficiency and Uncertainty-Aware Evidence Verification for Selective Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Jingxi Qiu, Zeyu Han, Cheng Huang

entry.summary: Introduces SURE-RAG, a framework treating evidence sufficiency as a set-level property for selective RAG answering. Uses a claim-evidence verifier with transparent aggregation to determine if evidence supports, refutes, or is insufficient for answers.

entry.title: Free Decompression with Algebraic Spectral Curves

author.name: Siavash Ameli, Chris van der Heide, Liam Hodgkinson, Michael W. Mahoney

entry.summary: Extends free decompression for extrapolating spectral information across matrix sizes using algebraic spectral curves. Removes strong assumptions from prior work, enabling application to more realistic ML models for understanding generalization, robustness, and scaling.

entry.title: Towards accurate extreme event likelihoods from diffusion model climate emulators

author.name: Peter Manshausen, Noah Brenowitz, Julius Berner, Karthik Kashinath, Mike Pritchard

entry.summary: Shows how diffusion model climate emulators (cBottle) can estimate probability densities of atmospheric states, enabling calculation of extreme event likelihoods like tropical cyclones under different boundary conditions. Useful for climate risk assessment.

entry.title: MTA: Multi-Granular Trajectory Alignment for Large Language Model Distillation

author.name: Pham Khanh Chi, Quoc Phong Dao, Thuat Nguyen, Linh Ngo Van, Trung Le, Thanh Hong Nguyen

entry.summary: Proposes Multi-Granular Trajectory Alignment (MTA) for knowledge distillation that aligns teacher-student representations along layer-wise trajectories, with word-level alignment at lower layers and phrase-level at higher layers.

entry.title: MemORAI: Memory Organization and Retrieval via Adaptive Graph Intelligence for LLM Conversational Agents

author.name: Hung Pham Van, Nguyen Manh Hieu, Khang Pham Tran Tuan, Nam Le Hai, Linh Ngo Van, Nguyen Thi Ngoc Diep, Trung Le

entry.summary: Introduces MemORAI, a graph-based memory framework for LLM conversational agents with selective filtering, provenance tracking, and query-adaptive retrieval using Dynamic Weighted PageRank. Achieves SOTA on LOCOMO and LongMemEval.

entry.title: MolViBench: Evaluating LLMs on Molecular Vibe Coding

author.name: Jiatong Li, Yuxuan Ren, Weida Wang, Changmeng Zheng, Xiao-yong Wei, Qing Li, Yatao Bian

entry.summary: Introduces MolViBench, a benchmark for evaluating LLMs on molecular vibe coding - generating executable programs for molecular tasks requiring joint programming, molecular understanding, and domain reasoning.

entry.title: FlexSQL: Flexible Exploration and Execution Make Better Text-to-SQL Agents

author.name: Quang Hieu Pham, Yang He, Ping Nie, Canwen Xu, Davood Rafiei, Yuepeng Wang, Xi Ye, Jocelyn Qiaochu Chen

entry.summary: Presents FlexSQL, a text-to-SQL agent with flexible database interaction that can explore schema and data at any reasoning point, generates diverse execution plans, and uses two-tiered repair.

entry.title: Attention Sinks in Massively Multilingual Neural Machine Translation:Discovery, Analysis, and Mitigation

author.name: Hillary Mutisya, John Mugane

entry.summary: Reports systematic attention sinks in NLLB-200 cross-attention where non-content tokens capture 83-91% of attention mass. Proposes filtering approach that reveals true content-level similarity hidden by the artifact.

entry.title: Who Decides What Is Harmful? Content Moderation Policy Through A Multi-Agent Personalised Inference Framework

author.name: Ewelina Gajewska, Michal Wawer, Katarzyna Budzynska, Jaroslaw A. Chudziak

entry.summary: Proposes an LLM-based multi-agent framework for personalized content moderation using Expert Agents, Manager Agent, and Ghost Profile Agent that simulates user perspectives for moderation decisions.

entry.title: Led to Mislead: Adversarial Content Injection for Attacks on Neural Ranking Models

author.name: Amin Bigdeli, Amir Khosrojerdi, Radin Hamidi Rad, Morteza Zihayat, Charles L. A. Clarke, Ebrahim Bagheri

entry.summary: Proposes CRAFT, a supervised framework for black-box adversarial attacks on neural ranking models using LLMs, with adversarial dataset generation, fine-tuning, and preference optimization for rank manipulation.

entry.title: FACTOR: Counterfactual Training-Free Test-Time Adaptation for Open-Vocabulary Object Detection

author.name: Kaixiang Zhao, Mao Ye, Lihua Zhou, Hu Wang, Luping Ji, Song Tang, Xiatian Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes FACTOR, a training-free test-time adaptation method for open-vocabulary object detection using counterfactual reasoning. Perturbs test images along non-causal attributes to identify and correct spurious correlations without online optimization.

entry.title: A Benchmark for Interactive World Models with a Unified Action Generation Framework

author.name: Jianjie Fang, Yingshan Lei, Qin Wan, Ziyou Wang, Yuchao Huang, Yongyan Xu, Baining Zhao, Weichen Zhang, Chen Gao, Xinlei Chen, Yong Li

entry.summary: Introduces iWorld-Bench, a benchmark for interactive world models with 330k video clips and 2.1k high-quality samples, plus an Action Generation Framework to unify different interaction modalities across world models.

entry.title: UniCorrn: Unified Correspondence Transformer Across 2D and 3D

author.name: Prajnan Goswami, Tianye Ding, Feng Liu, Huaizu Jiang

entry.summary: Presents UniCorrn, the first correspondence model with shared weights unifying geometric matching across 2D-2D, 2D-3D, and 3D-3D tasks through a dual-stream decoder separating appearance and positional features.

entry.title: Unifying Dynamical Systems and Graph Theory to Mechanistically Understand Computation in Neural Networks

author.name: Jatin Sharma, Danyal Akarca, Dan F. M Goodman

entry.summary: Shows that the function of trained RNNs can be recovered by analyzing multi-hop graph pathways between input and output units, with hop length decomposition revealing temporal routing of information.

entry.title: Learning Reactive Dexterous Grasping via Hierarchical Task-Space RL Planning and Joint-Space QP Control

author.name: Ho Jae Lee, Yonghyeon Lee, Alexander Alexiev, Tzu-Yuan Lin, Se Hwan Jeon, Sangbae Kim

entry.summary: Proposes a hierarchical control framework for reactive dexterous grasping combining multi-agent RL (arm and hand agents) for high-level planning with GPU-parallelized QP control for safe joint execution. Achieves zero-shot sim-to-real transfer.

entry.title: Toward a Better Evaluations Ecosystem

author.name: Benjamin Arnav

entry.summary: Argues that AI model evaluations are broken due to inconsistent methodologies and self-reporting by companies, advocating for third-party auditing similar to other high-stakes industries. Proposes specific reforms to the evaluation ecosystem.

entry.title: Faithful Mobile GUI Agents with Guided Advantage Estimator

author.name: Haowen Hu, Pengzhou Cheng, Zheng Wu, Lingzhong Dong, Gongshen Liu, Zhuosheng Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Faithful-Agent, a framework for GUI agents that prioritizes grounding actions in screen evidence rather than memorized shortcuts, using faithfulness-oriented SFT followed by RFT with a guided advantage estimator.

entry.title: SCALE-LoRA: Auditing Post-Retrieval LoRA Composition with Residual Merging and View Reliability

author.name: Shuaipeng Zhou, Yu Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces SCALE-LoRA, a post-retrieval framework for auditing and composing LoRA adapters from open pools, addressing compatibility issues between retrieved adapters through residual merging and view reliability assessment.

entry.title: CBV: Clean-label Backdoor Attacks on Vision Language Models via Diffusion Models

author.name: Ji Guo, Xiaolong Qin, Cencen Liu, Jielei Wang, Jierun Chen, Wenbo Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes CBV, a clean-label backdoor attack on Vision-Language Models that uses diffusion models to generate natural-looking poisoned examples via score modification during reverse diffusion, avoiding detectable image-text mismatches.

entry.title: Zero-Shot Confidence Estimation for Small LLMs: When Supervised Baselines Aren't Worth Training

author.name: Luong N. Nguyen

entry.summary: Shows that average token log-probability, a zero-shot signal requiring no training data, matches or exceeds supervised baselines for routing queries between local and cloud LLMs. Demonstrates practical cost-control for LLM deployment without needing labeled routing data.

entry.title: Strategy-Aware Optimization Modeling with Reasoning LLMs

author.name: Ruiqing Zhao, Fengzhi Li, Yuan Zuo, Rui Liu, Yansong Liu, Yunfei Ma, Fanyu Meng, Junlan Feng

entry.summary: Proposes SAGE, a strategy-aware framework that makes optimization modeling strategy explicit in LLM training. Builds solver-verified multi-strategy datasets and trains with Segment-Weighted GRPO, improving pass@1 from 72.7 to 80.3 on optimization benchmarks.

entry.title: First-Order Efficiency for Probabilistic Value Estimation via A Statistical Viewpoint

author.name: Ziqi Liu, Kiljae Lee, Yuan Zhang, Weijing Tang

entry.summary: Establishes first-order efficiency bounds for probabilistic value estimation (Shapley values, semivalues), showing that seemingly distinct estimators share a common first-order error structure that can be unified and optimized.

entry.title: Separating Intelligence from Execution: A Workflow Engine for the Model Context Protocol

author.name: Abhinav Singh Parmar

entry.summary: Presents MCP Workflow Engine that separates intelligence (reasoning about what to do) from execution (carrying it out) for LLM agents using the Model Context Protocol. An agent reasons once to produce a declarative workflow blueprint that can be re-executed without token cost.

entry.title: OceanPile: A Large-Scale Multimodal Ocean Corpus for Foundation Models

author.name: Yida Xue, Ningyu Zhang, Tingwei Wu, Zhe Ma, Daxiong Ji, Zhao Wang, Guozhou Zheng, Huajun Chen

entry.summary: Introduces OceanPile, a large-scale multimodal ocean corpus for foundation models, addressing the data bottleneck in AI for ocean science. Provides unified schemas and semantic alignment across fragmented marine data sources.

entry.title: Adversarial Flow Matching for Imperceptible Attacks on End-to-End Autonomous Driving

author.name: Xinyu Zeng, Xiangkun He, Lei Tao, Chen Lv, Hong Cheng

entry.summary: Proposes adversarial flow matching for generating imperceptible attacks on end-to-end autonomous driving systems that target the Transformer backbone shared across both monolithic and modular AD paradigms.

entry.title: Retrieval-Guided Generation for Safer Histopathology Image Captioning

author.name: Md. Enamul Hoq, Wataru Uegami, Saghir Alfasly, Ghazal Alabtah, Sahar Rahimi Malakshan, Armita Kazemi, Alex T. Schmitgen, Fred Prior, H. R. Tizhoosh

entry.summary: Proposes retrieval-guided generation (RGG) as a safer alternative to generative models for histopathology image captioning, reducing hallucinations by summarizing expert text from similar cases. Achieves better semantic alignment than MedGemma with fewer unsupported diagnoses.

entry.title: Graph Rewiring in GNNs to Mitigate Over-Squashing and Over-Smoothing: A Survey

author.name: Hugo Attali, Nathalie Pernelle, Davide Buscaldi, Fragkiskos D. Malliaros

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey of graph rewiring techniques in GNNs addressing over-squashing and over-smoothing. Reviews state-of-the-art approaches with theoretical foundations for modifying graph topology to enhance information propagation.

entry.title: Physiology-Aware Masked Cross-Modal Reconstruction for Biosignal Representation Learning

author.name: Hao Zhou, Simon A. Lee, Cyrus Tanade, Keum San Chun, Juhyeon Lee, Migyeong Gwak, Megha Thukral, Justin Sung, Eugene Hwang, Mehrab Bin Morshed, Li Zhu, Viswam Nathan, Md Mahbubur Rahman, Subramaniam Venkatraman, Sharanya Arcot Desai

entry.summary: Introduces xMAE, a biosignal pretraining framework using masked cross-modal reconstruction across temporally ordered biosignals (ECG to PPG). Leverages the directional temporal dynamics between physiologically related signals.

entry.title: Position: LLM Serving Needs Mathematical Optimization and Algorithmic Foundations, Not Just Heuristics

author.name: Zijie Zhou

entry.summary: Position paper arguing that LLM serving systems need mathematical optimization foundations rather than heuristics. Points out that vLLM, SGLang still use generic policies (FIFO, LRU, round-robin) that ignore LLM-specific structure.

entry.title: Chain of Evidence: Pixel-Level Visual Attribution for Iterative Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Peiyang Liu, Ziqiang Cui, Xi Wang, Di Liang, Wei Ye

entry.summary: Presents Chain of Evidence (CoE), a visual attribution framework for iterative RAG that provides pixel-level evidence grounding. Addresses coarse attribution and visual semantic loss in document-based retrieval systems.

entry.title: From Packets to Patterns: Interpreting Encrypted Network Traffic as Longitudinal Behavioral Signals

author.name: Rameen Mahmood, Omar El Shahawy, Souptik Barua, Zachary Beattie, Jeffrey Kaye, Xuhai "Orson'' Xu, Chao-Yi Wu, Danny Yuxing Huang

entry.summary: Tests whether encrypted smartphone network traffic can passively capture behavioral patterns related to sleep, stress, and loneliness. Uses transformer backbone with per-user adapters and sparse autoencoders for interpretable feature extraction. Demonstrates that network metadata alone reveals behavioral signals without content inspection.

entry.title: Khala: Scaling Acoustic Token Language Models Toward High-Fidelity Music Generation

author.name: Jiafeng Liu, Yuanliang Dong, Hongjia Liu, Yuqing Cheng, Zhancheng Guo, Huijing Liang, Wenbo Zhan, Yuming Sun, Xiaobing Li, Feng Yu, Maosong Sun

entry.summary: Khala proposes a two-stage coarse-to-fine music generation framework using a 64-layer residual vector quantization acoustic representation. A backbone generates coarse tokens for full tracks, then super-resolution completes finer tokens within the same acoustic space. Explores progressive modeling within a single deep acoustic-token hierarchy.

entry.title: Phone2Act: A Low-Cost, Hardware-Agnostic Teleoperation System for Scalable VLA Data Collection

author.name: Om Mandhane, Bipin Yadav, Sangeetha Prasanna Ram, Gopalakrishnan Narayanan

entry.summary: Phone2Act presents a low-cost teleoperation framework using commodity smartphones as 6-DoF robot controllers via Google ARCore, built on ROS 2 with modular bridge nodes supporting multiple robot platforms. Includes Universal Recorder for synchronized multi-camera + robot state data. Democratizes VLA data collection.

entry.title: EditPropBench: Measuring Factual Edit Propagation in Scientific Manuscripts

author.name: Garvin Kruthof

entry.summary: EditPropBench benchmarks whether LLM editors can propagate factual edits through dependent claims in scientific manuscripts - finding that when a dataset size changes, qualitative claims about it should also update. Current models struggle with this.

entry.title: On the Optimal Sample Complexity of Offline Multi-Armed Bandits with KL Regularization

author.name: Kaixuan Ji, Qiwei Di, Heyang Zhao, Qingyue Zhao, Quanquan Gu

entry.summary: Provides sharp sample complexity analysis of KL-regularized offline multi-armed bandits, showing tight bounds that depend on regularization strength and proving minimax optimality of KL-PCB algorithm.

entry.title: Hyp2Former: Hierarchy-Aware Hyperbolic Embeddings for Open-Set Panoptic Segmentation

author.name: Yao Lu, Rohit Mohan, Florian Drews, Yakov Miron, Abhinav Valada

entry.summary: Hyp2Former uses hyperbolic embeddings to encode hierarchical semantic relationships for open-set panoptic segmentation, enabling better discrimination of unknown objects from known categories without explicit unknown modeling during training.

entry.title: Learning Equivariant Neural-Augmented Object Dynamics From Few Interactions

author.name: Sergio Orozco, Tushar Kusnur, Brandon May, George Konidaris, Laura Herlant

entry.summary: PIEGraph combines analytical physics (spring-mass) with equivariant graph neural networks to learn object dynamics for both rigid and deformable bodies from limited real-world interaction data.

entry.title: Multilingual Safety Alignment via Self-Distillation

author.name: Ruiyang Qin, Qingzhuo Wang, Dongrui Liu, Qiang Li, Zhihua Wei, Wen Shen

entry.summary: Proposes Multilingual Self-Distillation (MSD) for transferring safety capabilities from high-resource to low-resource languages without requiring response data in any language, addressing multilingual safety misalignment in LLMs.

entry.title: Self-Mined Hardness for Safety Fine-Tuning

author.name: Prakhar Gupta, Garv Shah, Donghua Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes self-mined hardness for LLM safety fine-tuning: scores prompts by how often the model's own rollouts are harmful, then fine-tunes on hardest prompts. Dramatically reduces attack success but initially causes over-refusal, mitigated by interleaving benign prompts.

entry.title: Text-Conditional JEPA for Learning Semantically Rich Visual Representations

author.name: Chen Huang, Xianhang Li, Vimal Thilak, Etai Littwin, Josh Susskind

entry.summary: Proposes Text-Conditional JEPA (TC-JEPA) that uses image captions to condition masked feature prediction in visual self-supervised learning, reducing prediction uncertainty and making patch features more semantically meaningful.

entry.title: Partially Observed Structural Causal Models

author.name: Turan Orujlu, Jordan Matelsky, Martin V. Butz, Charley M. Wu, Konrad P. Kording

entry.summary: Introduces Partially Observed Structural Causal Models (POSCMs) where latent contexts co-determine interaction structure and mechanisms. Uses Kolmogorov-Arnold-Sprecher decomposition for edge-functional representation enabling surgical interventions.

entry.title: Toward Structural Multimodal Representations: Specialization, Selection, and Sparsification via Mixture-of-Experts

author.name: Hahyeon Choi, Nojun Kwak

entry.summary: Proposes S3 framework that decomposes multimodal inputs into semantic experts with selective routing and sparsification, finding a reverse U-shaped sparsity-performance trend. Demonstrates that structured sparse representations outperform fixed embeddings for multimodal learning.

entry.title: Rethinking the Rank Threshold for LoRA Fine-Tuning

author.name: Juneyoung Park

entry.summary: Shows that for binary classification in the NTK regime, the sufficient LoRA rank for absence of spurious local minima can be reduced from r≥12 to r=1, significantly relaxing prior theoretical constraints.

entry.title: Optimal Posterior Sampling for Policy Identification in Tabular Markov Decision Processes

author.name: Cyrille Kone, Kevin Jamieson

entry.summary: Proposes an efficient posterior sampling algorithm for policy identification in finite-horizon MDPs that achieves asymptotic optimal sample complexity with O(S²AH) per-episode computation.

entry.title: Refining Compositional Diffusion for Reliable Long-Horizon Planning

author.name: Kyowoon Lee, Yunhao Luo, Anh Tong, Jaesik Choi

entry.summary: Proposes Refining Compositional Diffusion (RCD), a training-free guidance method that addresses mode-averaging in compositional diffusion planning using self-reconstruction error as density proxy.

entry.title: Conformalized Percentile Interval: Finite Sample Validity and Improved Conditional Performance

author.name: Ran Zou, Wanrong Zhu, Bin Nan

entry.summary: Proposes a conformal prediction method using probability integral transform (PIT) of neural-network-estimated conditional CDFs to construct prediction intervals with finite-sample validity and improved conditional coverage. Addresses heteroskedasticity, skewed responses, and estimation errors.

entry.title: Revisiting Graph-Tokenizing Large Language Models: A Systematic Evaluation of Graph Token Understanding

author.name: Zhongjian Zhang, Yue Yu, Mengmei Zhang, Junping Du, Xiao Wang, Chuan Shi

entry.summary: Challenges the assumption that Graph-Tokenizing LLMs (GTokenLLMs) fully understand graph tokens. Proposes GTEval evaluation pipeline to assess graph-token understanding via instruction transformations, revealing limitations in current graph-LLM integration.

entry.title: Expanding functional protein sequence space using high entropy generative models

author.name: Roberto Netti, Emily Hinds, Francesco Calvanese, Rama Ranganathan, Martin Weigt, Francesco Zamponi

entry.summary: Investigates the relationship between Boltzmann Machine parameter density and experimental protein performance using Chorismate Mutase. Identifies a maximum-entropy model (meDCA) along decimation trajectories that optimally balances constraint satisfaction with generative flexibility.

entry.title: Training-Free Probabilistic Time-Series Forecasting with Conformal Seasonal Pools

author.name: Valery Manokhin

entry.summary: Proposes Conformal Seasonal Pools (CSP), a training-free probabilistic time-series forecaster mixing same-season empirical draws with residual draws. Significantly outperforms DeepNPTS on CRPS and coverage across 6 datasets while running 500x faster on CPU.

entry.title: Can AI Debias the News? LLM Interventions Improve Cross-Partisan Receptivity but LLMs Overestimate Their Own Effectiveness

author.name: Faisal Feroz, Jonas R. Kunst

entry.summary: Tests whether LLM-generated debiasing of liberal news headlines improves conservative readers' trust. Finds subtle lexical debiasing has no effect, but substantive reframing increases perceived trustworthiness and engagement without backfire effects. LLMs overestimate their own effectiveness.

entry.title: Embedding-based In-Context Prompt Training for Enhancing LLMs as Text Encoders

author.name: Ailiang Lin, Zhuoyun Li, Keyu Mao, Kotaro Funakoshi, Manabu Okumura

entry.summary: Proposes EPIC, replacing discrete text demonstrations with continuous embeddings for in-context learning in embedding generation. Reduces token overhead while maintaining or improving embedding quality during training and inference.

entry.title: Compositional Multi-hop Factual Error Correction via Decomposition-and-Injection

author.name: Lei Zhu, Xiaobao Wang, Jianbiao Yang, Chenyang Wang, Dongxiao He, Longbiao Wang, Jianwu Dang

entry.summary: Proposes CECoR for compositional multi-hop factual error correction, decomposing claims into reasoning steps and injecting corrections at specific points in the reasoning chain.

entry.title: A multilingual hallucination benchmark: MultiWikiQHalluA

author.name: Freja Thoresen, Dan Saattrup Smart

entry.summary: Creates multilingual hallucination benchmark for 306 languages using MultiWikiQA and LettuceDetect, training token-level classifiers for 30 European languages. Evaluates hallucination rates across multiple LLMs.

entry.title: Synthetic Users, Real Differences: an Evaluation Framework for User Simulation in Multi-Turn Conversations

author.name: Yu Lu Liu, Hyokun Yun, Tanya Roosta, Ziang Xiao

entry.summary: Proposes realsim, an evaluation framework for user simulation realism in multi-turn conversations, enabling distributional comparison of real vs. simulated dialogues along 8 dimensions.

entry.title: WindowQuant: Mixed-Precision KV Cache Quantization based on Window-Level Similarity for VLMs Inference Optimization

author.name: Wei Tao, Xiaoyang Qu, Peiqiang Wang, Guokuan Li, Jiguang Wan, Kai Lu, Jianzong Wang

entry.summary: Proposes WindowQuant for mixed-precision KV cache quantization in video language models, using window-level adaptive quantization that is hardware-efficient compared to token-level approaches.

entry.title: Fight Poison with Poison: Enhancing Robustness in Few-shot Machine-Generated Text Detection with Adversarial Training

author.name: Wenjing Duan, Qi Zhou, Yuanfan Li

entry.summary: Proposes REACT, an adversarial training framework combining RAG-guided attacker with contrastive few-shot detector for robust machine-generated text detection under limited supervision.

entry.title: VEBench:Benchmarking Large Multimodal Models for Real-World Video Editing

author.name: Andong Deng, Dawei Du, Zhenfang Chen, Wen Zhong, Fan Chen, Guang Chen, Chia-Wen Kuo, Longyin Wen, Chen Chen, Sijie Zhu

entry.summary: Introduces VEBench, the first comprehensive benchmark for evaluating Large Multimodal Models on real-world video editing tasks, containing 3.9K edited videos (257+ hours) and 3,080 human-verified QA pairs testing both editing knowledge and operational reasoning.

entry.title: VLMaxxing through FrameMogging Training-Free Anti-Recomputation for Video Vision-Language Models

author.name: JF Bastien, Sam D'Amico

entry.summary: Introduces a training-free anti-recomputation method for video VLMs that reuses visual state across follow-up queries on the same video, achieving 14.9-35.9x latency reduction on Qwen2.5-VL-7B while preserving accuracy.

entry.title: Erase Persona, Forget Lore: Benchmarking Multimodal Copyright Unlearning in Large Vision Language Models

author.name: JuneHyoung Kwon, JungMin Yun, YoungBin Kim

entry.summary: Introduces CoVUBench, the first benchmark for evaluating copyright content unlearning in Large Vision-Language Models, using procedurally generated synthetic data to test cross-modal concept erasure.

entry.title: Stream-R1: Reliability-Perplexity Aware Reward Distillation for Streaming Video Generation

author.name: Bin Wu, Mengqi Huang, Shaojin Wu, Weinan Jia, Yuxin Wang, Zhendong Mao, Yongdong Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Stream-R1 for streaming video generation distillation, introducing reliability-perplexity aware reward weighting that treats different rollouts, frames, and pixels differently based on supervision quality.

entry.title: Video Generation Models as World Models: Efficient Paradigms, Architectures and Algorithms

author.name: Muyang He, Hanzhong Guo, Junxiong Lin, Yizhou Yu

entry.summary: Comprehensive review of video generation frameworks as world models, introducing a taxonomy across efficient paradigms, architectures, and inference algorithms for practical world simulation.

entry.title: Generalization Bounds of Spiking Neural Networks via Rademacher Complexity

author.name: Shao-Qun Zhang, Zhi-Hua Zhou

entry.summary: Provides generalization bounds for Spiking Neural Networks via Rademacher complexity, extending beyond previous exponential bounds to cover deterministic, stochastic, and mixed firing regimes.

entry.title: Bridging the Embodiment Gap: Disentangled Cross-Embodiment Video Editing

author.name: Zhiyuan Li, Wenyan Yang, Wenshuai Zhao, Yue Ma, Yuanpeng Tu, Pekka Marttinen, Joni Pajarinen

entry.summary: Proposes a generative framework for cross-embodiment video editing that disentangles task-relevant information from embodiment-specific kinematics using dual contrastive objectives. Enables learning robot manipulation from human demonstration videos.

entry.title: On Model-Based Clustering With Entropic Optimal Transport

author.name: Gonzalo Mena

entry.summary: Develops model-based clustering using entropic optimal transport as a loss function that shares the same global optimum as log-likelihood but has a better-behaved optimization landscape, avoiding spurious local optima of EM.

entry.title: FIBER: A Differentially Private Optimizer with Filter-Aware Innovation Bias Correction

author.name: Duc Dm, Thao Do, Minh Son Hoang, Anh Le Duc Tran, Daeyoung Kim, Huy Nguyen

entry.summary: Proposes FIBER, a DP optimizer that correctly handles the interaction between temporal filtering and adaptive optimization in differentially private training. Addresses miscalibration of bias corrections when filtering privatized gradients.

entry.title: Complex Equation Learner: Rational Symbolic Regression with Gradient Descent in Complex Domain

author.name: Sergei Garmaev, Maurice Gauch\'e, Olga Fink

entry.summary: Proposes Complex Equation Learner that extends symbolic regression to complex domain, allowing optimization trajectories to bypass real-axis singularities. Enables stable use of division, log, and sqrt operators.

entry.title: GRPO-TTA: Test-Time Visual Tuning for Vision-Language Models via GRPO-Driven Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Yujun Li, Hongyuan Zhang, Yuan Yuan

entry.summary: Proposes GRPO-TTA, adapting Group Relative Policy Optimization for test-time adaptation of vision-language models like CLIP. Reformulates class-specific prompt prediction as group-wise policy optimization without ground-truth labels.

entry.title: Rethinking Temporal Consistency in Video Object-Centric Learning: From Prediction to Correspondence

author.name: Zhiyuan Li, Rongzhen Zhao, Wenyan Yang, Wenshuai Zhao, Pekka Marttinen, Joni Pajarinen

entry.summary: Demonstrates that learned dynamics modules in video object-centric learning are expensive approximations of discrete correspondence problems. Introduces Grounded Correspondence, replacing learned transitions with deterministic bipartite matching on frozen backbone features.

entry.title: Injecting Distributional Awareness into MLLMs via Reinforcement Learning for Deep Imbalanced Regression

author.name: Yao Du, Shanshan Li, Xiaomeng Li

entry.summary: Proposes a distribution-aware reinforcement learning framework for multimodal LLMs in imbalanced regression tasks, using Concordance Correlation Coefficient-based reward to address regression-to-the-mean behavior in long-tailed distributions.

entry.title: Can Multimodal Large Language Models Understand Pathologic Movements? A Pilot Study on Seizure Semiology

author.name: Lina Zhang, Tonmoy Monsoor, Mehmet Efe Lorasdagi, Prateik Sinha, Chong Han, Peizheng Li, Yuan Wang, Jessica Pasqua, Colin McCrimmon, Rajarshi Mazumder, Vwani Roychowdhury

entry.summary: Evaluates multimodal LLMs for automated recognition of pathological movements in seizure videos, finding MLLMs outperform fine-tuned CNN/ViT baselines on 13 of 18 semiological features in zero-shot settings.

entry.title: Diffusion Masked Pretraining for Dynamic Point Cloud

author.name: Zhuoyue Zhang, Jihua Zhu, Chaowei Fang, Jian Liu, Ajmal Saeed Mian

entry.summary: Proposes DiMP (Diffusion Masked Pretraining) for dynamic point clouds, using diffusion modeling for both positional inference and motion learning to address positional leakage and deterministic motion targets in existing methods.

entry.title: Before Forgetting, Learn to Remember: Revisiting Foundational Learning Failures in LVLM Unlearning Benchmarks

author.name: JuneHyoung Kwon, MiHyeon Kim, Eunju Lee, JungMin Yun, Byeonggeuk Lim, YoungBin Kim

entry.summary: Introduces ReMem benchmark for evaluating LVLM unlearning, diagnosing that current benchmarks fail because models don't properly memorize target information in the first place, rendering unlearning evaluations unreliable.

entry.title: Algebraic Semantics of Governed Execution: Monoidal Categories, Effect Algebras, and Coterminous Boundaries

author.name: Alan L. McCann

entry.summary: Companion paper to the governance formalization, providing algebraic semantics using monoidal categories and effect algebras. Proves that governance is compositional and coterminous with expressibility.

entry.title: A Low-Latency Fraud Detection Layer for Detecting Adversarial Interaction Patterns in LLM-Powered Agents

author.name: Sheldon Yu, Yingcheng Sun, Hanqing Guo, Julian McAuley, Qianqian Tong

entry.summary: Proposes a low-latency fraud detection layer that monitors multi-turn interaction sequences of LLM agents to detect adversarial patterns, rather than filtering individual prompts.

entry.title: EO-Gym: A Multimodal, Interactive Environment for Earth Observation Agents

author.name: Sai Ma, Zhuang Li, Sichao Li, Xinyue Xu, Ruibiao Zhu, Tony Boston, John A. Taylor

entry.summary: Introduces EO-Gym, a Gymnasium-style environment for Earth Observation AI agents with 660k+ multimodal files, 35 specialized tools, and a benchmark of 9,078 trajectories across six task families.

entry.title: Are LLMs More Skeptical of Entertainment News?

author.name: Huiqian Lai

entry.summary: Finds that LLMs show model-specific genre asymmetry in news credibility assessment: DeepSeek-V3.2 and GPT-5.2 are significantly more likely to misclassify legitimate entertainment news as fake compared to hard news, while Claude Opus 4.6 and Gemini 3 Flash show no such bias.

entry.title: Planner Matters! An Efficient and Unbalanced Multi-agent Collaboration Framework for Long-horizon Planning

author.name: Wenyi Wu, Sibo Zhu, Kun Zhou, Biwei Huang

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-agent framework with planner, actor, and memory manager roles, showing through systematic compute-allocation analysis that planning is the dominant factor influencing task performance.

entry.title: FitText: Evolving Agent Tool Ecologies via Memetic Retrieval

author.name: Kyle Zheng, Han Zhang, Renliang Sun, Chenchen Ye, Wei Wang

entry.summary: Introduces FitText, a training-free framework that makes tool retrieval dynamic by generating pseudo-tool descriptions as probes and refining them iteratively during agent execution. Uses memetic/evolutionary selection for tool description optimization.

entry.title: Measuring AI Reasoning: A Guide for Researchers

author.name: Munachiso Samuel Nwadike, Zangir Iklassov, Kareem Ali, Rifo Genadi, Kentaro Inui

entry.summary: Provides a guide for evaluating reasoning in language models, arguing reasoning should be assessed through evidence of adaptive multi-step search rather than final-answer accuracy. Formalizes reasoning as a search-like procedure requiring input-dependent computation depth.

entry.title: An explainable hypothesis-driven approach to Drug-Induced Liver Injury with HADES

author.name: Maciej Wisniewski, Bartosz Topolski, Pawel Dabrowski-Tumanski, Dariusz Plewczynski, Tomasz Jetka

entry.summary: Introduces HADES, an agentic system for drug-induced liver injury prediction that generates explainable mechanistic hypotheses rather than binary classifications. Also introduces DILER Benchmark with mechanistic hepatotoxicity annotations.

entry.title: An Empirical Study of Agent Skills for Healthcare: Practice, Gaps, and Governance

author.name: Gelei Xu, Ningzhi Tang, Xueyang Li, Toby Jia-Jun Li, Zhi Zheng, Wei Jin, Yiyu Shi

entry.summary: First empirical analysis of healthcare agent skills, examining 557 healthcare-related skills from 58,159 public skills on ClawHub. Finds public skills emphasize workflow automation over diagnostic tasks, with significant gaps in safety and governance.

entry.title: SCPRM: A Schema-aware Cumulative Process Reward Model for Knowledge Graph Question Answering

author.name: Jiujiu Chen, Yazheng Liu, Sihong Xie, Hui Xiong

entry.summary: Proposes SCPRM, a Schema-aware Cumulative Process Reward Model for knowledge graph question answering that addresses the 'risk compensation effect' where incorrect reasoning steps are offset by later correct ones.

entry.title: GhostServe: A Lightweight Checkpointing System in the Shadow for Fault-Tolerant LLM Serving

author.name: Shakya Jayakody, Youpeng Zhao, Chinmay Dhanraj Nehate, Jun Wang

entry.summary: Proposes GhostServe, a checkpointing system for fault-tolerant LLM serving that protects streaming KV caches using erasure coding to store parity shards in host memory, enabling recovery from hardware faults in long-running inference.

entry.title: Multi-View Hierarchical Representation Learning of Fetal Hemodynamics for Maternal Hypertension Detection at the Edge

author.name: Alireza Rafiei, Anah\'i Venzor Strader, Esteban Castro Arag\'on, Victoriana Rosibely Sut Serech, Enma Carolina Coyote Ixen, Reza Sameni, Peter Rohloff, Gari D. Clifford, Nasim Katebi

entry.summary: Develops AutoHyPE, a hierarchical attention network for detecting maternal hypertension from fetal Doppler ultrasound recordings. Trained on large-scale dataset of 3,255 pregnant women across 8,170 visits in rural Guatemala.

entry.title: Generalized Category Discovery under Domain Shifts: From Vision to Vision-Language Models

author.name: Hongjun Wang, Po Hu, Kai Han

entry.summary: Studies Generalized Category Discovery under domain shifts, proposing three frameworks (HiLo, HLPrompt, PromptGCD) that adapt foundation models from vision to vision-language models. Disentangles domain and semantic features through multi-level extraction.

entry.title: "I Don't Know" -- Towards Appropriate Trust with Certainty-Aware Retrieval Augmented Generation

author.name: Daan Di Scala, Maaike de Boer, P{\i}nar Yolum

entry.summary: Proposes CERTA, a certainty-enhanced RAG system that conveys self-reflected certainty levels to build appropriate user trust. Addresses over-confidence in LLM outputs by enabling 'I Don't Know' responses.

entry.title: MedMosaic: A Challenging Large Scale Benchmark of Diverse Medical Audio

author.name: Harshit Rajgarhia, Shuubham Ojha, Asif Shaik, Akhil Pothanapalli, Rachuri Lokesh, Abhishek Mukherji, Prasanna Desikan

entry.summary: Presents MedMosaic, a large-scale medical audio QA dataset with 46,701 question-answer pairs spanning physiological sounds, synthetic clinical voices, and real conversations. Designed to benchmark audio reasoning models.

entry.title: Value Functions for Temporal Logic: Optimal Policies and Safety Filters

author.name: Oswin So, William Sharpless, Sylvia Herbert, Chuchu Fan

entry.summary: Develops value functions for temporal logic specifications in undiscounted infinite-horizon settings, constructing non-Markovian policies that avoid pathological deferral behaviors. Proves optimality with respect to quantitative robustness scores.

entry.title: Multi-Perspective Transformers in ARC-AGI-2 Challenge

author.name: Caleb Talley, Vedant Tibrewal, Seun Adekunle, Weiwen Dong, Xinyu Wu, Fariha Sheikh

entry.summary: Applies multi-perspective transformers with test-time training and products of experts to the ARC-AGI-2 challenge. Achieves 96.1% on training and 21.7% on evaluation set.

entry.title: Decision Boundary-aware Generation for Long-tailed Learning

author.name: Jiacheng Yang, Ruichi Zhang, Chikai Shang, Mengke Li, Xinyi Shang, Junlong Gao, Yonggang Zhang, Yang Lu

entry.summary: Proposes Decision Boundary-aware Generation (DBG) framework for long-tailed learning that identifies and addresses boundary ambiguity caused by head-to-tail transfer in diffusion-based augmentation. Shows that while transfer helps balance decision space, it induces latent feature mixing causing boundary overlap. Generates informative near-boundary samples for improved representation learning.

entry.title: FT-RAG: A Fine-grained Retrieval-Augmented Generation Framework for Complex Table Reasoning

author.name: Zebin Guo, Weidong Geng, Ruichen Mao

entry.summary: FT-RAG introduces a fine-grained RAG framework for table reasoning that decomposes tables into entry-level semantic units and constructs structured graphs. Uses structural neighbor expansion for graph retrieval and multi-modal fusion to consolidate context. Addresses coarse retrieval granularity issues in conventional RAG for structured data.

entry.title: Motion-Aware Caching for Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation

author.name: Jing Xu, Yuexiao Ma, Songwei Liu, Xuzhe Zheng, Shiwei Liu, Chenqian Yan, Xiawu Zheng, Rongrong Ji, Fei Chao, Xing Wang

entry.summary: MotionCache proposes a motion-aware caching framework for autoregressive video generation that allocates denoising computation based on pixel motion intensity. Formalizes the connection between cache errors and residual instability. Static pixels tolerate aggressive step-skipping while high-motion pixels need more computation.

entry.title: Coopetition-Gym v1: A Formally Grounded Platform for Mixed-Motive Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning under Strategic Coopetition

author.name: Vik Pant, Eric Yu

entry.summary: Coopetition-Gym v1 is a benchmark platform for mixed-motive multi-agent RL with 20 environments organized into four mechanism classes covering trust, reputation, collective action, and reciprocity dynamics.

entry.title: GETA-3DGS: Automatic Joint Structured Pruning and Quantization for 3D Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Baobing Zhang, Wanxin Sui

entry.summary: GETA-3DGS proposes the first end-to-end automatic joint structured pruning and quantization framework for 3D Gaussian Splatting, enabling users to specify target rate or quality budgets rather than hand-tuning compression parameters.

entry.title: When Correct Isn't Usable: Improving Structured Output Reliability in Small Language Models

author.name: Cosimo Galeone, Minsu Park, Giuseppe Ettorre, Daniele Ligorio

entry.summary: Studies structured output reliability in small language models (7-9B), finding that naive prompting achieves high task accuracy but 0% output accuracy (correct + valid format), and proposes improved prompting strategies.

entry.title: Validation of an AI-based end-to-end model for prostate pathology using long-term archived routine samples

author.name: Xiaoyi Ji, Renata Zelic, Oskar Aspegren, Nita Mulliqi, Michelangelo Fiorentino, Francesca Giunchi, Luca Molinaro, Sol Erika Boman, Lorenzo Richiardi, Andreas Pettersson, Per Henrik Vincent, Martin Eklund, Olof Akre, Kimmo Kartasalo

entry.summary: Validates GleasonAI, an attention-based MIL model for prostate pathology, on 10,366 biopsy cores from 14 Swedish regions collected over 17 years, showing stable performance across time and geography.

entry.title: Perceptual Flow Network for Visually Grounded Reasoning

author.name: Yangfu Li, Yuning Gong, Hongjian Zhan, Teng Li, Yuanhuiyi Lyu, Tianyi Chen, Qi Liu, Ziyuan Huang, Zhihang Zhong, Dandan Zheng, Yue Lu

entry.summary: PFlowNet proposes a perceptual flow network that decouples perception from reasoning in visual question answering, achieving interpretable visual reasoning without rigid alignment to geometric expert priors.

entry.title: Decoupled Guidance Diffusion for Adaptive Offline Safe Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Rufeng Chen, Zhaofan Zhang, Zhejiang Yang, Hechang Chen, Sihong Xie

entry.summary: Proposes Safe Decoupled Guidance Diffusion (SDGD) for offline safe reinforcement learning, reinterpreting adaptive safe trajectory generation as sampling from a constrained distribution where budget restricts regions and reward shapes preferences within them. Decouples safety compliance from reward optimization in diffusion-based planners.

entry.title: Healthcare AI GYM for Medical Agents

author.name: Minbyul Jeong

entry.summary: Presents Healthcare AI GYM, a gymnasium-compatible environment spanning 10 clinical domains with 3.6K+ tasks and 135 tools for training medical AI agents through multi-turn agentic RL. Reveals that agentic structure degrades into verbose monologues.

entry.title: TCD-Arena: Assessing Robustness of Time Series Causal Discovery Methods Against Assumption Violations

author.name: Gideon Stein, Niklas Penzel, Tristan Piater, Joachim Denzler

entry.summary: Presents TCD-Arena, a modular testing framework for assessing robustness of time series causal discovery methods against assumption violations. Conducts ~30 million CD attempts revealing robustness profiles for 33 violations.

entry.title: Gated Subspace Inference for Transformer Acceleration

author.name: Stephen J. Thomas

entry.summary: Presents a method for accelerating transformer inference by exploiting low effective rank of token activations, using cached low-rank weight images and per-token gates to skip residual corrections. Achieves 3-10x speedups.

entry.title: PODiff: Latent Diffusion in Proper Orthogonal Decomposition Space for Scientific Super-Resolution

author.name: Onkar Jadhav, Tim French, Matthew Rayson, Nicole L. Jones

entry.summary: Proposes PODiff, performing diffusion in Proper Orthogonal Decomposition coefficient space for scientific super-resolution, enabling efficient ensemble generation with interpretable uncertainty quantification at lower computational cost.

entry.title: Learning Generalizable Action Representations via Pre-training AEMG

author.name: Zhenghao Huang, Huilin Yao, Kaikai Wang, Lin Shu

entry.summary: Proposes AEMG, the first large-scale self-supervised representation learning framework for EMG signals. Introduces a Neuromuscular Contraction Tokenizer that translates muscle activity into linguistic representations.

entry.title: Realizable Bayes-Consistency for General Metric Losses

author.name: Dan Tsir Cohen, Steve Hanneke, Aryeh Kontorovich

entry.summary: Studies Bayes-consistency in the realizable setting for learning with general metric losses, finding necessary and sufficient conditions on the hypothesis class for distribution-free learning convergence.

entry.title: Reasoning-Guided Grounding: Elevating Video Anomaly Detection through Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Sakshi Agarwal, Aishik Konwer, Ankit Parag Shah

entry.summary: Proposes VANGUARD for video anomaly detection unifying classification, spatial grounding, and chain-of-thought reasoning within a single VLM using three-stage curriculum training.

entry.title: Analysis and Explainability of LLMs Via Evolutionary Methods

author.name: Shannon K. Gallagher, Swati Rallapalli, Tyler Brooks, Chuck Loughin, Michele Sezgin, Ronald Yurko

entry.summary: Applies evolutionary/phylogenetic methods to analyze LLM relationships, treating weights as genotypes and outputs as phenotypes. Recovers model lineage topology and identifies important weight layers.

entry.title: Contrastive Regularization for Accent-Robust ASR

author.name: Van-Phat Thai, Aradhya Dhruv, Duc-Thinh Pham, Sameer Alam

entry.summary: Investigates supervised contrastive learning (SupCon) as an auxiliary objective for CTC fine-tuning to improve accent robustness in ASR. Achieves 25-29% relative WER reduction on unseen accents from L2-ARCTIC benchmark without architectural modifications.

entry.title: Adaptive Estimation and Optimal Control in Offline Contextual MDPs without Stationarity

author.name: Riddhiman Bhattacharyya, Sayak Chakrabarty, Imon Banerjee

entry.summary: Introduces adaptive estimation and cost optimization for offline contextual MDPs without stationarity assumptions. Claims first-of-its-kind estimator with strong optimality guarantees, addressing endogenous properties like non-stationarity and model irregularity.

entry.title: Random test functions, $H^{-1}$ norm equivalence, and stochastic variational physics-informed neural networks

author.name: Diego Marcondes

entry.summary: Proves that the H^{-1} norm of any functional equals its expected squared evaluation against a random test function, providing a computationally tractable characterization of weak solutions for elliptic PDEs. Introduces stochastic variational PINNs based on this equivalence.

entry.title: PHALAR: Phasors for Learned Musical Audio Representations

author.name: Davide Marincione, Michele Mancusi, Giorgio Strano, Luca Cerovaz, Donato Crisostomi, Roberto Ribuoli, Emanuele Rodol\`a

entry.summary: Introduces PHALAR, a contrastive framework for stem retrieval in music using phasors, achieving 70% relative accuracy improvement over SOTA with <50% parameters and 7x training speedup. Uses Learned Spectral Pooling and complex-valued head for pitch/phase equivariance.

entry.title: Large-Scale High-Quality 3D Gaussian Head Reconstruction from Multi-View Captures

author.name: Evangelos Ntavelis, Sean Wu, Mohamad Shahbazi, Fabio Maninchedda, Dmitry Kostiaev, Artem Sevastopolsky, Vittorio Megaro, Trevor Phillips, Alejandro Blumentals, Shridhar Ravikumar, Mehak Gupta, Reinhard Knothe, Jeronimo Bayer, Matthias Vestner, Simon Schaefer, Thomas Etterlin, Christian Zimmermann, Mathias Deschler, Peter Kaufmann, Stefan Brugger, Sebastian Martin, Brian Amberg, Tom Runia

entry.summary: Proposes HeadsUp, a scalable feed-forward method for 3D Gaussian head reconstruction from multi-camera setups using UV-parameterized Gaussians. Trained on 10,000+ subjects, decoupling Gaussian count from input resolution for efficient training.

entry.title: SRA: Span Representation Alignment for Large Language Model Distillation

author.name: Quoc Phong Dao, Hoang Son Nguyen, Pham Khanh Chi, Tung Nguyen, Linh Ngo Van, Nguyen Thi Ngoc Diep, Trung Le

entry.summary: Introduces SRA for cross-tokenizer knowledge distillation, reframing alignment through multi-particle dynamical systems lens. Shifts fundamental unit from tokens to spans for more robust distillation between differently-tokenized models.

entry.title: ReMedi: Reasoner for Medical Clinical Prediction

author.name: Yushi Cao, Yiming Chen, Hongchao Jiang, Hung-yi Lee, Robby T. Tan

entry.summary: Presents ReMedi, a framework for clinical outcome prediction from EHRs using rationale-answer generation with challenging sample regeneration. Uses ground-truth hints to enhance reasoning for fine-tuning and preference learning.

entry.title: EGAD: Entropy-Guided Adaptive Distillation for Token-Level Knowledge Transfer

author.name: Hao Zhang, Zhibin Zhang, Guangxin Wu, Wanyi Ning, Jiafeng Guo, Xueqi Cheng

entry.summary: Proposes EGAD, an entropy-based adaptive distillation strategy that dynamically adjusts token-level training based on entropy, recognizing that different tokens contribute unequally to model decisions.

entry.title: HalluScan: A Systematic Benchmark for Detecting and Mitigating Hallucinations in Instruction-Following LLMs

author.name: Ahmed Cherif

entry.summary: Presents HalluScan, a hallucination benchmark with 72 configurations, introducing HalluScore composite metric and Adaptive Detection Routing algorithm for hallucination detection across models and domains.

entry.title: SemEval-2026 Task 7: Everyday Knowledge Across Diverse Languages and Cultures

author.name: Nedjma Ousidhoum, Junho Myung, Carla Perez-Almendros, Jiho Jin, Amr Keleg, Meriem Beloucif, Yi Zhou, Rodrigo Agerri, Vladimir Araujo, Naomi Baes, James Barry, Joanne Boisson, Nancy F. Chen, Christine de Kock, Aleksandra Edwards, Joseba Fernandez de Landa, Mohamed Fazli Imam, Huda Hakami, Shu-Kai Hsieh, Joseph Marvin Imperial, Roy Ka-Wei Lee, Zhengyuan Liu, Chenyang Lyu, Younes Samih, Johan Sjons, Bryan Tan, Asahi Ushio, Weihua Zheng, Alice Oh, Jose Camacho-Collados

entry.summary: Presents SemEval-2026 shared task on everyday knowledge across 30+ language-culture pairs, focusing on low-resource languages. Evaluates LLM cultural adaptability through short-answer and multiple-choice questions.

entry.title: RECAP: An End-to-End Platform for Capturing, Replaying, and Analyzing AI-Assisted Programming Interactions

author.name: Keyu He, Qianou Ma, Valerie Chen, Wayne Chi, Tongshuang Wu

entry.summary: Presents RECAP, an open-source platform for capturing, replaying, and analyzing AI-assisted programming interactions in VS Code. Merges chat sessions and code edits into unified timeline for research.

entry.title: PubMed-Ophtha: An open resource for training ophthalmology vision-language models on scientific literature
