author.name: Jiaxu He, Chao Wang, Jie Lian, Yuqing Cai, Yongxiang Li, Renzeg Duojie, Jie Li

entry.summary: Presents what's claimed to be the first large-model-based Tibetan TTS system, integrating data quality enhancement, Tibetan-oriented tokenization, and cross-lingual adaptive training for low-resource synthesis.

entry.title: Boundary-Aware Uncertainty Quantification for Wildfire Spread Prediction

author.name: Jonas V. Funk

entry.summary: Introduces Fire-Centered Evaluation Region framework for uncertainty quantification in wildfire spread prediction, comparing ensemble vs distilled student model with spatially conditioned evaluation.

entry.title: Tracing Like a Clinician: Anatomy-Guided Spatial Priors for Cephalometric Landmark Detection

author.name: Sidhartha Mohapatra, Pallavi Mohanty

entry.summary: Presents an anatomy-guided pipeline for cephalometric landmark detection that mimics clinical orthodontist workflow, achieving 1.04mm mean radial error on 25 landmarks - surpassing prior SOTA by 15.4%.

entry.title: MASRA: MLLM-Assisted Semantic-Relational Consistent Alignment for Video Temporal Grounding

author.name: Ran Ran, Jiwei Wei, Shuchang Zhou, Yitong Qin, Shiyuan He, Zeyu Ma, Yuyang Zhou, Yang Yang

entry.summary: Proposes MASRA, using MLLMs during training to generate textual priors (event descriptions and clip captions) for improved video temporal grounding through semantic-relational consistent alignment.

entry.title: First Shape, Then Meaning: Efficient Geometry and Semantics Learning for Indoor Reconstruction

author.name: Remi Chierchia, L\'eo Lebrat, David Ahmedt-Aristizabal, Olivier Salvado, Clinton Fookes, Rodrigo Santa Cruz

entry.summary: Introduces FSTM, a two-step approach for indoor 3D reconstruction that first optimizes geometry from RGB inputs, then estimates semantic fields, improving efficiency over joint optimization methods.

entry.title: deSEO: Physics-Aware Dataset Creation for High-Resolution Satellite Image Shadow Removal

author.name: Lorenzo Beltrame, Jules Salzinger, Filip Svoboda, Phillipp Fanta-Jende, Jasmin Lampert, Radu Timofte, Marco K\"orner

entry.summary: Introduces deSEO, the first geometry-aware and physics-informed methodology for creating paired shadow/shadow-free satellite imagery datasets for training shadow removal models.

entry.title: The Detector Teaches Itself: Lightweight Self-Supervised Adaptation for Open-Vocabulary Object Detection

author.name: Yazhe Wan (Queen Mary University of London), Changjae Oh (Queen Mary University of London)

entry.summary: Presents DAT (Decoupled Adaptivity Training), a self-supervised fine-tuning approach to improve VLMs for cooperative open-vocabulary object detection by constructing region-aware pseudo-labels from pre-trained models.

entry.title: GeoTopoDiff: Learning Geometry--Topology Graph Priors through Boundary-Constrained Mixed Diffusion for Sparse-Slice 3D Porous Reconstruction

author.name: Yue Shi, Peng Wang, Mingzhe Yu, Yunlong Zhao, Li Liu, Gareth D Hatton, Yan Lyu, Liangxiu Han

entry.summary: Proposes GeoTopoDiff, a graph diffusion framework for reconstructing 3D porous microstructures from sparse CT slices, working in a mixed graph state space that captures both continuous pore morphology and discrete topology.

entry.title: Task-Aware Scanning Parameter Configuration for Robotic Inspection Using Vision Language Embeddings and Hyperdimensional Computing

author.name: Zhiling Chen, David Gorsich, Matthew P. Castanier, Yang Zhang, Jiong Tang, Farhad Imani

entry.summary: Proposes instruction-conditioned sensing parameter recommendation for robotic laser profiling, using VLM embeddings and hyperdimensional computing to infer optimal scanner configurations from RGB observation and natural language instructions.

entry.title: Benchmarking Local Language Models for Social Robots using Edge Devices

author.name: Dorian Lamouille, Matev\v{z} B. Zorec, Farnaz Baksh, Karl Kruusam\"ae

entry.summary: Benchmarks 25 open-source language models for local deployment on edge hardware (Raspberry Pi 4) for social-educational robots, evaluating inference efficiency, knowledge, and pedagogical quality.

entry.title: Robust Visual SLAM for UAV Navigation in GPS-Denied and Degraded Environments: A Multi-Paradigm Evaluation and Deployment Study

author.name: Prasoon Kumar, Akshay Deepak, Sandeep Kumar

entry.summary: Systematic comparative evaluation of five Visual SLAM systems across classical, deep learning, and ViT paradigms under degraded visual conditions for UAV navigation. Shows learning-based methods significantly outperform classical ORB-SLAM3 under severe degradation.

entry.title: Evaluating Generative Models as Interactive Emergent Representations of Human-Like Collaborative Behavior

author.name: Shinas Shaji, Teena Chakkalayil Hassan, Sebastian Houben, Alex Mitrevski

entry.summary: Evaluates whether embodied LLM agents exhibit emergent collaborative behaviors indicating mental models of collaborators in a 2D color-matching game. Studies coordination capabilities of foundation models in embodied settings.

entry.title: Codesign for Legibility (to AI and Everyone Else)

author.name: Adam Chlipala

entry.summary: Argues for 'codesign for legibility' - modifying systems to be easier to model and verify, making them amenable to fast symbolic methods. Connects formal verification with AI systems design.

entry.title: TRIMMER: A New Paradigm for Video Summarization through Self-Supervised Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Pritam Mishra, Coloma Ballester, Dimosthenis Karatzas

entry.summary: TRIMMER proposes a self-supervised reinforcement learning approach for video summarization that doesn't require manual annotations. Uses temporal relative information maximization with multi-objective efficient reinforcement learning. Addresses computational cost and generalization issues of existing supervised approaches.

entry.title: Federated Semi-Supervised Graph Neural Networks with Prototype-Guided Pseudo-Labeling for Privacy-Preserving Gestational Diabetes Mellitus Prediction

author.name: G. Victor Daniela, A. Mallikarjuna Reddya, Uday Kumar Addankia, Sridhar Reddy Gogua, Sravanth Kumar Ramakuria

entry.summary: FedTGNN-SS proposes a federated semi-supervised framework for clinical tabular EHR using graph neural networks with prototype-guided pseudo-labeling for GDM prediction. Each hospital builds local patient similarity graphs and trains GNN encoders. Addresses both label scarcity and data privacy in healthcare.

entry.title: Leveraging Data Symmetries to Select an Optimal Subset of Training Data under Label Noise

author.name: Kumar Shubham, Pavan Karjol, Kiran M K, Prathosh AP

entry.summary: Establishes that k-NN accuracy affects subset selection under label noise via cutstats, and demonstrates that leveraging data symmetries in high-dimensional settings improves k-NN performance and thus subset selection. Provides formal analysis connecting data geometry to noise-robust training.

entry.title: DocSync: Agentic Documentation Maintenance via Critic-Guided Reflexion

author.name: Sidhesh Badrinarayan, Adithya Parthasarathy

entry.summary: DocSync is an agentic workflow for documentation maintenance that uses AST-based structural grounding and critic-guided reflexion to keep documentation semantically consistent with code as it evolves.

entry.title: StateSMix: Online Lossless Compression via Mamba State Space Models and Sparse N-gram Context Mixing

author.name: Roberto Tacconelli

entry.summary: Presents StateSMix, a fully self-contained lossless compressor combining online-trained Mamba-style SSMs with sparse n-gram context mixing and arithmetic coding. Requires no pre-trained weights, no GPU, and no external dependencies.

entry.title: Learning Discriminative Signed Distance Functions from Multi-scale Level-of-detail Features for 3D Anomaly Detection

author.name: Haibo Xiao, Hanzhe Liang, Jie Zhou, Jinbao Wang, Can Gao

entry.summary: Proposes a surface-based method for 3D anomaly detection using discriminative signed distance functions with multi-scale level-of-detail features. Introduces noisy point generation and multi-scale feature extraction for point cloud anomaly detection.

entry.title: A Systematic Exploration of Text Decomposition and Budget Distribution in Differentially Private Text Obfuscation

author.name: Stephen Meisenbacher, Angelo Kleinert, Florian Matthes

entry.summary: Systematically evaluates text decomposition and privacy budget distribution techniques for differentially private text obfuscation at document level, testing how different chunking and budget allocation methods interact.

entry.title: MK-ResRecon: Multi-Kernel Residual Framework for Texture-Aware 3D MRI Refinement from Sparse 2D Slices

author.name: Prajyot Pyati, Sapna Sachan, Amulya Kumar Mahto, Pranjal Phukan

entry.summary: Proposes MK-ResRecon for reconstructing 3D MRI volumes from only 12.5% of axial slices using multi-kernel texture-aware loss, with a refinement network for the full 3D volume.

entry.title: Enhancing Visual Question Answering with Multimodal LLMs via Chain-of-Question Guided Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Quanxing Xu, Ling Zhou, Xian Zhong, Xiaohua Huang, Rubing Huang, Chia-Wen Lin

entry.summary: Proposes CoVQD, combining Chain-of-Thought reasoning with Visual Question Decomposition to guide retrieval-augmented generation for visual question answering with multimodal LLMs.

entry.title: Compute Optimal Tokenization

author.name: Tomasz Limisiewicz, Artidoro Pagnoni, Srini Iyer, Mike Lewis, Sachin Mehta, Alisa Liu, Margaret Li, Gargi Ghosh, Luke Zettlemoyer

entry.summary: As covered in Research yesterday, Systematically investigates how token compression rate affects scaling trends by training 988 BLT models (50M-7B parameters). Reveals compute-optimal configurations show model parameters scale proportionally to data size in bytes, with implications for tokenizer design.

entry.title: InfoLaw: Information Scaling Laws for Large Language Models with Quality-Weighted Mixture Data and Repetition

author.name: Fengze Liu, Weidong Zhou, Binbin Liu, Ping Guo, Zijun Wang, Bingni Zhang, Yifan Zhang, Yifeng Yu, Xiaohuan Zhou, Taifeng Wang

entry.summary: As covered in Research yesterday, Introduces InfoLaw, a data-aware scaling framework predicting loss from tokens, model size, mixture weights, and repetition. Models pretraining as information accumulation where quality controls density and repetition shows diminishing returns.

entry.title: Class-Aware Adaptive Differential Privacy in Deep Learning for Sensor-Based Fall Detection

author.name: Joydeb Kumar Sana

entry.summary: Proposes Class-Aware Adaptive Differential Privacy (CA-ADP) that dynamically adjusts noise magnitude based on class composition during training, integrated with 3D CNN-BiLSTM for fall detection. Addresses limitation of uniform noise application that degrades prediction in imbalanced healthcare settings. Maintains privacy guarantees while improving minority class detection.

entry.title: When Prompts Interact: Assessing Prompt Arithmetic for Deconfounding under Distribution Shift

author.name: Zhecheng Sheng, Yongsen Tan, Xiruo Ding, Trevor Cohen, Serguei Pakhomov

entry.summary: Investigates prompt arithmetic (task arithmetic applied to prompts) for deconfounding under distribution shift, finding it can reduce reliance on confounders but with limitations compared to full model-level task arithmetic.

entry.title: TabSurv: Adapting Modern Tabular Neural Networks to Survival Analysis

author.name: Stanislav Kirpichenko, Andrei Konstantinov, Lev Utkin

entry.summary: Proposes TabSurv, adapting modern tabular architectures to survival analysis using Weibull or non-parametric predictions with a novel histogram loss for censored data. Includes parallel deep ensembles.

entry.title: Exact and Approximate Algorithms for Polytree Learning

author.name: Juha Harviainen, Frank Sommer, Manuel Sorge

entry.summary: Studies exact and approximate algorithms for learning optimal polytrees (directed forest Bayesian networks). Devises O((2+ε)^n) algorithm improving over O(3^n) for bounded in-degree, and provides polynomial-time approximation algorithms.

entry.title: On Computing Total Variation Distance Between Mixtures of Product Distributions

author.name: Weiming Feng, Yucheng Fu, Minji Yang, Anqi Zhang

entry.summary: Provides randomized algorithm for approximating total variation distance between mixtures of product distributions in poly((nq)^{k1+k2}, 1/ε) time. Shows exact computation is #P-hard for general mixtures of subcubes.

entry.title: Quantifying and Predicting Disagreement in Graded Human Ratings

author.name: Leixin Zhang, \c{C}a\u{g}r{\i} \c{C}\"oltekin

entry.summary: Investigates annotation disagreement patterns in graded human ratings for inappropriate language, proposing the Opposition Index to quantify perspective opposition and examining predictability of contentious instances.

entry.title: 2026 Roadmap on Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning for Smart Manufacturing

author.name: Jay Lee, Hanqi Su, Marco Macchi, Adalberto Polenghi, Wei Wu, Zhiheng Zhao, George Q. Huang, Kiva Allgood, Devendra Jain, Benedikt Gieger, Vibhor Pandhare, Soumyabrata Bhattacharjee, Ram Mohril, Lingbao Kong, Qiyuan Wang, Xinlan Tang, Sungjong Kim, Chan Hee Park, Byeng D. Youn, Guo Dong Goh, Xi Huang, Wai Yee Yeong, Yung C Shin, He Zhang, Zitong Wang, Fei Tao, Jagjit Singh Srai, Satyandra K. Gupta, Byung Gun Joung, Albin John, John W. Sutherland, Sang Won Lee, Olga Fink, Vinay Sharma, Faez Ahmed, Wei Chen, Mark Fuge, Arild Waaler, Martin G. Skj{\ae}veland, Dimitris Kyritsis, Wei Chen, VispiNevile Karkaria, Yi-Ping Chen, Ying-Kuan Tsai, Joseph Cohen, Xun Huan, Jing Lin, Liangwei Zhang, Gregory W. Vogl, Aaron W. Cornelius, Xiaodong Jia, Dai-Yan Ji, Takanobu Minami, Ruoxin Wang

entry.summary: A comprehensive roadmap paper from dozens of authors outlining the current state, challenges, and future directions of AI/ML in smart manufacturing. Covers topics from industrial big data to trustworthy AI in high-stakes manufacturing environments.

entry.title: ClinicBot: A Guideline-Grounded Clinical Chatbot with Prioritized Evidence RAG and Verifiable Citations

author.name: Navapat Nananukul, Mayank Kejriwal

entry.summary: Introduces ClinicBot, a clinical chatbot that prioritizes evidence from structured clinical guidelines using a novel RAG approach with explicit provenance tracking and verifiable citations to reduce hallucination.

entry.title: Towards Multi-Agent Autonomous Reasoning in Hydrodynamics

author.name: Jinpai Zhao, Albert Cerrone, Joannes Westerink, Clint Dawson

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-agent system for hydrodynamics scientific workflows using a Layer Execution Graph to coordinate specialized agents, addressing context window limitations of single-agent systems.

entry.title: NEURON: A Neuro-symbolic System for Grounded Clinical Explainability

author.name: Anuradha Chandrasekaran, Dimitrios Zikos, Mutlu Mete, Alan Pang, Brady D. Lund, Kewei Sha

entry.summary: Presents NEURON, a neuro-symbolic system combining SNOMED CT ontology with ML models and RAG-grounded LLMs to generate clinically interpretable natural language explanations from SHAP attributions.

entry.title: Artificial Jagged Intelligence as Uneven Optimization Energy Allocation Capability Concentration, Redistribution, and Optimization Governance

author.name: Wesley Shu, Peng Wei

entry.summary: Develops a formal theory of 'Artificial Jagged Intelligence' (AJI) explaining why AI systems develop uneven capability profiles, modeling this as anisotropic optimization energy allocation across parameter space directions.

entry.title: Model Routing as a Trust Problem: Route Receipts for Adaptive AI Systems

author.name: Vincent Schmalbach

entry.summary: Proposes 'route receipts' - compact runtime transparency artifacts documenting the routing path that served an AI request, addressing trust concerns when routing changes cost, quality, or accountability.

entry.title: Moira: Language-driven Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Pair Trading

author.name: Polydoros Giannouris, Yuechen Jiang, Lingfei Qian, Yuyan Wang, Xueqing Peng, Jimin Huang, Guojun Xiong, Sophia Ananiadou

entry.summary: Proposes Moira, a hierarchical RL framework for pair trading where both high-level (asset selection) and low-level (execution) policies are parameterized by LLMs, addressing credit assignment in semantic reasoning.

entry.title: 12 Angry AI Agents: Evaluating Multi-Agent LLM Decision-Making Through Cinematic Jury Deliberation

author.name: Ahmet Bahaddin Ersoz

entry.summary: Recreates 12 Angry Men as a multi-agent LLM deliberation benchmark, finding that 17/18 runs end in hung juries and models show strong initial position bias regardless of alignment level.

entry.title: Personalized Digital Health Modeling with Adaptive Support Users

author.name: Zhongqi Yang, Mahkameh Rasouli, Neda Mohseni, Yong Huang, Iman Azimi, Amir M. Rahmani

entry.summary: Proposes a unified personalization framework for digital health that uses both similar and dissimilar users as adaptive support, with contrastive regularization from dissimilar users to suppress misleading correlations.

entry.title: NORA: A Harness-Engineered Autonomous Research Agent for End-to-End Spatial Data Science

author.name: Bing Zhou, Xiao Huang, Huan Ning, Qiusheng Wu, Diya Li, Ziyi Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces NORA, a multi-agent autonomous research system for spatial data science with 21 domain skills, 9 specialist sub-agents, and custom MCP servers for the complete GIScience research lifecycle.

entry.title: The Dynamic Gist-Based Memory Model (DGMM): A Memory-Centric Architecture for Artificial Intelligence

author.name: Terry Dorsey, Kevin Huggins

entry.summary: Proposes the Dynamic Gist-Based Memory Model (DGMM), a memory-centric architecture where experience is represented explicitly and persistently to support temporal grounding, provenance, and interpretability in AI systems.

entry.title: Perturbation Dose Responses in Recursive LLM Loops: Raw Switching, Stochastic Floors, and Persistent Escape under Append, Replace, and Dialog Updates

author.name: Pawel Kaplanski (Kaplanski AI Lab)

entry.summary: Studies how much injected text is needed to redirect recursive LLM loops from attractor states, comparing append, replace, and dialog context-update rules. Finds that persistent redirection is conditioned on memory policy, with different context management strategies showing different susceptibilities.

entry.title: Improving Model Safety by Targeted Error Correction

author.name: Abolfazl Mohammadi-Seif, Ricardo Baeza-Yates

entry.summary: Proposes a dual-classifier GBDT pipeline to distinguish routine human-like errors from high-risk non-human misclassifications in ML systems, demonstrating safety improvements across medical imaging domains with negligible latency overhead.

entry.title: Universal Smoothness via Bernstein Polynomials: A Constructive Approximation Approach for Activation Functions

author.name: Wentao Zhang, Yutong Zhang, Yifan Zhu, Wentao Mo

entry.summary: Proposes BerLU, a smooth activation function using Bernstein polynomials that approximates piecewise linear functions while maintaining differentiability, balancing optimization stability with computational efficiency.

entry.title: SCGNN: Semantic Consistency enhanced Graph Neural Network Guided by Granular-ball Computing

author.name: Genhao Tian, Taihua Xu, Shuyin Xia, Qinghua Zhang, Jie Yang, Jianjun Chen

entry.summary: Proposes SCGNN, a plug-and-play GNN framework using granular-ball computing to capture semantic consistency among graph nodes more efficiently than k-NN approaches, modeling group-level rather than node-level semantic structure.

entry.title: U-Define: Designing User Workflows for Hard and Soft Constraints in LLM-Based Planning

author.name: Christine P Lee, Xinyu Jessica Wang, Aws Albarghouthi, David Porfirio, Bilge Mutlu

entry.summary: Investigates how interaction workflows with hard and soft constraints can help users control and verify LLM-generated plans. Studies whether abstracting strictness into high-level constraint types improves user ability to express intent.

entry.title: Generative-AI and the transformation of workforce. A job postings-driven analysis

author.name: Diana Maria Popa, Simona-Vasilica Oprea, Adela B\^ara

entry.summary: Investigates how generative AI is reshaping job requirements through analysis of 150,000+ job postings from 2018-2025, examining whether GenAI is augmentative or substitutive across different sectors.

entry.title: An Algorithm for On-Sensor Agnostic Detection of Changes in Human Activity for Ultra-Low-Power Applications

author.name: Sara Rimoldi, Arianna De Vecchi, Hazem Hesham Yousef Shalby, Federica Villa

entry.summary: Proposes a lightweight change-detection gate for human activity recognition that triggers full classification only when activity changes are detected, reducing computation by 67% using a non-parametric template matching approach.

entry.title: Towards High Fidelity Face Swapping: A Comprehensive Survey and New Benchmark

author.name: Qi Li, Weining Wang, Shuangjun Du, Bo Peng, Jing Dong, Kun Wang, Zhenan Sun, Ming-Hsuan Yang

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey and benchmark for face swapping, organizing methods into five paradigms and providing standardized evaluation protocols. Addresses fragmentation in the field and inconsistent evaluation.

entry.title: RA-CMF: Region-Adaptive Conditional MeanFlow for CT Image Reconstruction

author.name: Md Shifatul Ahsan Apurba, Md Selim, Jin Chen

entry.summary: Develops a conditional MeanFlow network for CT image reconstruction that adapts spatially via region-specific enhancement. Uses flow fields conditioned on intermediate image states with consistency loss for improved image quality across different scanners.

entry.title: Leveraging Imperfect Medical Data: A Manifold-Consistent Spatio-Temporal Network for Sensor-based Human Activity Recognition

author.name: Jiangtao Fan, Anish Jindal, Amir Atapour-Abarghouei

entry.summary: Proposes MCSTN for robust human activity recognition under imperfect sensing conditions, using manifold-consistent learning with dual-level corruption modeling to handle missing data, sensor failures, and noise in IoMT signals.

entry.title: Fusing Urban Structure and Semantics: A Conditional Diffusion Model for Cross-City OD Matrix Generation

author.name: Bin Chen, Zhuoya Meng, Fang Yang, Runkang Guo, Jingtao Ding, Yin Zhang, Chuan Ai, Zhengqiu Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes SEDAN, a structure-enhanced diffusion model for cross-city OD matrix generation that models cities as attributed graphs. Uses adjacency and distance matrices to capture spatial structure for generalizable commuting flow prediction.

entry.title: Adaptive 3D-RoPE: Physics-Aligned Rotary Positional Encoding for Wireless Foundation Models

author.name: Chenyu Zhang, Xinchen Lyu, Chenshan Ren, Shuhan Liu, Qimei Cui

entry.summary: Proposes Adaptive 3D-RoPE, a physics-aligned rotary positional encoding for wireless foundation models that captures 3D spatio-temporal-frequency structure of channel state information.

entry.title: Certified Purity for Cognitive Workflow Executors: From Static Analysis to Cryptographic Attestation

author.name: Alan L. McCann

entry.summary: Presents a certified purity architecture for cognitive workflow systems using restricted WebAssembly compilation, cryptographic attestation, and zero-knowledge proofs to enforce governance boundaries.

entry.title: Separation Assurance between Heterogeneous Fleets of Small Unmanned Aerial Systems via Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Iman Sharifi, Hyeong Tae Kim, Maheed Hatem Ahmed, Mahsa Ghasemi, Peng Wei

entry.summary: Investigates multi-agent reinforcement learning for separation assurance of heterogeneous drone fleets in urban airspace. Studies whether tactical deconfliction policies converge and whether they discriminate against weaker-configured aircraft.

entry.title: Sparse Representation Learning for Vessels

author.name: Chinmay Prabhakar, Bastian Wittmann, Paul B\"uschl, Hongwei Bran Li, Bjoern Menze, Suprosanna Shit

entry.summary: VAEsselSparse proposes an efficient encoder-decoder model using sparse convolutions and attention mechanisms to represent organ-level vascular networks at sub-millimeter resolution. It achieves 8x8x8 spatial compression while maintaining reconstruction quality. This addresses the computational challenge of analyzing complete 3D vessel structures at clinical resolution.

entry.title: HepScript: A Dual-Use DSL for Human-AI Collaborative Data Analysis Workflows in High-Energy Physics

author.name: Junkun Jiao, Tong Liu, Ke Li, Weimin Song, Yipu Liao, Bolun Zhang, Beijiang Liu, Chang-Zheng Yuan, Yue Sun

entry.summary: HepScript introduces a dual-use domain-specific language for high-energy physics data analysis that serves as a shared formal interface between human experts and AI agents. Developed for the BESIII experiment, it abstracts analysis logic into constrained syntax usable by both humans and LLMs. Demonstrates a practical approach to human-AI collaboration in scientific workflows.

entry.title: Neuro-Symbolic Agents for Hallucination-Free Requirements Reuse

author.name: Ahmed Ibrahim

entry.summary: Presents a neuro-symbolic multi-agent system for requirements reuse that reconceptualizes it as model-driven elicitation. Uses LLM as a non-deterministic heuristic for traversing a deterministic domain model represented by formal OOMRAM ontology. Aims for hallucination-free requirements generation through symbolic constraints.

entry.title: IMPACT-HOI: Supervisory Control for Onset-Anchored Partial HOI Event Construction

author.name: Haoshen Zhang, Di Wen, Kunyu Peng, David Schneider, Zeyun Zhong, Alexander Jaus, Zdravko Marinov, Jiale Wei, Ruiping Liu, Junwei Zheng, Yufan Chen, Yufeng Zhang, Yuanhao Luo, Lei Qi, Rainer Stiefelhagen

entry.summary: IMPACT-HOI presents a mixed-initiative framework for annotating egocentric procedural video through structured event graphs for human-object interactions. Uses trust-calibrated controller that selects between queries, suggestions, and conservative completions. Targets high-quality supervision for learning robot manipulation from human demonstration.

entry.title: IMPACT-Scribe: Interactive Temporal Action Segmentation with Boundary Scribbles and Query Planning

author.name: Qian Yin, Di Wen, Kunyu Peng, David Schneider, Zeyun Zhong, Alexander Jaus, Zdravko Marinov, Jiale Wei, Ruiping Liu, Junwei Zheng, Yufan Chen, Chen Zhang, Lei Qi, Rainer Stiefelhagen

entry.summary: IMPACT-Scribe introduces a correction-driven framework for dense temporal action segmentation that uses each correction to improve future human-machine collaboration. Combines uncertainty-aware boundary scribbles, cost-aware query planning, and correction-driven adaptation. Shows improved labeling quality per effort in user study.

entry.title: BadmintonGRF: A Multimodal Dataset and Benchmark for Markerless Ground Reaction Force Estimation in Badminton

author.name: Kuoye Niu, Jianwei Li, Shengze Cai, Yong Ma, Mengyao Jia, Lishun Shen, Zhenheng Zhang, Yuxin Peng, Xian Song

entry.summary: BadmintonGRF provides a multimodal dataset for markerless ground reaction force estimation with eight synchronized RGB views at 120 FPS, four force plates, and Vicon motion capture. Designed for non-periodic court sports in realistic training settings. Includes benchmark tasks mapping 2D pose to GRF.

entry.title: Behavior-Grounded Lane Representation Learning for Multi-Task Traffic Digital Twins

author.name: Rei Tamaru, Pei Li, Bin Ran

entry.summary: GeoLaneRep introduces behavior-grounded lane representation learning that jointly encodes static geometry, vehicle trajectories, and operational descriptors into cross-camera semantic embeddings for traffic digital twins. Captures dynamic functional semantics beyond static geometric representations. Trained with contrastive alignment and temporal anomaly detection.

entry.title: PepSpecBench: A Unified Evaluation Benchmark for Peptide Tandem Mass Spectrometry Prediction

author.name: Zhiwen Yang, Pan Liu, Yifan Li, Yunhua Zhong, Jun Xia

entry.summary: PepSpecBench introduces a unified evaluation benchmark for peptide tandem mass spectrometry prediction, addressing inconsistent preprocessing, flawed data splitting with sequence leakage, and lack of cross-species evaluation. Provides standardized comparison framework for deep learning approaches in computational proteomics.

entry.title: FLoRA: Fusion-Latent for Optical Reconstruction and Flood Area Segmentation via Cross-Modal Multi-Task Distillation Network

author.name: Jagrati Talreja, Tewodros Syum Gebre, Leila Hashemi-Beni

entry.summary: FLoRA is a cross-modal framework that jointly reconstructs optical imagery and segments flood regions from SAR data by fusing complementary strengths of optical and SAR through knowledge distillation.

entry.title: Trees and Graphs with Non Log-concave Dominating Set Sequence via AI Tools

author.name: Alina Du, Steven Heilman, Greta Panova

entry.summary: Uses PatternBoost (a transformer-based RL tool) to find new examples of graphs and trees with non-log-concave dominating set sequences, demonstrating AI-assisted mathematical discovery.

entry.title: MultiSense-Pneumo: A Multimodal Learning Framework for Pneumonia Screening in Resource-Constrained Settings

author.name: Dineth Jayakody, Pasindu Thenahandi, Chameli Dommanige

entry.summary: MultiSense-Pneumo is a multimodal framework for pneumonia screening integrating symptoms, cough audio, spoken language, and chest radiographs, designed for resource-constrained settings.

entry.title: FEAT: Fashion Editing and Try-On from Any Design

author.name: Soye Kwon, Keonyoung Lee, Dahuin Jung, Jaekoo Lee

entry.summary: FEAT enables fashion editing and virtual try-on from diverse design sources (artwork, abstract imagery, photographs) across garments and accessories using Disentangled Dual Injection.

entry.title: From Experimental Limits to Physical Insight: A Retrieval-Augmented Multi-Agent Framework for Interpreting Searches Beyond the Standard Model

author.name: Altan Cakir, Ayca Yerlikaya

entry.summary: HEP-CoPilot is a retrieval-augmented multi-agent AI framework for exploring high-energy physics literature, integrating textual analyses, HEPData, and physics plots for evidence-grounded interpretation of BSM searches.

entry.title: ProPACT: A Proactive AI-Driven Adaptive Collaborative Tutor for Pair Programming

author.name: Anahita Golrang, Kshitij Sharma, olga viberg

entry.summary: ProPACT is a proactive AI tutor for pair programming that predicts suboptimal collaboration states 30 seconds in advance using multimodal signals (joint visual attention, mental effort) and delivers minimally intrusive scaffolds.

entry.title: TOC-SR: Task-Optimal Compact diffusion for Image Super Resolution

author.name: Sowmya Vajrala, Akshay Bankar, Manjunath Arveti, Shreyas Pandith, Sravanth Kodavanti, Subhajit Sanyal, Amit Unde, Srinivas Soumitri Miriyala

entry.summary: Presents TOC-SR, a framework for building efficient one-step super-resolution models by discovering compact diffusion backbones through feature-wise generative distillation and Bayesian optimization for architecture search. Achieves significant parameter reduction while maintaining quality.

entry.title: A second-order method landing on the Stiefel manifold via Newton$\unicode{x2013}$Schulz iteration

author.name: Xinhui Xiong, Bin Gao, P. -A. Absil

entry.summary: Proposes a second-order optimization method on the Stiefel manifold that avoids retractions by using Newton-Schulz iteration, achieving local quadratic convergence. Decomposes updates into tangent and normal components for objective reduction and constraint satisfaction respectively.

entry.title: Kernel Affine Hull Machines for Compute-Efficient Query-Side Semantic Encoding

author.name: Mohit Kumar, Somayeh Kargaran, Bernhard A. Moser, Manuela Gei{\ss}

entry.summary: Proposes Kernel Affine Hull Machines (KAHMs) for compute-efficient query-side semantic encoding, replacing neural inference with lightweight analytically explicit estimators using RKHS prototype-mixture weights.

entry.title: AutoRAGTuner: A Declarative Framework for Automatic Optimization of RAG Pipelines

author.name: Xintan Zeng, Yongchao Liu, Yice Luo, Jiajun Zhen

entry.summary: Presents AutoRAGTuner, a declarative framework that automates the full RAG lifecycle including construction, execution, evaluation, and optimization through Bayesian optimization and a modular component architecture.

entry.title: Mixed-Precision Information Bottlenecks for On-Device Trait-State Disentanglement in Bipolar Agitation Detection

author.name: Joydeep Chandra

entry.summary: Introduces MP-IB, using mixed-precision quantization as an information bottleneck for clinical trait-state separation in bipolar disorder monitoring. FP16 encodes speaker identity while INT4 captures agitation state, achieving 8x information asymmetry without adversarial training.

entry.title: GRAFT: Auditing Graph Neural Networks via Global Feature Attribution

author.name: Rishi Raj Sahoo, Subhankar Mishra

entry.summary: Proposes GRAFT, a post-hoc global explanation framework for GNNs that identifies class-level feature importance profiles using diversity-guided exemplar selection and Integrated Gradients. Can express explanations as natural language rules.

entry.title: Bandits on graphs and structures

author.name: Michal Valko

entry.summary: Survey/thesis covering bandits on graphs and structured domains, including spectral bandits, side observations, influence maximization, kernel bandits, and function optimization under various structural assumptions.

entry.title: Distribution-Free Pretraining of Classification Losses via Evolutionary Dynamics

author.name: Meng Xiang, Yan Pei

entry.summary: Proposes Evolutionary Dynamic Loss (EDL) that learns a transferable classification loss using unlimited synthetic data, trained with a ranking-consistency objective and evolutionary strategy with chaotic mutation.

entry.title: Vanishing L2 regularization for the softmax Multi Armed Bandit

author.name: Stefana-Lucia Anita, Gabriel Turinici

entry.summary: Proves theoretical convergence of L2-regularized softmax policy gradient for multi-armed bandits when the regularization parameter vanishes, a regime previously lacking theoretical analysis.

entry.title: Phoneme-Level Deepfake Detection Across Emotional Conditions Using Self-Supervised Embeddings

author.name: Vamshi Nallaguntla, Shruti Kshirsagar, Anderson R. Avila

entry.summary: Proposes phoneme-level framework for analyzing emotionally manipulated synthetic speech using WavLM embeddings, finding that phoneme behavior varies across categories with complex vowels showing highest divergence.

entry.title: MedStruct-S: A Benchmark for Key Discovery, Key-Conditioned QA and Semi-Structured Extraction from OCR Clinical Reports

author.name: Yingyun Li, Yu Wang, Haiyang Qian

entry.summary: Introduces MedStruct-S, a benchmark for evaluating semi-structured information extraction from OCR-derived clinical reports, covering key discovery, key-conditioned QA, and key-value extraction under realistic noise conditions. Contains 3,582 annotated real-world clinical report pages. Addresses gap in evaluating model robustness with heterogeneous keys and OCR noise.

entry.title: Leveraging Code Automorphisms for Improved Syndrome-Based Neural Decoding

author.name: Rapha\"el Le Bidan, Ahmad Ismail, Elsa Dupraz, Charbel Abdel Nour

entry.summary: Shows how code automorphisms can enhance syndrome-based neural decoding through data augmentation during training and inference. Achieves near-MLD performance with small datasets for short high-rate codes, suggesting prior SBND results underestimate capability due to undertraining.

entry.title: Real Image Denoising with Knowledge Distillation for High-Performance Mobile NPUs

author.name: Faraz Kayani, Sarmad Kayani, Asad Ahmed, Radu Timofte, Dmitry Ignatov

entry.summary: Proposes NPU-aware co-design for mobile image denoising using knowledge distillation from a high-capacity teacher to a lightweight student designed for tiled-memory architectures. Achieves 37.66 dB PSNR on validation set with NPU-native primitives.

entry.title: Psychologically Potent, Computationally Invisible: LLMs Generate Social-Comparison Triggers They Fail to Detect

author.name: Hua Zhao, Jiapei Gu, Michelle Mingyue Gu

entry.summary: Introduces XHS-SCoRE benchmark for detecting social comparison triggers in Xiaohongshu posts. Finds LLMs can generate social comparison content fluently but fail to reliably detect it, revealing generation-detection asymmetry.

entry.title: Leveraging Argument Structure to Predict Content Hatefulness

author.name: Nicol\'as Benjam\'in Ocampo, Davide Ceolin

entry.summary: Studies how argument structure (premises/conclusions) in white supremacy forum messages can predict content hatefulness, exploring connections between argumentation and hate speech detection.

entry.title: The Pre-Training Study of Expanded-SPLADE Models on Web Document Titles

author.name: Hiun Kim, Tae Kwan Lee, Taeryun Won

entry.summary: Studies pre-training of Expanded-SPLADE models on web document titles, examining effects of different pre-training datasets and options on MLM pre-trained models for retrieval fine-tuning.

entry.title: Approaching human parity in the quality of automated organoid image segmentation

author.name: Chase Cartwright, Gongbo Guo, Sai Teja Pusuluri, Christopher N. Mayhew, Mark Hester, Horacio E. Castillo

entry.summary: Develops automated organoid image segmentation approaching human parity for measuring iPSC-derived spheroids, using computer vision and machine learning for developmental biology research.

entry.title: CropVLM: A Domain-Adapted Vision-Language Model for Open-Set Crop Analysis

author.name: Abderrahmene Boudiaf, Sajd Javed

entry.summary: Presents CropVLM, a Vision-Language Model adapted for agricultural plant phenotyping via Domain-Specific Semantic Alignment. Trained on 52,987 image-caption pairs covering 37 species, enabling open-set crop analysis without species-specific annotation.

entry.title: Dynamic Distillation and Gradient Consistency for Robust Long-Tailed Incremental Learning

author.name: Taigo Sakai, Kazuhiro Hotta

entry.summary: Proposes gradient consistency regularization and dynamic distillation loss weighting for long-tailed class incremental learning, stabilizing training and adapting to varying class imbalance across tasks.

entry.title: MHPR: Multidimensional Human Perception and Reasoning Benchmark for Large Vision-Languate Models

author.name: Kangkang Wang, Qinting Jiang, Wanping Zhang, Bowen Ren, Shengzhao Wen

entry.summary: Introduces MHPR, a comprehensive benchmark for human-centric perception-reasoning in LVLMs spanning individual, multi-person, and human-object interaction dimensions with multi-level data design.

entry.title: Uncertainty Estimation in Instance Segmentation of Affordances via Bayesian Visual Transformers

author.name: Lorenzo Mur-Labadia, Ruben Martinez-Cantina, Jose J. Guerrero

entry.summary: Presents a Bayesian Visual Transformer approach for instance segmentation of affordances with uncertainty estimation, using sample-based and ensemble approaches to quantify prediction confidence.

entry.title: Identity-Consistent Multi-Pose Generation of Contactless Fingerprints

author.name: Zhiyu Pan, Xiongjun Guan, Jianjiang Feng, Jie Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes IMPOSE, a physics-inspired framework for generating identity-consistent multi-pose contactless fingerprint samples to address cross-modal domain gap between contactless and contact-based fingerprints.

entry.title: Structured Analytic Coherent Point Drift for Non-Rigid Point Set Registration

author.name: Wei Feng, Haiyong Zheng

entry.summary: Introduces Analytic-CPD, replacing the point-indexed displacement field in Coherent Point Drift with a finite-dimensional structured analytic mapping for non-rigid point set registration, using truncated Taylor mappings.

entry.title: Robust Path Tracking for Vehicles via Continuous-Time Residual Learning: An ICODE-MPPI Approach

author.name: Shugen Song, Wenjie Mei, Chengyan Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes ICODE-MPPI, combining neural ODEs with Model Predictive Path Integral control to learn and compensate for unmodeled dynamics in vehicle path tracking. Achieves up to 69% reduction in cross-tracking error under persistent disturbances compared to standard MPPI.

entry.title: Sensorless State Estimation and Control for Agile Cable-Suspended Payload Transport by Quadrotors

author.name: Ana Maria Nascimento, Augusto Sales, Antonio Marcus Lima, Tiago Nascimento

entry.summary: Develops sensorless state estimation and control for cable-suspended payload transport by quadrotors using the Udwadia-Kalaba method. Eliminates need for direct load measurements through geometric constraint-based estimation.

entry.title: Say the Mission, Execute the Swarm: Agent-Enhanced LLM Reasoning in the Web-of-Drones

author.name: Andrea Iannoli, Lorenzo Gigli, Luca Sciullo, Angelo Trotta, Marco Di Felice

entry.summary: Presents an LLM-based agent framework for UAV swarm control where users express missions in natural language and the system executes through grounded real-time interactions using Web of Things standards and Model Context Protocol.

entry.title: What if LLMs are mostly crystallized intelligence?

author.name: deep

entry.summary: Argues that LLMs excel at crystallized intelligence (learned patterns) but are weak at fluid intelligence (novel reasoning) relative to humans at comparable capability levels. Proposes this as a framework for understanding LLM limitations.

entry.title: EMOVIS: Emotion-Optimized Image Processing

author.name: Dor Barber, Rony Zatzarinni, Hava Matichin, Noam Levy

entry.summary: Introduces EMOVIS, mapping emotional states (Happy, Calm, Angry, Sad) to ISP parameters for real-time emotion-optimized image processing during video capture, validated by user study.

entry.title: TCDA: Thread-Constrained Discourse-Aware Modeling for Conversational Sentiment Quadruple Analysis

author.name: Xinran Li, Xinze Che, Yifan Lyu, Zhiqi Huang, Xiujuan Xu

entry.summary: TCDA proposes Thread-Constrained DAG and Discourse-Aware Rotary Position Embedding for conversational sentiment quadruple analysis. Addresses structural noise from simple GCNs and distance dilution in standard RoPE for multi-turn dialogues. Separates token-level syntactic order from utterance-level progression.

entry.title: PRISM-CTG: A Foundation Model for Cardiotocography Analysis with Multi-View SSL

author.name: Sheng Wong, Ravi Shankar, Beth Albert, Hao Fei, Lin Li, Imane Ben M'Barek, Manu Vatish, Gabriel Davis Jones

entry.summary: Proposes PRISM-CTG, a self-supervised foundation model for cardiotocography (fetal monitoring) analysis that uses multi-view SSL with three complementary pretext objectives on unlabelled clinical recordings.

entry.title: OCRR: A Benchmark for Online Correction Recovery under Distribution Shift

author.name: Adrian Grassi

entry.summary: Introduces OCRR benchmark measuring how quickly models recover from errors when receiving online correction streams under distribution shift, evaluating novel-class accuracy and original-distribution accuracy over time.

entry.title: Where to Bind Matters: Hebbian Fast Weights in Vision Transformers for Few-Shot Character Recognition

author.name: Gavin Money, Sindhuja Penchala, Jiacheng Li, Noorbakhsh Amiri Golilarz

entry.summary: Studies Hebbian Fast-Weight modules in vision transformers for few-shot character recognition, evaluating placement across ViT, DeiT, and Swin backbones on Omniglot.

entry.title: The Manokhin Probability Matrix: A Diagnostic Framework for Classifier Probability Quality

author.name: Valery Manokhin

entry.summary: Introduces the Manokhin Probability Matrix, a 2D diagnostic framework separating calibration (Spiegelhalter Z-statistic) and discrimination (AUC-ROC) for classifiers into four archetypes. Evaluates 21 classifiers with 5 calibrators across 30 tasks.

entry.title: Label-Efficient School Detection from Aerial Imagery via Weakly Supervised Pretraining and Fine-Tuning

author.name: Zakarya Elmimouni, Fares Fourati, Mohamed-Slim Alouini

entry.summary: Proposes a weakly supervised framework for school detection from aerial imagery that minimizes annotation needs. Introduces automatic labeling pipeline leveraging satellite imagery for low-data regimes to support education infrastructure planning.

entry.title: Revisiting Semantic Role Labeling: Efficient Structured Inference with Dependency-Informed Analysis

author.name: Sangpil Youm, Leah Jones, Bonnie J. Dorr

entry.summary: Revisits Semantic Role Labeling with a modernized framework replacing the deprecated AllenNLP, incorporating dependency-informed analysis with current encoder architectures.

entry.title: Mapping Discourse Reframing: A Multi-Layer Network Approach to Italian HPV Vaccine Discourse on X (2010-2024)

author.name: Lorella Viola

entry.summary: Proposes multi-layer network framework to track discourse reframing in Italian HPV vaccine discourse on X (2010-2024), capturing low-frequency signals of emerging information disorder.

entry.title: A Deeper Dive into the Irreversibility of PolyProtect: Making Protected Face Templates Harder to Invert

author.name: Vedrana Krivoku\'ca Hahn, J\'er\'emy Maceiras, S\'ebastien Marcel

entry.summary: Provides deeper analysis of PolyProtect biometric template protection, demonstrating that cosine-distance-based numerical solvers make templates easier to invert, and proposes countermeasures to strengthen irreversibility.

entry.title: Agentic AI Systems Should Be Designed as Marginal Token Allocators

author.name: Siqi Zhu

entry.summary: Position paper arguing that agentic AI systems should be designed as marginal token allocation economies where routing, agent decisions, serving, and training all optimize the same first-order condition of marginal benefit equals marginal cost.

entry.title: MAP-Law: Coverage-Driven Retrieval Control for Multi-Turn Legal Consultation

author.name: Qinchuan Cheng, Ruixuan Xie, Jiaqi Liu, Xiaoya Yuan, Yuxin Liu

entry.summary: Proposes MAP-Law, a coverage-driven retrieval control framework for multi-turn legal consultation that models consultation as a controlled process over structured state and determines when evidence is sufficient.

entry.title: Sheaf-Theoretic Planning: A Categorical Foundation for Resilient Multi-Agent Autonomous Systems

author.name: Manuel Hern\'andez, Eduardo S\'anchez-Soto

entry.summary: Proposes sheaf-theoretic planning using category theory to provide resilient multi-agent planning that handles unobserved interventions, plan interruptions, and belief-reality divergence beyond traditional closed-world assumption approaches.

entry.title: AI and Open-data Driven Scalable Solar Power Profiling

author.name: Shiliang Zhang, Sabita Maharjan, Damla Turgut

entry.summary: Presents an AI and open-data framework for detecting solar panels from satellite imagery using foundation vision models and converting detections into regional solar power profiles using weather data.

entry.title: Triple Spectral Fusion for Sensor-based Human Activity Recognition

author.name: Ye Zhang, Longguang Wang, Qing Gao, Chaocan Xiang, Mohammed Bennamoun, Yulan Guo

entry.summary: Proposes a triple spectral fusion framework for sensor-based human activity recognition that combines adaptive filtering, graph spectral processing for heterogeneous IMU data, and multi-scale temporal analysis.

entry.title: Agentopic: A Generative AI Agent Workflow for Explainable Topic Modeling

author.name: Brice Valentin Kok-Shun, Johnny Chan, Gabrielle Peko, David Sundaram

entry.summary: Presents Agentopic, an agent-based workflow for explainable topic modeling using multiple LLM agents that collaboratively perform topic identification, validation, and natural language explanation. Achieves F1 of 0.95 on BBC dataset.

entry.title: DIAGRAMS: A Review Framework for Reasoning-Level Attribution in Diagram QA

author.name: Anirudh Iyengar Kaniyar Narayana Iyengar, Tampu Ravi Kumar, Manan Suri, Raviteja Bommireddy, Dinesh Manocha, Puneet Mathur, Vivek Gupta

entry.summary: Presents DIAGRAMS, a lightweight review framework for reasoning-level attribution in diagram question answering. Decouples interface logic from dataset-specific formats through a meta-schema approach for annotating visual evidence.

entry.title: MindMelody: A Closed-Loop EEG-Driven System for Personalized Music Intervention

author.name: Yimeng Zhang, Yueru Sun, Haoyu Gu

entry.summary: Proposes MindMelody, a closed-loop EEG-driven system for personalized music intervention using an emotion-mediated semantic bridge. Addresses real-time adaptation to psychological states without requiring direct EEG-to-music paired data.

entry.title: The Garden of Forking Paths: Narrative Arc-Conditioned Gameplay Planning

author.name: Yunge Wen, Chenliang Huang, Hangyu Zhou, Zhuo Zeng, Chun Ming Louis Po, Julian Togelius, Timothy Merino, Sam Earle

entry.summary: Proposes Forking Garden, a framework for narrative arc-conditioned gameplay planning that generates branching games from user storylines using narrative archetypes like Hero's Journey. Achieves multimodal alignment of gameplay elements.

entry.title: AI Expert Twin: Capturing Expert Cognition for Human-Centred, Practice-Based Learning

author.name: Annie Yuan, Xiaohua Chen, Kalina Yacef, Judy Kay

entry.summary: Introduces the 'AI Expert Twin' framework that models tacit expert knowledge as structured, computable representations of procedural actions, semantic concepts, and decision processes. Formalizes expert cognition as a three-layer representation considering value-laden preferences and uncertainty. Targets practice-based learning domains where expert reasoning is difficult to capture.

entry.title: CGFformer: Cluster-Guidance Frequency Transformer for Pansharpening

author.name: Zijian Zhou, Jianing Zhang, Kai Sun, Xiangyu Zhao, Chunxia Zhang, Xiangyong Cao

entry.summary: CGFformer proposes a cluster-guidance frequency Transformer for pansharpening that adaptively handles complex frequency distributions rather than using fixed filters. Addresses limitations of current frequency-based methods that cannot adapt to spatially diversified frequency patterns. Combines clustering with frequency-domain processing for image fusion.

entry.title: Pair2Score: Pairwise-to-Absolute Transfer for LLM-Based Essay Scoring

author.name: \.Ibrahim R{\i}za Halla\c{c}, Hasan O\u{g}ul

entry.summary: Pair2Score presents a two-stage framework that transfers pairwise comparison learning into absolute scoring for automated essay grading, using parameter-efficient LLaMA adaptation with Siamese ranking followed by absolute prediction.

entry.title: Recurrent Deep Reinforcement Learning for Chemotherapy Control under Partial Observability

author.name: Firas Mohamed Elamine Kiram, Imane Youkana, Rachida Saouli, Gian Antonio Susto, Laid Kahloul

entry.summary: Investigates recurrent deep RL (TD3 with LSTM) for chemotherapy dose optimization under partial observability, comparing against feed-forward baselines on a pharmacokinetic benchmark.

entry.title: Beyond State Machines: Executing Network Procedures with Agentic Tool-Calling Sequences

author.name: Purna Sai Garigipati, Onur Ayan, Kishor Chandra Joshi, Xueli An

entry.summary: Studies how LLM-based network AI agents can execute mobile network procedures as tool invocation sequences, comparing four approaches with different levels of agent autonomy for a UE IP allocation procedure.

entry.title: IConFace: Identity-Structure Asymmetric Conditioning for Unified Reference-Aware Face Restoration

author.name: Axi Niu, Jinyang Zhang, Senyan Qing

entry.summary: Proposes IConFace, a unified reference-aware face restoration framework with identity-structure asymmetric conditioning. Uses a norm-weighted global identity anchor from references while maintaining spatial structure from degraded inputs through low-rank residuals.

entry.title: PAMNet: Cycle-aware Phase-Amplitude Modulation Network for Multivariate Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Yingbo Zhou, Yutong Ye, Zhiwei Ling, Shuhao Li, Rui Qian, Jian Xiong, Li Sun, Dejing Dou

entry.summary: Proposes PAMNet for multivariate time series forecasting that explicitly decomposes periodic patterns into phase and amplitude components with dedicated learnable embeddings for each, avoiding implicit extraction through complex architectures.

entry.title: AsymK-Talker: Real-Time and Long-Horizon Talking Head Generation via Asymmetric Kernel Distillation

author.name: Yuxin Lu, Qian Qiao, Jiayang Sun, Min Cao, Guibo Zhu

entry.summary: Introduces AsymK-Talker for real-time talking head generation using diffusion distillation with asymmetric kernel conditioning. Addresses causal inefficiency, temporal coherence, and long-horizon drift issues.

entry.title: Attribution-Guided Masking for Robust Cross-Domain Sentiment Classification

author.name: Shubham Harkare, Arvind Yogesh Suresh Babu, Yash Kulkarni

entry.summary: Proposes Attribution-Guided Masking (AGM) for robust cross-domain sentiment classification by detecting and penalizing highly-attributed spurious tokens during fine-tuning to improve out-of-domain generalization.

entry.title: Stable Multimodal Graph Unlearning via Feature-Dimension Aware Quantile Selection

author.name: Jingjing Zhou, Yongshuai Yang, Qing Qing, Ziqi Xu, Xikun Zhang, Renqiang Luo, Ivan Lee, Feng Xia

entry.summary: Proposes FDQ, a feature-dimension aware quantile framework for multimodal graph unlearning that adaptively identifies high-dimensional sensitive layers and applies dimension-aware parameter selection to avoid catastrophic utility degradation.

entry.title: From Code to Prediction: Fine-Tuning LLMs for Neural Network Performance Classification in NNGPT

author.name: Mahmoud Hanouneh, Radu Timofte, Dmitry Ignatov

entry.summary: Fine-tunes LLMs to predict which dataset a neural network architecture performs better on, integrating this classification task into the NNGPT framework. Built on LEMUR dataset with standardized implementations.

entry.title: Donor-Aware scRNA-seq Benchmarks for IBD Classification

author.name: Jonathan Muhire

entry.summary: Presents a donor-aware benchmark for IBD classification from scRNA-seq, demonstrating that naive cell-level splitting inflates performance through pseudoreplication. Compares CLR composition, GatedStructuralCFN, and scVI embeddings across two IBD cohorts.

entry.title: Raising the Ceiling: Better Empirical Fixation Densities for Saliency Benchmarking

author.name: Susmit Agrawal, Jannis Hollman, Matthias K\"ummerer

entry.summary: Proposes improved empirical fixation density estimation for saliency benchmarking using a mixture model with adaptive-bandwidth KDE, center bias, and uniform components. Argues this is critical as the field shifts toward sample-level evaluation.

entry.title: Maistros: A Greek Large Language Model Adapted Through Knowledge Distillation From Large Reasoning Models

author.name: Nikolaos Giarelis, Charalampos Mastrokostas, Nikos Karacapilidis

entry.summary: Introduces Maistros, a Greek LLM adapted through knowledge distillation from large reasoning models. Demonstrates transfer of reasoning capabilities to a low-resource language model.

entry.title: Orientation-Aware Unsupervised Domain Adaptation for Brain Tumor Classification Across Multi-Modal MRI

author.name: Sapna Sachan, Amulya Kumar Mahto, Prashant Wagambar Patil

entry.summary: Proposes an orientation-aware unsupervised domain adaptation framework for brain tumor classification that first categorizes MRI slices by orientation, then applies domain-adapted CNNs for each view.

entry.title: Parameter-Efficient Multi-View Proficiency Estimation: From Discriminative Classification to Generative Feedback

author.name: Edoardo Bianchi, Antonio Liotta

entry.summary: Discusses three approaches to multi-view proficiency estimation: SkillFormer (discriminative), PATS (temporal sampling), and ProfVLM (generative feedback), progressing from classification to language-based proficiency assessment.

entry.title: Feasibility-aware Hybrid Control for Motion Planning under Signal Temporal Logics

author.name: Panagiotis Rousseas, Dimos V. Dimarogonas

entry.summary: Proposes a hybrid control method for motion planning under Signal Temporal Logic specifications, using control barrier functions on transformed workspace representations to avoid deadlocks in complex environments.

entry.title: Virtual Speech Therapist: A Clinician-in-the-Loop AI Speech Therapy Agent for Personalized and Supervised Therapy

author.name: Shakeel Sheikh, Patrick Marmaroli, MD Sahidullah, Slim Ouni, Fabrice Hirsch, Goncalo Leal, Bjorn W Schuller

entry.summary: Presents Virtual Speech Therapist (VST), a multi-agent LLM platform for automated stuttering assessment and personalized therapy planning, with a critic agent for iterative refinement of treatment plans.

entry.title: PERSA: Reinforcement Learning for Professor-Style Personalized Feedback with LLMs

author.name: Ravi Ranjan, Utkarsh Grover, Xiaomin Lin, Agoritsa Polyzou

entry.summary: Introduces PERSA, an RLHF pipeline for adapting LLM feedback generation to match a specific professor's grading style while preserving diagnostic correctness, using supervised fine-tuning, reward modeling, and PPO.

entry.title: Rethinking Explanations: Formalizing Contrast in Description Logics

author.name: Yasir Mahmood, Arnab Sharma, Axel-Cyrille Ngonga Ngomo, Balram Tiwari

entry.summary: Formalizes contrastive explanations in description logics, answering 'why P instead of Q' questions about knowledge base entailments, addressing user-centered explanation needs beyond standard justifications.

entry.title: MILD: Mediator Agent System with Bidirectional Perception and Multi-Layered Alignment for Human-Vehicle Collaboration

author.name: Jiyao Wang, Yunbiao Wang, Yubo Jiao, Xiao Yang, Dengbo He, Sasan Jafarnejad, Luis Miranda-Moreno, Raphael Frank, Jiangbo Yu

entry.summary: Introduces MILD, a mediator agent system for human-vehicle collaboration that provides bidirectional perception and multi-layered alignment between human drivers and automated vehicles.

entry.title: A Study of Belief Revision Postulates in Multi-Agent Systems (Extended Version)

author.name: Michael Thielscher, Tran Cao Son

entry.summary: Generalizes classical AGM belief revision postulates to multi-agent epistemic planning settings using Kripke models. Presents generalized full-meet multi-agent belief revision as an operator satisfying all postulates.

entry.title: Can Causal Discovery Algorithms Help in Generating Legal Arguments?

author.name: Soham Wasmatkar, Subinay Adhikary, Rakshit Rohan, Shouvik Kumar Guha, Saptarshi Pyne, Kripabandhu Ghosh

entry.summary: Investigates whether causal discovery algorithms can be applied to legal argumentation, exploring an unexplored application of Pearl's causal reasoning framework in the legal domain.

entry.title: Counterfactual Reasoning in Automated Planning

author.name: Alberto Pozanco, Daniel Borrajo, Manuela Veloso

entry.summary: Surveys counterfactual reasoning in automated planning, categorizing existing work by what elements change, when reasoning triggers, and why/how changes occur. Outlines open research questions.

entry.title: 1BT: One-Block Transformer for EEG-Based Cognitive Workload Assessment

author.name: Stefanos Gkikas, Christian Arzate Cruz, Thomas Kassiotis, Giorgos Giannakakis, Raul Fernandez Rojas, Randy Gomez

entry.summary: Introduces 1BT, a minimal one-block transformer for EEG-based cognitive workload assessment using a single cross-attention module with lightweight self-attention. Validated on 11-participant study with three cognitive tasks.

entry.title: Ablation Study of Multimodal Perception, Language Grounding, and Control for Human-Robot Interaction in an Object Detection and Grasping Task

author.name: Zi Tian, Guanting Shen

entry.summary: Conducts ablation study of multimodal HRI system components: LLM for action extraction, perception for visual grounding, and controller for motion execution. Evaluates best combinations for object detection and grasping.

entry.title: Toward a Scientific Discovery Engine for Weather and Climate Data: A Visual Analytics Workbench for Embedding-Based Exploration

author.name: Nihanth W. Cherukuru, Matt Rehme, Kirsten J. Mayer, David John Gagne, John Schreck, John Clyne, Charlie Becker

entry.summary: Presents an open-source visual analytics workbench for exploring embedding-based representations of weather and climate data, linking embedding experiments with meteorological domain knowledge.

entry.title: ABox Abduction for Inconsistent Knowledge Bases under Repair Semantics

author.name: Anselm Haak, Patrick Koopmann, Yasir Mahmood, Anni-Yasmin Turhan

entry.summary: Defines ABox abduction for inconsistent knowledge bases under repair semantics, providing complexity analysis for meaningful reasoning in the presence of erroneous data.

entry.title: MU-SHOT-Fi: Self-Supervised Multi-User Wi-Fi Sensing with Source-free Unsupervised Domain Adaptation

author.name: Ahmed Y. Radwan, Hina Tabassum

entry.summary: Proposes MU-SHOT-Fi, a source-free unsupervised domain adaptation framework for multi-user WiFi sensing. Uses permutation-invariant architectures for activity recognition without access to labeled source data.

entry.title: Research on Vision-Language Question Answering Models for Industrial Robots

author.name: Ping Li, Bartlomiej Brzozka

entry.summary: Proposes a hierarchical cross-modal fusion model for vision-language question answering in industrial robotics, integrating object detection, multi-scale visual encoding, syntactic parsing, and task-aware semantic attention. Targets challenges of semantic ambiguity and domain-specific terminology in manufacturing. Combines region-based features with recurrent language parsing.

entry.title: KG-First, LLM-Fallback: A Hybrid Microservice for Grounded Skill Search and Explanation

author.name: Ngoc Luyen Le, Marie-H\'el\`ene Abel, Bertrand Laforge

entry.summary: SkillGraph-Service is a microservice that unifies competency frameworks (ESCO, ROME, O*NET) into a provenance-preserving Knowledge Graph with KG-first, LLM-fallback architecture. Combines symbolic retrieval (SQLite FTS5 + HNSW vector search) with LLMs for constrained ranking and explanation. Bridges gap between authoritative frameworks and practical educator use.

entry.title: RAFNet: Region-Aware Fusion Network for Pansharpening

author.name: Jianing Zhang, Zijian Zhou, Kai Sun

entry.summary: RAFNet proposes a region-aware fusion network for pansharpening that exploits regional sparsity in remote sensing imagery with dynamic convolution kernels adapting to frequency and regional variations.

entry.title: EdgeLPR: On the Deep Neural Network trade-off between Precision and Performance in LiDAR Place Recognition

author.name: Pierpaolo Serio, Hetian Wang, Zixiang Wei, Vincenzo Infantino, Lorenzo Gentilini, Lorenzo Pollini, Valentina Donzella

entry.summary: Benchmarks efficient LiDAR-based place recognition architectures for edge deployment, evaluating performance under different quantization levels (FP32, FP16, INT8) with Bird's Eye View representations.

entry.title: LLM-enabled Social Agents

author.name: \"Onder G\"urcan, Moharram Challenger

entry.summary: Proposes a conceptual framework for LLM-enabled social agents grounded in role definitions and persona descriptions, arguing that fluent language alone doesn't yield socially intelligible behavior.

entry.title: PC-MNet: Dual-Level Congruity Modeling for Multimodal Sarcasm Detection via Polarity-Modulated Attention

author.name: Maoheng Li, Ling Zhou, Xiaohua Huang, Rubing Huang, Wenming Zheng, Guoying Zhao

entry.summary: PC-MNet proposes dual-level congruity modeling for multimodal sarcasm detection using polarity-modulated attention and scalar congruity routing to identify incongruities between text and nonverbal cues.

entry.title: Fuzzy Fingerprinting Encoder Pre-trained Language Models for Emotion Recognition in Conversations: Human Assessment and Validity Study

author.name: Patr\'icia Pereira, Helena Moniz, Joao Paulo Carvalho

entry.summary: Combines pre-trained language models with Fuzzy Fingerprints for interpretable emotion recognition in conversations, providing class-specific prototypes that explain classification decisions.

entry.title: From Synthesis to Clinical Assistance: A Strategy-Aware Agent Framework for Autism Intervention based on Real Clinical Dataset

author.name: Junhong Lai, Shuzhong Lai, Yanhao Yu, Wanlin Chen, Chenyu Yan, Haifeng Li, Lin Yao, Yueming Wang

entry.summary: Introduces ASDAgent, an LLM-based framework for autism intervention that combines high-fidelity clinical dialogue synthesis with strategy-aware clinical decision support following Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) protocols.

entry.title: Mitigating the reconstruction-detection trade-off in VAE-based unsupervised anomaly detection

author.name: Agathe Senellart (UPCit\'e, INSERM, HeKA | U1346), Ma\"elys Solal (ARAMIS, ICM), St\'ephanie Allassonni\`ere (UPCit\'e, INSERM, HeKA | U1346), Ninon Burgos (ARAMIS, ICM)

entry.summary: Reveals a trade-off between reconstruction quality and anomaly detection in β-VAE models, showing models with constrained latent space achieve better detection but worse reconstruction. Proposes beta-scheduling and Sparse Prior VAE to mitigate this.

entry.title: From Static Analysis to Audience Dissemination: A Training-Free Multimodal Controversy Detection Multi-Agent Framework

author.name: Zihan Ding, Ziyuan Yang, Yi Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes AuDisAgent, a training-free multi-agent framework for multimodal controversy detection that models content dissemination among audience groups rather than treating it as static representation learning.

entry.title: Pose Tracking with a Foundation Pose Model and an Ensemble Directional Kalman Filter

author.name: Tianlu Lu, Asif Sijan, Thomas Noh, Huaijin Chen, Andrey A. Popov

entry.summary: Introduces the ensemble directional Kalman filter (EnDKF) for pose tracking that uses unit-quaternion representation with directional statistics to properly handle rotational uncertainty, demonstrated with FoundationPose.

entry.title: Global and Local Topology-Aware Attention with Persistent Homology and Euler Biases for Time-Series Forecasting

author.name: Usef Faghihi, Amir Saki

entry.summary: Introduces topology-aware attention for time series forecasting using persistent homology (H0-H2), Euler characteristic transforms, and kernel-Hilbert channels as additional biases in attention computation.

entry.title: Quantum Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning via Variational Quantum Circuits

author.name: Yu-Ting Lee, Samuel Yen-Chi Chen, Fu-Chieh Chang

entry.summary: Develops a hybrid hierarchical RL agent using the option-critic architecture with variational quantum circuits for feature extraction, value functions, and policies. Evaluated on standard benchmarks.

entry.title: Adaptive graph-based algorithms for conditional anomaly detection and semi-supervised learning

author.name: Michal Valko

entry.summary: Develops graph-based methods for semi-supervised learning with online algorithms and applies graph-based anomaly detection to clinical settings. Proposes fast approximate methods using local representative points.

entry.title: Bandits attack function optimization

author.name: Philippe Preux, R\'emi Munos, Michal Valko

entry.summary: Proposes Simultaneous Optimistic Optimization (SOO) for function optimization under budget constraints, treating it as a sequential decision-making problem inspired by multi-armed bandits.

entry.title: Graph Convolutional Support Vector Regression for Robust Spatiotemporal Forecasting of Urban Air Pollution

author.name: Nourin Jahan, Madhurima Panja, Muhammed Navas T, Tanujit Chakraborty

entry.summary: Proposes GCSVR combining graph convolutional learning for spatial dependencies with SVR for robust temporal modeling in urban air pollution forecasting across Delhi and another city.

entry.title: From Data Lifting to Continuous Risk Estimation: A Process-Aware Pipeline for Predictive Monitoring of Clinical Pathways

author.name: Pasquale Ardimento, Mario Luca Bernardi, Marta Cimitile, Samuele Latorre

entry.summary: Presents a process-aware pipeline for predictive monitoring of clinical pathways, integrating data lifting, temporal reconstruction, and prefix-based prediction. Evaluated on COVID-19 ICU admission prediction.

entry.title: An Information-Geometric Framework for Stability Analysis of Large Language Models under Entropic Stress

author.name: Hikmat Karimov, Rahid Zahid Alekberli

entry.summary: Proposes a thermodynamic-inspired framework for analyzing LLM stability under uncertainty, introducing a composite score integrating utility, entropy, and internal structural proxies.

entry.title: On the Spectral Structure and Objective Equivalence of Orthogonal Multilabel Fisher Discriminants

author.name: Brian Keith-Norambuena, Juan Bekios-Calfa

entry.summary: Provides unified theoretical analysis of Linear Discriminant Analysis with multilabel scatter matrices and Stiefel orthogonality constraints. Shows effective discriminant dimensionality can exceed the classical C-1 bound and proves equivalence of Fisher objectives under specific constraints.

entry.title: StreakMind: AI detection and analysis of satellite streaks in astronomical images with automated database integration

author.name: Rafael Carrillo Navarro, Ren\'e Duffard, Pablo Garc\'ia-Mart\'in, Javier Romero, Nicol\'as Morales, Luis Gon\c{c}alves

entry.summary: Presents StreakMind, an automated pipeline for detecting satellite streaks in astronomical images using YOLO OBB models, characterizing their geometry, and cross-identifying with known orbital objects. Trained on 2335 images for large survey integration.

entry.title: Low Rank Tensor Completion via Adaptive ADMM

author.name: Niclas F\"uhrling, Getuar Rexhepi, Giuseppe Thadeu Freitas de Abreu

entry.summary: Proposes an ADMM-based algorithm for low-rank tensor completion using nuclear norm minimization with over-relaxation and adaptive penalty parameters. Shows improved convergence speed and performance over conventional approaches.

entry.title: Controlled Paraphrase Geometry in Sentence Embedding Space: Local Manifold Modeling and Latent Probing

author.name: Leonid Bedratyuk

entry.summary: Studies local geometry of sentence embedding clouds under controlled paraphrase variation, fitting affine/quadratic/cubic models and proposing surface-based latent probing in reduced PCA space.

entry.title: Fine-Tuning Pre-Trained Code Models for AI-Generated Code Detection

author.name: Jany-Gabriel Ispas, Sergiu Nisioi

entry.summary: Describes a system for SemEval-2026 Task 13 on AI-generated code detection, fine-tuning CodeBERT, GraphCodeBERT, UniXcoder, and CodeT5+ with strategies for binary classification and model attribution.

entry.title: A Systematic Benchmark of Machine Transliteration Models for the Tajik-Farsi Language Pair: A Comparative Study from Rule-Based to Transformer Architectures

author.name: Mullosharaf K. Arabov

entry.summary: Presents first comprehensive comparative analysis of machine learning architectures for Tajik-Farsi transliteration, including creation of a parallel corpus and evaluation of six model classes.

entry.title: Structural Dilemmas and Developmental Pathways of Legal Argument Mining in the Era of Artificial Intelligence

author.name: Xianglei Liao, Chuanyi Li, Kun Chen

entry.summary: Survey paper on legal argument mining tracing evolution from rule-based systems to LLMs, identifying structural dilemmas across data, technology, and theory dimensions.

entry.title: ATLAS: Article Tracking, Linking, and Analysis of Swedish Encyclopedias

author.name: Albin Andersson, Salam Jonasson, Fredrik Wastring, Pierre Nugues

entry.summary: Builds ATLAS pipeline to restore structure in digitized Swedish encyclopedias: extracting headwords, categorizing entities, matching across editions, and linking to Wikidata.

entry.title: Sentinel2Cap: A Human-Annotated Benchmark Dataset for Multimodal Remote Sensing Image Captioning

author.name: Lucrezia Tosato, Gianluca Lombardi, Ronny Hansch

entry.summary: Introduces Sentinel2Cap, a human-annotated captioning dataset for multimodal satellite data (Sentinel-1 SAR and Sentinel-2 multi-spectral) at 10m and 20m resolution. Fills a gap in captioning datasets for medium-resolution and SAR remote sensing imagery.

entry.title: SoDa2: Single-Stage Open-Set Domain Adaptation via Decoupled Alignment for Cross-Scene Hyperspectral Image Classification

author.name: Yiwen Liu, Minghua Wang, Jing Yao, Xin Zhao, Gemine Vivone

entry.summary: Proposes SoDa2, a single-stage open-set domain adaptation method for cross-scene hyperspectral image classification using decoupled alignment of spectral and spatial features to reduce computational costs.

entry.title: PriorNet: Prior-Guided Engagement Estimation from Face Video

author.name: Alexander Vedernikov

entry.summary: Presents PriorNet for engagement estimation from face video, injecting task-relevant priors at preprocessing, model adaptation (Prior-LoRA), and objective design stages with uncertainty-weighted evidential learning.

entry.title: RPBA-Net: An Interpretable Residual Pyramid Bilateral Affine Network for RAW-Domain ISP Enhancement

author.name: Yucheng Xin, Wu Chen, Xiang Chen, Guangwei Gao, Xinchun Wang, Ruize Wu, Dianjie Lu, Guijuan Zhang, Linwei Fan, Zhuoran Zheng

entry.summary: Proposes RPBA-Net, an interpretable residual pyramid bilateral affine network for RAW-domain ISP enhancement that unifies demosaicing, color correction, and detail enhancement.

entry.title: On Surprising Effects of Risk-Aware Domain Randomization for Contact-Rich Sampling-based Predictive Control

author.name: Sergio A. Esteban, Junheng Li, Vince Kurtz, Aaron D. Ames

entry.summary: Studies risk-aware domain randomization in contact-rich sampling-based predictive control, finding that DR affects not just robustness but the effective cost landscape of the optimizer. Uses a Push-T task as a testbed.

entry.title: Height Control and Optimal Torque Planning for Jumping With Wheeled-Bipedal Robots

author.name: Yulun Zhuang, Yuan Xu, Binxin Huang, Mandan Chao, Guowei Shi, Xin Yang, Kuangen Zhang, Chenglong Fu

entry.summary: Develops accurate height jumping control for wheeled-bipedal robots through a novel dynamics model and Bayesian optimization for torque planning. Addresses the problem of robots jumping higher than necessary, wasting energy.

entry.title: Jiao: Bridging Isolation and Customization in Mixed Criticality Robotics

author.name: James Yen, Zhibai Huang, Zhixiang Wei, Tinghao Yi, Shupeng Zeng, Liang Pang, Songtao Xue, Zhengwei Qi

entry.summary: Presents Jiao, a mixed-criticality architecture for consumer robotics that bridges safety-critical control with user-customizable applications. Addresses the expertise asymmetry between platform developers and end-users.

entry.title: Decision theory doesn’t prove that useful strong AIs will doom us all

author.name: deep

entry.summary: Argues against the inevitability of 'world-optimizer' AI agents, claiming people will prefer bounded, deontological agents for practical reasons including misalignment risk and trust limitations, similar to how we manage human subordinates.

entry.title: To Use AI as Dice of Possibilities with Timing Computation

author.name: Jia Li, Vipin Kumar, Rui Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes a 'verb-based' AI paradigm called timing computation that treats possibilities as open temporal dimensions, applied to longitudinal EHR data for breast cancer trajectory discovery and counterfactual deduction.

entry.title: Structural Ranking of the Cognitive Plausibility of Computational Models of Analogy and Metaphors with the Minimal Cognitive Grid

author.name: Alessio Donvito, Antonio Lieto

entry.summary: Uses the Minimal Cognitive Grid framework to systematically rank computational models of analogy and metaphor (SME, CogSketch, METCL, LLMs) for cognitive plausibility using formal quantitative criteria.

entry.title: CyberAId: AI-Driven Cybersecurity for Financial Service Providers

author.name: George Fatouros, Georgios Makridis, John Soldatos, Dimosthenis Kyriazis, Pedro Malo, George Kousiouris, Giannis Ledakis, Louiza Kachrimani, Panagiotis Rizomiliotis, Bruno Almeida, Despina Tomkou, Kostas Metaxas, Konstantinos Ilias, Christos Gkizelis, Ernstjan de Gooyert, Amin Babazadeh, Kostis Mavrogiorgos, Pepi Paraskevoulakou, Christos Xenakis, Giannis Chouchoulis, Konstantina Tripodi

entry.summary: Presents CyberAId, an AI-driven cybersecurity platform for financial institutions that composes LLM capabilities across functions including alert triage, vulnerability assessment, and regulatory mapping.

entry.title: Reinforcement Learning Trained Observer Control for Bearings-Only Tracking

author.name: Branko Ristic, Sanjeev Arulampalam

entry.summary: Develops a deep RL observer control policy for bearings-only target tracking, using a cubature Kalman filter belief state and balancing estimation accuracy against filter consistency on the Pareto front.

entry.title: Complexity Horizons of Compressed Models in Analog Circuit Analysis

author.name: Pacome Simon Mbonimpa

entry.summary: Proposes a performance-aware model compression strategy using prerequisite graphs to optimize LLM selection for circuit analysis tasks. Structures electronics concepts as DAGs to identify complexity horizons of compressed model variants.

entry.title: Efficient Temporal Datalog Materialisation for Composite Event Recognition

author.name: Periklis Mantenoglou

entry.summary: Maps event specification languages into Temporal Datalog for composite event recognition over high-velocity event streams. Provides a unified framework for comparing expressivity of different event specification languages.

entry.title: The 2026 ACII Dyadic Conversations (DaiKon) Workshop & Challenge

author.name: Panagiotis Tzirakis, Alice Baird, Jeffrey Brooks, Emilia Parada-Cabaleiro, Lukas Stappen, Sharath Rao, Theo Lebryk, Jakub Piotr Clapa, Jens Madsen

entry.summary: Introduces the 2026 ACII Dyadic Conversations Workshop & Challenge with three sub-challenges on interpersonal influence, turn-taking prediction, and rapport trajectory prediction in dyadic conversations.

entry.title: Democratizing the medieval English legal tradition

author.name: Michael Zhang, Elise Wang, Charlotte Whatley, Seth Strickland, Dylan Bannon

entry.summary: Constructs a dataset and end-to-end pipeline for transcribing medieval English legal manuscripts written in abbreviated medieval Latin. Trains line segmentation and handwriting recognition models on 4029 text lines.

entry.title: SCION: Size-aware Policy Orchestration for Nonstationary Object Caches (Long Paper Version)

author.name: Qizhi Wang
