entry.title: FedACT: Concurrent Federated Intelligence across Heterogeneous Data Sources

author.name: Md Sirajul Islam, Isabelle G Chapman, N I Md Ashafuddula, Xu Yuan, Li Chen, Nian-Feng Tzeng, Klara Nahrstedt

entry.summary: FedACT addresses multi-task federated learning where multiple ML tasks simultaneously train across shared devices. Proposes resource heterogeneity-aware device scheduling for efficient multi-FL system operation.

entry.title: Remote SAMsing: From Segment Anything to Segment Everything

author.name: Osmar Luiz Ferreira de Carvalho, Osmar Ab\'ilio de Carvalho J\'unior, Anesmar Olino de Albuquerque, Daniel Guerreiro e Silva

entry.summary: Remote SAMsing extends SAM2 to large remote sensing scenes with a multi-pass pipeline that resolves quality-coverage tradeoffs and cross-tile fragmentation without modifying SAM2 or requiring training data.

entry.title: Hypergraph and Latent ODE Learning for Multimodal Root Cause Localization in Microservices

author.name: Xin Liu, Yuhang He, Sichen Zhao, Kejian Tong, Xingyu Zhang

entry.summary: HyperODE RCA combines hypergraph attention, latent ODEs, and multimodal cross-attention fusion for root cause analysis in microservices. Handles higher-order service interactions, continuous anomaly evolution, and heterogeneous observability data.

entry.title: The Banach-Butterfly Invariant: Influence-Adaptive Walsh Geometry for Ternary Polynomial Threshold Functions

author.name: Gorgi Pavlov

entry.summary: Introduces the Banach-Butterfly Invariant (BBT), an influence-adaptive geometry on Walsh-Hadamard factorizations that assigns per-layer exponents based on coordinate influences, yielding scaling classes for different Boolean functions.

entry.title: Demographic-Aware Transfer Learning for Sleep Stage Classification in Clinical Polysomnography

author.name: S M Asif Hossain, Shruti Kshirsagar

entry.summary: Proposes demographic-aware transfer learning for sleep stage classification, pretraining on full population then fine-tuning independently for subgroups defined by gender, age, and sleep apnea severity.

entry.title: Recurrent Deep Reinforcement Learning for Chemotherapy Control under Partial Observability

author.name: Firas Mohamed Elamine Kiram, Imane Youkana, Rachida Saouli, Gian Antonio Susto, Laid Kahloul

entry.summary: Investigates recurrent TD3 with LSTM actor-critic for chemotherapy dose optimization under partial observability, comparing against feed-forward baselines on the DTR-Bench AhnChemoEnv.

entry.title: Foundation Model Guided Dual-Branch Co-Adaptation for Source-Free EEG Decoding

author.name: Peiliang Gong, Han Zhang, Zhen Jiang, Chenyu Liu, Ziyu Jia, Xinliang Zhou, Daoqiang Zhang, Xiaoli Li

entry.summary: Proposes FUSED, a framework that integrates EEG foundation models with compact specialist models via dual-branch co-adaptation for source-free cross-subject EEG decoding. Exploits FM generalizability without requiring source data access.

entry.title: NAKUL-Med: Spectral-Graph State Space Models with Dynamics Kernels for Medical Signals

author.name: Badri N. Patro, Vijay S. Agneeswaran

entry.summary: Introduces NAKUL-Med, extending state space models for medical signals with dynamic kernel generation, spectral-graph context for electrode topology, and multi-scale temporal dynamics adaptive selection.

entry.title: Pi-Change: A Prior-Informed Multiple Change Point Detection Algorithm

author.name: Jonathon Jacobs, Shanshan Chen

entry.summary: Proposes Pi-Change, a prior-informed change point detection algorithm that incorporates contextual information about plausible change point locations through a time-varying penalty, embedded in the Pruned Exact Linear Time framework for efficiency.

entry.title: InfiltrNet: Dual-Branch CNN-Transformer Architecture for Brain Tumor Infiltration Risk Prediction

author.name: S M Asif Hossain, Shruti Kshirsagar

entry.summary: InfiltrNet is a dual-branch CNN-Transformer architecture for predicting brain tumor infiltration risk beyond visible tumor margins on MRI, using cross-attention fusion and distance transform-based labels.

entry.title: Open-access model for detecting openly dumped dispersed municipal solid waste from crowdsourced UAV imagery in Sub-Saharan Africa

author.name: Steffen Knoblauch, Ram Kumar Muthusamy, Luis M. A. Bettencourt, Costas Velis, Pierre Chrzanowski, Edward Charles Anderson, Pete Masters, Innocent Maholi, Antonio Inguane, Levi Szamek, Alexander Zipf

entry.summary: Open-access deep learning model for detecting dispersed solid waste from crowdsourced UAV imagery across 29 regions in 10 Sub-Saharan African countries.

entry.title: ProPACT: A Proactive AI-Driven Adaptive Collaborative Tutor for Pair Programming

author.name: Anahita Golrang, Kshitij Sharma, olga viberg

entry.summary: ProPACT is a proactive AI tutoring system for pair programming that models collaborative states using multimodal signals (joint attention, mental effort) and predicts suboptimal states 30 seconds in advance to provide scaffolding.

entry.title: Adaptive Interpolation-Synthesis for Motion In-Betweening on Keyframe-Based Animation

author.name: Anton Ra\"el, Julien Boucher, Antoine Lhermitte

entry.summary: Proposes an adaptive interpolation-synthesis method for motion in-betweening aligned with professional keyframe animation workflows, addressing the gap between research methods and production environments.

entry.title: A Systematic Benchmark of Machine Transliteration Models for the Tajik-Farsi Language Pair: A Comparative Study from Rule-Based to Transformer Architectures

author.name: Mullosharaf K. Arabov

entry.summary: Presents the first comprehensive comparative analysis of machine learning architectures for transliteration between Tajik (Cyrillic) and Persian (Arabic script). Creates a parallel corpus from multiple heterogeneous sources and compares six model classes.

entry.title: Multi-Branch Non-Homogeneous Image Dehazing via Concentration Partitioning and Image Fusion

author.name: Yingming Zhang, Wuqi Su, Qing Xiao, Yonggang Yang

entry.summary: Proposes CPIFNet, a multi-branch neural network that decomposes non-homogeneous image dehazing into multiple homogeneous sub-problems based on haze concentration partitioning and image fusion.

entry.title: CEZSAR: A Contrastive Embedding Method for Zero-Shot Action Recognition

author.name: Valter Estevam, Rayson Laroca, Helio Pedrini, David Menotti

entry.summary: Proposes CEZSAR, a contrastive learning-based method for zero-shot action recognition that addresses semantic gap and domain shift between textual label representations and visual representations.

entry.title: Adaptive Texture-aware Masking for Self-Supervised Learning in 3D Dental CBCT Analysis

author.name: Xinquan Yang, Jianfeng Ren, Xuguang Li, Kian Ming Lim, He Meng, Linlin Shen, Yongqiang Deng

entry.summary: ATMask proposes an adaptive texture-aware masking strategy for self-supervised learning in 3D dental CBCT analysis, prioritizing diagnostically critical regions based on texture complexity rather than random masking.

entry.title: A Hybrid Approach for Closing the Sim2real Appearance Gap in Game Engine Synthetic Datasets

author.name: Stefanos Pasios

entry.summary: Investigates using FLUX.2 diffusion model to enhance photorealism of game-engine synthetic datasets, comparing against traditional image translation methods for closing the sim-to-real appearance gap.

entry.title: Rethinking Low-Light Image Enhancement: A Log-Domain Intensity--Chromaticity Decoupling Perspective

author.name: Guangrui Bai, Yifan Mei, Yahui Deng, Yuhan Chen, Yuze Qiu, Wenhai Liu, Erbao Dong

entry.summary: Proposes a log-domain intensity-chromaticity decoupling approach for low-light image enhancement, achieving 29.71 dB PSNR on LOLv2-Real. Demonstrates improved downstream face detection under low-light conditions.

entry.title: Bi-Level Reinforcement Learning Control for an Underactuated Blimp via Center-of-Mass Reconfiguration

author.name: Xiaorui Wang, Hongwu Wang, Yue Fan, Hao Cheng, Feitian Zhang

entry.summary: Presents a bi-level reinforcement learning framework for underactuated blimp control with center-of-mass reconfiguration, decoupling task-level CoM planning from continuous thrust control.

entry.title: On the Characterization and Limits of 4D Radar for Aided Inertial Navigation

author.name: Morten Nissov, Kostas Alexis

entry.summary: Analyzes fundamental measurement relations of FMCW 4D radar for aided inertial navigation, deriving noise models from first principles and designing a factor graph-based estimator. Addresses radar's promise as a robust alternative to LiDAR/vision in challenging environments.

entry.title: Robotic Desk Organization: A Multi-Primitive Approach to Manipulating Heterogeneous Objects via Environmental Constraints

author.name: Yi Dong. Yangjun Liu, Jinjun Duan, Yang Li, Zhendong Dai

entry.summary: Presents a task-oriented framework for robotic desk organization handling heterogeneous planar rigid and deformable objects using environment-assisted manipulation primitives like edge-based push-grasping and levering-based grasping.

entry.title: Robust Adaptive Predictive Control for Hook-Based Aerial Transportation Between Moving Platforms

author.name: P\'eter Antal, Andrea Carron, Melanie Zeilinger, Roland T\'oth, Tam\'as P\'eni

entry.summary: Presents robust adaptive MPC for hook-based aerial manipulation between moving platforms using MuJoCo digital twin as predictive model. Integrates zero-order robust optimization with EKF for parameter estimation.

entry.title: Why Model Selection Fails in Time Series Forecasting: An Empirical Study of Instability Across Data Regimes

author.name: Tahir Cetin Akinci, Alfredo A. Martinez-Morales

entry.summary: Investigates why rule-based model selection fails in time series forecasting by analyzing relationships between data-regime descriptors and model performance. Shows no consistent mapping exists between data characteristics and optimal model choice.

entry.title: AirFM-DDA: Air-Interface Foundation Model in the Delay-Doppler-Angle Domain for AI-Native 6G

author.name: Kejia Bian, Meixia Tao, Jianhua Mo, Zhiyong Chen, Leyan Chen

entry.summary: Proposes AirFM-DDA, a wireless foundation model operating in the Delay-Doppler-Angle domain for 6G physical layer tasks. Reparameterizes channel state information from space-time-frequency to DDA domain for better multipath component separation.

entry.title: Compliance-Aware Agentic Payments on Stablecoin Rails

author.name: Kenneth See, Xue Wen Tan

entry.summary: Proposes a compliance-aware architecture for agentic payments on stablecoin rails, combining signature-based payment authorization with programmable on-chain compliance guardrails. Enforces compliance at execution time rather than as separate off-chain workflow.

entry.title: Adaptation of AI-accelerated CFD Simulations to the IPU platform

author.name: P. Rosciszewski, A. Krzywaniak, S. Iserte, K. Rojek, P. Gepner

entry.summary: Evaluates Intelligence Processing Units (IPUs) for AI-accelerated computational fluid dynamics simulations, adapting training programs to the IPU-POD16 platform and investigating performance scalability.

entry.title: Sparse Regression under Correlation and Weak Signals: A Reproducible Benchmark of Classical and Bayesian Methods

author.name: Hao Xiao

entry.summary: Benchmarks six sparse regression methods (OLS, Ridge, Lasso, Elastic Net, Horseshoe, Spike-and-Slab) across 2,600+ experiments with varying correlation, signal strength, and dimensionality.

entry.title: Hybrid Quantum Reinforcement Learning with QAOA for Improved Vehicle Routing Optimization

author.name: T. Satyanarayana Murthy, B. Swathi Sowmya, Santhosh Voruganti, Sai Varshini Giridi, Chaitanyya Pratap Agarwal, Vanteddu Akshitha

entry.summary: Proposes a hybrid quantum-classical approach integrating QAOA into QRL policy networks for vehicle routing, claiming faster convergence and ability to handle larger instances than pure quantum approaches.

entry.title: How Can One Choose the Best CAM-Based Explainability Method for a CNN Model?

author.name: Daniel da Silva Costa, Pedro Nuno de Souza Moura, Adriana C. F. Alvim

entry.summary: Proposes using different distance metrics beyond IoU for evaluating CAM-based explainability methods for CNNs, hypothesizing that metrics better matching human perception of saliency maps would improve method selection.

entry.title: Predicting Post Virality with Temporal Cross-Attention over Trend Signals

author.name: Sarvagya Somvanshi, Mohan Xu, Rakhi Chadalavada, Nathan Canera

entry.summary: Proposes ViralityNET that predicts Reddit post virality by fusing internal platform features with exogenous temporal signals from Wikipedia pageview spikes, using cross-attention over trend signals.

entry.title: Evaluating Tabular Representation Learning for Network Intrusion Detection

author.name: Muhammad Usman Butt, Andreas Hotho, Daniel Schl\"or

entry.summary: Systematically evaluates tabular representation learning techniques for network intrusion detection on NetFlow data, comparing against traditional autoencoders and end-to-end training baselines.

entry.title: Physics-Informed Neural Learning for State Reconstruction and Parameter Identification in Coupled Greenhouse Climate Dynamics

author.name: Sani Biswas, Khursheed J. Ansari, Md. Nasim Akhtar

entry.summary: Applies physics-informed neural networks to jointly reconstruct indoor temperature and humidity in greenhouse environments while identifying model parameters, incorporating a reduced-order physical model.

entry.title: Enhancing RL Generalizability in Robotics through SHAP Analysis of Algorithms and Hyperparameters

author.name: Lingxiao Kong, Cong Yang, Oya Deniz Beyan, Zeyd Boukhers

entry.summary: Uses SHAP analysis to quantify how RL algorithm and hyperparameter configurations contribute to generalization gaps across robotic environments. Establishes theoretical connections between Shapley values and generalizability for configuration selection.

Huang, Kiva Allgood, Devendra Jain, Benedikt Gieger, Vibhor Pandhare, Soumyabrata Bhattacharjee, Ram Mohril, Lingbao Kong, Qiyuan Wang, Xinlan Tang, Sungjong Kim, Chan Hee Park, Byeng D. entry.title: An Efficient Spatial Branch-and-Bound Algorithm for Global Optimization of Gaussian Process Posterior Mean Functions

author.name: Wei-Ting Tang, Akshay Kudva, Calvin Tsay, Joel A. Paulson

entry.summary: Proposes PALM-Mean, a spatial branch-and-bound algorithm for deterministic global optimization of Gaussian process posterior mean functions. Uses piecewise-analytic lower bounds for efficient optimization as training data grows.

entry.title: PPO guided Agentic Pipeline for Adaptive Prompt Selection and Test Case Generation

author.name: Gourisetty Venkata Sai Koushik, Dama Aditya, Mahankali Harish Sai, Peddi Siddarhta, Shadab Ahmad, Vivek Yelleti

entry.title: Equation-Free Digital Twins for Nonlinear Structural Dynamics

author.name: Mohammad Mahdi Abaei, Ahmad BahooToroody, Arttu Poloj\"arvi, Heikki Remes, Ulf Tyge Tygesen, Mikko Suominen, Michael Beer

entry.title: Differentiable Multiphysics Co-Optimization via Implicit Neural Representations: A Transient Hamburger-Cooking Benchmark

author.name: Navid Zobeiry

entry.summary: Presents an end-to-end differentiable co-optimization framework coupling implicit neural representations of geometry with a JAX-compiled multiphysics solver, demonstrated on a transient hamburger-cooking benchmark with phase transitions.

entry.title: Multimodal Data Curation Through Ranked Retrieval

author.name: Pratyush Muthukumar, Harshil Kotamreddy, Sarah Amiraslani, Tomo Kanazawa, Ramani Akkati, Shaan Jain, Andrew Mathau

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for multimodal data curation using Symmetric Nucleus Subsampling to refine training pairs and Expert Embedding Engineering to align cross-modal embeddings, addressing modality gap in shared embedding spaces.

entry.title: Mean Testing under Truncation beyond Gaussian

author.name: Yuhao Wang, Roberto Imbuzeiro Oliveira, Themis Gouleakis

entry.summary: Characterizes fundamental limits of high-dimensional mean testing under arbitrary truncation, where hidden probability mass creates a sharp detectability floor. Proves a second-order test achieves near-optimal sample complexity above this floor.

entry.title: SwiftChannel: Algorithm-Hardware Co-Design for Deep Learning-Based 5G Channel Estimation

author.name: Shengzhe Lyu, Yuhan She, Di Duan, Tao Ni, Yu Hin Chan, Chengwen Luo, Ray C. C. Cheung, Weitao Xu

entry.summary: SwiftChannel proposes algorithm-hardware co-design for 5G channel estimation using CNN with parameter-free attention and a dedicated FPGA accelerator for real-time performance.

entry.title: Benchmarking Wireless Representations: High-Dimensional vs. Compressed Embeddings for Efficiency and Robustness

author.name: Murilo Batista, Shirin Salehi, Saeed Mashdour, Paul Zheng, Rodrigo C. de Lamare, Anke Schmeink

entry.summary: Benchmarks wireless channel representations comparing high-dimensional foundation model embeddings, compact autoencoder representations, and raw data across multiple downstream tasks for efficiency and robustness.

entry.title: Pair2Score: Pairwise-to-Absolute Transfer for LLM-Based Essay Scoring

author.name: \.Ibrahim R{\i}za Halla\c{c}, Hasan O\u{g}ul

entry.summary: Pair2Score transfers pairwise comparison learning to absolute essay scoring using LLaMA with a two-stage framework: directional Siamese ranking followed by absolute prediction with configurable transfer strategies.

entry.title: MultiSense-Pneumo: A Multimodal Learning Framework for Pneumonia Screening in Resource-Constrained Settings

author.name: Dineth Jayakody, Pasindu Thenahandi, Chameli Dommanige

entry.summary: MultiSense-Pneumo integrates symptoms, cough audio, spoken language, and chest radiographs for pneumonia screening in resource-constrained settings using a multimodal framework.

entry.title: Can Causal Discovery Algorithms Help in Generating Legal Arguments?

author.name: Soham Wasmatkar, Subinay Adhikary, Rakshit Rohan, Shouvik Kumar Guha, Saptarshi Pyne, Kripabandhu Ghosh

entry.summary: Investigates whether causal discovery algorithms can be leveraged for automated generation of legal arguments, bridging Pearl's causal calculus with legal reasoning.

entry.title: TRACED: In vivo imaging of extracellular intrinsic diffusivity, tortuosity, cell size distribution and cell density in human glioma patients

author.name: Joshua K. Marchant, Hong-Hsi Lee, Elizabeth R. Gerstner, Susie Y. Huang, Bruce R. Rosen

entry.summary: Introduces TRACED, a biophysical model using neural networks trained on Monte Carlo diffusion simulations to quantify tumor microstructure properties from diffusion MRI data in glioma patients.

entry.title: Structural Dilemmas and Developmental Pathways of Legal Argument Mining in the Era of Artificial Intelligence

author.name: Xianglei Liao, Chuanyi Li, Kun Chen

entry.summary: A survey paper on structural dilemmas and developmental pathways of legal argument mining in the AI era, covering data, technology, and theoretical dimensions of the field.

entry.title: mdok-style at SemEval-2026 Task 9: Finetuning LLMs for Multilingual Polarization Detection

author.name: Dominik Macko, Alok Debnath, Jakub Simko

entry.summary: System description for SemEval-2026 Task 9 on multilingual polarization detection, using QLoRA fine-tuning of mid-size LLMs for sequence classification across 22 languages.

entry.title: Spoken Language Identification with Pre-trained Models and Margin Loss

author.name: Zhihua Fang, Liang He, Weiwu Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes a language identification method using pre-trained ECAPA-TDNN with margin-based losses for the TidyLang Challenge 2026. Achieves 85.95% macro accuracy on the Tidy-X dataset.

entry.title: Single Image Defogging Using a Fourth-Order Telegraph PDE Guided by Physical Haze Modeling

author.name: Manish Kumar, Rajendra K. Ray

entry.summary: Proposes a hybrid image defogging model combining a fourth-order nonlinear PDE (telegraph type) with Dark Channel Prior for atmospheric parameter estimation. The PDE-based evolution preserves structural details while suppressing haze.

entry.title: Profile-Specific 3DMM Regression from a Single Lateral Face Image

author.name: Taiki Kanaya, Hideo Saito

entry.summary: Proposes profile-specific 3D Morphable Model regression from a single lateral face image, targeting clinical applications like cephalometric analysis in orthodontics as an alternative to lateral X-ray imaging.

entry.title: Super-resolution of airborne laser scanning point clouds for forest inventory

author.name: Jinyuan Shao, Sangyoong Park, Chunxi Zhao, Ayman Habib, Songlin Fei

entry.summary: 3DFSR proposes a voxel-based U-Net CNN for super-resolution of airborne laser scanning point clouds in forests, simultaneously improving point density and reducing noise for better individual tree inventory.

entry.title: EdgeLPR: On the Deep Neural Network trade-off between Precision and Performance in LiDAR Place Recognition

author.name: Pierpaolo Serio, Hetian Wang, Zixiang Wei, Vincenzo Infantino, Lorenzo Gentilini, Lorenzo Pollini, Valentina Donzella

entry.summary: EdgeLPR explores efficient LiDAR place recognition for edge devices using Bird's Eye View representations, benchmarking architectures under different quantization levels (FP32, FP16, INT8) for autonomous navigation.

entry.title: Multispectral Blind Image Super-Resolution for Standing Dead Tree Segmentation

author.name: Mete Ahishali, Anis Ur Rahman, Einari Heinaro, Aysen Degerli, Samuli Junttila

entry.summary: Proposes a blind super-resolution framework using Attention-Guided Domain Adaptation Networks for multispectral images of standing dead trees, working with unpaired low-resolution and high-resolution samples.

entry.title: Quaternion Nonlinear Transform-Induced Nuclear Norm for Low-Rank Tensor Completion

author.name: Biswarup Karmakar, Ratikanta Behera

entry.summary: Proposes quaternion-based nonlinear transform tensor nuclear norm for low-rank tensor completion, extending existing methods to handle quaternion-valued data like color images and videos.

entry.title: Sonar-GPS Fusion for Seabed Mapping in Turbid Shallow Waters with an Autonomous Surface Vehicle

author.name: Yisheng Zhang, Michael Xu, Alan Williams, Matthew Gray, Nare Karapetyan, Miao Yu

entry.summary: Presents a sonar-GPS fusion framework for seabed mapping in turbid shallow waters using autonomous surface vehicles, combining Fourier-Mellin transform for local alignment with extended Kalman filtering for trajectory optimization.

entry.title: Optimized and kinematically feasible multi-agent motion planning

author.name: Anja Hellander, Kristoffer Bergman, Daniel Axehill

entry.summary: Proposes a two-step method for multi-agent motion planning: finding an initial feasible solution via CBS/PBS, then improving it through multi-phase optimal control with warm-starting. Also introduces optimized motion primitive generation.

entry.title: VILAS: A VLA-Integrated Low-cost Architecture with Soft Grasping for Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Zijian An (Luna), Hadi Khezam (Luna), Bill Cai (Luna), Ran Yang (Luna), Shijie Geng (Luna), Yiming Feng (Luna), Yue (Luna), Zheng, Lifeng Zhou

entry.summary: Presents VILAS, a low-cost modular robotic manipulation platform for VLA policy learning with a kirigami-based soft compliant gripper extension. Integrates collaborative arm, gripper, and dual cameras through ZMQ-based communication.

entry.title: Sim-to-Real Transfer and Robustness Evaluation of Reinforcement Learning Control with Integrated Perception on an ASV for Floating Waste Capture

author.name: Luis F. W. Batista, St\'ephanie Aravecchia, C\'edric Pradalier

entry.summary: Presents a field-validated system combining polarimetric perception with DRL-based control for autonomous floating-waste capture by surface vessels. Contributes a sim-to-real testing methodology with perception abstraction module.

entry.title: Quasi-Static Control of Discrete Cosserat Rod

author.name: Srishti Siddharth

entry.summary: Designs feedback control laws for soft robots modeled as discrete Cosserat rods using the Piecewise Constant Strain approach. Demonstrates state-feedback linearization in strain and task spaces for end-effector trajectory tracking.

entry.title: Persistent Homology of Time Series through Complex Networks

author.name: \.Ismail G\"uzel

entry.summary: Presents a pipeline for time series classification via complex networks and persistent homology. Maps time series to graphs using five constructions, applies Vietoris-Rips filtration, and vectorizes persistence diagrams for classification.

entry.title: On the Role of Artificial Intelligence in Human-Machine Symbiosis

author.name: Ching-Chun Chang, Yuchen Guo, Hanrui Wang, Timo Spinde, Isao Echizen

entry.summary: A philosophical/conceptual paper examining AI's role in human-machine symbiosis, arguing that the boundary between human and AI-generated information is increasingly ambiguous. Proposes examining how AI participates rather than whether it participated.

entry.title: AIDA-ReID: Adaptive Intermediate Domain Adaptation for Generalizable and Source-Free Person Re-Identification

author.name: Sundas Iqbal, Qing Tian, Danish Ali, Jianping Gou, Weihua Oue

entry.summary: AIDA-ReID proposes an adaptive intermediate domain approach for person re-identification that works in multi-source and source-free settings, addressing limitations of fixed mixing strategies requiring joint source-target access.

entry.title: Interpretable experiential learning based on state history and global feedback

author.name: Anton Kolonin

entry.summary: Presents an interpretable experiential learning model based on state history and global feedback, using transition graphs for reinforcement learning in resource-constrained environments, evaluated on Atari Breakout.

entry.title: Continual Learning of Feedback-based Molecular Communication

author.name: Siddhant Setia, Junichi Suzuki, Tadashi Nakano

entry.summary: Proposes continual learning estimators for molecular communication protocol simulation that incrementally learn estimation tasks without catastrophic forgetting, using regularization and replay strategies.

entry.title: GA-VisAgent: A Multi-Agent application for code generation and visualization in interactive learning

author.name: Wang Jian, Zhou Jianbo, Xiong Yuhao, Liu Zhenxia, Luo Wen, Yuan LinWang, Yu ZhaoYuan

entry.summary: Proposes GA-VisAgent, a multi-agent LLM application for generating Geometric Algebra code and visualizations interactively, addressing the high learning curve of existing GA software.

entry.title: NeuroViz: Real-time Interactive Visualization of Forward and Backward Passes in Neural Network Training

author.name: Reza Rawassizadeh, Tanvi Sharma

entry.summary: NeuroViz is an interactive visualization tool for exploring neural network training in real-time, showing activations, weight updates, and loss progression for both forward and backward passes. User study with 31 participants shows advantages over existing tools.

entry.title: A Novel Preprocessing-Driven Approach to Remaining Useful Life (RUL) Prediction Using Temporal Convolutional Networks (TCN)

author.name: Florent Imbert, Tosin Adewumi, Hui Han

entry.summary: Proposes a preprocessing pipeline for remaining useful life prediction in aero-engines using temporal convolutional networks, emphasizing data quality improvement over architectural innovation.

entry.title: Robust Cross-Domain WiFi Fall Detection via Physics-Driven Attention-Enhanced Transformers

author.name: Yingzhe Wang, Cunhua Pan, Ruijing Liu, Shaokai Li, Hong Ren, Kezhi Wang, Jiangzhou Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a physics-driven attention-enhanced CNN-Transformer for WiFi-based fall detection that uses a Dynamic Variance Gate to eliminate static environmental patterns, enabling cross-domain generalization without environment-specific retraining.

entry.title: An Algorithm for On-Sensor Agnostic Detection of Changes in Human Activity for Ultra-Low-Power Applications

author.name: Sara Rimoldi, Arianna De Vecchi, Hazem Hesham Yousef Shalby, Federica Villa

entry.summary: Proposes a lightweight change-detection gate for wearable activity recognition that invokes the full classification network only when activity changes are detected, reducing computation by 67% with only ~16kFLOPs per step.

entry.title: On the explainability of max-plus neural networks

author.name: Ikhlas Enaieh (S2A, LTCI), Olivier Fercoq (S2A, LTCI), Garc\'ia \'Angel (DATSI, UPM)

entry.summary: Investigates explainability of linear-min-max neural networks (max-plus networks), which can trace decisions to single most-activated neurons. Designs a pixel fragility measure and compares favorably to SHAP on medical imaging.

entry.title: Separation Assurance between Heterogeneous Fleets of Small Unmanned Aerial Systems via Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Iman Sharifi, Hyeong Tae Kim, Maheed Hatem Ahmed, Mahsa Ghasemi, Peng Wei

entry.summary: Investigates multi-agent RL for tactical deconfliction of heterogeneous drone fleets, studying whether convergent policies discriminate against companies with weaker UAV configurations.

entry.title: Data-Driven, Geometry-Aware Optimal-Transport Calibration of Flavor Tagger

author.name: Yeonjoon Kim, Un-ki Yang

entry.summary: Proposes geometry-aware flavor tagger calibration as an optimal transport problem on the probability simplex, parameterizing transport maps in isometric log-ratio coordinates for continuous event-level calibration across multicomponent tagger outputs.

entry.title: Spatial-Temporal Learning-Based Distributed Routing for Dynamic LEO Satellite Networks

author.name: Po-Heng Chou, Chiapin Wang, Shou-Yu Chen, Hsiang-Ming Wang

entry.summary: Proposes spatial-temporal distributed routing for LEO satellite networks using GAT+LSTM within DQN, formulated as POMDP to handle dynamic topology and time-varying traffic.

entry.title: Representation learning from OCT images

author.name: Hedi Tabia, D\'esir\'e Sidib\'e, Nawres Khlifa, Ahmed Tabia, Ines Rahmany, Noura Aboudi, Zainab Haddad, Hajer Khachnaoui, Hsouna Zgolli

entry.summary: Provides a comprehensive survey of representation learning methods for retinal OCT image analysis, covering deep learning approaches through recent foundation models.

entry.title: Multi-fidelity surrogates for mechanics of composites: from co-kriging to multi-fidelity neural networks

author.name: Haizhou Wen, Elham Kiyani, Gang Li, Srikanth Pilla, George Em Karniadakis, Zhen Li

entry.summary: Reviews multi-fidelity surrogate modeling approaches for composite materials mechanics, covering Gaussian processes, co-Kriging, and multi-fidelity neural networks.

entry.title: Addressing Data Scarcity in Bangla Fake News Detection: An LLM-Based Dataset Augmentation Approach

author.name: Ahmed Alfey Sani, Kazi Akib Zaoad, Shefayat E Shams Adib, Md Abdul Muqtadir, Ajwad Abrar

entry.summary: Uses Gemma 3 27B to generate synthetic Bangla news for augmenting imbalanced fake news datasets, achieving improved classification performance with semantic filtering.

entry.title: Fine-Tuning Pre-Trained Code Models for AI-Generated Code Detection

author.name: Jany-Gabriel Ispas, Sergiu Nisioi

entry.summary: Fine-tunes pre-trained code models (CodeBERT, GraphCodeBERT, UniXcoder, CodeT5+) for AI-generated code detection as part of SemEval-2026 Task 13.

entry.title: Automatic Reflection Level Classification in Hungarian Student Essays

author.name: Zsolt Csibi, M\'onika S\'andor, M\'onika Serf\H{o}z\H{o}, Kinga Gy\"ongy, Kristian Fenech

entry.summary: Presents the first study on automatic reflection level classification in Hungarian student essays, using a dataset of 1,954 expert-annotated essays. Compares classical ML approaches with Hungarian-specific transformer models.

entry.title: mdok-style at SemEval-2026 Task 10: Finetuning LLMs for Conspiracy Detection

author.name: Dominik Macko

entry.summary: System description for SemEval-2026 Task 10 on conspiracy detection, using data augmentation and self-training to fine-tune Qwen3-32B for binary classification. Ranks in 85th percentile.

entry.title: AgriKD: Cross-Architecture Knowledge Distillation for Efficient Leaf Disease Classification

author.name: Minh-Dung Le, Minh-Duc Hoang, Hoang-Vu Truong, Thi-Thu-Hong Phan

entry.summary: Proposes AgriKD, a cross-architecture knowledge distillation framework transferring knowledge from Vision Transformer teachers to compact CNN students for plant disease classification on edge devices.

entry.title: Deep neural networks with Fisher vector encoding for medical image classification

author.name: Lucas O. Lyra, Antonio E. Fabris, Joao B. Florindo

entry.summary: Proposes integrating Fisher Vector encoding with hybrid CNN+ViT architectures for medical image classification, aiming to handle both small and large datasets effectively. Combines orderless encoding with modern hybrid architectures.

entry.title: From Spherical to Gaussian: A Comparative Analysis of Point Cloud Cropping Strategies in Large-Scale 3D Environments

author.name: Maximilian Kellner, Dominik Merkle, Michael Brunklaus, Alexander Reiterer

entry.summary: Proposes Gaussian vs. spherical cropping strategies for large-scale 3D point clouds, showing that alternative methods can provide larger spatial context while maintaining similar point counts for neural network processing.

entry.title: Cross-Polarization Fusion of VV AND VH SAR Observations for Improved Flood Mapping

author.name: Jagrati Talreja, Tewodros Syum Gebre, Leila Hashemi Beni

entry.summary: Investigates cross-polarization fusion of VV and VH SAR observations for flood mapping using deep learning segmentation, comparing single-polarization vs. fused configurations under identical training conditions.

entry.title: Laplacian Frequency Interaction Network for Rural Thematic Road Extraction

author.name: Baiyan Chen, Weixin Zhai

entry.summary: LFINet uses Laplacian frequency decomposition to separate rural road extraction into low-frequency semantic contexts and high-frequency structural details, addressing challenges of sparse road structures and dense field operation noise.

entry.title: Lateral String Stability for Vehicle Platoons: Formulation, Definition, and Analysis

author.name: Sixu Li, Swaroop Darbha, Yang Zhou

entry.summary: Presents a formal framework for lateral string stability in vehicle platoons, addressing how path-tracking errors propagate along a vehicle string. Important for safety of autonomous vehicles using onboard sensing in tight formations.

entry.title: The Bayesian Reflex: Online Learning as the Autonomic Nervous System of Modern and Future AI

author.name: Durba Bhattacharya, Sucharita Roy, Sourabh Bhattacharya

entry.summary: Introduces the 'Bayesian reflex' analogy with the autonomic nervous system as a unifying framework for online learning in AI. Surveys Bayesian online methods highlighting computational principles for sequential inference and sampling.

entry.title: AoI-Aware Multi-Robot Sensing and Transport on Connected Graphs

author.name: John Tadrous

entry.summary: Addresses multi-robot sensing and transport where robots monitor spatially distributed processes and deliver measurements to a base, minimizing Age of Information. Derives AoI bounds and proposes optimal resource allocation and scheduling algorithms.

entry.title: TADI: Tool-Augmented Drilling Intelligence via Agentic LLM Orchestration over Heterogeneous Wellsite Data

author.name: Rong Lu

entry.summary: TADI is an agentic AI system for drilling operations that combines structured databases (DuckDB) and semantic search (ChromaDB) with 12 domain-specialized tools orchestrated by an LLM. Applied to the Equinor Volve Field dataset, it demonstrates multi-step evidence gathering across heterogeneous wellsite data. This is a domain-specific application paper with limited broader novelty.

entry.title: NorBERTo: A ModernBERT Model Trained for Portuguese with 331 Billion Tokens Corpus

author.name: Enzo S. N. Silva, Pablo B. Costa, Raphael C. Vlasman, Rosimeire P. Costa, Henrique L. P. Silva, Lucas F. A. O. Pellicer, Guilherme Rinaldo, Renato A. Almeida, Darian S. R. Rabbani, Cinthya O. Oestreich, Vinicius F. Carid\'a

entry.summary: NorBERTo is a ModernBERT-based encoder model for Brazilian Portuguese, trained on a new 331 billion token corpus (Aurora-PT). Achieves best results among encoder-only models on Portuguese NLP benchmarks.

entry.title: Unbox Responsible GeoAI: Navigating Climate Extreme and Disaster Mapping

author.name: Hao Li, Steffen Knoblauch

entry.summary: Position paper examining responsible GeoAI for climate extreme and disaster mapping, proposing four dimensions: Representativeness, Explainability, and two others. Addresses spatial inequalities, carbon footprint, and decision-making in emergency contexts.

entry.title: Deep learning-based pavement performance modeling using multiple distress indicators and road work history

author.name: Lu Gao, Zhe Han, Yunshen Chen

entry.summary: Applies CNN and LSTM deep learning models to predict pavement deterioration using 18 years of Texas DOT data with 21 condition indicators and maintenance history. A domain-specific application of standard deep learning methods to infrastructure management.

entry.title: Large margin classifier with graph-based adaptive regularization

author.name: V\'itor M. Hanriot, Tur\'ibio T. Salis, Luiz C. B. Torres, Frederico Coelho, Antonio P. Braga

entry.summary: Introduces per-class regularization hyperparameters in Gabriel graph-based classifiers that can handle outliers and class imbalance through flexible thresholds, expanding the solution space.

entry.title: CNNs for Vis-NIR Chemometrics: From Contradiction to Conditional Design

author.name: D\'ario Passos

entry.summary: A review paper analyzing why CNN design studies in NIR chemometrics produce contradictory results, arguing the inconsistencies arise from uncontrolled moderating variables rather than fundamental method incompatibilities. It provides a framework for reconciling conflicting findings in spectroscopy deep learning.

entry.title: Autonomous QA Agent: A Retrieval-Augmented Framework for Reliable Selenium Script Generation

author.name: Dudekula Kasim Vali

entry.summary: Presents an autonomous QA agent using RAG to ground Selenium test script generation in project-specific documentation and HTML structure, achieving 100% syntax validity and 90% execution success compared to lower rates without RAG. Addresses hallucination of non-existent UI elements.

entry.title: 1BT: One-Block Transformer for EEG-Based Cognitive Workload Assessment

author.name: Stefanos Gkikas, Christian Arzate Cruz, Thomas Kassiotis, Giorgos Giannakakis, Raul Fernandez Rojas, Randy Gomez

entry.summary: Introduces 1BT, a minimal one-block transformer for EEG-based cognitive workload assessment using cross-attention with a latent bottleneck. Balances representational capacity with computational efficiency for practical deployment.

entry.title: Benchmarking local Hebbian learning rules for memory storage and prototype extraction

author.name: Anders Lansner, Andreas Knoblauch, Naresh B Ravichandran, Pawel Herman

entry.summary: Benchmarks local Hebbian learning rules for associative memory and prototype extraction, comparing different neural network architectures on their ability to recall generating prototypes from distorted instances.

entry.title: FeedbackLLM: Metadata driven Multi-Agentic Language Agnostic Test Case Generator with Evolving prompt and Coverage Feedback

author.name: Kushal Jasti, Tejamani Prashanth Sahu, Rishitha Pentyala, Muvvala Mohit, Vivek Yelleti

entry.summary: Proposes FeedbackLLM, a two-stage framework for automated test case generation that extracts input constraints from source code metadata, then uses coverage feedback to iteratively improve test generation with LLMs.

entry.title: CGFformer: Cluster-Guidance Frequency Transformer for Pansharpening

author.name: Zijian Zhou, Jianing Zhang, Kai Sun, Xiangyu Zhao, Chunxia Zhang, Xiangyong Cao

entry.summary: CGFformer proposes a cluster-guidance frequency Transformer for pansharpening that adapts to complex frequency distributions in satellite images. Uses adaptive frequency filters instead of fixed ones.

entry.title: Class-Aware Adaptive Differential Privacy in Deep Learning for Sensor-Based Fall Detection

author.name: Joydeb Kumar Sana

entry.summary: Proposes Class-Aware Adaptive Differential Privacy (CA-ADP) for fall detection that dynamically adjusts noise based on class composition of mini-batches, integrated with a 3D CNN-BiLSTM architecture.

entry.title: Toward Resilient 5G Networks: Comparative Analysis of Federated and Centralized Learning for RF Jamming Detection

author.name: Samhita Kuili, Mohammadreza Amini, Burak Kantarci

entry.summary: Proposes federated learning-based jamming detection for 5G networks using IQ samples from synchronization signal blocks. Compares federated and centralized approaches for RF jamming detection.

entry.title: Stochastic Modeling of Human-Machine Authentication Channels under Partial Information Leakage

author.name: Nilesh Chakraborty, Mohammad Zulkernine, Burak Kantarci

entry.summary: Models PIN-based authentication as a stochastic communication channel and proposes context-conditioned probabilistic inference for progressive security degradation under partial information leakage.

entry.title: H3: A Healthcare Three-Hop Index for Physician Referral Network Prediction

author.name: Zhexi Gu, Jiaxin Ying, Xu-Wen Wang, Can Chen

entry.summary: H3 proposes a healthcare three-hop index for physician referral network prediction that models indirect pathways with degree normalization and redundancy penalty to handle hub-dominated topology.

entry.title: RAFNet: Region-Aware Fusion Network for Pansharpening

author.name: Jianing Zhang, Zijian Zhou, Kai Sun

entry.summary: RAFNet proposes region-aware fusion for pansharpening that exploits regional sparsity in remote sensing imagery with dynamic convolution kernels adapting to frequency and regional variations.

entry.title: Dueling DDQN-Based Adaptive Multi-Objective Handover Optimization for LEO Satellite Networks

author.name: Po-Heng Chou, Chiapin Wang, Chung-Chi Huang, Kuan-Hao Chen

entry.summary: Proposes dueling DDQN-based adaptive handover optimization for LEO satellite networks balancing throughput, blocking probability, and switching cost.

entry.title: Creating and Evaluating Figurative Language Dataset for Sindhi

author.name: Wazir Ali, Adeeb Noor, Saifullah Tumrani

entry.summary: Introduces SiNFluD, a benchmark dataset for Sindhi figurative language classification with baseline results from multilingual transformers.

entry.title: Methods, Data, and Conceptual Change: Reflections from Two Quantitative Diachronic Case Studies

author.name: Catherine Wong, Bach Phan-Tat, Susan Fitzmaurice

entry.summary: A discussion paper reflecting on how quantitative approaches to historical linguistics interact with dataset properties, examining English data through two case studies of Early Modern English and scientific writing from the Royal Society Corpus.

entry.title: Visual Chart Representations for Cryptocurrency Regime Prediction: A Systematic Deep Learning Study

author.name: Dustin M. Haggett

entry.summary: Systematic study comparing visual chart representations (candlestick charts, Gramian Angular Fields, multi-channel GAF) and neural network architectures (CNN, ResNet, EfficientNet, ViT) for cryptocurrency regime prediction from chart images.

entry.title: CNN-based Multi-In-Multi-Out Model for Efficient Spatiotemporal Prediction

author.name: Hyeonseok Jin

entry.summary: Proposes a CNN-based multi-input multi-output model for spatiotemporal prediction that addresses limitations of both CNN (local information only) and Transformer (high computation) approaches.

entry.title: Research on Vision-Language Question Answering Models for Industrial Robots

author.name: Ping Li, Bartlomiej Brzozka

entry.summary: Proposes a hierarchical cross-modal fusion model for vision-language question answering in industrial robotics, integrating object detection, multi-scale visual encoding, and syntactic parsing.

entry.title: TemPose-TF-ASF: Two-Stage Bidirectional Stroke Context Fusion for Badminton Stroke Classification

author.name: Tzu-Yu Liu, Duan-Shin Lee

entry.summary: TemPose-TF-ASF enhances badminton stroke classification by incorporating bidirectional stroke context (preceding and subsequent strokes) through a two-stage training strategy with adjacent-stroke fusion.

entry.title: Human Activity Recognition Method for Moderate Violence Detection

author.name: Luis Angel Aparicio Borjas, Victor Elias Nieto, Juan Irving Vasquez, Alfonso Fernandez-Vazquez, Gerardo Antonio Alvarez Hernandez

entry.summary: Develops an automated system for real-time detection of moderate physical violence (pushing) in surveillance footage using YOLO11 for detection and skeletal analysis with a Random Forest classifier.

entry.title: A Coupled Fourth Order Telegraph Diffusion Framework Using Grayscale Indicators for Image Despeckling

author.name: Manish Kumar, Rajendra K. Ray

entry.summary: Presents a fourth-order coupled hyperbolic-parabolic PDE model for image despeckling that reduces speckle noise while preserving structure, addressing staircase artifacts of second-order approaches.

entry.title: Distributed Algorithm with Emergent Area Partitioning and Base Station's Situation Awareness for Multi-Robot Patrolling

author.name: Kazuho Kobayashi, Shohei Kobayashi, Seiya Ueno, Takehiro Higuchi

entry.summary: Proposes the LR-PT algorithm for multi-robot patrolling that balances patrol efficiency with operator situation awareness at base stations. Robots independently select targets using local information while emergent area partitioning provides predictable behavior for operators.

entry.title: Tensegrity crutches with compliance from a pre-stressed self-tensile module improve ground reaction force profiles, speed, effort, comfort, and perceived stability

author.name: Jingxian Gu, Joanna Spyra, Andrew Walski, Lyla Elsaesser, Samuel Bierner, Dobromir Dotov

entry.summary: Designed and evaluated biologically-inspired tensegrity crutches with compliant modules against rigid and spring-loaded designs. Human trials with 18 participants showed improvements in ground reaction force profiles, speed, effort, comfort, and stability.

entry.title: Improving Imbalanced Multi-Label Chest X-Ray Diagnosis via CBAM-Enhanced CNN Backbones

author.name: Duy Nguyen Huu, Duy Hoang Khuong, Ngu Huynh Cong Viet

entry.summary: Integrates CBAM attention modules into CNN backbones for multi-label chest X-ray classification, achieving improved AUC on ChestXray14 dataset by enhancing feature refinement for multiple co-existing pathologies.

entry.title: Agentic AI for Trip Planning Optimization Application

author.name: Tiejin Chen, Ahmadreza Moradipari, Kyungtae Han, Hua Wei, Nejib Ammar

entry.summary: Presents an agentic AI framework for trip planning optimization with specialized agents for traffic, charging, and points of interest, coordinated by an orchestration agent. Introduces a benchmark dataset with verifiable ground truth for optimization performance.

entry.title: ViLegalNLI: Natural Language Inference for Vietnamese Legal Texts

author.name: Nhung Thi-Hong Duong, Mai Ngoc Ho, Tin Van Huynh, Kiet Van Nguyen

entry.summary: ViLegalNLI is the first large-scale Vietnamese NLI dataset for legal text with 42,012 premise-hypothesis pairs. Uses a semi-automatic generation framework with LLMs for controlled hypothesis generation.

entry.title: Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning for Chartered Accountancy

author.name: Jatin Gupta, Akhil Sharma, Saransh Singhania, Ali Imam Abidi

entry.summary: CA-ThinkFlow is a RAG framework for Indian Chartered Accountancy using a 14B quantized reasoning model with layout-aware document extraction. Addresses numerical multi-step tasks requiring legal regulation knowledge.

entry.title: Spectral Model eXplainer: a chemically-grounded explainability framework for spectral-based machine learning models

author.name: Jose Vinicius Ribeiro, Rafael Figueira Goncalves, Fabio Luiz Melquiades, Sylvio Barbon Junior

entry.summary: Introduces the Spectral Model eXplainer (SMX), an explainability framework specifically designed for spectral ML models that provides chemically meaningful zone-level explanations rather than individual variable attributions. Addresses the mismatch between generic XAI tools and the physical structure of spectral data.

entry.title: Federated Reinforcement Learning for Efficient Mobile Crowdsensing under Incomplete Information

author.name: Sumedh J. Dongare, Patrick Weber, Andrea Ortiz, Walid Saad, Oliver Hinz, Anja Klein

entry.summary: Applies federated reinforcement learning to mobile crowdsensing, where mobile units must decide task participation strategies under incomplete information without sharing private data. Addresses the dynamic nature of task requirements and resource availability.

entry.title: A Hybrid Windkessel-Neural Approach for Improved Noninvasive Blood Pressure Monitoring

author.name: Vaibhav Gollapalli, Aniruth Ananthanarayanan

entry.summary: Combines Windkessel physiological models with ML for cuffless blood pressure estimation, incorporating physical aspects to improve interpretability and clinical applicability beyond pure data-driven approaches.

entry.title: An Adaptive Spatiotemporal Clustering Framework for 3D Ocean Subsurface Temperature Reconstruction

author.name: Ming Shan Loo, Wengen Li, Xudong Jiang, Hailiang Cheng, Zhifei Zhang, Jihong Guan, Yichao Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes an adaptive spatiotemporal clustering framework for reconstructing ocean subsurface temperature from satellite data, capturing vertical structural dependencies and temporal variation patterns.

entry.title: MU-SHOT-Fi: Self-Supervised Multi-User Wi-Fi Sensing with Source-free Unsupervised Domain Adaptation

author.name: Ahmed Y. Radwan, Hina Tabassum

entry.summary: Proposes MU-SHOT-Fi for source-free domain adaptation in multi-user WiFi sensing, using permutation-invariant architecture and self-supervised adaptation without accessing source data or target labels.

entry.title: Hall-Like Transversal Stress and Sandpile Criticality on Real Production Networks

author.name: Diego Vallarino

entry.summary: Develops a Hall-Sandpile model combining transversal stress mechanisms with sandpile threshold dynamics on real production networks to model economic instability. Calibrated on World Input-Output Database networks.

entry.title: Hybrid Visual Telemetry for Bandwidth-Constrained Robotic Vision: A Pilot Study with HEVC Base Video and JPEG ROI Stills

author.name: Natalia Trukhina, Vadim Vashkelis

entry.summary: Proposes a hybrid visual telemetry scheme with continuous low-bitrate video augmented by selectively transmitted high-detail ROI stills for bandwidth-constrained robotic systems.

entry.title: CLaC at SemEval-2026 Task 6: Response Clarity Detection in Political Discourse

author.name: Nawar Turk, Lucas Miquet-Westphal, Leila Kosseim

entry.summary: Presents a system for detecting clarity and evasion in political discourse, comparing fine-tuned encoders with prompt-based LLMs for SemEval-2026 Task 6.

entry.title: Comparative Evaluation of Convolutional and Transformer-Based Detectors for Automated Weed Detection in Precision Agriculture

author.name: Alcides Toledo Espinosa, Gerardo Antonio \'Alvarez Hern\'andez, \'Angel Eduardo Zamora-Su\'arez, Miguel Bola\~nos, Juan Irving V\'asquez

entry.summary: Comparative evaluation of CNN-based (YOLOv26-nano) vs. transformer-based (RTDETR, RF-DETR) object detectors for weed detection in precision agriculture, analyzing accuracy-efficiency tradeoffs.

entry.title: Cross-Domain Adversarial Augmentation: Stabilizing GANs for Medical and Handwriting Data Scarcity

author.name: Md. Sohanuzzaman Soad, Mahady Al Hady, S M Rafiuddin Rifat, Sudip Ghose

entry.summary: Studies GAN-based generative augmentation for two low-resource domains (Bangla handwriting and chest X-rays), comparing stability enhancements and evaluating downstream classifier improvements from synthetic data.

entry.title: Parking Assistance for Trailer-Truck Transport Vehicles Using Sensor Fusion and Motion Planning

author.name: George Alenchery, Thomas Jeske, Tova Quinones, Lentz Fortune, Tristan Lindo-Slones, Amber Jones, Jordan Fletcher

entry.summary: Proposes an autonomous truck parking framework integrating sensor fusion, Hybrid A* planning, NMPC, and infrastructure awareness for trailer-truck transport vehicles. Addresses the challenging low-speed articulated vehicle maneuvering problem.

entry.title: Semantic Risk-Aware Heuristic Planning for Robotic Navigation in Dynamic Environments: An LLM-Inspired Approach

author.name: Hamza Ahmed Durrani, Rafay Suleman Durrani

entry.title: What Does a Meow Mean? In Search of Intuitively Understandable Communication by a Nonverbal Companion Robot

author.name: Vivienne Bihe Chi, Claudia B. R\'ebola, Bertram F. Malle

entry.summary: Explores nonverbal communication design for a companion cat robot for older adults using auditory (cat sounds) and visual (icons) signals. Large-sample online experiment tested signal comprehension in adults over 65.

author.name: Steven Redolfi

entry.summary: Reviews the ROC curve and formally proves the probabilistic interpretation of AUC (probability that classifier ranks positive above negative), providing bounds when assumptions are violated.

entry.title: Autonomous Reliability Qualification of Ga$_2$O$_3$-based Hydrogen and Temperature Sensors via Safe Active Learning

author.name: Davi Febba, William A. Callahan, Anna Sacchi, Andriy Zakutayev

entry.title: Machine Learning Enhanced Laser Spectroscopy for Multi-Species Gas Detection in Complex and Harsh Environments

author.name: Mohamed Sy

entry.summary: Develops ML-enhanced laser absorption spectroscopy using deep denoising autoencoders for shock-tube measurements and an unsupervised framework (HT-SIMNet) for handling unknown species in complex gas mixtures.

entry.title: Exact Loop Controllers for ReLU Realization of Homogeneous Curve Refinements

entry.title: A Light Weight Multi-Features-View Convolution Neural Network For Plant Disease Identification

author.name: Muhammad Kaleem Ullah Khan

entry.title: Developing a Strong Pre-Trained Base Model for Plant Leaf Disease Classification

author.name: David J. Richter

entry.summary: Develops a pre-trained base model for plant leaf disease classification, focusing on dataset influence and CNN feature extraction for agricultural applications.

author.name: Eric Zipor

entry.summary: Uses genetic algorithms to evolve neural network weights for autonomous Minecraft parkour navigation, treating the game's physics engine as a dynamic puzzle requiring frame-precise control.

entry.title: Robotic Affection -- Opportunities of AI-based haptic interactions to improve social robotic touch through a multi-deep-learning approach

author.name: Ali Askari, Jens Gerken

entry.title: Sequential Minimal Optimization for $\varepsilon$-SVR with MAPE Loss and Sample-Dependent Box Constraints

entry.title: The Topology of Multimodal Fusion: Why Current Architectures Fail at Creative Cognition

author.name: Xiujiang Tan (Guangzhou Academy of Fine Arts, Guangzhou, China)

author.name: Eun Som Jeon, Jisoo Lee, Huisu Lim, Omik M. Save, Hyunglae Lee, Pavan Turaga

entry.title: Accelerating battery research with an AI interface between FINALES and Kadi4Mat

entry.title: Higher-Order Flexible Configurations of Planar Parallel Manipulators Constructed by Averaging

author.name: Athanasios Koukosiasa, Vasileios Tzanidakis, Sotiris Athanasiou, Kostas Kolomvatsos

entry.title: AI Adoption Among Teachers: Insights on Concerns, Support, Confidence, and Attitudes

author.name: Vanessa B. Sibug, Maria Anna D. Cruz, Vicky P. Vital, Juvy C. Grume, Almer B. Gamboa, Emerson Q. Fernando, Lloyd D. Feliciano, Jordan L. Salenga, John Paul P. Miranda

author.name: Vira Putri Maharani, Kharisa Harvanny, Daris Samudra, Luluk Muthoharoh, Ardika Satria, Martin Clinton Tosima Manullang

author.name: Juliana Eberschlag

author.name: Dawn Drescher

author.name: Zvi

entry.summary: Detailed analysis of housing policy's bias against renters, examining how subsidies for homeownership, anti-renter regulations, and zoning policies systematically disadvantage those who rent.
